jobs.title: Receiving Associate
jobs.description:
North 40 Outfitters in Spokane, WA. (West Location), is looking to hire a Full-Time Receiving Associate to join our team.  We believe that each team member plays a vital role in the success of our company.  We are looking for authentic and enthusiastic people who love our lifestyle and believe in service before self.  As a Receiving Associate at North 40, you will be responsible for the accurate, timely and safe movement of merchandise from the moment merchandise leaves a truck until it is placed onto the sales floor.  This position requires a candidate with a high attention to detail and the ability to operate multiple computer programs.

This full-time position requires the ability to work all scheduled shifts between the business hours of Mon-Sat 7am to 8 pm and Sunday 9 am to 5 pm. This shift can include working weekends and certain holidays and will require flexibility in scheduling based on business needs.

• Willingness to share credit, work with others in a team environment, and define success collectively rather than individually
• Ability to work in a fast paced environment while remaining detailed and focused
• Familiar with computers and various programs
• Ability to become forklift certified a must, must be 18+ years old to acquire
• Receiving and/or warehouse experience helpful
• Ability to take initiative, embrace change, and learn new things
• Drive to be dependable, and to perform well against the expectations of the role
• Ability to work independently or in a group setting
• Committed to supplying our North 40 guests with phenomenal customer service
• Good communication skills and the ability to effectively engage with individuals on a regular basis
• Must be able to multitask and prioritize
• Understanding of correct lifting and loading techniques. Physical ability to lift and carry 0-25 lbs. continuously, 25-45 lbs. frequently, and 45-65 lbs. occasionally, and team lift anything over 65 lbs. Spending 100% of work time on your feet, including use of ladders, rolling staircases and pallet jacks.

BENEFITS & COMPENSATION

We offer a competitive wage $17.75-$18.85, a rewarding work environment, and generous benefits and perks such as paid holidays, a 401(k) option, Health Savings Accounts (HSAs), medical, dental, vision, and life insurance, and a phenomenal employee discount on all products North 40 sells.

North 40 Outfitters is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Engineer II Reg Eng Spain
jobs.description:
Mechanical Engineer – Regional Engineering (Spain)

As an Engineer (Mechanical) within our Regional Engineering team in Spain, you will support the evaluation and processing of customer applications and engineering projects, helping develop reliable and technically sound solutions based on customer requirements and the John Crane product portfolio.

Working closely with experienced engineers, designers, Sales teams and international colleagues, you will contribute to engineering proposals, technical calculations, CAD documentation and customer-facing technical support.

This role offers the opportunity to develop your expertise in rotating equipment and industrial applications while working in an international engineering environment.

Key Responsibilities

• Review and process customer applications, requests and engineering projects.
• Select suitable John Crane products, including mechanical seals, seal support systems, couplings and filtration solutions.
• Prepare engineering proposals, technical specifications and CAD documentation in line with customer requirements.
• Perform engineering calculations related to seal leakage, heat generation, balancing temperatures, flow rates and other rotating equipment applications.
• Prepare drawing office requests and collaborate with designers on general arrangement and detailed drawings.
• Support technical investigations, failure analysis, troubleshooting and the resolution of engineering issues.
• Review non-conforming fabricated parts and support decisions regarding their acceptance or rejection.
• Prepare and deliver technical presentations to customers in cooperation with the Sales team.
• Participate in retrofit projects, 3D scanning activities and technical training for employees and customers.
• Collaborate with global engineering teams and contribute to continuous improvement and the development of technical solutions.

What We Are Looking For

• Education: Bachelor's degree or higher in Engineering. Mechanical Engineering is strongly preferred; Chemical Engineering may also be considered.
• Technical knowledge: Understanding of rotating equipment, mechanical seals, pumps, compressors or hydraulic systems.
• Relevant experience: Experience with mechanical seals, pumps or related industrial equipment is a strong advantage. Experience in the oil and gas, petrochemical, energy or other process industries is particularly valuable.
• CAD skills: Experience with Solid Edge or SolidWorks. Computational simulation such as FEA, CFD
• Engineering skills: Ability to interpret technical drawings, understand customer requirements and apply engineering principles to practical problems.
• Languages: Fluent English and fluent Spanish, both written and spoken. Both languages are essential for this role.
• Additional advantage: Exposure to automation, artificial intelligence applications or digital engineering tools.
• Personal skills: A proactive and accountable approach, strong communication and listening skills, flexibility, teamwork and a customer-focused mindset.

What We Offer

• An international engineering environment with opportunities to collaborate with colleagues and customers across different regions.
• The opportunity to develop technical expertise within a globally recognised engineering business.
• Cooperation with experienced engineers, technical guidance and opportunities for knowledge sharing.
• A role combining practical engineering, technical problem-solving and customer interaction.

Working Arrangements

The role is office-based during the first six months. After this initial period, the possibility of working from home one day per week may be available, subject to the applicable arrangements.

How to Apply

Are you passionate about mechanical engineering, rotating equipment and finding practical technical solutions for customers?

We would be pleased to hear from you.

Please submit your CV in English.

ENTORNO DE TRABAJO

El entorno de trabajo se encuentra normalmente en una ubicación de Smiths durante el horario laboral habitual o ampliado e incluye oficinas, plantas de producción y centros de reparación. El entorno de trabajo también puede incluir instalaciones de clientes, incluidos campos petrolíferos, así como lugares donde se celebran reuniones.

• El nivel de ruido en el entorno de trabajo suele ser elevado y es obligatorio utilizar los equipos de protección individual (EPI) homologados cuando se trabaja en la planta de producción.

DIVERSIDAD E INCLUSIÓN

John Crane es una empresa internacional y abierta, basada en valores de igualdad y ética, donde acogemos, apoyamos y valoramos la diversidad. La diversidad de perspectivas y experiencias es una de las razones por las que nuestra empresa prospera.

Todas las personas candidatas cualificadas tienen las mismas oportunidades de acceder a un empleo, independientemente de su raza, color de piel, religión, género, orientación sexual, identidad de género, nacionalidad, situación económica, estado de salud, edad o cualquier otra característica personal.

jobs.title: Civil/Structural Forensics Professional Engineer
jobs.description:
Our Forensic Architecture & Engineering team is seeking a mid to senior-level Forensic Civil Structural Engineer (PE or SE) to enhance our already robust team of professionals supporting our clients throughout the US. Our engineers routinely perform forensic investigations, provide consultation, prepare and deliver technical papers; and serve as expert witnesses. Our areas of practice include residential, commercial, and industrial buildings’ roofing, fenestration, foundation and envelopes; hazard assessments and resulting damage; design and construction defect evaluation; and premise liability evaluations. Assignments will require regular local and regional travel to project sites. Active involvement in professional associations and societies is encouraged and supported.

Job Responsibilities

• Conducts field observations, testing and data collection.
• Prepares reports detailing observations made, testing results, research conducted, and opinions or recommendations.
• Works with building departments to determine repair directives.
• Conducts research and develops technical topics for publication.
• Meets with and presents to peers and clients.
• Engages in client-relations marketing

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering (from an ABET accredited school required)
• PE or SE license
• Highly qualified and experienced EI/EITs are considered
• Familiar with modern building codes and industry standards
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
• Excellent verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills
• Willing to travel and conduct site inspections
• A desire to learn, excel and grow with us and within the profession
• Valid Driver's License

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience as a forensic engineer
• Testimony experience as a designated expert witness (preferred for senior level)
• Experience in engineering design or construction
• Experience conducting damage assessments and forensic investigations (preferred but not required)
• Storm damage and building envelope evaluation experience is a plus

Physical and Mental Job Qualifications

• Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds at times.
• Must be able to travel to various project sites and conduct field investigations.
• Must be able to work at heights.
• Must be able to work in hot and cold environments, both indoors and outdoors.
• Must be able to periodically access and work on roofs, scaffolds, lifts, and other elevated surfaces and in enclosed spaces (attics, crawlspaces, etc.) with appropriate personal protection.
• Must be able to lift, transport, set up, and utilize an extension ladder to access roofs and other elevated surfaces.
• Physically able to climb, stand, walk, kneel, and crouch for extended periods of time

Some of the Benefits We Have Include

J.S. Held understands all our employees are people and sometimes life needs flexibility. We work to always provide an environment that best supports and suits our team’s needs.

• Our flexible work environment allows employees to work remotely, when needed
• Flexible Time Off Policy
• Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
• 401k Match
• Commuter Benefits

The estimated salary range for this role is $86,000 - $91,000 USD. The salary range is based on a wide array of factors, including but not limited to skillset, experience, training, location, scope of role, management responsibility, etc.

Other Duties

jobs.title: Ophthalmic Account Manager
jobs.description:
Sales Support:

• Assist the Ophthalmic Sales Manager (OSM) in achieving territory sales goals.
• Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities within existing accounts.
• Develop strategic account plans and territory management strategies w/ guidance from OSM.
• Support lead-generation and pipeline development through proactive prospecting.
• Monitor account performance using Business Intelligence and Analytics tools.
• Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and sales activities.
• Develop and maintain a collaborative working relationship with your local manufacturing sales partner to cultivate new opportunities.

Customer Engagement:

• Serve as the main point of contact for assigned hospital and surgery center accounts.
• Build and maintain long-term relationships with practice and hospital stakeholders including surgeons, procurement, clinical staff, and administration.
• Collaborate with internal teams to ensure seamless service delivery, including scheduling, logistics, finance, and clinical support.
• Oversee product installations, training, and onboarding for new CATALYS® users.
• Conduct regular client meetings and quarterly business reviews with OSM.
• Resolve client issues promptly and effectively to ensure high levels of customer satisfaction and retention.

Training and education:

• Attend cases to observe and learn how to support surgeons and staff in the operating room.
• Develop deep knowledge of the CATALYS® Precision Laser System, competitive landscape, and clinical use cases.
• Provide in-service education to surgery center and hospital staff on product usage, safety, and compliance.
• Drive increased utilization within existing accounts by training staff to implement the ForTec CATALYS Practice Development Program materials and strategies within their practices.

Work Environment:

Occasionally exposed to all types of weather conditions when driving. Employees occasionally work in operating room environment during surgical cases.

Travel: Employee travels independently to customer locations to conduct sales calls or to deliver, set up and operate laser and/or equipment at hospitals, surgical centers, and surgeon offices.  May encounter extensive travel time/distance including travel by vehicle or airline based on business needs and overnight stay may be required. 40% overnight travel required.

Schedule: This is a full-time position working regular business hours with flexibility required to meet business needs.

Education: Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, Life Sciences, or related field (required).

Requirements/ Preferences:

1–3 years of experience in B2B sales or healthcare preferred.  Optometry or Ophthalmology experience is strongly preferred.

Strong understanding of surgical procedures and operating room protocols. Well-versed in the industry dynamics of the US Healthcare market.  Proficient in CRM systems (e.g., Dynamics 365 or Salesforce) and Microsoft Office Suite. (preferred)

Excellent verbal, written, multitasking and presentation skills required. Customer focused; results driven.  Self-motivated, organized, and eager to learn.

Customer Credentialing Requirement:

Must be able to meet the credentialing requirements of assigned medical facilities, which include customer-required immunizations (which may include the Covid-19 vaccine and flu vaccine), and may include health screenings, background checks, and passing drug screens (including marijuana/THC testing) as required for facility credentialing and permitted by applicable law.

jobs.title: CNC Machinist (Weekend Day)
jobs.description:
Must have previous CNC machining experience.

Available Shifts

• Monday - Thursday, 6:00 PM - 6:00 AM

Additional shift differential available for eligible night and weekend schedules.

Day shift prefers someone with experience on Mazak lathe (exp. on Haas and DMG lathe is a plus).

John Crane is seeking experienced CNC Lathe Operators and CNC Mill Operators to join our manufacturing operation in Pasadena, Texas.

Whether your background is in CNC turning, CNC milling, or both, you'll have the opportunity to work with advanced equipment, modern tooling, and a skilled manufacturing team producing high-precision components for critical industrial applications.

We welcome experienced specialists in either lathes or mills. Experience with both is beneficial but not required.

What You'll Do

• Set up and operate CNC lathes or CNC machining centers
• Install and verify tooling, fixtures, jaws, and workholding devices
• Establish and adjust tool and work offsets
• Load and secure materials for machining operations
• Read and interpret engineering drawings, work orders, and setup documentation
• Perform first-piece, in-process, and final inspections
• Use precision measuring instruments to verify dimensional requirements
• Monitor tool wear, machine performance, and product quality
• Make offset adjustments and minor program edits as needed
• Troubleshoot machining and setup issues
• Document production and inspection results accurately
• Maintain a safe, organized, and efficient work area

Our machinists work with modern manufacturing technology, including:

• Mazak CNC lathes with MAZATROL controls
• Mazak INTEGREX multitasking machines
• Haas CNC machining centers
• Advanced tooling and workholding systems
• Precision inspection equipment

Why Join John Crane?

• Clean, climate-controlled facility
• Modern CNC equipment and tooling
• Well-lit, professional manufacturing environment
• Strong commitment to safety and quality
• Stable global organization with long-term career opportunities
• Opportunities to develop advanced machining skills

Weekend-shift employees enjoy a three-day workweek while maintaining full-time status and benefits.

• High school diploma or equivalent
• Minimum 3 years of CNC machining experience
• Experience setting up and operating CNC lathes or CNC milling machines
• Ability to independently perform machine setups
• Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and dimensional tolerances
• Experience with tooling selection, offsets, and setup verification
• Proficiency with micrometers, calipers, indicators, bore gauges, and related inspection tools
• Knowledge of speeds, feeds, machining practices, and quality standards
• Ability to perform in-process inspections and maintain tight tolerances
• Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities
• Ability to work assigned shifts and overtime when required

Ideal Candidate

You are an experienced CNC Lathe Operator or CNC Mill Operator who takes pride in producing quality work, maintaining tight tolerances, and solving machining challenges. You can independently complete setups, inspect parts, make adjustments when needed, and consistently deliver high-quality results in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

If you're a skilled CNC machinist looking to work with modern Mazak and Haas equipment in a professional manufacturing environment, we'd like to hear from you.

Physical Requirements

Ability to stand and walk for extended periods during a 12-hour shift Ability to lift up to 40 pounds safely Ability to bend, reach, grip, and handle tooling and machined components Ability to wear required PPE and work safely around manufacturing equipment

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Mazak or Haas equipment Experience using MAZATROL controls Experience operating Mazak INTEGREX machines Experience with both CNC turning and CNC milling GD&T knowledge Experience machining close-tolerance components Experience machining stainless steel, alloy steels, and specialty alloys Technical degree, machining certificate, or formal CNC training

jobs.title: Digital Sales Manager
jobs.description:
The Digital Sales Manager is responsible for driving the growth of recurring digital revenue across the assigned region through the sale of software, SaaS and cybersecurity solutions. Working in partnership with Key Account Managers, Market Sales teams and the Digital Business Unit, the role identifies, develops and converts opportunities that enhance customer outcomes while accelerating digital transformation and software adoption.

The role acts as the regional digital sales specialist, leading opportunity generation, customer engagement and commercial execution for digital solutions, while contributing to the development of scalable sales methodologies, market strategies and digital growth initiatives.

Duties:

• Own and deliver assigned annual recurring revenue (ARR) and digital sales targets within the designated territory, including achievement of net-new digital/SaaS revenue growth.
• Own the end-to-end sale of digital and SaaS propositions, including the ELECTORA platform, iCMORE AI-enabled algorithms, Cloud Products & CRE, and Cybersecurity solutions, both as standalone offerings and as an attachment to core detection equipment.
• Proactively identify, qualify, and pursue software and digital opportunities across the installed base, new business prospects, and upcoming tenders.
• Develop and execute regional digital growth plans aligned with commercial objectives and Digital Business Unit priorities.
• Partner closely with Key Account Managers (KAMs) and Market Sales Directors to maximise software attach opportunities and ensure digital solutions complement and strengthen core equipment relationships.
• Build and maintain relationships with customer decision-makers, influencers and executive stakeholders.
• Lead customer discussions focused on business outcomes, operational improvements, efficiency gains, compliance and risk reduction rather than product features alone.
• Collaborate with Technical Pre-Sales Engineers, Solution Architects, Integration Engineers, and Digital Subject Matter Experts to develop solutions, scope requirements, and support complex bids and tender responses.
• Apply strong financial and commercial acumen to support business case development, opportunity qualification, pricing discussions, contract negotiations, and recurring revenue growth.
• Maintain accurate forecasting, pipeline management, and ARR reporting through CRM systems and governance processes to support business planning and performance management.
• Collaborate with the prospect to Bid Process to support inputs required to obtain approval to bid via Smiths Detection’s DOA.
• Monitor market trends, customer requirements, competitive developments, and emerging technologies to identify growth opportunities and support portfolio development.
• Prioritise strategic aviation accounts while supporting the expansion of digital solutions across Ports & Borders, Urban Security, and other target market segments.
• Contribute to the development of digital sales methodologies, customer use cases, and best practices to strengthen regional capability and drive consistent execution.
• Support onboarding and enablement activities for future digital sales colleagues and contribute to the growth of the regional digital sales capability.
• Ensure all commercial activities are conducted in accordance with company policies, ethical standards, regulatory requirements, and applicable governance processes.

Technical Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

Knowledge & Experience:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in business, Sales, Marketing, Technology, or a related field.
• Proven B2B software/SaaS sales track record, ideally in aviation, ports & borders, defence or another regulated, critical-infrastructure sector.
• Comfortable selling a newer, evolving product line and helping shape the pitch and playbook as the offer matures.
• Experience selling software attached to a hardware/equipment sale is a strong advantage.
• Confident engaging both technical and commercial/C-level stakeholders with an outcome-led pitch.
• Disciplined pipeline and forecast management; fluent in CRM tools (e.g. Salesforce).
• Comfortable operating in a newly-formed, matrixed structure with both a market line manager and a functional Digital BU relationship.
• Experience selling software and digital solutions integrated with hardware or equipment solutions.
• Knowledge of cybersecurity, cloud solutions, AI-enabled applications or digital transformation programs.
• Experience participating in government procurement and tender processes.
• Willingness to travel within region.

Competence and Abilities:

• Excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.
• Strong negotiation and influencing capability across multiple organizational levels.
• Consultative, value-based and outcome-focused sales approach.
• Operate with a ‘hunting mindset’
• Ability to translate technical concepts into clear business value propositions.
• Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills.
• Effective planning, prioritization and pipeline management capability.
• High degree of resilience, self-motivation and accountability.
• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across global teams.
• Strong relationship-building and customer engagement skills
• Exposure in selling to customers in market segments such as Aviation, Ports & Borders & Urban Security
• Strong understanding of Digital/IT technology, procurement processes, and industry regulations.
• Strong financial and commercial acumen, with the ability to develop business cases, evaluate ROI, understand recurring revenue models, and conduct value-based commercial discussions with customer executives and procurement stakeholders.

We offer…

Join us and we’ll help build your career, with excellent training and opportunities for career growth across the business, both locally and globally. You’ll experience an inclusive environment, with strong leadership and a focus on safety and wellbeing. You’ll also have the flexibility to choose from a wide range of benefits to suit your lifestyle, offering you and your family support from a health and wellbeing, financial and lifestyle perspective.

Join us and work for a world-leader, with the benefits and training to reward your dedication and skills. Be part of a team where we are making the world a safer place.

jobs.title: CNC Machine Operator
jobs.description:
SECOND SHIFT

YOU MUST BE AUTHORIZED TO WORK IN THE USA

Competitive Shift Differential

Operate various CNC machines in compliance with the corporate mission and values, and department financial objectives.

Essential Functions:

• Mill, turn, drill, tap, deburr, mold and all bench operations and inspections as required
• Detect and report defective materials or questionable conditions to supervisor or trainer
• Follow prescribed safety regulations and equipment tag-out procedures
• Comply with Global Harmonized System (GHS), Safety Data Sheets (SDS), and hazardous waste labeling requirements
• Execute proper spill response procedures
• Perform prescribed preventative maintenance on machines as required
• Keep equipment and work area clean and in order
• Maintain a positive work atmosphere by behaving and communicating in an effective manner with customers, co-workers, clients and supervisors
• Work in a safe and conscientious manner
• Assist other employees in the performance of their duties as necessary
• Perform other job duties as assigned by supervisor

• Three months of CNC machine operations or training; or the equivalent combination of education and experience
• Ability to work independently without direct supervision and as a team member
• Read and speak English
• Experience in structural steel operations (preferred)

John Crane is seeking experienced CNC Lathe Operators and CNC Mill Operators to join our manufacturing operation in Pasadena, Texas.

• Make offset adjustments and minor program edits as needed
• Troubleshoot machining and setup issues
• Document production and inspection results accurately
• Maintain a safe, organized, and efficient work area

Our machinists work with modern manufacturing technology, including:

• Mazak CNC lathes with MAZATROL controls
• Mazak INTEGREX multitasking machines
• Haas CNC machining centers
• Advanced tooling and workholding systems
• Precision inspection equipment

• Clean, climate-controlled facility
• Modern CNC equipment and tooling
• Well-lit, professional manufacturing environment
• Strong commitment to safety and quality
• Stable global organization with long-term career opportunities
• Opportunities to develop advanced machining skills

Weekend-shift employees enjoy a three-day workweek while maintaining full-time status and benefits.

• High school diploma or equivalent
• Minimum 3 years of CNC machining experience
• Experience setting up and operating CNC lathes or CNC milling machines
• Ability to independently perform machine setups
• Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and dimensional tolerances
• Experience with tooling selection, offsets, and setup verification
• Proficiency with micrometers, calipers, indicators, bore gauges, and related inspection tools
• Knowledge of speeds, feeds, machining practices, and quality standards
• Ability to perform in-process inspections and maintain tight tolerances
• Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities
• Ability to work assigned shifts and overtime when required

Ideal Candidate

You are an experienced CNC Lathe Operator or CNC Mill Operator who takes pride in producing quality work, maintaining tight tolerances, and solving machining challenges. You can independently complete setups, inspect parts, make adjustments when needed, and consistently deliver high-quality results in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

If you're a skilled CNC machinist looking to work with modern Mazak and Haas equipment in a professional manufacturing environment, we'd like to hear from you.

Ability to stand and walk for extended periods during a 12-hour shift Ability to lift up to 40 pounds safely Ability to bend, reach, grip, and handle tooling and machined components Ability to wear required PPE and work safely around manufacturing equipment

Experience with Mazak or Haas equipment Experience using MAZATROL controls Experience operating Mazak INTEGREX machines Experience with both CNC turning and CNC milling GD&T knowledge Experience machining close-tolerance components Experience machining stainless steel, alloy steels, and specialty alloys Technical degree, machining certificate, or formal CNC training

jobs.title: da Vinci Specialist
jobs.description:
*Please note: Candidates must live within or be willing to relocate to the White Plains, NY area to perform the duties of this role.

Primary Function of Position

The DaVinci Specialist (DVS) will provide expert clinical & technical support, build, customize and coordinate education & training to physicians, nurses, and hospital staff on the use of DaVinci surgery, devices and therapies. This role partners closely with the sales team, specifically the Clinical Sales Representative and Clinical Sales Manager, to ensure safe and effective product adoption and quality control while driving positive patient outcomes.

The DaVinci Specialist is a dedicated program execution & clinical education partner for hospitals running a da Vinci robotic surgery program.   Based on its expertise, this role focuses on identifies and tailors the nature and extent of staff in-servicing, day-to-day program execution, technology onboarding and operational support, communicating identified needs to hospital OR operations and leadership. The DVS will work alongside the da Vinci Clinical Sales Representative .

Essential Job Duties

Collaboration & Field Partnership (Within a CSM Team)

• Partner with the local CSR/CSM and cross-functional business partners to create, own, scale and execute best practices and deployment of ecosystem resources.
• Lead account support plans that drive safe program execution and increase customer autonomy over time, including setting objectives, timelines and resources for relevant customers, in consultation with CSR/CSM.
• Identify, solicit and provide field feedback and customer insights to internal teams to improve training, support resources, and customer experience.
• Support adoption of digital solutions by helping customers build comfort and capability through in-servicing and troubleshooting.

Clinical & Technical Support

• Identify and provide on-site, non-scrubbed operating room support for procedures utilizing the da Vinci Surgical System and associated technologies.

• Support OR teams with room readiness and procedural workflow, including system setup support, docking workflow support, and intraoperative troubleshooting.
• Serve as a clinical product expert to help ensure optimal, safe system use and adherence to applicable IFUs, hospital policies, and safety protocols.
• Motivate and support adoption of advanced instruments and accessories by ensuring teams understand proper setup, handling, and intended use.

• Partner with and promote consistent readiness and workflow by supporting day-to-day execution of the robotic program, coordinating with OR leadership, nursing, SPD/sterile processing, and biomedical teams.
• Assist with operational support activities such as facilitating appropriate internal handoffs for service needs.
• Ensure the right stakeholders are aligned (OR, SPD, biomed, IT) for successful day-to-day operation and new technology onboarding to help reduce friction.
• Maintain accurate internal documentation of support activities per company process (e.g., case support notes, training records, service/escalation tracking).

Training & Education (Care Team Enablement)

• Determine the need for, customize and deliver customer-specific hands-on training and in-services to nurses, surgical technologists, SPD teams, and other care team members on safe and effective use of da Vinci platforms and associated technologies.
• Support onboarding and education for new users through structured training touchpoints (e.g., new staff orientation, refresher training, workflow standardization).
• Lead new site start-ups by identifying and delivering onboarding programs and coordinating training logistics with the CSR/CSM and hospital stakeholders.
• Support new technology installs by coordinating readiness activities and providing post-install education to care teams.
• Act as a resource for ongoing education, product updates, and workflow optimization.

Escalation & Customer Issue Management

• Analyze and leverage utilization, turnover, and other relevant case data to recommend operational changes to customers
• Provide first-line support and expertise for common setup and workflow issues during live cases and training sessions.
• Identify, resolve and where necessary escalate issues appropriately to internal partners (e.g., Technical Support, Field Service, Clinical/Medical counterparts).

Market & Clinical Insights

• Collect and communicate customer feedback and experiences to clinical counterparts and internal business partners. Prioritizing, distilling and reporting relevant customer feedback, in real time.
• Stay up to date on clinical literature, competitive products, and evolving treatment guidelines.
• Assist in clinical trial support when required.
• Assist in field action activities when necessary.

Required Skills and Experience

• Experience: 2+ years in an operating room-related role
• Clinical experience is preferred.
• Experience as a robotics coordinator, surgical assistant, and/or surgical nurse plus industry experience strongly preferred.
• Understanding of soft tissue anatomy & procedures.
• Exhibit a working knowledge of typical hospital policies.
• Excellent communication, teaching, and interpersonal skills.
• Strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills.
• Ability to work in high-pressure environments (managing multiple ORs) and coordination of multiple tasks at one time.
• Adaptability to evolving technologies and complex procedures.
• Team oriented with a commercial mindset.
• Willingness to travel up to 40%. Primary travel will be within a CSM team.
• Ability to travel within a Clinical Sales Manager team geography, supporting multiple hospitals.
• Flexibility to support early starts, after-hours cases, and weekend procedures based on customer need and territory utilization.

Required Education and Training

• Associates degree. Bachelor’s degree preferred.
• Degrees in (RN, PA, NP, RT, or other clinical credentials) are welcomed.

Working Conditions

• Ability to stand for extended periods and provide in-person case support within an operating room (OR) environment, which includes pushing, pulling, lifting and squatting.

jobs.title: Health Systems Director - North-Texas
jobs.description:
Role & Function

As members of the Health Systems Director team, individuals in this position are responsible for the sales and access strategies that underpin SOBI Rare Disease products in and for achievement of assigned objectives for both the region and assigned institutions/hospitals/health systems. The ideal candidate for this position will live in North Texas.

Key Responsibilities

• Access: The Health Systems Director (HSD) will be accountable for working cross-functionally to help ensure access to therapy for patients in hospitals and other care settings, as per the product label. This includes appropriate management and coordination of supporting SOBI teams to engage with the health system stakeholders including C-Suite leaders, P&T committees, Pharmacy Directors, and external experts. Health Systems Directors are accountable for coordinating their own account-based activities alongside those in Market Access, Patient Services, and medical teams who have responsibilities in the same accounts.
• Clinical Acumen: Strong clinical acumen will be paramount in this role. The HSD is responsible for effectively sharing on-label scientific information that translates into real world practice. A strong background in the rare disease market is preferred, and significant Hospital Systems/buy-and-bill knowledge is a must. In addition, previous experience educating clinicians about diagnostic criteria and testing options will be highly valuable.
• Partnerships: The HSD will build strong relationships with key decision makers throughout their accounts and will provide customers with the product and disease information that helps them develop and implement protocols for optimal patient care.
• Rare Disease Advocacy: The Health Systems Director will be responsible for nurturing and channeling advocacy to support patient protocols consistent with the full parameters of the label.
• Delivering Results: The Health Systems Director will be responsible for delivering against assigned objectives, favorably navigating assigned SOBI products through the key influential pathways in assigned systems to include C and D suite stakeholders.
• Identifying and engaging with thought leaders: The HSD will build relationships with key thought leaders to ensure regional understanding of targeted Sobi products. Specifically, raise awareness of Rare Disease products with existing experts and identify and maintain relationships with the next generation of KOLs by targeting residency and fellow programs and Multi-Disciplinary Teams through clinical in-services and product/disease discussion and educational programs.
• Developing and Executing Business Plans: The HSD is responsible for targeting, prioritizing and clinically managing and selling to multiple stakeholders both at the Physician and Administration/leadership level, based on approved target lists. These may include Hem-Onc. and PICU Physicians, leaders, Nurses, Pharmacists and other Stakeholders such as Rheumatologists, Immunologists, GI/HEP and Infectious Disease. An effective business planning process should be developed and executed with all cross-functional team members.
• Developing and Executing Account Plans: The HSD will develop and execute account plans based on the national and regional strategies. These account plans will include: (1) priority and attention level for each account; (2) account objectives and action plans; (3) key targets and network maps (4) details for synchronization and coordination of SOBI personnel

• A four-year college degree, preferably in a scientific/medical or business discipline or relevant experience is required.
• Requires 8-12 years of successful field sales experience with at least 3-5 years complex Institutional experience in the Rare Disease, Specialty Pharmaceutical, Biotechnology, or Medical Device industry.
• Experience with complex dynamics of biologic distribution and acquisition at inpatient level is strongly preferred.
• Experience with successfully navigating Health System formulary pathways and complex access/reimbursement landscape.
• Exceptional Account and Stakeholder Management experience required; strong organizational and leadership skills necessary to coordinate internal and external Stakeholder, as well as strong customer management skills.
• Strong clinical acumen with demonstrated experience with complex diseases, preferably a rare disease.
• Demonstrated success with medical benefit products added to hospital formulary.
• Prior experience working with Pediatric and Adult Rheumatology and/or Hematology/Oncology physicians a plus
• In addition, you must demonstrate behaviors in line with Sobi's core values: Care, Ambition, Urgency, Ownership and Partnership.

Compensation and Total Rewards at Sobi

At Sobi, we are dedicated to providing our employees with a comprehensive and industry-competitive total rewards package. Our compensation philosophy is designed to recognize and reward talent, ensuring that your contributions are valued and reflected in your overall rewards.

Your total compensation at Sobi goes beyond just your base salary and annual bonus. It also includes a robust suite of benefits, such as:

• A competitive 401(k) match to support your financial future.
• Tuition and wellness reimbursements to invest in your personal and professional growth.
• A comprehensive medical, dental, and vision package to prioritize your health and well-being.
• Additional recognition awards to celebrate your achievements.

The base salary range for this role is $180,000 to $220,000. Each individual offer will be determined based on several factors, including your experience, qualifications, and location. Additionally, this role is eligible for both short-term and long-term bonuses, as outlined in the plan details.

All Sobi employees need to demonstrate behaviors in line with Sobi's core values: Care, Ambition, Urgency, Ownership and Partnership. Are you ready to be on the Sobi team? Come join a culture that empowers every person to be the person that makes a difference for rare disease.

Why Join Us?

We are a global company with over 1,900 employees in more than 30 countries and are committed to the societies where we operate. With a deeply skilled management team directing our day-to-day wins, and a Board with a stellar track record, we’re ready to take on the world’s diseases, ailments and adversity. Our people believe they have the power to make a positive impact in others’ lives because that’s exactly what we do here. If you’re seeking a career that taps into your talents in a way that makes the world a better, healthier place, we just may have a job for you.

We know our employees are our most valuable asset, and our culture conveys that. We offer a competitive benefits package, to support the health and happiness of our staff.

Testimonials

Hear from our team: “I am so proud to be with Sobi for nearly 14 years and while the company has grown, evolved and become more innovative over the years, what has not changed is our collaborative environment, patient-first culture, and tireless passion for making a difference in people’s lives. It’s truly inspiring to work alongside people who care so deeply about the work we do.” National Commercial Business Director, Kineret

Sobi Culture

At Sobi, we refuse to accept the status quo. This is because we have witnessed first-hand the challenges facing those affected by rare diseases, and have used this knowledge to shape our business to find new ways of helping them.

As a specialized biopharmaceutical company, we are dedicated to rare diseases. And we see this focus as a strength. By effectively turning our research into ground-breaking treatments, we help make medicine more accessible and open up more possibilities for patients and more opportunities for those caring for them. This has been our approach since day one, but we know we can’t change the world of rare diseases on our own. Accomplishing this requires strong partnerships with patients, partners and stakeholders across the entire value chain. Together, we define how our business can create solutions that serve the needs of those affected by rare diseases while facilitating sustainable growth.

An Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs.title: Project Controls Manager
jobs.description:
The Project Controls Manager will support and lead project controls functions across integrated design and construction projects within our advanced facilities portfolio. This role partners closely with design, engineering, and construction leadership to provide cost, schedule, forecasting, and performance visibility throughout the full project lifecycle — from early design through construction closeout.

The ideal candidate brings a strong background supporting technically complex projects, understands how project controls evolve from design into execution, and can drive predictable outcomes through data-driven insights.

Responsibilities

• Lead project controls activities across both design-phase and construction-phase projects, including cost control, scheduling, forecasting, and performance reporting
• Develop, manage, and maintain project budgets, cost-loaded schedules, and cash flow forecasts from early design through construction
• Support design-phase cost modeling, schedule development, and scope validation in partnership with engineering and estimating teams
• Oversee change management across design development and construction execution, including trend logs, change estimates, and impact analysis
• Provide regular project performance and forecast reporting to Project Directors, leadership, and clients
• Identify cost, schedule, and execution risks and mitigation strategies across design development and field execution
• Ensure alignment with CRB project controls standards, tools, and reporting templates
• Support baseline development, earned value analysis, progress measurement, and productivity tracking
• Collaborate with estimating, procurement, contracting, engineering, and construction teams throughout the full project lifecycle
• Mentor and support project controls staff, cost engineers, and analysts as needed
• Participate in internal and client-facing meetings representing CRB’s project controls expertise

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or related field.
• Minimum of 10 years of experience in project controls, cost management, or project management within a construction, EPC, or design-build environment
• Experience supporting GMP-regulated or highly technical Life Science design and/or construction
• Demonstrated experience supporting both design and construction phases of complex projects
• Strong understanding of cost control, scheduling (Primavera P6 or similar), forecasting, and earned value management
• Experience working in design-build, integrated EPC, or engineer-led project delivery models
• Advanced proficiency in Excel and project controls software/toolsStrong financial acumen and ability to translate project data into actionable insights
• Excellent communication skills with the ability to work across engineering, construction, and leadership teams
• Ability to operate effectively in fast-paced, technically complex project environments

Preferred Qualifications

jobs.title: Patient Care Tech-Float Pool Full-time Days
jobs.description:
The Patient Care Technician reflects the mission, vision, and values of Northwestern Memorial, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

The Patient Care Technician’s primary function is to assist and support the Professional Registered Nurse in all aspects of direct and indirect patient care activities.  The Patient Care Technician functions as a member of the unit staff under the direction and supervision of the professional Registered Nurse.

Responsibilities:

• Direct Patient Care Activities Assists with admission, transfer, and discharge process.Takes and records temperature, pulse, respirations, weight for adults and/or neonates, height, and blood pressure.Measures and records intake and output including output from drains.Applies cardiac monitor/oximetry.Obtains EKG.Adheres to the infant security protocol (accurate assessment of band placement).Performs normal newborn hearing screening.Obtains capillary blood glucose for adults and/or neonates.Performs phlebotomy.Applies Fetal Monitor equipment on pregnant patients.Discontinues heplocks and foley catheters. Administers enemas.Collects specimens (urine, stool, blood and sputum) on adults and/or neonates. Makes rounds of patients and anticipates their needs and observes newborns in the nursery.Responds to patient call lights in a timely manner, especially emergency lights.Distributes fresh drinking water and nourishments to patients. Prepares patients for meals; assists or feeds patients as necessary. Feeds normal newborns as assigned.Provides morning care, bed baths and evening care according to established Nursing Care Procedures. Provides peri-care to appropriate patients.Provides newborn care to the infant including bath, dressing, obtaining foot prints, assistance with feeding (bottle and breast), glucose checks.Makes occupied and unoccupied beds.Ambulates patients and instructs on walker, cane and crutch walking as appropriate for assigned unit. Assists with pre-and post-operative care; positions patients as ordered; applies special equipment for safety; lifts and turns patients with proper and safe body mechanics and available resources.Applies comfort and safety measures (side rails and call lights). Sets up oxygen and suction equipment and other respiratory equipment for adults and/or neonates.Applies dressings to Stage I and Stage II skin breakdown. Prepares patient room for MD or RN assessment, evaluation, diagnostic and therapeutic procedures. Assists with procedures in the normal newborn nursery as directed.Transports patients, equipment and/or supplies during urgent and emergent situations and to front door on discharge.Responds to emergency situations, secures assistance and initiates basic life support.Reports observations and documents appropriately. Promptly notifies RN of any change in patient condition.Performs post-mortem care and transports bodies to the morgue when necessary.Assumes responsibility for the care of patient’s prosthetic devices, hearing aides, dentures, eye glasses, etc.Follows established policies, procedures and standards of care in all areas of practice.

• Indirect Patient CareMaintains a safe and clean environment. Duties may include: maintaining temperature logs on, defrosting, and cleaning refrigerator, straightening linen, cleaning utility rooms, cleaning IV poles, cleaning scale, cleaning and returning equipment to SPD, replacing and disposing of soiled linen bags.Performs duties delegated by the RN to facilitate patient care and the efficient operations of the assigned patient care unit.Collects and inventories patient belongings on admission, transfer and discharge.Completes charges using appropriate documentation.Orders supplies on-line or appropriate requisitions and stocks in appropriate location.Obtains necessary equipment and supplies to facilitate patient care.Assures room readiness for incoming patients.Checks designated equipment for proper functioning.Counts instruments and sterile trays sent and received from SEP as appropriate for assigned unit.Stocks and removes linen from patient rooms.Sets up and breaks down delivery table.Participates in staff meetings.Demonstrates cost effective approach to patient care in terms of equipment, supplies and other resource use.Participates in quality improvement activities.Participates in daily/weekly/monthly QC’s.Participates in orientation of new staff.Performs related duties as assigned.Uses established communication channels to resolve work related problems.Understands and consistently demonstrates principles of “Patient’s First” philosophy.Carries out assigned tasks and activities on a shift basis, as delegated by the RN.Assumes responsibility for meeting mandatory requirements.

Required:

• CNA Certification or currently enrolled in School of Nursing who has successfully completed basic clinical rotations.
• CPR recognition by the American Heart Association (BLS for Healthcare Providers).
• Minimum of 90% correct on annual mandatory Health and Safety Training quizzes.
• Unit based recognition for Capillary Blood Glucose Monitoring.
• High school diploma required. One year of college or nursing education or equivalent experience preferred.
• Previous experience in a health care setting preferred with a demonstrated ability to relate to patients, family, nursing and medical staff.

Preferred:

• Associates or Bachelor’s degree.

The Manufacturing Software Engineer Inter will be responsible for developing and maintaining software and reports specifically used in manufacturing environments. This role focuses on maintaining, upgrading, and redeveloping existing applications that control and interact with customized fixtures or instruments. The ideal candidate should have experience and knowledge of MES (Manufacturing Execution Systems) and be capable of integrating paperless workflows, automating data collection, and improving visualization and quality control in the manufacturing process. The candidate should have a strong understanding of shop floor process applications. In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams and management to design and develop custom manufacturing software applications, using preferred languages such as VC++, C#, Java, and Python.

Additionally, your expertise will be applied in visualizing process metrics through reports and live dashboards. You will also spend time on the production floor, assisting with troubleshooting software, workstations, and network-related issues.

Key Characteristics

• Create and maintain manufacturing software applications and reports.
• MES implementation, administration, and support.
• Ability to effectively troubleshoot and problem solve.
• Ability to work both independently and in a cross functional team-oriented environment.
• Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks.

Duties & Responsibilities

• Create and maintain software applications and databases that support manufacturing in a variety of languages VC++, C#, Java, Python, MySQL, Tableau.
• Oversee the day-to-day administration, monitoring, troubleshooting, maintenance, and ongoing support of the MES system.
• Create documentation for software usage, maintenance, and other requirements.
• Works closely with management, engineering, manufacturing, and quality teams to design and develop intuitive custom applications to reduce downtime, maintain regulatory compliance, and improve productivity.
• Create and execute advanced SQL queries to produce process metrics, reports, and live dashboards.
• Liaison for manufacturing and Corporate IT for project implementation.

Qualifications

Education & Experience Required:

• Working toward a Bachelor’s degree in software engineering, Information Technology, or relevant degree.

Preferred:

• Experience supporting manufacturing operations.
• Experience with Microsoft Visual Studio.
• Experience with VS Code
• Experience with VC++, C#, Python
• Experience with RDBMS such as MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, etc.
• Experience with SAP and Tableau.
• Experience with development process tools such as Git, GitHub, GitLab and Jira.

Additional information

Working Conditions

• Work will primarily take place on the production floor (70%) but also in office or laboratory environments.
• 85% of the time will be dedicated to supporting existing/legacy manufacturing software, with 15% focused on supporting new MES development. (Note: The time spent on new MES development will gradually increase as the new system phases out the legacy system.)
• Must be able to sit or stand at a workstation or work cell for the duration of a full work shift.

jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

The Safety Manager ensures safe working conditions and practices that meet all applicable health, safety, and environmental regulations and company policies are being followed at site locations. The Safety Manager also coaches site manager and personnel on the recognition, elimination, and control of occupational hazards and environmental risks. This position is responsible for the development of HSE improvement plans, metrics, and strategies as it applies to job site locations.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Provide safety leadership for the facility in Watertown, WI.
• Assist the plant with the required training and training logistics
• Implement and manage Management System processes: ISO 14001, OSHAS 18001
• Conduct periodic safety meetings, safety training, safety audits, risk assessments and other safety related assistance at the facility and occasionally job site or branch locations
• Create effective safety partnerships with all employees
• Ensure the effectiveness of day to day safety compliance and procedures.
• Lead or take part in the investigation and conduct Root Cause Analysis on all injury/illness and/or near hit incidents to include corrective action plans
• Assist, advise, follow-up and/or lead implementation with local management on corrective actions with all incidents and near hits.
• Implement and follow-up on Konecranes safety policies and procedures
• Assist or act as backup resource to other Safety Managers (all business units) and the Region Americas Safety Director
• Assist Safety Director, as needed, with client meetings and presentations to demonstrate Konecranes safety commitment and history
• Represent company with safety and health regulatory agencies including OSHA, EPA and DOT
• Other tasks as required

REQUIRED SKILLS & COMPETENCIES:

• Thorough knowledge and understanding of OSHA 1910 and 1926 and applicable MSHA 30 CFR standards.

• Strong organizational skills.

• Strong English communication skills (both verbal and written). The ability to speak and understand Spanish is a plus.

• Proficiency with database applications and administration systems, specifically Microsoft® Office.

• Ability to work effectively alone and prioritize.

• Must be a highly motivated and motivational team-oriented individual with an attention to detail.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

• Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Safety, Industrial Safety, or equivalent preferred.

• 5 or more years of progressive safety management experience in occupational safety and health within an industrial service or mine mining sector is required.

• Experience with both OSHA and MSHA standards is required.

• Safety certifications such as CSP, OHST, CHST and CMSP are considered a strong asset.

OTHER REQUIREMENTS:

• Travel expectancy is 50% with frequent overnights.

What we offer:

Benefits: Medical Plan, Dental, Vision, 401k plan with a match from day one, identity theft protection, accident insurance, travel insurance and so much more!

Vacation: 2 weeks of vacation per year (pro-rated for the first year depending on start date). 5-12 years of service, 3 weeks. 13+ years of service, 4 weeks.

Sick Leave: 5 days of Sick Leave per year. Pro-rated the first year after 90 days of service

Holidays: 10 paid holidays per year

Konecranes moves what matters. Konecranes is a global leader in material handling solutions, serving a broad range of customers across multiple industries. jobs.title: Senior Firmware Verification Engineer
jobs.description:
Renesas Electronics America is seeking a Senior Firmware Verification Engineer to join the Infrastructure Power team. This role owns pre-silicon verification of embedded firmware used to control high-performance power management ICs for data center, AI accelerator, networking, and computing platforms. The engineer will apply a solid understanding of the firmware development process to build effective test strategies, verify ARM Cortex-M firmware in simulation-based environments, and identify firmware, RTL, and interface defects before silicon availability.

Key Responsibilities

•  Build, maintain, and enhance SystemVerilog-based simulation tests and environments that execute ARM Cortex-M firmware with the associated RTL and hardware models.

•  Verify firmware behavior across reset, boot, initialization, configuration, sequencing, telemetry, protection, fault handling, recovery, and firmware–hardware interface scenarios.

•  Analyze C and assembly firmware at source, instruction, register, memory, interrupt, and peripheral levels to diagnose functional and timing-related failures.

•  Develop directed, constrained-random, negative, stress, boundary, and error-injection tests to validate expected behavior and robustness.

•  Run regressions; triage failures; perform waveform, log, memory, and register analysis; and isolate issues to firmware, RTL, models, testbench, or tools.

•  Define and track requirements coverage, functional coverage, code coverage, and regression quality; identify gaps and drive closure.

•  Create automation using Python, Perl, or similar scripting languages for build and test execution, result checking, log parsing, failure classification, reporting, and continuous integration.

•  Collaborate closely with firmware developers, RTL designers, architects, and validation engineers to review requirements, improve observability and controllability, reproduce defects, and verify fixes.

•  Document verification plans, test procedures, coverage results, debug findings, known issues, and release-readiness assessments.

Required Qualifications

•  BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.

•  Deep understanding of C and assembly-based firmware for ARM Cortex-M processors, including exception and interrupt handling, memory maps, startup code, registers, peripherals, and low-level debugging.

•  Strong ability to debug firmware–hardware interactions using simulation logs, waveforms, memory and register traces, and source-level analysis.

•  Experience in firmware verification, embedded firmware testing, firmware development, or pre-silicon verification.

•  Proficiency in Python, Perl, or similar languages for verification automation and regression infrastructure.

•  Strong understanding of the embedded firmware development process and how requirements, architecture, implementation, integration, test, debug, and release activities connect.

•  Proven firmware testing experience, including test planning, test-case design, negative and boundary testing, regression analysis, defect isolation, and coverage closure.

•  Familiarity with embedded interfaces such as I2C, PMBus, SPI, UART, or similar protocols.

•  Strong analytical, problem-solving, written communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

•  Experience verifying PMIC firmware, digital power management, voltage regulation, sequencing, telemetry, or protection features.

•  Hands-on experience developing, maintaining, or debugging SystemVerilog-based pre-silicon simulation environments.

•  Experience with waveform and debug tools such as SimVision, Verdi, or similar tools.

•  Working knowledge of RTL design and firmware-controlled digital subsystems.

•  Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated regression farms, test dashboards, and scalable failure-triage workflows.

•  Experience improving firmware testability through assertions, monitors, scoreboards, reference models, hooks, or diagnostic instrumentation.

•  Post-silicon bring-up or lab-debug experience is beneficial but is not the primary focus of this role.

•  Experience with QEMU, emulation, FPGA-based prototyping, virtual platforms, or other pre-silicon execution environments.

•  Exposure to UVM or other structured verification methodologies and coverage-driven verification.

jobs.title: Ethics & Compliance Investigations Manager
jobs.description:
The Ethics & Compliance Investigations Manager leads complex, hands-on internal investigations and supports ethics and compliance programs across Bosch Home Comfort’s North American operations.

This role provides leadership and strategic direction to help ensure the organization operates in accordance with applicable laws, regulations, and internal policies. The role translates compliance risks and business priorities into practical, risk-based actions; leads complex internal investigations from intake through fact-finding, interviews, findings, and recommendations; and supports implementation of the company’s broader Compliance Program, including risk assessments and training. As a trusted advisor to management and a role model for ethical behavior, the Compliance Investigations Manager promotes integrity, accountability, and a culture in which employees feel empowered to raise concerns without fear of retaliation.

Main Responsibilities

• Lead complex, hands-on internal investigations from initial intake and scoping through fact-finding, interviews, evidence review, findings, recommendations, reporting, and case closure, ensuring matters are handled thoroughly, objectively, consistently, and in a timely manner.
• Manage misconduct and compliance concerns raised through the Hotline and other reporting channels, assess allegations and risk, establish appropriate investigative approaches, and maintain independence and impartiality throughout the process.
• Investigate a range of ethics and compliance matters, including fraud and financial misconduct, bribery and corruption, conflicts of interest, third-party misconduct, whistleblower allegations, and other potential violations of law or company policy.
• Manage multiple investigations concurrently, prioritizing cases based on risk, severity, and business impact, coordinating appropriate resources, and maintaining timely and well-documented case progression.
• Gather and analyze relevant evidence, conduct investigative interviews, and prepare clear, well-supported findings and recommendations for relevant stakeholders and senior management.
• Identify current and emerging compliance risks and translate investigation trends, recurring issues, and business priorities into practical corrective actions, controls, and risk-mitigation measures.
• Support implementation of the company’s broader Compliance Program through compliance risk assessments, training, policy guidance, and practical advice on ethical decision-making and applicable requirements.
• Partner with Legal, Human Resources, Internal Audit, Finance, and other business functions as appropriate, while maintaining appropriate independence, confidentiality, and need-to-know handling of sensitive investigation information.
• Provide clear, decision-ready reporting to senior management on significant compliance matters, findings, risk implications, and recommended actions, and constructively challenge decisions that could compromise compliance or integrity.
• Promote a culture of integrity and speak-up behavior by reinforcing ethical standards, protection against retaliation, accountability, and leaders’ responsibility to model appropriate conduct.

Experience and Education

• Bachelor's degree in law, business administration, accounting, finance, criminal justice, or a related discipline.
• 7+ years of experience in compliance, investigations, ethics, legal, fraud, forensic accounting, internal audit, or a related risk function.
• Demonstrated hands-on experience leading complex internal investigations from intake and scoping through interviews, evidence review, findings, recommendations, reporting, and case closure.
• Experience investigating fraud, financial misconduct, bribery/corruption, conflicts of interest, third-party misconduct, whistleblower allegations, or other ethics and compliance matters.
• Proven ability to manage multiple investigations concurrently, prioritize matters based on risk, coordinate resources, and deliver timely, well-supported findings.
• Strong knowledge of relevant compliance laws, regulations, investigative practices, and emerging risk trends.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate complex information, identify risk, establish findings, and develop practical recommendations.
• Strong leadership and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build collaborative relationships and influence stakeholders with and without formal authority.
• Clear, persuasive communication and sound judgment, including the ability to present sensitive investigation findings and recommendations to senior management.
• Uncompromising ethical standards, integrity, impartial judgment, accountability, and willingness to raise concerns and challenge inappropriate practices.
• Ability to travel up to 30% domestically and internationally, including on short notice as required to support investigations and business needs.

Preferred Skills and Qualifications

• Experience conducting fraud, anti-bribery/anti-corruption, AML or other financial misconduct investigations.
• Experience with investigative interviewing, eDiscovery, electronic evidence review, or investigative case-management tools.
• Experience conducting compliance risk assessments, audits, or internal control reviews.
• Experience with third-party due diligence and investigations involving suppliers, vendors, or other business partners.
• Spanish-language proficiency to support communication and collaboration with Spanish-speaking stakeholders.

Investigate, analyze, and assist with corrective actions to supplier quality concerns to develop and maintain overall supplier delivery and final product performance.

• Take ownership for the definition, updating, and communication of the HydraForce Supplier Quality Assurance Manual requirements internally within HydraForce and externally to the supply base.
• Work together with the Purchasing Team to identify and qualify new suppliers and in developing existing suppliers to meet the business needs and better manage product life cycle.

• Develop and implement a follow up mechanism with suppliers on a regular basis with an end toward increasing the Quality performance.

• Education & Licensing You hold a high school diploma or GED, are at least 18 years old, hold a valid driver's license with a clean driving record, and are authorized to work in the United States
• Technical Skills You possess basic computer navigation skills and are familiar with Microsoft Office applications such as Excel
• Communication & Teamwork You have excellent communication skills and thrive as a team player in a fast-paced environment, coordinating effectively across departments with a positive attitude
• Schedule Flexibility You can work up to 40 hours per week, including day or evening shifts and weekend shifts

WHAT WE OFFER

• Bonus Plan Take advantage of a bonus plan based on performance

jobs.description:

jobs.title: HouseKeeper
jobs.description:
Salary Range: $16.00 - $17.00 Hourly

Reports To

The Housekeeper reports directly to the Maintenance Director.

Job Overview

The Housekeeper is responsible for maintaining resident apartments and common areas to established cleaning, sanitation, safety, and presentation standards as assigned by the Maintenance Director.

Responsibilities and Duties

• Provide housekeeping services in resident apartments by dusting, sweeping, mopping, vacuuming, cleaning and disinfecting bathrooms and high-touch surfaces, emptying trash, making beds, and changing bed and bath linens.

• Follow the assigned resident service schedule, which may consist of routine apartment cleaning, scheduled deep cleaning, and general upkeep in Independent Living, Assisted Living, and Memory Care.

• Clean and sanitize assigned common areas daily, including entrances, corridors, lounges, activity spaces, dining areas, elevators, offices, and guest bathrooms.

• Complete routine common-area rounds and wipe-throughs as assigned, responding to spills, cleanliness concerns, restocking needs, and changing priorities.

• Complete other resident apartments, common-area, and periodic cleaning assignments based on community needs and the daily work plan.

• Perform assigned deep-cleaning and periodic tasks, including carpet and hard-floor care, baseboards, high and low dusting, windows and window treatments, accessible exterior entry areas and glass, cleaning under or behind furniture, and approved furniture touch-ups.

• Follow standardized cleaning methods: complete a visual pre-check; work from cleaner to dirtier areas and from high to low; clean high-touch points; complete floors last; and conduct a final inspection.

• Maintain the housekeeping cart to standard; separate clean and soiled items; secure chemicals; use required personal protective equipment and wet-floor signs; follow labels, Safety Data Sheets, and contact times; and never mix chemicals.

• Maintain storage areas and equipment; document completed work; report maintenance and safety concerns to the Maintenance Director; protect resident privacy and property; attend required training; and comply with applicable requirements and community policies.

• Other duties as assigned.

• High school diploma or GED preferred.

• Previous housekeeping or cleaning experience; senior living experience preferred.

• Dependable, organized, and able to follow an assigned route independently or as part of a team.

• Able to communicate respectfully, protect confidentiality, and follow product labels, Safety Data Sheets, checklists, and written instructions.

Physical Abilities

• While performing these duties, the associate frequently stands, walks, reaches, bends, stoops, kneels, crouches, and uses fine and gross motor skills.

• Must be able to lift or carry up to 50 lbs., with reasonable accommodation as applicable; push and pull carts and equipment; and use proper body mechanics. This role does not physically assist, lift, transfer, or reposition residents; contact the care team for assistance.

jobs.title: Industrial Boiler & Steam Operator (1st Shift)
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Boiler & Steam Operator to take primary ownership of our plant’s low-pressure boiler, steam, and compressed air infrastructure. Hands-on low-pressure boiler and steam experience is required. This role focuses heavily on boiler management, industrial steam distribution, mechanical plumbing, and compressor maintenance, with commercial HVAC serving as an added bonus.

Key Responsibilities

• Boiler & Steam Operations (Core Focus): Safely operate, monitor, and maintain low-pressure boilers and industrial steam distribution systems. Perform daily water chemical testing, system blowdowns, steam trap maintenance, and valve inspections.
• Compressed Air Systems: Maintain, troubleshoot, and execute preventive maintenance on industrial air compressors, air dryers, filters, and pneumatic piping.
• Mechanical Plumbing & Pipefitting: Install, modify, and repair steam piping, condensate return lines, water connections, and compressed air lines (heavy mechanical plumbing emphasis over electrical work).
• Preventive Maintenance: Carry out daily, monthly, semi-annual, and annual PMs across all boiler, steam loop, and compressed air equipment.
• Diagnostics & System Tracing: Read as-built piping schematics, blueprints, and pressure gauges to identify leaks, pressure drops, or equipment issues using standard hand and power tools.
• Inventory & Parts Ordering: Maintain inventory and order replacement parts for boilers, pipe fittings, valves, and air compressor systems.
• Safety & Compliance: Ensure full compliance with local boiler codes, safety regulations, EPA rules, and environmental standards.
• HVAC Support (Bonus): Provide basic troubleshooting for commercial HVAC equipment and Metasys building automation systems as needed.

Required:

• Boiler & Steam Expertise: Proven experience operating and maintaining low-pressure boilers and industrial steam systems.
• Compressed Air Equipment: Experience running, troubleshooting, and servicing industrial air compressors and air piping.
• Plumbing & Pipefitting Skills: Strong mechanical plumbing capabilities, including soldering, brazing, pipe fitting, and valve rebuilds.
• Technical Skills: Ability to read piping schematics, use pressure gauges and diagnostic tools, and troubleshoot mechanical loops.

Preferred / Bonus:

• Commercial HVAC troubleshooting experience.
• Familiarity with Metasys Building Automation Systems (BAS).

Physical Requirements & Environmental Conditions

• Physical Demands: Standing, walking, stooping, kneeling, crawling, squatting, reaching, and climbing ladders or elevated platforms.
• Lifting: Ability to lift, carry, push, or pull up to 50 lbs solo and up to 100 lbs as a team lift.
• Fine Motor Skills: Frequent use of hands for pipe fitting, valve assembly, and fine mechanical adjustments.
• Work Environment: Comfortable working around low-pressure steam lines, moving machinery, elevated heights, and in varying thermal and atmospheric conditions (heat, humidity, dust, fumes).
