• We’ve worked with some of the biggest enterprises in utilities and the public sector such as Hydro One, Liberty Utilities, the Government of Canada, and the Province of Ontario.

• We’re a team of 50+ staff and a network of 200+ alumni with 17+ years of experience delivering SAP solutions.

 

What you'll need

Mandatory Qualifications

 - Must have a minimum of five (5) years experience in delivering software solutions

 - Must have a minimum of two (2) years experience in developing AI solutions

 - Resource must be able to work and be located full-time on site at in Regina, Monday to Friday

 - Have a recognized bachelor’s degree or technical diploma in computer science, information systems, engineering, or a related discipline

 - Have a minimum of three (3) years of development experience using C# .NET

 - Have a minimum of three (3) years of development experience using Python

 - Have a minimum of two (2) years experience in developing and deploying AI solutions using Azure Foundry or a comparable AI development platform

 - Have a minimum of two (2) years experience in developing AI agents and chatbots, including tool calling, workflow orchestration and integration with enterprise APIs

 - Have a minimum of two (2) years experience in implementing retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector indexes and grounded responses over enterprise information

 - Have a minimum of two (2) years experience in integrating AI services through APIs and SDKs, including authentication, permissions, error handling and testing

 - Have a minimum of two (2) years experience in defining and applying AI quality evaluations and acceptance criteria, including handling incorrect responses and failed tool actions

 - Have a minimum of two (2) years experience in using Git, code reviews, automated testing and CI/CD processes

 - Have a minimum of two (2) years experience in using AI-assisted and agentic software development tools, such as GitHub Copilot, Codex or equivalent

 - Have a minimum of one (1) year experience in developing solutions and workflows using ChatGPT Enterprise

 - Have a minimum of one (1) year experience in using or integrating with Databricks

 - Have a minimum of one (1) year experience in developing custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers or integrating AI solutions with MCP tools, including enterprise data services such as Databricks

Nice-to-Have

 - Have a minimum of two (2) years experience in leading AI initiatives independently through discovery, scoping, prioritization, architecture, implementation, support and benefits realization

 - Have a minimum of two (2) years experience in deploying and supporting production AI solutions, including monitoring, usage cost management and operational handover

 - Have a minimum of two (2) years experience in working with business stakeholders to assess value, establish benefit measures and evaluate realized outcomes

 

Who you are

 - Problem solver: You quickly formulate approaches from problem statements and target outcomes, undertake research using creative strategies, solve complex problems independently, and quickly learn and adapt to new situations.

 - Highly organized: You think in systems and process, create structure in ambiguity, and relentlessly prioritize to pursue what drives the business forward.

 - Clear communicator: You are an excellent writer (memos, slides) and excel at distilling complex information into simple messaging.

 - Outcomes driven: You collaborate with your clients, partners, and stakeholders to deeply understand their needs and ruthlessly prioritize to meet those needs.

 

Additional information

 - Duration: 1 year

 - Onsite (Regina, Saskatchewan - 5 times a week)

 - Background check required

jobs.title: Senior Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

About the Role

Rippling is building a unified platform that brings together the systems businesses rely on to manage their people, operations, and finances. Our Spend products are reimagining how companies manage and control business spending, bringing together financial workflows, automation, and real-time visibility into a single, seamless experience.

We're looking for a Senior Director of Engineering to help shape the next phase of growth for our Spend organization. This is a high-impact leadership opportunity at the intersection of financial technology, enterprise software, and large-scale distributed systems.

You'll play a critical role in defining technical strategy, scaling engineering teams, and delivering innovative products that solve complex problems for businesses of all sizes. We're looking for a leader who combines deep technical expertise with strong product instincts, organizational leadership, and a track record of building exceptional teams.

What You Will Do

• Drive the engineering vision, strategy, and execution for a growing portfolio of financial technology products.
• Build, lead, and develop high-performing engineering teams, fostering a culture of technical excellence, ownership, and innovation.
• Partner closely with Product, Design, and cross-functional leadership to define product strategy, prioritize investments, and deliver exceptional customer experiences.
• Lead architectural and technical decisions across complex, highly scalable systems, balancing long-term platform investments with rapid product development.
• Establish engineering practices and organizational structures that enable teams to move quickly while maintaining high standards for reliability, security, and quality.
• Identify opportunities to leverage automation, AI, and emerging technologies to transform how businesses manage financial operations.
• Attract, mentor, and develop exceptional engineering leaders, building a strong leadership bench as the organization scales.
• Navigate ambiguity, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and drive execution across multiple teams and initiatives in a fast-paced environment.

What You Will Need

• 12+ years of software engineering experience, including significant experience leading and scaling engineering organizations.
• A proven track record of building and delivering complex, customer-facing products at scale, ideally within fintech, financial infrastructure, or enterprise SaaS.
• Experience leading multiple engineering teams and developing engineering managers and senior technical leaders.
• Strong technical depth, with the ability to engage in architectural discussions, challenge technical decisions, and guide teams through complex engineering problems.
• Demonstrated success partnering with Product and business leaders to translate ambitious product visions into scalable technical strategies.
• Experience operating in high-growth environments, with a strong bias toward action, ownership, and execution.
• Exceptional leadership and communication skills, with the ability to influence across organizations and align teams around shared priorities.
• A builder's mindset, strong product intuition, and a passion for developing both technology and people.

This role will receive a competitive salary + benefits + equity. The salary for US-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here.

jobs.title: Fieldwork Co-ordinator
jobs.description:
Main duties and requirements

The Fieldwork Co-ordinator is responsible for overseeing the end-to-end delivery of international fieldwork projects within SAM, either through InterCo or when fieldwork is outsourced to external suppliers. Acting as the key liaison between clients, internal stakeholders, and fieldwork partners, the role ensures projects are delivered efficiently, on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. Responsibilities include project planning and tracking, supplier management, budget oversight, issue resolution, performance reporting, audit support, and the identification and sharing of best practices to drive operational excellence.

Project Planning and Feasibility

• Cost InterCo fieldwork using established ratecards or in collaboration with InterCo colleagues.
• Source, evaluate, and obtain quotations from external fieldwork suppliers when necessary.
• Recommend and appoint external suppliers based on project requirements, budget, quality standards, and capacity.

Project Delivery & Management

• Manage the day-to-day delivery of projects from commission through to completion of data collection.
• Coordinate project kick-off meetings with all relevant stakeholders.
• Develop and maintain detailed project plans and timelines, monitoring progress against key milestones.
• Monitor recruitment performance against agreed quotas and project specifications.
• Ensure fieldwork is delivered on time, within budget, to the required quality standards and in line with client expectations.
• Manage project changes, including updates to timelines, scope, quotas, or recruitment requirements.
• Proactively identify project risks and implement mitigation plans to minimise impact on project delivery.
• Escalate project issues and delivery risks as appropriate.

Stakeholder & Client Management

• Act as the central point of contact between clients, research teams, fieldwork teams and external suppliers.
• Provide regular project updates and status reports to stakeholders.
• Liaise with research teams and clients to resolve any fieldwork issues to ensure smooth project execution and high levels of client satisfaction.

Supplier Management

• Develop and maintain relationships with fieldwork suppliers across multiple markets.
• Monitor supplier performance against agreed service levels, timelines and quality standards.
• Conduct post-project evaluations and provide feedback where appropriate.
• Maintain awareness of supplier capabilities, strengths, and market coverage to support future project requirements.
• Support the onboarding, evaluation, and ongoing performance management of fieldwork suppliers.

Financial & Performance Management

• Monitor project budgets and supplier costs, escalating concerns where necessary.
• Raise purchase orders and support the processing of supplier invoices.

Quality, Compliance & Continuous Improvement

• Support audit activities to ensure adherence to agreed processes and quality standards.
• Ensure project documentation and supplier activities comply with company processes, information security requirements, and applicable data protection regulations.
• Identify and promote best practice, sharing learnings and improvements across internal teams.

• Graduate level qualification (or equivalent experience).
• Strong IT skills, including proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
• High level of attention to detail and organisational ability.
• Able to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment with time sensitive deadlines.

jobs.title: Triage Nurse-Medical Oncology Full time Days
jobs.description:
**This is a Full Time position at 40 hours per week located the Lake Forest Hospital Cancer Center. Schedule is Monday through Friday with some remote capabilities.**

The Triage Nurse reflects the mission, vision, and values of Northwestern Memorial, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

The Triage Nurse provides clinically expert triage service within a physicians’ practice. In their role, triage nurses serve as liaisons between patients and physicians, assessing and determining the acuity of patients’ symptoms and communicating these to the physicians as appropriate. They provide education to patients and to staff concerning clinical issues. Triage nurses must demonstrate excellent customer service and communication skills and the ability to function as part of a highly effective team that consistently puts “Patients First.”

Responsibilities:

• Establish positive first impressions with patients and customers, establishing a role as patient advocate.
• Triage all incoming telephone calls and electronic messages, prioritizing and resolving, involving the provider as appropriate, successfully completing the communication cycle.
• Document all communications in the electronic medical record.
• Schedule patient for visit with provider when telephone assessment indicates this.
• Assist in obtaining appointment for patients with specialists within NM.
• Coordinate emergency and hospital transfers, including paperwork and telephone communications.
• Administer medications and treatments in accordance with Nursing Standards and as ordered by the provider.
• Provide education to patients and staff concerning clinical issues.
• Assist in coordinating and monitoring activities of clinical staff to ensure adequate coverage and adherence to OSHA and CDC guidelines.
• Assist in orientation of new staff members.
• Perform other duties as assigned; may include:Assist in specific process improvement projects.Administer intravenous and injectable medications to adult, geriatric and wheelchair bound patients. Must demonstrate competency for age related responsibilities.Quality control must be maintained during all aspects of patient care. The triage nurse ensures that all exam rooms and equipment are maintained according to OSHA and CDC guidelines.Participates in departmental quality improvement activities.
• For triage nurses in the Immediate Care Clinics (ICC), float to other ICCs/departments.

Required:

• Graduate of accredited RN program.
• At least 3 years of experience in a hospital or outpatient setting.
• Current Registered Nurse License issued by State of Illinois.
• American Heart Association Basic Life Support CPR certification.

Preferred:

• BSN
• Specialty Certified
• At least 5 years’ experience in a hospital or outpatient setting
• Spanish speaking

Northwestern Medicine is an equal opportunity employer (disability, VETS) and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status.

Background Check

Northwestern Medicine conducts a background check that includes criminal history on newly hired team members and, at times, internal transfers. If you are offered a position with us, you will be required to complete an authorization and disclosure form that gives Northwestern Medicine permission to run the background check.  Results are evaluated on a case-by-case basis, and we follow all local, state, and federal laws, including the Illinois Health Care Worker Background Check Act.

Artificial Intelligence Disclosure

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools may be used in some portions of the candidate review process for this position, however, all employment decisions will be made by a person.

Benefits

We offer a wide range of benefits that provide employees with tools and resources to improve their physical, emotional, and financial well-being while providing protection for unexpected life events.

Click on or copy and paste URL to your browser to view detailed benefits information https://jobs.nm.org/benefits

Exception: New graduate internal employees seeking their first licensed clinical position as a Registered Nurse at NM may be eligible.

EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS

jobs.title: SN - Head of Performance Marketing - Jumia (full time)
jobs.description:
About Jumia:

Jumia is a leading pan-African e-commerce platform. Its mission is to improve the quality of everyday life in Africa by leveraging technology to deliver innovative, convenient and affordable online services to customers, while helping businesses grow as they use Jumia's platform to better reach and serve customers.

Jumia is built around a marketplace and supported by a proprietary logistics business [Jumia Logistics] and a digital payment and fintech platform [Jumia Pay]. With over 3,000 employees, Jumia is led by top talented leaders offering a great mix of local and international talents and is backed by very high-profile shareholders. Jumia is committed to creating a sustainable impact in Africa.

In April 2019, Jumia was the first Tech company in Africa to be listed on the New York Stock Exchange.

Summary:
The Head of Performance is responsible for marketing channel efficiency and the execution of marketing initiatives. The role centers on marketing analytics: measuring the return of each channel and action, identifying growth drivers, and turning these insights into actionable decisions (budget allocation, priorities, action plans). They lead the Paid OM, Online, CRM, and JForce functions in project mode, coordinating with other departments to acquire, activate, and retain customers at optimal cost.

What you will be doing :

• Set up and lead the routine monitoring of critical KPIs: new customers, CIR, traffic, conversion rates, customer acquisition cost (CAC), and GMV per channel.

• Detect deviations from targets, identify underlying root causes, and trigger corrective action plans with channel owners.

• Produce and present daily, weekly, and monthly performance reporting, including clear executive summaries outlining observations, drivers, and recommendations for the CMO and leadership.

• Build and maintain real-time marketing performance dashboards in collaboration with the BI team.

• Validate monthly digital marketing targets, define KPIs, recommend budget allocation based on channel profitability, and drive the execution plan in PMO mode.

• Steer marketing and cross-functional projects by tracking scope, milestones, deliverables, risks, budgets, and post-closure retrospectives to share key learnings.

• Lead priority growth initiatives across customer retention, reactivation, mobile app adoption, and purchase frequency using hypothesis-driven A/B testing protocols.

• Gather and deploy marketing best practices across the Jumia Group while collaborating with the Commercial team to unlock data-driven growth opportunities.

• Guide, develop, and evaluate channel owners through measurable targets, 1-on-1s, and regular performance reviews.

• Measure acquisition contribution, return on ad spend (ROAS), and cost per order across every channel and campaign against previous and YoY periods.

• Track new customer cohorts at 30, 60, and 90 days to evaluate retention, repeat purchases, and customer value.

• Segment the customer database by frequency, spend, tenure, and purchase categories to guide acquisition and CRM strategies.

• Analyze the entire purchase funnel—from visit and add-to-cart to final checkout—to identify and resolve drop-off points.

• Guarantee the accuracy of tracking and attribution tools (GA4, Adjust, pixels) while reconciling conflicting data sources.

• Evaluate the true incremental impact of marketing actions using control groups and A/B tests beyond self-reported platform metrics.

• Prepare forecasts, budgets, and targets for major commercial events (Black Friday, Anniversary, seasonal campaigns), monitor execution in real time, and deliver comparative post-mortems.

• Continuously optimize performance by reallocating budgets toward top-performing channels, scaling conclusive tests, and terminating unprofitable initiatives.

• Steer Paid Online Marketing (Paid OM) across Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, and other ad networks in coordination with Commercial, Finance, and Group teams to manage spend, CPA, and installs.

• Oversee organic and brand channels (Online)—including SEO, social media, content, affiliate marketing, and influencers—in collaboration with Tech and Communications.

• Drive CRM campaigns alongside Product, Tech, and Customer Service to expand the opt-in base and increase customer lifetime value.

• Partner with JForce, Commercial, Operations, Logistics, and Finance to optimize agent recruitment, retention, active engagement, and order generation.

• Run governance rituals including daily KPI pulses, weekly performance reviews, weekly cross-departmental project committees, monthly business reviews, and post-campaign retrospectives.

• Maintain direct accountability for monthly new customer targets, cost per new customer, group CIR compliance, cohort retention, budget adherence, and the share of orders completed on the mobile app.

• Bring over 3 years of digital marketing experience—ideally in e-commerce or performance-driven environments—with strong expertise in GA4, Meta Business Manager, Google Ads, mobile attribution platforms, Power BI, and Claude.

• Demonstrate advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets, hands-on experience with BI tools (Power BI, Looker Studio), working knowledge of SQL, and proven strength in cross-functional project management.

What we are looking for :

• Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field.

• Minimum of 7 years of experience in performance marketing or digital marketing roles, with at least 3 years in a leadership position.

• Proven track record of managing successful multi-channel marketing campaigns.

• Strong analytical skills with experience using marketing analytics tools such as Google Analytics, Tableau, or similar.

• Excellent leadership and team management abilities.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

We Offer:

• A unique experience in an entrepreneurial, yet structured environment

• A unique opportunity of having strong impact in building the African e-commerce sector

• The opportunity to become part of a highly professional and dynamic team

• An unparalleled personal and professional growth as our longer-term objective is to train the next generation of leaders

Please ensure to only apply for jobs with Jumia through our official website.

Jumia will never charge you a fee to apply for a job: be wary of websites that claim to help you apply for a Jumia job or that charge a fee to get you a job.

jobs.description:
About Us

 

Sprinter Health is an on-demand mobile health service that sends medical professionals to patients’ homes to perform blood draws, diagnostic and low acuity services, and wellness visits. We are building the clinical and technological infrastructure to realize a future of healthcare untethered.  We have a rapidly growing team of visionary leaders who are passionate about increasing access to care, lowering healthcare costs, and improving outcomes for patients.

 

About The Role

 

Are you ready to join the pioneering healthcare team at Sprinter Health? We're looking for dynamic Nurse Practitioners who are ready to revolutionize healthcare delivery by conducting virtual wellness visits directly to patients in the comfort of their homes. As a Nurse Practitioner with Sprinter Health, you'll leverage your medical expertise to offer a wide range of healthcare services that could include but not limited to virtual adult and/or pediatric wellness visits, health assessments, and more!

 

Successful candidates will have prior experience performing wellness visits, along with key traits such as dependability, professionalism, and problem-solving abilities. A commitment to delivering exceptional customer service is essential, as is the ability to work autonomously while maintaining high-quality standards.

 

Above all, we're seeking individuals who are friendly, compassionate, empathetic, and deeply invested in providing personalized care to every patient they serve. If you're ready to make a difference in patients' lives and shape the future of healthcare, we invite you to join us at Sprinter Health.

jobs.title: Business Process Analyst
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Business Process Analyst to support ForTec Medical's Systems Design & Intelligence (SDI) team by analyzing, documenting, and maintaining business processes across the organization. The primary focus of this role is transforming meeting transcripts, business interviews, discovery sessions, and existing documentation into accurate, organized, and reusable process maps, process narratives, and supporting knowledge materials.

Working closely with functional SDI team members and business stakeholders, the analyst helps document current-state processes, identify gaps and inconsistencies, and develop a shared understanding of how business activities, teams, and systems interact. The position also contributes to the SDI process knowledge repository by organizing and maintaining process documentation and related materials for validation, traceability, and reuse. Through participation in discovery and validation activities, the analyst develops broader business analysis and process improvement capabilities over time.

Business Process Documentation & Mapping:

• Analyze meeting transcripts, discovery notes, existing procedures, system documentation, and other source materials to develop accurate current-state business process documentation.
• Create and maintain process maps, workflows, SIPOC diagrams, swimlane diagrams, and supporting process narratives using established SDI methodologies, templates, and standards.
• Document process activities, decision points, business rules, participating teams, roles and responsibilities, handoffs, exceptions, workarounds, and interactions between business systems.
• Organize complex or incomplete information into clear, logical, and understandable documentation, identifying gaps, inconsistencies, and areas requiring clarification.
• Refine documentation based on feedback from functional SDI members and business subject matter experts, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and appropriate levels of detail.

Process Discovery & Analysis:

• Work alongside functional SDI team members to learn and understand business operations, workflows, and supporting systems.
• Participate in business process discovery meetings, stakeholder interviews, workshops, and system demonstrations, capturing key information and asking clarifying questions.
• Research and investigate business processes using available documentation, meeting recordings, and other approved information sources.
• Assist in identifying process gaps, inefficiencies, manual workarounds, and opportunities for improvement.
• Assist with targeted follow-up discussions to clarify process details, resolve documentation questions, and support increasingly independent process analysis.

Process Knowledge Management & SDI Collaboration:

• Organize, maintain, and update process documentation within the SDI process knowledge repository and approved collaboration tools, applying consistent templates, naming conventions, classifications, and version control practices.
• Maintain appropriate links between process documentation, project artifacts, supporting source materials, decisions, and related business or systems information to ensure traceability, context, and reuse.
• Collaborate with functional SDI members, business process owners, and IT teams to validate documentation and support a shared understanding of business processes.
• Support SDI initiatives by capturing and preserving process knowledge developed through discovery and project activities, providing documentation that supports future analysis, process design, and system improvements.
• Learn and apply approved process mapping, collaboration, and AI-assisted documentation tools while contributing ideas to improve documentation practices and team effectiveness.

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Operations, Industrial Engineering, or related field, or an equivalent combination of education, training and relevant experience.
• 1–3 years of experience in business analysis, business process documentation, operations analysis, or a related field preferred. Candidates with less experience who demonstrate strong analytical aptitude and relevant skills will be considered.
• Experience creating process maps, workflow diagrams, or structured business documentation through employment, internships, academic projects, or other relevant experience.
• Familiarity with business process mapping techniques, including flowcharts, SIPOC diagrams, and swimlane diagrams.
• Experience with process mapping tools such as Miro, Microsoft Visio, Lucidchart, or similar applications preferred.
• Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including Word, Excel, Teams, and SharePoint.
• Familiarity with enterprise business applications, such as ERP, CRM, or other operational systems, and exposure to Lean, Six Sigma, or similar process improvement methodologies are beneficial but not required.

What You Need to Be Successful

• Strong analytical thinking, curiosity, and a willingness to learn.
• The ability to organize complex information, work diligently through details, ask thoughtful questions, and produce high-quality documentation.
• Strong collaboration skills, receptiveness to feedback, and a commitment to professional growth are also important.
• Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and completeness when reviewing information and producing documentation.
• Patience, persistence, and a strong work ethic, with a willingness to work diligently through detailed and sometimes repetitive analytical tasks.
• Strong written communication skills, with the ability to translate complex information into clear, logical, and understandable documentation.
• Active listening and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively, seek clarification, and communicate comfortably with colleagues at different levels of the organization.
• Highly organized, self-motivated, curious, and eager to learn, with a willingness to accept feedback, follow established methodologies, and continuously develop new skills.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Plant Operator - RMW (3:30pm - 2:00am)
jobs.description:
Our story began with a passionate idea that we could change the world.... And to be honest, we’ve never stopped believing that... In 1986 it was a simple concept that microbiology teamed with innovation and clinical contribution could eliminate an issue that was profoundly impacting the healthcare industry – HIV acquired through needle-stick injuries.
 
In Australia, we lived out our dream. Investing years into R&D to create the safest containment system in the world and taking on the industry status quo to petition for higher standards in sharps protection, we witnessed an 80+ percent reduction in disposal-related needlestick injuries nationwide. The ideal Plant Operator is an individual who likes variety in their work and can think through practical problems.

jobs.description:
Second Front Systems is looking for a customer-obsessed, mission-driven, high-agency Director of Commercial Mission Success to lead and scale our Commercial Mission Success organization.


As the leader of the team at the frontline of the Second Front customer journey, you will own the end-to-end customer experience across our Game Warden portfolio, from contract signature through kickoff, implementation, authorization, steady-state support, and renewal. You will build and develop a high-performing team of Mission Success Managers, define the playbooks and metrics that drive customer outcomes, and serve as the first point of escalation for our accounts.


As a senior leader who partners with nearly every function at Second Front, including Sales, Engineering, Security, Product, and Finance, you will ensure that customers achieve authorization and secure deployment of their SaaS solutions, and that the voice of the customer, and the missions they support, shapes how we build and grow.


Note: Candidates must reside in one of our approved hiring hubs:
• DC/Maryland/Virginia
• Denver/Colorado Springs, CO

What You'll Do

 - Lead, hire, coach, and develop a team of Mission Success Managers, setting clear expectations, portfolio assignments, and career growth paths.

 - Own Commercial Mission Success strategy and operating model, including customer segmentation, coverage models, and team capacity planning as the business scales.

 - Define and own key customer health and retention metrics (e.g., gross and net revenue retention, time-to-ATO, customer health scores, CSAT/NPS) and report on them to executive leadership.

 - Build repeatable, scalable playbooks for kickoff, onboarding, implementation, ATO/FedRAMP navigation, QBRs, and renewals.

 - Serve as a critical sponsor for customers, building trusted relationships with customer leadership.

 - Act as the senior escalation point for high-severity customer issues, driving cross-functional resolution with Support, Engineering, and Security leadership.

 - Partner with Sales and Finance to own the renewal forecast and drive expansion and upsell strategy across the portfolio.

 - Drive tooling and process maturity across Salesforce, Jira, and customer health systems to improve visibility and operational rigor.

What You Bring

 - 10+ years of leadership experience, building and managing teams, preferably in customer/mission success, or technical delivery supporting PaaS or cloud infrastructure in government contracts.

 - Direct experience working in or supporting the Department of War (DoW) or Federal Civilian agencies.

 - Proven track record owning retention and expansion outcomes, including renewal forecasting and revenue targets.

 - Working knowledge of Authority to Operate (ATO), FedRAMP, or equivalent compliance frameworks.

 - Strong understanding of IaaS, PaaS, and/or SaaS delivery models.

 - Executive presence and the ability to manage complex relationships across technical, non-technical, and senior government stakeholders.

 - Experience designing and scaling customer success processes, metrics, and playbooks.

 - U.S. citizenship is required for this role.

Preferred

 - Experience leading customer success teams in an IaaS, PaaS, or SaaS environment.

 - Experience scaling a team or function in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment.

 - Experience with customer success platforms alongside Salesforce and Jira.

 - Active security clearance or eligibility to obtain one.

The base salary for this position will fall between $170,000 and $195,000. Your ultimate compensation will be determined by professional background, technical proficiency, seniority, and regional cost factors. Furthermore, this opportunity includes potential eligibility for equity awards and discretionary bonuses, rounding out a comprehensive total rewards offering.


Success at 2F Looks Like:
• A proactive and solutions oriented mindset
• Viewing obstacles as opportunities for growth
• Having a bias toward action and tangible, measurable results
• Being team-oriented with a focus on personal responsibility and autonomy

Perks & Benefits:
This role is a full time position. As a public benefit corporation, we’re a team of purpose-driven trailblazers transforming the future of U.S. national security. We hire the best to do their best and, as such, we are committed to providing the perks and benefits you need to be successful—both in- and outside the workplace.


Perks of Joining Our Team:
• Competitive salary
• 100% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents
• 401(k) with a 3% company contribution
• Comprehensive wellness benefits, including a One Medical membership, mental health resources, family planning support, and more
• Equity incentive plan
• New hire technology and home office stipend
• Annual professional development stipend
• Flexible paid time off, plus all federal holidays
• Generous parental leave
• Flexible remote work opportunities
• Employee referral bonus program
Visit our careers page to learn more.


Who We Are:
Second Front Systems (2F) is a public-benefit software company powering software for the free world. We eliminate the friction that slows innovation, enabling faster, more secure development and deployment of software across government and regulated networks. Built by national security veterans and backed by top-tier venture capital, our platform is trusted by the world’s leading organizations to cut deployment timelines from years to weeks. We move fast, solve hard problems, and deliver trusted capabilities where they’re needed most. Our work strengthens global security and gives the United States and its allies a lasting competitive advantage. Learn more at secondfront.com http://secondfront.com.

jobs.description:
SmartBear delivers application integrity for modern tech stacks, ensuring continuous, measurable assurance that software just works as intended with governance to operate at AI speed and scale. SmartBear offers deep test automation, API lifecycle management, and observability capabilities. With integrations across the SDLC, it sets a new quality standard for application delivery teams.

SmartBear is trusted by developers, testers, and software engineers across 32,000 organizations, including 75% of the largest financial institutions and industry leaders such as Adobe, JetBlue, and Microsoft. SmartBear’s open source tools are downloaded more than 100 million times a month and have earned over 30,000 GitHub stars from the developer community. With its best-loved brands, including Swagger, TestComplete, Reflect, QMetry, Zephyr, and more, SmartBear meets customers where they are to make our technology-driven world a better place. Learn more at www.smartbear.com, or follow us on LinkedIn, X, and Reddit.

At SmartBear, you will be part of a dynamic team solving one of the most critical challenges facing modern businesses: ensuring the integrity of software in an AI-driven world. Whether you are working directly with customers, driving go to market strategies, supporting operations, building products, or enabling teams, your contributions help shape the future of software quality for organizations worldwide. Join us in our mission.

About the role

SmartBear is hiring a Sr. Paid Media Manager to own our paid search, paid social and third-party paid programs, and to manage our agency partner. You'll run a multi-million dollar budget with a clear mandate: drive pipeline growth at a positive, provable return.

Primary objective: Drive campaigns that produce pipeline and ARR for the business.

This role sits in Demand Generation as a centralized service. You'll partner with the product-aligned demand gen teams to turn their goals into campaigns that perform. You'll report to the VP of Demand Generation.

What you'll do

• Paid search: Plan, build and optimize campaigns on Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising to hit growth and profitability targets.

• Paid social: Run campaigns across LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit and YouTube that grow reach and drive qualified leads at a positive ROI.

• Third-party paid programs: Manage paid placements with review sites, newsletters, content syndication and media partners, and judge each on pipeline contribution.

• Category awareness strategy: Set the strategy for building market awareness of a new category through paid media programs, including connected TV, paid social and programmatic ads.

• Agency management: Lead our paid media agency day to day. Set priorities, review performance and hold the team accountable to results.

• Budget ownership: Manage a multi-million dollar budget, pace spend against plan and reallocate funds to the channels that perform.

• Return on investment: Partner with Finance to show the return from paid campaigns, then recommend where to pivot or invest more.

• Cross-team alignment: Work closely with the product-aligned demand gen teams so campaigns support their launches, offers and pipeline goals.

• Measurement and reporting: Use GA4, Salesforce and Tableau to track performance from click to closed-won revenue, and share clear readouts with stakeholders.

• Testing: Run ongoing tests on audiences, creative, landing pages and bidding to keep improving results.

What you'll bring

• 4–6 years of hands-on paid media experience across search and social.

• Proven success managing a multi-million dollar paid media budget against plan.

• Deep working knowledge of Google Ads, Microsoft Advertising, LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit and YouTube.

• Experience with GA4 and Salesforce for tracking, attribution and pipeline reporting.

• Experience managing an agency, including setting goals, reviewing work and holding it to performance targets.

• A strong analytical mindset. You're comfortable building the business case for spend with Finance.

• Clear communication and the ability to work across teams with competing priorities.

• Builds AI into repeatable workflows for paid media analysis, from budget pacing to trend detection, and checks the quality of what those workflows produce.

Nice to have

• A major plus: Experience running paid media for both a product-led growth (PLG) motion that drives free trials and a sales-led motion that drives leads.

• Experience in a B2B SaaS environment, ideally with technical or developer audiences.

• Experience with Marketo or HubSpot.

• Familiarity with multi-touch attribution and with long, multi-stakeholder B2B buying cycles.

Why You Should Join the SmartBear Crew

• You can grow your career at every level.

• We invest in your success as well as the spaces where our teams come together to work, collaborate, and have fun.

• We love celebrating our SmartBears; we even encourage our crew to take their birthdays off.

• We are guided by a People and Culture organisation — an important distinction for us. We think about our team holistically — the whole person.

• We celebrate our differences in experiences, viewpoints, and identities because we know it leads to better outcomes.

Did You Know?

• Our main goal at SmartBear is to make our technology-driven world a better place.

• SmartBear is committed to ethical corporate practices and social responsibility, promoting good in all the communities we serve.

• SmartBear is headquartered in Somerville, MA with offices across the world including Galway, Ireland; Bath, UK; Wroclaw, Poland; and Bangalore, India.

SmartBear is committed to creating an inclusive workplace for employees where all individuals are treated with respect and dignity. We are an equal opportunity employer and make employment decisions based on merit, qualifications, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, gender, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other protected status under applicable laws. This includes performance-based bonuses for eligible roles, a generous benefits package that supports employees’ health and well-being, and promotes work-life balance through flexible time off and hybrid work options.  You can build your career at SmartBear through professional development opportunities, and an inclusive, collaborative culture where everyone can thrive.

jobs.title: IT Support Engineer (Hybrid, $90-$115k)
jobs.description:
IT SUPPORT ENGINEER — GLOBAL (BASED IN NEW YORK)




ABOUT CONVEO

Conveo is an AI-powered qualitative research platform. Our AI moderates real interviews at scale, so insights teams can run qual research with the speed and reach of quant — without losing the depth that makes qual worth doing.

We've raised a Series A ($50M) and we're headquartered in London, with a team across Belgium and the US. We hold ISO 27001, ISO 27701 and SOC 2 Type II certifications, with ISO 42001 in progress.




HOW WE WORK

 - AI-first, genuinely. We use AI across the whole company, not just in the product.

 - Automate the boring parts. If a process runs often, it shouldn't be manual.

 - Small team, real ownership. You'll own systems outright, not a slice of someone else's queue.

 - Distributed by design. Being in a different time zone from your colleagues shouldn't be a handicap.
   
   


ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a global IT role, based in New York.

You'd be the second person on Conveo's IT team, working alongside our IT Manager in London and reporting to him. You'd take day-to-day ownership of support, devices, access and the office - freeing the IT Manager to focus on strategy, security and governance.



Why New York? Presence and coverage. Our US team is growing, and they should be able to reach someone in their own hours rather than wait for the next London morning. With one of us in each region, IT's combined working day stretches across both.



You'd inherit a modern stack — Okta with SSO and SCIM, Google Workspace, Iru for macOS management,Notion, 1Password, Vanta and a whole load of Internal AI agents — and a lot of room to shape what comes next.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Support the team, wherever they are

 - Be a first point of contact for colleagues across the US, UK and Belgium - patient and clear with people who don't share your technical vocabulary

 - Triage and resolve requests end-to-end, from password resets to complex access problems, fixing causes rather than symptoms

 - When something bigger breaks, drive it to resolution, keep people informed before they ask, and document the root cause

 - Own vendor escalations, and know when to bring in the IT Manager — you'll be the only IT person in your time zone for much of the day

Run identity, access and the employee lifecycle

 - Administer Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, Notion and 1Password day-to-day

 - Handle access requests through our approval workflow, and keep our SaaS inventory accurate

 - Run onboarding and offboarding end-to-end for any region

Own devices and the office

 - Manage our macOS fleet through Iru — blueprints, configuration profiles, security baselines — plus BYOD enrolment and hardware lifecycle

 - Help engineers with development environment issues: tooling, permissions, machine setup

 - Own office AV, meeting booths and hardware, and hold the standard that calls start on time without anyone fiddling with cables

 - Shape the office into somewhere people choose to come, because collaborating there is easier than doing it from home

Improve how IT runs

 - Design the processes that repeat - onboarding, access requests, provisioning

 - Decide what should be automated and what shouldn't. Judgement about where a human needs to approve something matters as much as knowing what can be handed off

 - Build how we track IT work. We don't have a request tracking system and we want one  but we don't want to become a ticket-driven company. Visibility not bureaucracy

 - Turn repeat questions into self-service. Write the documentation once — clear internal guides and a knowledge base that colleagues and our helpdesk tooling can both answer from.

Keep IT compliant

 - Operate the IT controls that sit behind ISO 27001, ISO 27701, SOC 2 and ISO 42001 — access reviews, evidence collection, joiner-mover-leaver records, so audits are seamless rather than a scramble

 - Help answer customer security questionnaires and vendor assessments. Clear, accurate answers about how we actually run things.

Security and compliance ownership

 - You'd start by supporting our certifications, evidence, access reviews, control operation across ISO 27001, ISO 27701, SOC 2 and ISO 42001,  and grow into being accountable for a defined set of controls.




WHERE THIS ROLE CAN GROW

Deeper identity work. User lifecycle management, joiner-mover-leaver automation, and access governance and  designing the policy and procedures

AI governance. Conveo runs on AI internally as well as selling it. There's a growing body of work around how we govern our own agent and tool usage,  access, data boundaries, audit trails.

The automation roadmap. More say in what gets built and in what order, and eventually owning the decision rather than proposing it.




WHAT YOU BRING

The stack is learnable. The temperament isn't.

 - You genuinely like helping people. Not "tolerates end users" — you enjoy unblocking someone and explaining it in a way that leaves them better off. Personable, approachable, empathetic. This is the one we won't compromise on.

 - Meticulous, and calm when things break. Access provisioning is a security control, not an errand — a sloppy mistake is an incident. You know what to handle yourself and what needs another pair of eyes.

 - Comfortable working across time zones. Much of your support happens in writing, with colleagues you may rarely meet. You write things down without being chased.

 - You think in processes. You notice when something's being done the slow way, and can describe a better version clearly enough that someone else could build it.

 - You care about the physical environment. Working AV and a well-set-up office aren't beneath you — they're most of how people experience IT.

 - Solid IT fundamentals — macOS, networking basics, SaaS administration — and hands-on experience with an identity provider and Google Workspace. Okta or Entra ID, or a track record of picking things like this up fast.

 - You've run onboarding and offboarding before — groups, roles, access changes, secure deprovisioning.

 - Comfortable working autonomously in a fast-changing environment, without a defined procedure for everything.

 - Experience of Information security frameworks and experience of customer security assessment.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Startup experience — somewhere small and fast-moving, where the answer to "who owns this?" was often "you, now"

 - Agentic AI — you've used AI agents in your own work and have a view on where they're reliable and where a human still needs to approve

 - Supporting a distributed or multi-country workforce

 - Setting up request tracking from scratch, especially somewhere that wanted visibility without bureaucracy

 - An early-stage IT function where the processes were still being built

jobs.description:

And the job of creating better internet is never done - so we’re growing! The application window will be open until at least November 15th, 2026. This opportunity will remain online based on business needs which may be before or after the specified date.

This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship.

Role Description

As our Special Projects Manager, Technical Operations, you will support engineering, deployment, operations, last mile and maintenance of a fiber optic network for residential and business customers throughout Denver. In your role, you will report to the Head of Metro Technical Operations and flex within the Market to meet the needs of the business, plugging into areas where needs are critical, then rapidly moving to new improvement opportunities as the business evolves. As a part of your development, you may lend support to other Markets within the Region and take on stretch opportunities leading initiatives impacting functional, Market, or Regional areas of influence. Your ability to see process / performance gaps, adapt, and proactively pursue solutions is a must.

We are seeking a dynamic, adaptable, proactive, performance driven individual to execute complex, on-the-ground projects aimed at improving internet access, speed, and customer experience in the community. This evolving role requires a problem-solving mindset, comfort with ambiguity, and a resilient, positive approach to challenges, alongside substantial knowledge of our industry and willingness to learn much more.  An entrepreneurial spirit, a versatile skill set, a flexible approach, and a willingness to learn and adapt to new challenges as the role evolves and changes is critical.

In this role, you’ll:

• Support the Tech Ops Market Team of GFiber's FTTH build with ownership and project management across functional areas and Team members - Engineering, Construction, and Network Maintenance - as assigned by the Head of Metro Technical Operations (HoMTO).

• Ensure alignment between various parts of the customer network deployment from design to service delivery, guaranteeing the best local network is designed, built, and maintained with speed and budget.

• Coordinate with city management (city officials, jurisdictional authorities and utility representatives) to ensure business targets are met.

• Support and manage the end-to-end Fiber-to-the-Home (FTTH) network deployment cycle, including Geographic Information Systems (GIS), network planning, engineering design, permitting, and design reviews, across Single-Family (SFU), Multi-Dwelling (MDU), and Single Business Unit (SBU) environments. This includes supporting proposals, bids, scope definitions, vendor selection, and final approvals.

At a minimum, we would like you to have:

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Telecommunications or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

jobs.title: Digital Media Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
At gFiber, we believe that great internet has the power to drive innovation, strengthen communities, enable the impossible, and do all the everyday things that make all of our world go round. And the job of creating better internet is never done - so we’re growing! Our team is committed to building a place where people who want to make a difference can grow their careers and find their spot to belong.

Role Description:

You will be part of the gFiber Digital team, a growth marketing team that delivers and nurtures customers through digital touch points. We bridge local go-to-market execution with nationwide brand scale, collaborating closely with Product Marketing, Web/UX, Creative, Data Science, and Local Field Operations.

In this role, you will be a strategic owner of our digital media investments while serving as the primary bridge between media execution and our data/martech infrastructure. You will oversee media strategy, buying, and optimization—both direct and through agency management—while bringing a highly analytical lens to how we measure success. You will partner closely with MarTech and Data Engineering to shape dashboard requirements, implement advanced tracking, and design incrementality tests, ensuring our media dollars are driving measurable subscriber growth.

In this role, you’ll:

• Lead the design, execution, and optimization of large-scale customer acquisition campaigns (search, display, video, programmatic) to maximize ROI and hit aggressive performance goals.

• Direct external media agencies and strategic partners, ensuring flawless execution, holding them accountable to performance targets, and guiding them to adopt data-backed optimization tactics.

• Act as the primary liaison to the MarTech and Data Science teams. You won't build the dashboards from scratch, but define the requirements, KPIs, and data structures needed to evaluate media efficiency and budget pacing.

• Go beyond standard reporting by designing and overseeing rigorous A/B tests, geo-experiments, and incrementality tests to prove causal media impact.

• Partner with MarTech on the strategic implementation and QA of tracking mechanisms (GA4, GTM, server-side tagging, UTM taxonomies) to ensure seamless data flow from ad platforms into our data warehouses.

• Strategic Budget & Mix Ownership: Advise senior marketing leadership on media mix optimization, forecasting, and agile budget allocation based on modeling and inference.

At a minimum we’d like you to have:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 8 years of progressive experience in digital media strategy, buying, and optimization, with a significant emphasis on data-driven performance marketing.

• Proficient in Google Analytics (GA4) and tracking technologies (e.g., GTM, pixel implementation), with the ability to troubleshoot data discrepancies between media platforms and internal systems.

• Experience managing substantial media budgets, driving agile resource allocation, and presenting complex performance data to executive leadership.

• Experience managing media agencies and leading cross-functional internal partnerships (MarTech, Creative, Data Science).

• Experience with collecting, summarizing, presenting, and speaking about data associated with online paid media, marketing performance, budget management, and digital consumer insights.

It’s preferred if you have:

• Experience designing and executing complex incrementality tests, geo-experiments, or collaborating on Media Mix Modeling, Multi-Touch Attribution projects.

• Familiarity with SQL or data visualization tools (Looker, Tableau) to independently query data and validate dashboard logic alongside technical teams.

• Understanding of modern privacy-centric tracking architecture (Conversions API, clean rooms like Ads Data Hub)

• Experience with telecom and/or subscription service business models, focusing heavily on customer acquisition cost (CAC), retention, and lifetime value .

The City of Fort Worth is one of the fastest growing large cities in the U.S. Our employees serve the needs of over 1,000,000 residents, promoting our values of exceptional customer experience, mutual respect, embracing our diversity, continuous improvement, ethical behavior, and accountability. 🌆

A Sr. Management Analyst job is available with the City of Fort Worth FWLab department’s Analytics & Intelligence (A&I) Division. This role sits within the Business Strategy & Performance (BSP) team, a small forward-facing team of 2 senior analysts and a working manager. The fast-paced team leads FWSTAT, the City’s citywide strategy and performance program, and facilitates meetings and strategy and performance workshops for departments. BSP also leads continuous improvement projects, which are short evaluations that recommend ways to fix or automate processes and improve efficiency, and leads the Innovation Hub, which builds employee skills with technology and identifies innovation opportunities across the City.

Work Sample Requirement:
As part of the interview process, candidates will be asked to prepare and present an 8-minute presentation. Samples of a Power BI, Tableau, or Excel dashboard they have personally built will also be requested. Candidates unable to demonstrate hands-on work they have built will not move forward in the process.

Minimum Qualifications:

• Master’s degree from an accredited college or university with major course work in Public Administration, Finance, Business Administration, or related field

• Four (4) years of experience in the analysis of processes, procedures, operations, systems or methods, including experience in the functional area of assignment such as budget/financial management, research analysis or related experience

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience facilitating meetings, workshops, or trainings for diverse audiences, including executives, directors, managers, and frontline staff. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of building trusted relationships and delivering results without formal authority. Facilitation certification is a plus

• Experience developing performance metrics, establishing processes, and identifying the data needed to track and improve results, preferably in a government or other public-sector environment

• Moderate proficiency in Power BI and Excel to analyze, interpret, and present data, along with a commitment to continuously strengthen those skills on the job

The Sr. Management Analyst job responsibilities include:

• Manages and supports the FWSTAT program by working with departments to develop metrics, gather data, and report results to leadership

• Designs and facilitates meetings, strategy and performance workshops, and planning sessions for departments across the City

• Leads continuous improvement projects with departments by evaluating processes, finding inefficiencies, and recommending fixes or automation opportunities

• Supports the Innovation Hub by training employees to use technology, identifying innovation opportunities, and helping decide whether to train staff to build their own tools or hand development to the Data Analytics Team

• Uses Power BI and Excel to analyze data and build reports and dashboards that track department performance and project outcomes

• Builds relationships and communicates clearly with executives, directors, assistant directors, managers, and individual contributors, and guides results without formal authority

• Documents processes, recommendations, and outcomes, and reports progress and impact to division leadership on a regular basis

• Takes on special projects and other responsibilities as assigned in support of FWLab and citywide priorities

Working Conditions and Physical Demands

Depending on assignment, positions in this class typically require touching, talking, hearing, seeing, grasping, standing, walking, and repetitive motions.

jobs.title: Senior Modernization Analyst
jobs.description:
What You'll Be Owning:

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Modernization Analyst to support mission-critical intelligence operations. The ideal candidate brings deep analytic expertise, modernization capabilities, and demonstrated experience supporting national security objectives across GEOINT, multi-INT, and enterprise-level analytic environments. This position requires the ability to innovate, modernize analytical tradecraft, and drive the integration of advanced methodologies into customer mission sets.

What You'll Be Doing

As a Senior Modernization Analyst, you will develop advanced analytic methods and solutions that transform complex intelligence data into meaningful insights for mission stakeholders. You will design and implement analytic processes that enable analysts to identify patterns, trends, and operational opportunities across large, diverse datasets. Working directly with intelligence professionals, you will apply modernization techniques to solve challenging mission problems while improving the efficiency, repeatability, and rigor of analytic workflows.

What You Must Have:

• Active TS/SCI Clearance is required with the ability to obtain a CI Poly

• 10+ years of relevant experience. (A combination of years of experience & professional certifications/trainings/degrees)

• Expertise in advanced analytic methodologies and proven ability to implement them to perform multi-INT analysis to augment imagery analysis and provide mission-specific context to uncover relationships, trends, and mission-relevant events.

• Proven Intelligence Community experience working with integrated teams and applying documented analytic methodologies to answer complex intelligence questions.

• Demonstrated proficiency using various methods to modernize workflows and enhance analytic rigor (Python, Arc Model Builder, JEMA, Brewlytics, etc.).

• Demonstrated experience in data mining and developing/maintaining/manipulating databases.

• Experience in using FADE to perform analysis and produce analytical discoveries

What Would Be Nice to Have:

• Familiarity with SOM or object-based production to capture insights that supports mission

• Senior level proficiency with Python and developing solutions to advance analytics and operationalizing analytic models into repeatable processes, supporting intelligence production at scale.

• Understanding modern data science best practices, including governance, reproducibility, transparency, and lifecycle management.

• Experience supporting DoD and IC report production, briefings, and formal analytic publications.

• Experience with API-driven ingestion, ETL pipelines, or microservice-based analytic architectures.

• An understanding of coca cultivation and production areas Familiarity with Intelligence Community Directive (ICD) 203 (Analytic Standards) and ICD 206

• Ability to design and deliver briefings, demonstrations, and training events for users at all skill levels across mission applications.

jobs.title: Senior Systems Analyst, Data Operations
jobs.description:
Amylyx has an audacious mission to usher in a new era for treating diseases with high unmet needs. Where others see challenges, we see opportunities that we pursue with urgency, rigorous science, and unwavering commitment to the communities we serve. We are a clinical-stage company currently focused on post-bariatric hypoglycemia (PBH), Wolfram syndrome, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS).

Our mission is powered by our people. Our core values – be audacious, be curious, be authentic, be engaged, and be accountable – creating a culture of caring. Amylyx has assembled an experienced team ready to take action because the communities we serve have no time to wait. If you share our passion and are determined to tackle some of medicine’s toughest problems, we encourage you to read the opportunity below and apply.

The Opportunity

Amylyx Pharmaceuticals is seeking a highly motivated and hands-on Senior Systems Analyst, Data Operations to support and continuously improve our enterprise data and analytics ecosystem.

This role is responsible for maintaining the day-to-day operation of critical data platforms, integrations, and reporting solutions that support Commercial, Medical, R&D, Quality, Finance, and Corporate functions. The successful candidate will ensure that data pipelines, system integrations, master data processes, and reporting environments operate reliably, accurately, and efficiently.

The individual will serve as the primary operational lead for data platform support, troubleshooting, incident resolution, and vendor coordination while also partnering with business stakeholders to identify enhancement opportunities and deliver new capabilities.

This is a highly hands-on role requiring deep technical expertise across Snowflake, Power BI, Talend/Qlik Data Integration, Python, SQL, APIs, and Master Data Management (MDM).

The role will work closely with managed service providers (MSPs), implementation partners, internal IT teams, and business stakeholders to ensure the delivery of high-quality, scalable data solutions that support Amylyx's growing business needs.

Responsibilities

Data Operations & Platform Support

• Monitor and support day-to-day operations of Amylyx's enterprise data platform and analytics ecosystem.

• Ensure successful execution of data ingestion, transformation, integration, and reporting processes.

• Monitor scheduled jobs, data pipelines, interfaces, workflows, and report refreshes to ensure reliable performance.

• Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve production issues impacting data availability, quality, or performance.

• Perform root cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive actions.

• Coordinate and manage incident resolution activities across internal teams and external support providers.

• Establish and maintain operational dashboards, monitoring tools, alerting mechanisms, and service metrics.

• Ensure adherence to service-level agreements (SLAs) and operational support processes.

Data Engineering & Technical Support

• Perform hands-on development, maintenance, and support of data integration processes and workflows.

• Develop and support ELT/ETL processes using: Snowflake, Talend/Qlik Data Integration, Python, SQL, APIs

• Support data ingestion from enterprise systems including: Veeva, Salesforce, NetSuite, HR systems, Data vendors, Third-party SaaS platforms

• Execute code reviews and ensure adherence to development standards.

• Optimize database performance, data transformations, and reporting processes.

• Support environment migrations, deployments, testing, and release management activities.

Master Data Management (MDM)

• Support and maintain enterprise Master Data Management processes and solutions.

• Manage customer, product, organization, territory, and reference data maintenance activities.

• Monitor data quality metrics and proactively identify data issues.

• Investigate and resolve master data discrepancies and integration issues.

• Collaborate with business stakeholders to improve data governance and stewardship processes.

• Support implementation and maintenance of data quality controls and standards.

Business Analysis & Solution Delivery

• Partner with business stakeholders to gather, document, and prioritize business requirements.

• Facilitate workshops, requirements sessions, and process reviews.

• Translate business requirements into technical designs and implementation plans.

• Evaluate requests for enhancements, reports, dashboards, integrations, and automation opportunities.

• Coordinate development activities between internal teams and external implementation partners.

• Perform functional and technical testing to validate delivered solutions.

• Ensure solutions are delivered on time, within scope, and meet quality expectations.

• Support user acceptance testing (UAT), training, and adoption activities.

Reporting & Analytics Support

• Support and maintain Power BI reporting solutions and semantic models.

• Troubleshoot report refresh failures, data discrepancies, and performance issues.

• Partner with business users to improve reporting capabilities and KPI delivery.

• Develop or enhance dashboards and reports as needed.

• Ensure reporting solutions align with business requirements and data standards.

Vendor & MSP Management

• Serve as primary operational liaison for managed service providers and external partners.

• Manage day-to-day activities of outsourced support and development teams.

• Track service performance, issue resolution, backlog management, and deliverables.

• Review technical deliverables and ensure compliance with Amylyx standards.

• Escalate issues and risks as appropriate.

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives with vendors and support partners.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related discipline.

• 5+ years of experience supporting enterprise data platforms, data warehouses, analytics solutions, or data operations environments.

• Strong hands-on experience with: Snowflake, SQL/SnowSQL, Python, Power BI, Talend or Qlik Data Integration

• Strong experience supporting production data operations and troubleshooting complex data issues.

• Hands-on experience with Master Data Management (MDM), reference data management, and data quality processes.

• Experience developing and supporting ETL/ELT pipelines and data integrations.

• Experience working with APIs, file-based integrations, and SaaS application integrations.

• Strong understanding of: Data Warehousing, Data Modeling, Data Governance, Data Quality, Integration Architecture

• Experience gathering business requirements and converting them into technical solutions.

• Experience managing external vendors, consultants, or managed service providers.

• Strong problem-solving, analytical, and troubleshooting skills.

• Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, healthcare, or regulated industries.

• Experience supporting commercial pharmaceutical data environments.

• Experience supporting commercial data sources such as: Specialty Pharmacy, Specialty Distributor, Claims Data, Patient Services, Formulary and Market Access Data

• Experience working in Agile delivery environments.

• Snowflake, Microsoft, Talend, Qlik, or Power BI certifications.

Work Location and Conditions

• At Amylyx, we proudly support remote work opportunities within the United States. However, due to business considerations candidates must be able to attend meetings at our office in Cambridge, MA on a regular basis. Preference will be given to candidates who reside in the New England region and can be in person on an as needed basis.

• When working remotely, you must have access to a work setting which enables meeting all requirements of the role (including privacy, reliable internet access, phone, ability to video conference, etc.) at your remote location.

Compensation

The pay range posted below represents our good faith estimate of compensation for this role, based on market data and internal benchmarks. The final offer may vary depending on a candidate’s experience, skills, and qualifications, as well as considerations of internal equity.

Base salary is one component of Amylyx’s total rewards package. In addition to competitive base pay, eligible employees may receive annual performance-based bonuses and equity awards, providing an opportunity to share in the company’s long-term success. Amylyx also offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, well-being, and financial security of our employees.

Estimated Pay Range

$138,000—$155,000 USD

• Perform environmental monitoring of GMP manufacturing and process areas.
• Collect samples from high-purity water, clean steam, and compressed gas systems to support quality and compliance requirements.
• Conduct routine utility testing in accordance with established procedures.
• Use the Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) to track samples, test results, and laboratory activities.
• Maintain inventory of laboratory supplies, microbiological media, and reagents to ensure uninterrupted operations.
• Support the coordination of equipment maintenance, calibration, and laboratory readiness activities.
• Assist with the training and onboarding of team members by sharing knowledge and best practices.
• Perform basic microbial identification and data review, as assigned.
• Conduct acceptance testing of commercially prepared microbiological culture media, as applicable.
• Participate in an on-call, overtime, and weekend rotation to support business and operational needs.

What You'll Gain

• Hands-on experience with microbiological testing and environmental monitoring programs.
• Exposure to regulated laboratory and manufacturing environments.
• Opportunities to develop expertise in LIMS, utility monitoring, GMP compliance, and laboratory operations.
• Collaboration with experienced scientists and quality professionals in a team-oriented environment.

• Bachelor's or Associates Degree in Life Sciences, Microbiology majors preferred
• Relevant experience, preferably in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industries
• Environmental Monitoring experience preferred
• Microbial identification procedure knowledge
• Knowledge cGMP is a plus
• Strong computer, scientific, and organizational skills
• Excellent communication (oral and written) and attention to detail
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team, self-motivation, adaptability, and a positive attitude
• Ability to learn new techniques, perform multiple tasks simultaneously, keep accurate records, follow instructions, and comply with company policies
• Experience with LIMS preferred
• Authorization to work in the United States indefinitely without restriction or sponsorship

• Position is full-time, Sunday-Wednesday 12:30 PM - 11:00 PM.
• Pay range: $18.00- $23.50 per hour based on degree and experience level
• Excellent full-time benefits, including comprehensive medical coverage, dental, and vision options
• Life and disability insurance
• 401(k) with company match
• Paid vacation and holidays

Eurofins USA PSS Insourcing Solutions is a Disabled and Veteran Equal Employment Opportunity employer.
