jobs.title: Specialty Representative, Rheumatology - Oregon / Alaska
jobs.description:
This role is field-based, and candidates should live within a reasonable distance from the primary city. Talent will be hired at a level commensurate with experience.

This geography covers the areas surrounding: Oregon and Alaska

Execute brand strategy and tactics in field, sales performance, effectively manage assigned territory and targeted accounts, build strong customer relationships and customer needs solving capability to maximize short and long term sales performance placing the patient into the center of any efforts and operating within AbbVie’s business code of conduct, policies and all applicable laws and regulations.

Responsibilities:

• Deliver sales performance, brand KPIs, financial targets, marketing objectives, etc. in order to meet or exceed on those objectives.
• Create pre-call plan using SMART objectives and execute post-call evaluation in order to continuously improve sales performance. Effectively handle objections, misunderstandings, concerns and consistently gain logical and reasonable calls to action in order to close on every sales call.
• Proactively and continuously aspire to serve customer needs, customer expectations and challenges in order to build trusted customer relationships and to achieve win-win agreements between AbbVie and customers.
• Develop and execute a call plan that achieves set call metrics and optimizes coverage and frequency to key customers in order to maximize access and sales opportunities.
• Continuously build understanding on customer needs and expectations, territory market landscape, competitors, market segments/dynamics, accounts, disease, product, clinical and sales expertise and share this market intelligence information with in-field team, brand team and sales manager to achieve alignment, to anticipate environmental changes and challenges and to optimize brand strategy and its execution.
• Differentiate AbbVie’s value proposition with health providers assigned and identify, develop and maintain disease state experts and speakers/advocates in order to maximize brand performance.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in health, sciences, pharmacy or business-related field preferred or relevant and equivalent industry experience required
• Relevant and equivalent industry experience required in lieu of a bachelor’s degree is at least five (5) years of experience with three (3) or more years of experience within the pharmaceutical/health/science industry preferred and a high school diploma/GED required
• Proven track record of success in selling and solid presentation skills. Proactively identifies customer style / behavior and adapts quickly all aspects of selling approach. Offers innovative ideas and solutions to maximize business opportunities to address challenges. Provides impact with ideas for the larger organization and anticipates and responds to changes.
• Influences others & is viewed as a credible and respected role model and resource among peers. Builds collaborative partnership with district colleagues and matrix team, etc. Leads by example; consistently displays positive behaviors and peer coaching through changing and challenging environments.
• Documented success in leadership and support role of increased responsibility at the district, region and/or organizational levels. Understands and leverages findings to develop sales strategies.
• Preferred: Proven track record of success in sales performance within respective therapeutic areas. Commercial pharmaceutical industry experiences such as physician/account based selling, training, managed health care or marketing preferred. English language proficiency verbally and in writing (for all non-English speaking countries).
• An essential requirement of your position is to satisfy all applicable health care industry representative (HCIR) credentialing requirements to gain and maintain entry into facilities and organizations that are in your assigned territory. You must also be in good standing and/or eligible to obtain these credentials.
• These HCIR credentialing requirements may include, but are not limited to, background checks, drug screens, proof of immunization/vaccination for various diseases, fingerprinting and specific licenses required by individual state or cities. Please remember that you are solely responsible for ensuring that you satisfy all HCIR credentialing requirements and for any associated liability for failing to do so. AbbVie has resources available to you to help answer questions you may have.
• Demonstrates in-depth scientific, therapeutic, product, and competitive knowledge and is recognized as an expert resource by all relevant stakeholders. Strong business acumen and proficient use of business tools; possesses strategic and critical thinking capabilities. Operates effectively in a matrix environment.
• Driving a personal auto or company car or truck, or a powered piece of material handling equipment
• Valid driver’s license: Ability to pass a pre-employment drug screening test and meet safe driving requirements.

Key Stakeholders

• External: Specialty Physicians in Therapeutic brand area, pharmacists, nurses, others depending on brand plan.
• Internal: In-field team members, Sales Management (i.e. DSM), Marketing Management, Training, Customer Excellence, & Brand Plan stakeholders.

jobs.title: Account Strategist
jobs.description:
Somos Decolar, parte do ecossistema Prosus, e há mais de 25 anos revolucionamos a forma de viajar na América Latina ✈️. Construímos tecnologia que transforma experiências e conecta milhões de pessoas aos seus sonhos de viagem.
Buscamos talentos que pensem em 10x, ajam com autonomia e gerem impacto real. Se você é apaixonado por inovar, aprender rápido e construir em equipe, este lugar é para você.


Este é o ponto de entrada em um dos motores comerciais mais dinâmicos do travel tech na América Latina. É um papel de IC com ownership real sobre uma carteira de hotéis, dentro de uma das verticais que mais crescem na Decolar.
O papel tem uma régua clara: ser trusted advisor dos hotéis da sua carteira. Isso significa que o parceiro te procura antes de tomar uma decisão comercial, confia na sua leitura de mercado e te enxerga como parte da estratégia de crescimento do próprio negócio. Não é um vendedor que aparece pra renegociar tarifa. É alguém que conhece o hotel, conhece o destino e conhece a Decolar bem o suficiente para conectar os três.
Você vai ler dado, visitar parceiro, negociar, fechar campanha, entender por que uma conta está subindo e outra caindo, e levar isso pro time pensar junto.

jobs.title: Senior Department Financial Specialist - Cybersecurity
jobs.description:
The Senior Department Financial Analyst will be responsible for enabling Information Security and Risk Management (ISRM) solutions delivery through effective execution of departmental procurement and budget management processes. This role will partner with key stakeholders, leadership, and cross-functional teams to provide consulting, support, and direction in areas associated with the planning, procurement, provisioning, and financial management of information security solutions. They are expected to collaborate with colleagues and stakeholders to ensure financial targets are met, drive cost optimization opportunities, and contribute to the improvement of operational practices and processes.

Responsibilities:

• Partner with key stakeholders to understand specific business processes and objectives, supporting short and long-term strategic planning, solution discovery, and procurement needs.
• Lead and refine procurement processes in collaboration with finance, procurement partners, and other key stakeholders, ensuring purchasing activities flow cleanly and support budgetary tracking and reporting.
• Establish and define processes to ensure financial data is accurate across workbooks.
• Manage the departmental budget and project spend, partnering closely with functional leaders and portfolio management partners to ensure we accurately plan and consistently execute against financial targets.
• Collaborate with portfolio and project management partners to align project management processes to financial forecasting and reporting requirements.
• Partner with corporate finance to drive operational excellence and standards for monthly and quarterly forecasts and LBE’s (Latest Best Estimates).
• Support annual Capital Plan, and Long-Range Planning (LRP) activities, ensuring funding requests clearly support our defined strategic objectives.
• Develop reporting for leadership and key stakeholders to enable effective financial governance and transparent communications.
• Meet monthly with cross-functional partners to review active projects and proactively manage change orders, renewal timelines, and planned expenditures to ensure maximum transparency and alignment and drive effective forecasting.
• Maintain compliance with all applicable AbbVie Corporate (e.g., Finance, Purchasing, OEC, Legal), and IT department policies and procedures.

• Bachelor's Degree in a business or financial field and 6 years’ experience OR Master's Degree and 5 years’ experience OR PhD and 0 years’ experience.
• Respective years of demonstrated experience in corporate financial management including budgeting, forecasting, and contracting/procurement support.
• Proven experience in budget management and forecasting for complex, multi-faceted organizations.
• Experience operating within complex procurement processes to drive efficient purchasing and clear alignment with budgetary requirements.
• Proven ability to establish and maintain high-quality relationships with all levels across the company and with external partners.
• Ability to design impactful financial reporting for both technical and non-technical customers including executive audiences.
• Experience working with enterprise financial systems and tools such as SAP.
• Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
• Demonstrated ability to articulate and negotiate projects and priorities across functions and/or organizations, proven experience in situations of conflict resolution, problem solving, and crisis management.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to clearly and concisely present financial information to a variety of audiences, including executive leadership and stakeholders.
• Sound business judgment, proven ability to influence without authority, and strong analytical thinking skills are critical to success in this position.
• The ability to think clearly, analyze quantitatively, solve problems, scope financial requirements, and prioritize.
• Experience modernizing and automating departmental budget and financial management processes.
• Understanding of IT or Information Security concepts, terminology, and operations.
• Experience supporting business or financial operations for an IT or Information Security department.
• Experience with technical writing and process documentation.
• Experience working with globally distributed stakeholders and customers.

jobs.title: Contract Specialist
jobs.description:
At Accenture Federal Services, nothing matters more than helping the US federal government make the nation stronger and safer and life better for people. Our 13,000+ people are united in a shared purpose to pursue the limitless potential of technology and ingenuity for clients across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health organizations.

Join Accenture Federal Services, a technology company within global Accenture. Recognized as a Glassdoor Top 100 Best Place to Work, we offer a collaborative and caring community where you feel like you belong and are empowered to grow, learn and thrive through hands-on experience, certifications, industry training and more.

Join us to drive positive, lasting change that moves missions and the government forward!

The Contract Management Specialist in the Analytics Operations Service Center (AOSC) role will facilitate the management of multiple competing priorities.  Duties will include understanding and analyzing data, correlating data to determine needed actions, project management of multiple complex and competing priorities, proactive issue resolution, and implementation/improvement of tools and processes.

• The individual must manage complex activities in accordance with company policies and procedures, applicable laws, and customer requirements.

• Applies expertise in contract management system of record procedures and processes to create accurate contract management records to ensure all Contract Management systems are current, accurate, and complete with all of AFS' contract related data

• Responds to complex inquiries into any aspect of AFS' current and past contracts from both internal and external sources

• Identifies risks and issues, suggests alternatives or process improvements that lead to the best solution

• Prepares and disseminates information regarding status of deliverables

• Achieves a reasonable level of understanding of AFS major business areas to communicate effectively with project Senior Executives and provide relevant advice.

• May additionally be responsible for drafting, negotiating, and processing Non-Disclosure agreements (NDA) and Teaming agreements (TA), working closely with Project Leadership, Proposal Managers, AFS Legal, External Vendors, and Contract and Subcontract Managers, including some or all of the following key responsibilities: Manage a queue of NDA and TA requests through the full life cycle from request through final signature. Prepare NDA and TA documents tailored to specific requirements, using standard company templates, by incorporating opportunity specific information. Apply knowledge of federal contracting and procurement cycle to the NDA and TA process. Provide advice and support to Proposal and Program teams in developing Teaming Agreement language including, but not limited to, workshare and exclusivity. Validate status of external companies in SAM.gov or an equivalent system. Distribute documents to external companies for review and act as the main point of contact between the external company and AFS during the negotiation process. Review document changes requested by external companies and determine if AFS can accept the document as amended. Coordinate with the Program team, Contract and Subcontract Management, and Legal to accept or negotiate requested changes. Document AFS approvals as required for the NDA and TA processes. Advise Proposal and Program teams, as needed, with the process for entering document requests and checking document status. Create and maintain records of document negotiations and approvals on AFS systems.

Applicant must be detail oriented and very organized in order to execute the process in a timely manner.  Workload is variable and applicants should be good at managing their time and seeking clarification for prioritization if needed.

What you need

• US Citizen

• College degree required

• Minimum 3-4 years of experience (or 2+ years of experience with JD), including a preferred background in contracts, data science, compliance, project management and knowledge of the Federal government environment or related discipline

• Demonstrated successful management of complex functions

• Collaborative and persuasive; able to influence and communicate with executives and non-executives

Bonus if you have

• Prior experience in ServiceNow processes/reporting and Unison / CLM experience highly preferable

• Prior experience in the contract management/procurement/legal/finance field highly preferable

• Understanding of basic Federal contracting principles highly preferable

• Familiarity with FAR, DFAR and agency-specific supplements highly preferable

• Proficiency using Microsoft Office applications (e.g. Excel, Word, PowerPoint)

• Detail-oriented, organized, flexible

• Able to set priorities and juggle multiple demands

• Demonstrated leadership in professional setting; either military or civilian

• Demonstrated teamwork and collaboration in a professional setting

• Working knowledge of Accenture policy and Contract and Commercial Management Processes preferred

• Ability to manage a fast-moving queue of work items at various points in the processing lifecycle.

• Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills

• Able to apply sound business judgment

jobs.title: Demand Generation Manager
jobs.description:
ARE YOU INTERESTED IN JOINING AN INNOVATIVE LOGISTICS TECHNOLOGY COMPANY?
 
Loadsmart is a growth-stage technology company valued at over $1 billion (a true Tech Unicorn)!
 
We are a collection of industry veterans and user-centered engineers using innovative technology to fearlessly reinvent the future of freight by helping shippers, brokers, warehouses and carriers to move more with less.
 
With headquarters in Chicago and a globally distributed remote team, Loadsmart continues to attract top talent committed to driving meaningful change. We seek professionals who embody our core values: curiosity, clarity, results, commitment, and teamwork.


We are looking for a talented Demand Generation Manager to add to our team! 
Loadsmart is one connected platform that runs the complete freight lifecycle: planning, procurement, execution, settlement and payments, gate, yard and dock. Loadsmart AI is the intelligence layer across all of it, and trained freight operators take the exceptions. AI runs it. Operators guarantee it. ShipperGuide runs the transportation side for shippers. Opendock runs the facility side and is one of the largest dock scheduling networks in the industry.
We're building marketing around our product lines, with one person accountable for each line's growth. As Demand Generation Manager, you own the pipeline and performance for your product line end to end. That covers go-to-market strategy, launch planning with Product, competitive positioning, campaigns and paid media. When the number moves, you know why and you already have a plan.
You'll join as we head into a two-year push to scale each product line.
 
ShipperGuide + Loadsmart AI: ShipperGuide, our TMS (including ShipperGuide Instant Rates), and Loadsmart AI both sell to enterprise shippers. You'll own one pipeline across them, including taking Loadsmart AI to market.
Opendock: dock scheduling and facility operations. It has our largest paid media budget and a high-velocity digital funnel alongside an enterprise motion.
 
 
Job Type: (Exempt) 
DEPARTMENT: Marketing 
LOCATION: Chicago (Hybrid)

TRAINING

The Sales Trainee (ST) is a training role.

Upon successful participation in the training program, the ST is eligible to interview for open Account Sales Manager (ASM) roles.

Upon completion of the program and certification, if no ASM or otherwise qualified role is available AND the ST is meeting performance standards, the employee may remain in the ST role up to 12-months OR until an ASM or another qualified role is available (whichever comes first).

Once an ASM or another qualified role is available, the certified ST must interview for that available role.

If promotion to the role of ACCOUNT SALES MANAGER (or other role) does not happen prior to the expiration of the 12-mos completion period, the SALES TRAINEE role will be vacated due to end of assignment unless an exception applies.

For exception, based on continued high performance, no open roles and certification completion, a manager may extend the 12-month completion period an additional 6-months.

jobs.title: Director, CRM Product Lead
jobs.description:
The Analytics & Performance Analytics (APEX) function supports AbbVie’s US organization and is comprised of highly respected researchers, analysts, data scientists and strategists who are committed to being best-in-class within the biopharmaceutical industry. We serve as strategic in-house counsel, ensuring that all decisions leverage the key insights that we develop. We continue to build new capabilities and skill sets, encouraging our team members to pull up a chair, be themselves, be creative, speak their minds, and do good work. We are a passionate, diverse, flexible, and inclusive organization with a culture that supports the best ideas, wherever they originate. We are smart, fun, quirky, and innovative – and we’d love for you to join us.

Purpose

Director, CRM Product Leader owns the CRM product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the US commercial organization. This leader oversees a team of dedicated Product Owners accountable for ensuring the CRM platform meets current and future business needs, while building product management discipline and fostering a culture of customer-centric, user-focused, and data-informed decision-making. The Director, CRM Product Leader partners closely with business and IT leadership to build a robust CRM foundation and drive transformational change across the US commercial organization.

Primary Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Delivery:

• Serve as Product Owner for the CRM platform across the US commercial organization, owning the roadmap, release planning, and strategic priorities.
• Lead CRM product strategy for the NextGen CRM program by defining the future-state vision and translating it into scalable platform requirements and business processes.
• Own documentation and decision frameworks for NextGen CRM processes, ensuring clarity, traceability, and alignment across the US business.
• Champion advanced CRM technologies, including AI, and innovative processes that improve customer engagement, generate actionable insights, and reflect emerging industry trends.
• Gather and interpret business requirements, translating them into technology-enabled system enhancements and process improvements grounded in analytics and best practices.
• Conduct build-versus-buy analyses and prioritize investments to maximize the value of the CRM platform and related technologies.
• Lead design reviews and sprint demonstrations to ensure the product reflects field and business needs before deployment.
• Maintain strong product management discipline to deliver predictable, high-quality releases and support continuous improvement.

Leadership & Collaboration:

• Oversee Product Owners supporting US Therapeutics, ensuring alignment with enterprise strategy and delivery standards.
• Lead, mentor, and develop the Product Owner team through coaching, performance guidance, and career development support.
• Facilitate collaboration between senior business leaders and cross-functional teams to secure input, feedback, and alignment on CRM initiatives.
• Partner with the Associate Director, CRM Activation, on deployment planning and field readiness to integrate product and activation strategies.
• Communicate roadmap updates, release decisions, and strategic direction clearly and consistently to senior leadership, field stakeholders, and key forums.
• Promote the CRM strategy and its organizational impact through stakeholder meetings, leadership forums, and targeted communications.
• Enable change by aligning stakeholders, proactively identifying risks, and removing barriers to successful adoption and sustained progress.
• Assess business processes and capability gaps; design, implement, and scale data-driven and technology-enabled improvements.

Governance & Compliance:

• Establish and enforce governance frameworks to ensure CRM initiatives comply with applicable regulatory, privacy, and data requirements.
• Manage product delivery risks and cross-vertical dependencies, making risk-informed decisions that minimize disruption and maintain momentum.
• Ensure product decisions, process documentation, and platform configurations align with enterprise standards and governance protocols.

• Bachelor’s Degree required, and 10+ years of relevant experience across field leadership, marketing, and analytics.
• Prior 3-5 years’ experience in field or functional leadership and/or business management or consulting.
• Experience with AI-enabled CRM capabilities, data analytics, and digital customer engagement is highly desirable
• Deep familiarity with CRM platforms, particularly Salesforce and/or Veeva, and the broader commercial technology ecosystem
• Previous experience leading broad organizational change initiatives, navigating new ways of working, building positive, accountable, and highly engaged team culture.
• Knowledge and deep understanding of overall business operations in pharma/biotech and healthcare industry.
• Strong understanding of industry legal, analytical and compliance landscape and ability to apply to diverse situations to keenly evaluate risk and develop appropriate risk mitigation strategies.
• Demonstrated leadership ability to develop and drive an organizational strategy in a very complex matrix internal and external environment.
• Ability to lead without authority, driving through execution across multiple functionally diverse stakeholders. jobs.title: Marketing Activations Intern
jobs.description:
WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON

Main challenge

We are opening a 6-month Marketing Activations internship on Asphalt, starting in February 2027, to support the Principal Activations Manager. Our roadmap of IP collaborations and in-game activations is already well defined, and you will help deliver it while shaping what comes next with new IPs, audiences and concepts.

What it means on a daily basis

• Contribute to the creative concept of in-game activations and how each IP can best be integrated into the game, from characters and cars to dialogue, content and game modes.
• Coordinate activations from concept through implementation with the game team, tracking the status of deliverables and communicating progress across the teams involved.
• Ensure marketing plans around each activation, including social media, influencer campaigns and other promotional initiatives, are aligned with the in-game experience, and coordinate the creation of promotional assets such as trailers, web assets, screenshots and store descriptions.
• Gather, share and monitor IP guidelines and coordinate approvals with IP partners so that in-game content and promotional materials meet their requirements.
• Research potential IPs and collaboration opportunities based on player insights and market trends, and propose new concepts for the future activations roadmap.

What success will look like

As you grow into the role, you become increasingly autonomous in coordinating activations from month 2-3, identifying opportunities and contributing ideas to the future roadmap.

You help deliver activations on time and to a high standard, keeping internal teams and external partners aligned throughout the process. You understand our players and use available insights to contribute relevant ideas for IP collaborations and in-game experiences.

Who you would be working with

You will work directly with the Principal Activations Manager as part of the Operational Marketing team, alongside Product, ASO, Partnerships, Community, Influencer Marketing, User Acquisition and Marketing Art.

You will also work closely with the Asphalt game team, including Producers, Game Design, Art, QA and Game Economy, to coordinate the development and implementation of each activation.

Externally, you will interact with IP rights holders and partners, as well as Licensing and Legal teams when required.

Your recruitment journey

• Recruiter pre-screen interview
• Case study / test
• Hiring Manager interview
• Final interview (optional)

Where this role can take you

This role can give you practical experience at the intersection of gaming, entertainment, IP partnerships and live operations. Depending on how you develop and on the needs of the team, you could take on more ownership over activations, contribute to the future direction of our collaboration roadmap and explore other opportunities within Gameloft through Talent Move.

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

• Good understanding of the game industry and of how player expectations differ across console, PC and mobile, with first-hand knowledge of Asphalt games, racing games and car culture, and the motivation to step into game development.
• Ability to use player behaviour, market research and available data to inform creative and commercial decisions.
• Fluent English and Spanish, both written and spoken, with the ability to produce clear, accurate copy.

WHO YOU ARE

• Creative and initiative-driven, able to turn ideas into relevant concepts for in-game activations and to contribute new IPs, audiences and concepts rather than simply executing an existing plan.
• Organised and collaborative, able to track multiple deliverables, coordinate feedback, requirements and approvals across teams and partners, and work with people from very different disciplines.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU​

Benefits

• Flexible schedule adapted to your student needs
• Flexible work from home hybrid model

Life at Gameloft

Our Barcelona studio offers real career development opportunities and a positive working environment in a centrally located office. We value supportive working conditions and a balanced work-life approach, and our teams work together with a collaborative mindset.

Ready to level up your career? Apply now with your CV in English.

jobs.title: Продавач - консултант - Panorama Mall
jobs.description:
КАКВО ЩЕ ПРАВИШ

Като продавач - консултант ти ще заемаш ключова роля в създаването на изключително клиентско преживяване. Посрещайки нашите клиенти, ще им помагаш в техния избор, като същевременно ще ги запознаваш с нашите нови продукти и колекции. Следвайки нашите ценности, ще допринасяш както за своя успех, така и за развитието на компанията.

Ти ще:

• Споделяш модните си познания, така че клиентите ни да изберат най-доброто за себе си.
• Работиш заедно с екипа, за да осигурите перфектно обслужване на клиента, включително активно промотиране на лоялната ни програма
• Подсигуряваш етажа и складовите помещения заредени и подредени.
• Помагаш с процедурите по отварянето и затварянето на магазина.
• Представяш себе си и компанията по позитивен и професионален начин.

​

С КОГО ЩЕ РАБОТИШ

Магазините ни са сърцето на компанията – мястото, където клиентите се запознават с нашата марка от първа ръка. Като част от динамичния екип в магазина, всяка роля – от продавач-консултант и ръководител отдел до управител, визуален мърчандайзер и главен касиер – допринася за създаването на вдъхновяваща и приветстваща обстановка. Ще имаш възможност да си сътрудничиш с колеги от различни магазини, да обменяте опит и да постигате успехи заедно. Работейки с твоя екип, ще имаш ключова роля в това да помагаш на клиентите да се чувстват уверени и свободни да изразят себе си чрез най-новите модни тенденции и класически модели. Изграждайки значима връзка с клиентите в нашите магазини, ние създаваме достъпна и устойчива мода за всички.

​

КОЙ СИ ТИ

Ние търсим човек с…​

• Опит в обслужването на клиенти в сферата на търговията ще е предимство.
• Удоволствие от общуването с клиенти и интерес към модата – ние ще те научим на всичко останало!

И човек, който е…​

• Успяващ в динамична среда, със силни комуникативни умения.
• Комуникативен, креативен и любопитен.
• Адаптивен и ориентиран към постигане на резултати.

КОИ СМЕ НИЕ

H&M Group е международна група от утвърдени модни марки и инициативи. Нашата цел е да докажем, че няма компромис между изключителния дизайн, достъпните цени и устойчивите решения. Стремим се да направим модата достъпна за всички, като поставяме клиентите в центъра на всяко наше решение.

Нашият екип се състои от хиляди отдадени и талантливи професионалисти, обединени от обща култура и ценности. Заедно използваме силата, различията и знанията си, за да изградим бъдещето на модната индустрия, като го направим по-приобщаващо и устойчиво.

ЗАЩО ЩЕ ОБИКНЕШ РАБОТАТА СИ ПРИ НАС ​​

В H&M Group се гордеем с това, че сме динамична и приветстваща компания. Предлагаме на нашите служители атрактивни придобивки и множество възможности за професионално развитие по целия свят.

• 25% служителска отстъпка за всички марки част от H&M Group, както в магазините, така и онлайн (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories и ARKET);
• H&M Incentive Program – HIP. Научи повече за програмата ни тук;
• Ваучери за храна на стойност 78 €;
• Осигуровки върху реално брутно възнаграждение;
• Допълнително здравно осигуряване;
• Възможност за издаване на Multisport карта на преференциална цена;
• Обучения и възможност за световно кариерно развитие в компанията;
• Програма “Препоръчай приятел” с включен бонус;
• Платен отпуск при сключване на брак;
• H&M карта-подарък при раждане на бебе;
• Ваучер при навършване на 10 години в компанията;
• Възнаграждение при пенсиониране;

ПРИСЪЕДИНИ СЕ КЪМ НАС

Нашите ценности, приобщаваща и сплотена култура ни различават от всички останали. Но най-важни са хората, които ни правят това, което сме.

Това е постоянна позиция на непълен работен ден, намираща се в град Плевен.

Очакваме твоята кандидатура като ни изпратиш актуално CV на български език. Поради политиката за личните данни, приемаме кандидатури единствено през кариерната ни страница.

Направи следващата крачка в кариерното си развитие с нас. Пътешествието започва тук.

*Оценка за ролите в магазина:

За да успеем да обработим голямото количество кандидатури за позицията продавач-консултант, използваме онлайн метод за оценка на уменията за подбор в някои от нашите магазини. Трябва да го попълниш като част от процеса на кандидатстване и селекция. Твоите отговори ще бъдат оценени с помощта на инструмент за оценка, който прилага предварително зададени критерии от H&M Group.

След като завършиш оценката, ще имаш възможност да споделиш мнение и да зададеш въпроси. Ако срещнеш трудности или предпочиташ алтернативен метод за оценка, моля, свържи се с recruitment_support@hm.com. Изборът на алтернативен метод няма да има влияние върху твоята кандидатура.

За повече информация относно това как обработваме твоите лични данни, моля, виж нашето уведомление за конфиденциалност.

** Стремим се да имаме справедлив и прозрачен процес и затова любезно молим да не прилагаш мотивационно писмо към кандидатурата си, тъй като то често съдържа информация, която лесно би могла да бъде разбрана пристрастно.

jobs.title: Analista Negócios Sênior- Growth
jobs.description:
Nosso modo de fazer no time

Transforme sua carreira com o iFood! Somos uma empresa brasileira de tecnologia referência na América Latina. Por meio de soluções inovadoras, conectamos milhares de restaurantes a milhões de consumidores diariamente com uma média de 100 milhões de pedidos mensais. Além do delivery de comida, também somos Mercado, Farmácia e Pet. Temos também o iFood Pago, nossa Fintech, que engloba o iFood Benefícios, o vale alimentação e refeição do iFood e o próprio iFood Pago, o banco do restaurante. Junte-se a nós e faça parte de uma equipe que está sempre à frente com tecnologia de ponta e inovação constante.

Seu Cardápio Diário

• Liderança analítica da curadoria: desenhar a estratégia de diversidade de oferta, identificando gaps de cobertura por categoria, geografia e perfil de consumo; recomendar priorização entre expandir lojas parceiras existentes e captar novas

jobs.title: Electronics Technician - Cable & Harness Fabrication
jobs.description:
Location: Onsite — Austin, TX

Employment Type: Direct Hire, Full-Time

Job Title: Electronics Technician



About 9 Mothers

The modern battlefield has changed. Cheap, autonomous suicide drones have turned the tactical advantage upside down, and the world is looking for a solution. At 9 Mothers, we aren’t just "innovating"—we are building the shield.

Backed by top-tier investors, we develop AI powered machines designed to intercept and neutralize Group 1/sUAS threats in real-time. Our flagship product is a low-power, counter-drone system built for the edge—on vehicles, at bases, or in a soldier's pack.



Why 9 Mothers?

While others build for "awareness" or "long-term research," we build for the immediate survival of those in harm’s way. We are a team of hackers, engineers, and mission-driven builders who value field-ready capability over polished slide decks. If you want to see your code or hardware in the field next month—not next year—this is your playground.



Position Summary

9 Mothers builds robotic weapons systems — including EDDA, a robotic shotgun turret for counter-UAS, and a proprietary belt-fed shotgun platform. Every prototype we field is an electromechanical system full of cable harnesses, wired compute and control boxes, and custom PCBAs. Today, that build work is done by mechanical engineers and engineering management. That stops with this hire.

This role owns hands-on electronics fabrication for the company: building cables and harnesses, wiring compute and control enclosures, and reworking PCBAs. Your workmanship goes directly into weapons systems that get run hard at the range, so it has to be right — clean, documented, and durable. Most of your time is in the Cable & Harness Fabrication (Core)

 - Build cables and wire harnesses from schematics, harness drawings, or an engineer’s sketch — cut, strip, crimp, solder, pin, and pot as required

 - Work across connector families common to robotic and vehicle systems: circular/mil-spec connectors, D-subs, Molex/JST/board-level connectors, RF/coax, and power connectors, using correct tooling for each

 - Label, sleeve, and strain-relieve harnesses for hard use on outdoor, live-fire robotic platforms — vibration, heat, dust, and repeated teardown

 - Verify every build: continuity, pinout, insulation resistance / hipot where appropriate; capture as-builts and redline drawings so the next build is faster

Box Builds & System Wiring

 - Wire compute and control enclosures end-to-end: panel layout, component mounting, power distribution, wire routing and dressing, grounding and shielding

 - Perform point-to-point checkout and initial power-up checks before handing boxes to engineering for bring-up

 - Build repeatably — when we need the second and third unit, they should match the first

PCBA Rework & Repair

 - Rework and repair PCBAs: component replacement (through-hole and SMT), ECO / blue-wire modifications, connector replacement, and conformal coating touch-up

 - Troubleshoot boards and assemblies to the failed component using DMM, oscilloscope, and bench power supplies

Test Setups & Fixtures

 - Build and run simple electrical test setups: cable life/flex testing, actuator test fixtures, breakout boxes, load banks, and long-duration soak tests

 - Instrument tests, log results, and report failures with enough detail that engineering can act on them

 - Maintain the electronics lab: test equipment, soldering stations, crimp tooling, and stock of wire, connectors, and consumables

Field Support

 - Travel to test ranges when needed to repair harnesses, boxes, and electronics on deployed systems and support live-fire test events

 - Work safely around firearms and an active belt-fed shotgun platform, with disciplined adherence to range safety protocols



Requirements

 - 5+ years of hands-on experience as an electronics technician, electrical assembler, or similar role building and repairing complex electromechanical hardware — robotics, aerospace, defense, automotive, test equipment, or industrial systems

 - Expert-level cable and harness fabrication: crimping, soldering, pinning, and the judgment to pick the right connector, wire gauge, and strain relief for the application

 - Proficient soldering and rework skills, including SMT component replacement

 - Able to read and work from schematics, wiring diagrams, and harness drawings — and to build sensibly from an engineer’s verbal description or sketch when a drawing doesn’t exist yet

 - Competent with standard bench equipment: DMM, oscilloscope, power supplies; able to trace electrical faults methodically

 - Meticulous workmanship and documentation habits: labeling, as-builts, redlines, test records

 - Comfortable working around firearms and live-fire operations, and willing to travel occasionally to test ranges in central Texas conditions (heat, dust, outdoor work)

 - US person (citizen or lawful permanent resident) — required for ITAR compliance



Nice-to-Have

 - IPC/WHMA-A-620 (cable and harness), IPC-A-610, or J-STD-001 certification — or demonstrably equivalent workmanship

 - Military electronics maintenance background (avionics, armament, ground systems, or similar MOS)

 - Experience designing and fabricating simple test fixtures, including basic mechanical work — drilling, tapping, 3D printing, panel fabrication

 - Familiarity with motors, servos, actuators, and motion-control wiring on robotic systems

 - Experience with data logging or basic scripting (e.g., Python) for automated or long-duration tests



What Success Looks Like

 - Within the first 30 days, engineers have stopped building cables and wiring boxes — that work comes to you, and it comes back done right, on time, and documented. The lab is organized, tooling and stock are under control, and harness drawings are getting better because of your redlines.

 - On an ongoing basis, nothing electrical fails at the range because of workmanship. Test setups you build produce data the engineering team trusts, and when something does break in the field, you’re the one who gets it running again.



Work Environment

This role is based in our Austin, TX lab and shop. It involves occasional travel to outdoor test ranges in central Texas — heat, dust, direct sun, and limited infrastructure — including live-fire test events in close proximity to an active belt-fed shotgun system, with strict adherence to safety protocols.



Benefits

 - Meaningful Early Equity: You aren't just an employee; you are a foundational owner. Your contributions directly drive the value of your stake in the company.

 - Direct Roadmap Influence: Forget the bureaucracy of big defense. You will have a seat at the table, directly shaping our product and technology trajectory from day one.

 - Mission-Critical Work: We don't build for "what if." We build systems the Department of War actively needs to counter immediate, real-world threats.

 - The Builder's Playground: Work in a brand-new lab fully optimized for rapid prototyping, equipped with NVIDIA Jetsons, high-end scopes, and 3-D printers.

 - 100% Employer-Paid Premiums: We cover 100% of your medical, dental, and vision insurance premiums and cover 50% of healthcare premiums for your dependents.

 - Unlimited PTO: We value results, not clock-watching. Take the time you need to stay sharp and recharge.

 - Zero Red Tape: You report to the founders. You have the autonomy to make technical decisions that would take months of committee approval at a larger firm.

 - Austin-Based Culture: Join an onsite team in Austin, TX, where we prioritize high-bandwidth collaboration and rapid field-testing.

 - Relocation Assistance: We want the best talent in the room. If you aren't in Austin yet, we’ll help you get here, to make your transition to the Silicon Hills seamless.



About the Interview

 1. Application screen phone call (30 min)

 2. Virtual interview with Operations Director (45 min via MS Teams)

 3. In-person visit & technical exercise in Austin

 4. Offer

jobs.title: Senior Electrical & Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

Found Industries is a Cambridge, MA-based industrial technology company building new critical supply chains from resources and infrastructure hiding in plain sight. Launched out of MIT, Found develops and deploys technologies that unlock critical materials and dispatchable clean energy from overlooked industrial feedstocks.

The company operates through two complementary business units: Found Metals and Found Energy. Found Metals recovers strategic materials, including gallium, from existing industrial processing streams. Found Energy converts aluminum, including low-grade and scrap material, into a fuel for behind-the-meter industrial heat and power. The two businesses reinforce one another: Found Metals expands domestic supplies of critical materials used in advanced energy technologies, while Found Energy creates new applications and demand for those materials. Together, they form the foundation of a broader industrial platform focused on strengthening U.S. energy and materials security.

At Found Industries, we are building the industrial capabilities needed for a more resilient and self-reliant future. We believe secure access to critical materials and energy is foundational to economic strength, national security, and long-term prosperity, and we are looking for talented people motivated by that mission to join us. For more, visit https://found-industries.com/.

Position Summary:

As the Senior Electrical & Controls Engineer, you will own the architecture, development, and commissioning of the electrical, control, and functional safety systems for our gallium extraction plant. This role bridges the gap between our novel chemical processing technology and the rigorous, continuous-operation environment of a host aluminum refinery. You will be fully responsible for designing systems that manage hazardous chemical flows (high temperature, caustic Bayer liquor)  for our pilot, prototype and subscale equipment. You will independently drive assigned projects, coordinate vendors and contractors, and bring technical decisions and risks forward for review.

• Employment Type: Full-time

• Location: Cambridge, MA – Onsite

• Reports To: Head of Instrumentation and Controls

• Salary range: $135,000-$170,000 with early-stage equity

• Comprehensive health, dental, vision, matching 401K benefits and paid life insurance

• 20 days PTO, 11 holidays, 5 sick days, 12 weeks parental leave

Key Responsibilities and Duties:

• Project Ownership: Own assigned electrical and controls projects from requirements and scope definition through commissioning and handover. Develop estimates and schedules, track procurement and technical interfaces, communicate progress and risks, and close out outstanding issues.

• PLC Programming: Develop, test, and commission PLC programs and operator interfaces for assigned equipment, including sequences, interlocks, alarms, and process control.

• Safety & Design Reviews: Participate in hazard reviews and implement documented interlocks and shutdown requirements in coordination with the I&C lead, process engineers, and functional safety specialists as needed.

• Refinery Integration: Design secure, deterministic communication interfaces (e.g., Modbus TCP, EtherNet/IP, Profinet) to sync our controls with host refinery Distributed Control Systems (DCS) like Emerson DeltaV or Honeywell Experion.

• Electrical Design: Personally develop electrical schematics, panel layouts, wiring diagrams, cable schedules, and bills of materials. Select and size power supplies, protective devices, conductors, motor controls, and other components for industrial power distribution and control systems, applying relevant electrical codes and standards.

• Commissioning: Develop and execute factory and site acceptance tests, perform loop checks, configure instruments and drives, and troubleshoot electrical hardware and PLC/HMI software. Complete as-built drawings, operating documentation, and handover to the team.

• Vendor Management: Select and manage system integrators, electrical contractors, and equipment vendors to ensure compliance with project timelines and engineering standards.

Qualifications:

Required:

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, Mechatronics, or a closely related STEM discipline.

• Experience: 5+ years of industrial electrical and controls engineering experience, with demonstrated ownership of projects from requirements and electrical design through installation, testing, and commissioning.

• PLC Expertise: Hands-on experience programming, testing, and commissioning at least one industrial PLC platform, with the ability to independently deliver controls for assigned equipment. Beckhoff/TwinCAT experience is preferred; transferable experience with Rockwell/Allen-Bradley, Siemens, or similar platforms will be considered.

• Electrical Design & Instrumentation: Strong experience producing industrial electrical schematics and panel layouts using AutoCAD Electrical; selecting and sizing components; and integrating process instrumentation, motor controls, and drives in accordance with NEC, NFPA 79, and UL 508A.

• Travel: Willingness to travel up to 10% to international or domestic aluminum refinery sites for deployment and commissioning.

Preferred Attributes

• Start-Up Agility: Prior experience working in a fast-paced start-up, pilot plant, or technology scale-up environment where ambiguity is common.

• Instrumentation Selection: Expertise in selecting specialized process instruments (magnetic flowmeters, slurry valves, pH/conductivity sensors) that withstand highly corrosive process fluids.

• Pilot & Scale-Up Experience: Prior work in a start-up, pilot plant, process equipment manufacturer, or systems integrator, translating evolving requirements into working equipment. Experience developing HMI/SCADA applications, particularly Ignition, is a plus.

• Safety Standards: Proven experience implementing functional safety standards such as IEC 61511 or ISA-84, and programming safety-rated PLCs.

• Industrial Networks: Deep technical understanding of industrial networking protocols, switching, firewalls, and OT cybersecurity best practices.

• Advanced Certification: Certified Functional Safety Expert (CFSE) or Functional Safety Engineer (TÜV Rheinland).

• Professional License: Professional Engineer (PE) license is highly desirable.

If interested, please email us directly at careers@found-industries.com with your CV.

Found Industries does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender expression, age, national origin, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, or military status, in any of its activities or operations. These activities include, but are not limited to, hiring and firing of staff, selection of vendors, and provision of services. We are committed to providing an inclusive and welcoming environment for all members of our staff, subcontractors, vendors, and clients.

jobs.title: Lead Sourcing Recruiter
jobs.description:
At Dragos, the mission is personal. The systems we protect deliver the water you drink, power your home, and keep the hospitals your community depends on running. Those critical infrastructure systems that power our civilization around the world are under attack every day by adversaries. When those systems fail, people are immediately at risk. We are the global leader in xOT cybersecurity, combining technology, threat intelligence, and expert services. The people here chose this work because they understand what is at stake. Here, you will find a remote-first mission-driven team across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and APAC built on authenticity, transparency, and trust. If safeguarding the systems that protect your family, friends, and community is the kind of work that matters to you, you are in the right place.

About the Role

We're hiring a Lead Sourcing Recruiter to build the talent pipelines to drive our next phase of growth. This is a research-driven, market-facing role: you'll map the specialized talent markets we compete in, provide intel to key stakeholders, and find the people who won't be found through a job posting.

You'll be the person stakeholders come to when they need to know who's hiring in OT security, what a staff-level detection engineer costs in Austin versus Amsterdam, and which five companies are worth mapping before we open a req. Sourcing here is a long game of research, mapping, and relationship-building.

What You'll Do

• Build talent market maps and competitor analyses that tell hiring managers where the talent is, who has it, and what it will take to move them.

• Advise stakeholders with real market intelligence - compensation benchmarks, skill scarcity, and talent availability by region, so hiring decisions are grounded in data rather than assumption.

• Design targeted sourcing strategies for niche and highly technical markets, including the ones where conventional search returns nothing useful.

• Engage passive talent with outreach worth responding to and cultivate those relationships over months or years rather than days.

• Run multiple complex searches in parallel without letting quality or candidate experience slip.

• Track pipelines rigorously and analyze funnel metrics (response rates, conversion health, time-in-stage) then adjust your approach based on what the data shows.

• Partner with recruiters and hiring managers across the business to translate vague role concepts into searchable, well-defined profiles.

You Should Have

• 7+ years sourcing specialized talent across highly technical domains.

• A track record of finding and landing technical talent that competitors missed.

• Genuine interest in AI and how it's reshaping sourcing research and workflows. You've experimented with the tooling and have opinions about what works.

• Fluency with sourcing research methods: Boolean, market mapping, org charting, and whatever you've built yourself.

• Comfort presenting market intelligence to senior stakeholders and defending a recommendation with data.

• A real appreciation for the research and mapping side of the craft. This work compounds slowly; the people who love it do it best.

You May Have

• Experience sourcing in cybersecurity, OT/ICS, industrial technology, or another deeply specialized technical market.

• Experience building sourcing processes, playbooks, or tooling from scratch.

Compensation:

• Salary: $155,000.00

• Competitive Equity Package

• Comprehensive Benefits Plan

jobs.title: Executive Assistant, Product Pillar
jobs.description:
POS-34044

The mission of the Product EA team is to support the Product, Design, and Engineering teams to drive the business forward and succeed at scale. Coordinating across all of these functions, we help teams run effectively by streamlining processes, creating best practices across the org, and ensuring daily operations run smoothly. In addition, we work to build connection, community and belonging in our org, so that we can foster a healthy, happy, and high-performing culture.

We are seeking an Executive Assistant to join HubSpot’s Product EA team who is passionate about providing top-tier support to our leaders and employees, while thinking creatively about how we can continuously improve the employee experience and optimize their time so they can focus on growing better. This role is hybrid, with at least one day a week in the Cambridge, MA office on average. Expect more time onsite during Product Summit season (late February through late May) and for leadership offsites and in-person events.

In this role, you’ll get to:

• Act as a thought partner to our leaders: anticipate needs, flag scheduling and priority conflicts early, and offer a point of view on how their time is best spent.

• Manage the daily calendars and travel needs of Product and Engineering leaders, handling all incoming/outgoing meeting requests.

• Support the leadership team in the preparation of All Team meetings, AMAs, and team offsites. This may include ownership of the agenda, arranging and managing logistics, and pulling content together.

• Collaborate with a network of HubSpot Executive Assistants and Coordinators on cross-team backup support and broader company initiatives.

• Partner closely with our Product & Engineering Employee Experience Team to arrange and support a number of cross-functional team events.

• Organize regional in-office events and programming, including Product Summits and leadership offsites.

• Process expense reports, open purchase orders, coordinate payments, and manage relationships with external vendors.

• Assist in event management and travel preparation for large-scale marquee events.

• Explore and adopt new AI tools to streamline workflows, automate repetitive tasks, and share what works with the broader EA community.

We are looking for people with:

• 3+ years of experience providing executive or administrative support, with a proven track record in a high-performing, fast-paced environment.

• Experience supporting senior leaders in a technology company, ideally Product, Engineering and/or Design leaders.

• High level of professionalism, acting as a representative of their executives and HubSpot in all internal and external interactions.

• Remarkable drive, bias for action, and enthusiasm for exceptional customer service, no matter how large or small the request.

• Exceptional written and oral communication skills; capable of interaction with employees at all levels of HubSpot, including executives, as well as guests and external contacts.

• Comfort with ever-changing technology and proficiency in Google Apps.

• AI proficiency and genuine curiosity about new AI tools, with a drive to experiment and apply them to optimize workflows.

• The capacity to thrive with ambiguity while prioritizing tasks in response to unexpected changes in priorities/requests.

• Ability to take a proactive approach to tasks and be comfortable working with minimal instruction and guidance; impeccable attention to detail.

• Flexible and able to handle ad hoc issues that may arise outside of core business hours.

• Availability to work onsite at Product Summits and for in-office events and engagements.

Pay & Benefits

The cash compensation below includes base salary, on-target commission for employees in eligible roles, and annual bonus targets under HubSpot’s bonus plan for eligible roles. In addition to cash compensation, some roles are eligible to participate in HubSpot’s equity plan to receive restricted stock units (RSUs). Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay. Individual compensation packages are tailored to your skills, experience, qualifications, and other job-related reasons.

This resource will help guide how we recommend thinking about the range you see. Learn more about HubSpot’s compensation philosophy.

At HubSpot, fair compensation practices aren’t just about checking off the box for legal compliance. It’s about living out our value of transparency with our employees, candidates, and community.

$79,900—$119,900 USD

At HubSpot, we value both flexibility and connection. Whether you’re a Remote employee or work from the Office, we want you to start your journey here by building strong connections with your team and peers. If you are joining our Engineering team, you will be required to attend a regional HubSpot office for in-person onboarding. If you join our broader Product team, you’ll also attend other in-person events, such as your Product Group Summit and other gatherings, to continue building on those connections.

If you require an accommodation due to travel limitations or other reasons, please inform your recruiter during the hiring process. We are committed to supporting candidates who may need alternative arrangements

About HubSpot

HubSpot (NYSE: HUBS) is an AI-powered customer platform with all the software, integrations, and resources customers need to connect marketing, sales, and service. HubSpot's connected platform enables businesses to grow faster by focusing on what matters most: customers.

At HubSpot, bold is our baseline. Our employees around the globe move fast, stay customer-obsessed, and win together. jobs.title: Vice President, Compensation
jobs.description:
Company introduction:

Compass Pathways plc (Nasdaq: CMPS) is a biotechnology company dedicated to unlocking urgently needed new treatment options in mental health care.

The Company is headquartered in London, UK, with a U.S. office in New Jersey. We believe mental health patients deserve the possibility of a better future. Our initial focus is developing COMP360 psilocybin, a proprietary, investigational, synthetic psilocybin treatment under evaluation for treatment-resistant depression (TRD) and post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD). COMP360 is a potentially first-in-class treatment and has Breakthrough Therapy designation from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA), as well as Innovative Licensing and Access Pathway (ILAP) designation in the UK for TRD.

We are leading the world’s largest classic psychedelic clinical program in TRD, and building upon that robust foundation, we are executing a late-stage trial evaluating COMP360 for PTSD, another condition with high unmet need. Our goal is to advance treatments that move the field of psychiatry towards treatment options that offer rapid onset and sustained durability with infrequent dosing. - Compass Pathways

Job overview:

The Vice President, Compensation is a strategic leadership role responsible for developing and executing the company’s compensation strategy, with primary responsibility for executive compensation and oversight of the company’s broader compensation philosophy, structures and programs.

Reporting to the Chief People Officer, this role will design and govern competitive, equitable and performance-driven compensation programs that attract, retain and motivate exceptional talent while supporting the company’s business strategy and long-term growth.

The VP, Compensation will serve as a trusted adviser to the executive leadership team and Board of Directors, partnering closely with the Compensation Committee, Legal, Finance and external advisers. The role will shape executive pay philosophy, incentive and equity programs, compensation governance and disclosure, balancing talent priorities, market competitiveness, financial considerations and shareholder interests.

Location: Remote, US.

Reports to: Chief People Officer.

Roles and responsibilities
(Include but are not limited to):

• Develop and lead the company’s executive compensation strategy, including base salary, annual and long-term incentives, equity awards and retention arrangements, ensuring alignment with business objectives, shareholder interests and long-term value creation

• Advise the Chief People Officer, CEO and executive leadership team on executive pay, incentive design, compensation governance and emerging market practices

• Partner with the Chief People Officer, CEO, Legal and external advisers to prepare recommendations and materials for the Board of Directors and Compensation Committee

• Oversee executive compensation benchmarking, annual reviews, pay recommendations and incentive outcomes

• Lead the company’s equity compensation strategy, including stock option and RSU awards, equity dilution and share usage

• Oversee executive compensation disclosures and proxy statement preparation in partnership with Legal and external advisers

• Establish and evolve the company’s broader compensation philosophy, salary structures, job architecture and market-benchmarking frameworks

• Oversee annual compensation planning, including merit increases, promotions, market adjustments and pay equity assessments

• Partner with Finance on compensation budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling and the financial impact of compensation programs

• Monitor market, regulatory, governance and investor developments, ensuring compensation programs remain compliant, competitive and aligned with shareholder expectations

• Provide clear, data-driven compensation insights and recommendations to senior leaders, using market data, analytics and industry trends

Candidate Profile:

• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Finance, Economics or a related discipline required; MBA or relevant master’s degree preferred

• Significant progressive compensation experience, with substantial expertise in executive compensation strategy, program design and governance

• Demonstrated experience advising CEOs, executive leadership teams, Boards of Directors and Compensation Committees on executive pay strategy, reviews and governance

• Proven expertise in equity compensation, including stock options, RSUs and performance-based long-term incentive programs

• Strong experience in executive benchmarking, annual incentive design, compensation modeling and pay governance

• Experience supporting a US commercial-stage organization, ideally within biotechnology, pharmaceuticals or the broader life sciences industry, strongly preferred

• Experience within a publicly traded company highly desirable, including knowledge of SEC reporting, proxy statement requirements and executive compensation disclosure

• Deep understanding of compensation market practices, regulatory requirements, tax considerations and compensation accounting principles

• Advanced analytical and financial modeling skills, with the ability to assess incentive outcomes, equity implications and pay positioning

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex compensation matters into clear recommendations for senior leaders and Board members

• Strong influencing, negotiation and stakeholder-management capabilities, with the credibility to operate effectively at executive and Board level

• Strategic, commercially minded and solutions-oriented, with the ability to balance talent priorities, financial considerations and shareholder interests

• Demonstrates discretion, sound judgment and integrity when handling highly confidential and sensitive compensation matters

Our compensation package for permanent hires includes base salary, discretionary bonus, and equity, alongside our comprehensive benefits offering.

Please note that the base salary range is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location.

Who We Are

Our mission is to be personally committed to solving our partners’ most difficult, systematic challenges by reimagining what is possible and realizing more resilient communities together. We believe a culture of caring, purposeful, diverse and courageous humans who want to make a difference for our partners will help us achieve that mission.

This role is expected to lead by example and take a hands-on approach to the day-to-day management of resident services.

Primary Responsibilities Include:

• Assist in the oversight of the day-to-day resident relations functions and partner with cross-functional colleagues to ensure a positive resident experience.

• Assume a proactive role in enhancing the resident experience by personally resolving complex or sensitive resident concerns, questions, and requests, and addressing chronic resident noncompliance with community policies.

• Assist in deploying resident information and engagement campaigns aimed at increasing resident satisfaction as measured by survey responses and community ranking.

• Create accountability and ownership among team members; communicate clear expectations, supervise, and provide timely performance feedback.

• Assist the Resident Manager in training and developing team members through coaching, motivating, and mentoring on company culture, business goals, sales techniques, and leasing operations.

• Develop and maintain win-win relationships with key partner stakeholders, respond to partner requests, and collaborate as necessary to ensure program effectiveness.

• Perform all duties of a Resident Associate as needed, and other duties as assigned.

Role Specific Requirements Include:

• 3+ years of relevant work experience with minimum of 6 months experience in residential property management. Six months experince in a a supervisory or lead role required.

• Proven ability to lead a team, including proven success coaching team members to improve performance and training team members on customer service procedures, policies, and standards.

• Proven ability to maximize resident retention through the design and delivery of data-driven customer loyalty and retention programs.

• Demonstrated ability to interpret and analyze data, identify trends, and use data to connect operational and administrative activities to overall business strategies.

• Demonstrated ability to organize individual and team activities to ensure operations are highly productive and meet or exceed business goals.

• Problem Solving and Decision Making - Uses critical thinking to evaluate problems, gather information, understand causes, and identify best possible solutions. Invests time in planning, discovery, and reflection to drive better decisions and more efficient implementations.

At EquipmentShare, we’re not just filling a role — we’re assembling the best team on the planet to build something that’s never been built before. We’re on a mission to transform an industry that’s been stuck in the past by empowering contractors and communities through innovative technology, real-time support, and a team that truly cares.

We’re looking for someone who’s ready to grow with us, bring energy and drive to their work, and help us build the future of construction.

The primary responsibility of the Customer Support Billing Specialist I is to consistently provide exceptional service and support to EquipmentShare’s internal and external customers in a multi-channel environment. Work cross-functionally with Accounts Receivable, Collections, and Rental Operations in servicing internal and external customers as it relates to billing and payment processes and inquiries. Establish and maintain excellent working relationships with rental markets and help facilitate support requests throughout EquipmentShare. As a primary customer-facing role, the ability to provide professional, exceptional, timely and accurate service to internal and external customers is critical to the success of this position.

Primary Responsibilities

• Perform job duties in accordance with EquipmentShare’s vision, mission, and values.

• Provide excellent customer service for EquipmentShare customers with clear answers to billing and payment inquiries and appropriate referrals as needed.

• Respond to customer inquiries via telephone, chat, and email in an accurate, timely, and professional manner and within established quality and service standards.

• Show empathy towards customers, understanding their concerns, and offering them reassurance while providing assistance.

• Complete Voice of Customer (VOC) reports to capture customer concerns.

• Establish and maintain professional working relationships with internal and external customers and co-workers.

• Manage time effectively to ensure productivity levels and turnaround times are within established service standards.

• Establish and maintain adequate knowledge of EquipmentShare products, service offerings, and core systems, and respond effectively and efficiently to customer and co-worker inquiries.

• Establish and maintain an understanding of all EquipmentShare subsidiaries, guaranteeing current knowledge of their payment stipulations and designated points of contact.

• Perform administrative functions within core systems across all customer platforms (phone, email, and Intercom), including but not limited to:

• Setting up new users and profiles in ES Admin, including sending T3 Customer password re-sets.

• Update and accurately maintain customer account billing configurations, including user access rights, billing contact information, electronic billing preferences, customer billing receipt requests, and rental billing cycle parameters.

• Issue customer credit notes, invoices, and statement copies upon customer request.

• Ensure customer interactions are documented accurately and promptly for reference in ES Admin.

• Develop and maintain billing and payment systems knowledge and exhibit the ability to comprehend and communicate basic accounting and billing system practices in a manner that is easily understood by internal and external customers.

• Possess sufficient expertise regarding the various bank accounts to accurately provide and verify information to both internal and external clientele.

• Maintain familiarity with multiple remittance addresses and demonstrate the ability to appropriately direct customer inquiries.

• Ability to troubleshoot, comprehend, and fully reconcile billing and payment information to identify and resolve discrepancies.

• Proficiency in generating customized customer reports and statements beyond those automatically produced by Admin or T3 systems.

• Process customer credit card and ACH payments in the appropriate system (ES Admin, SlimCD, or Stripe) with high attention to detail to ensure accuracy, data integrity, and compliance with state and federal payment industry guidelines.

• Partner with Accounts Receivable in the creation of credit request documents and application of such as requested by the customer.

• Engage with new customers throughout the onboarding process to educate them on specific areas of doing business with EquipmentShare, such as self-service options, billing and payment features, rental agreements and contracts, and insurance requirements.

jobs.title: Environmental Monitoring Quality Systems Specialist (GMP/QA)
jobs.description:
Eurofins is seeking an Environmental Monitoring Quality Systems Specialist (GMP/QA) to support the continued growth and standardization of Environmental Monitoring (EM) and Facility Validation (FV) services across our U.S. laboratory network.

This position partners closely with the Vice President, Environmental Monitoring & Facility Validation to develop, implement, maintain, and continuously improve the quality systems that support environmental monitoring operations. The role serves as a key resource for quality documentation, training programs, investigations, compliance initiatives, and accreditation support across multiple laboratory locations.

The ideal candidate combines strong GMP quality systems experience with excellent technical writing, organizational, and document control skills. This is a highly collaborative, systems-focused position that works with site quality representatives, laboratory personnel, and subject matter experts to ensure procedures, training materials, and quality records remain accurate, compliant, and effective.

This is a growth-oriented opportunity for a quality professional looking to expand their impact beyond a single laboratory and contribute to network-wide quality initiatives supporting a rapidly growing business line.

Responsibilities

• Draft, revise, and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), work instructions, forms, templates, and quality documents supporting Environmental Monitoring and Facility Validation services.
• Collaborate with subject matter experts and site quality personnel to ensure procedures accurately reflect technical and regulatory requirements.
• Support the administration and maintenance of quality systems, including eQMS, LIMS, training records, controlled documents, and related compliance records.
• Assist with accreditation programs and quality documentation associated with laboratory certifications and standards, including ISO/IEC 17025 requirements.
• Develop and maintain environmental monitoring training materials, competency assessments, and associated documentation across the laboratory network.
• Support environmental monitoring investigations, deviations, out-of-specification or out-of-limit events, CAPAs, and change control activities.
• Assist in maintaining compliance with applicable GMP, GLP, data integrity, and regulatory requirements.
• Support implementation of 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles related to electronic data capture, review, and reporting processes.
• Work with laboratory teams to improve the effectiveness, consistency, and efficiency of environmental monitoring quality systems.
• Participate in internal audits, accreditation audits, regulatory inspections, and audit readiness activities.
• Maintain quality metrics, action item tracking, and project documentation while providing summaries and recommendations to leadership.
• Support the onboarding and integration of newly acquired or newly established laboratory locations into network quality systems.
• Identify opportunities for continuous improvement and assist with implementation of corrective and preventive measures.
• Escalate compliance issues, quality concerns, and risks as appropriate.
• Perform all duties in accordance with company policies, safety requirements, and applicable regulations.
• Perform other related duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Biology, Microbiology, Chemistry, Environmental Sciences, Quality Systems, Life Sciences, or a related scientific discipline.
• Minimum of 3 years of experience in a GMP-regulated pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, contract laboratory, or related regulated environment.
• Experience developing, reviewing, or maintaining SOPs and controlled quality documentation.
• Experience supporting quality systems, investigations, deviations, CAPAs, change controls, or audit programs.
• Familiarity with electronic Quality Management Systems (eQMS), Learning Management Systems (LMS), and/or Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS).
• Strong technical writing, document control, and organizational skills.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
• Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while working independently and collaboratively.

Preferred Qualifications

• Direct experience supporting Environmental Monitoring programs, cleanroom certification, microbiological testing, or facility validation activities.
• Knowledge of ISO/IEC 17025 laboratory requirements.
• Familiarity with EU GMP Annex 1 requirements.
• Understanding of USP <797>, USP <1116>, and ISO 14644 standards.
• Experience supporting laboratory accreditation, regulatory inspections, and audit readiness activities.
• Knowledge of environmental monitoring equipment such as viable air samplers, particle counters, compressed gas testing systems, and related instrumentation.

This is a full-time, first-shift position working Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, with overtime as business needs require.

The position is based in Lancaster, PA and requires approximately 10-25% travel to laboratory locations throughout the network. Occasional work in controlled environments and limited off-shift support may be required.

Candidates living within a commutable distance of Lancaster, PA are encouraged to apply.

What We Offer

• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance
• Company-paid life and disability insurance
• 401(k) with company match
• Paid vacation and holidays
• Career development and advancement opportunities within a global organization

Eurofins USA BioPharma Services is a Disabled and Veteran Equal Employment Opportunity employer.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

You will act as an autonomous "player-coach" who leads by doing—defining the work directly in working files, setting the bar for excellence, and solving complex design challenges in real time. jobs.title: Accounting Manager
