Jobber exists to help people in small businesses be successful. We work with small home service businesses, like your local plumbers, painters, and landscapers, to transform the way service is delivered through technology. With Jobber they can quote, schedule, invoice, and collect payments from their customers while providing an easy and professional customer experience. Running a small business today isn't like it used to be—the way we consume and deliver service is changing rapidly, technology is evolving, and customers expect more. That's why we put the power and flexibility in their hands to run their businesses how, where, and when they want!

Our culture of transparency, inclusivity, collaboration, and innovation has been recognized by Great Place to Work, Canada's Most Admired Corporate Cultures, and more. Jobber has also been named on the Globe and Mail's Canada's Top Growing Companies list, and Deloitte Canada's Technology Fast 50™, Enterprise Fast 15, and Technology Fast 500™ lists. With an Executive team that has over thirty years of industry experience of leading the way, we've come a long way from our first customer in 2011—but we've just scratched the surface of what we want to accomplish for our customers https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EkfZmHrRLx4&list=PLoktA_D-2UEnxMLfCe93bANKXVXd2bdN8&index=24.



The team:

The Finance team at Jobber is responsible for anything money-related, helping us plan, budget, and implement Jobber's best ideas.



The role:

Reporting to the Manager, Accounting, the Accounting Manager will drive the accounting projects that make the rest of the function better. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports, working in focused sprints — you sit outside the day-to-day general ledger close, but you understand it deeply enough to improve it. You're known for your curiosity, your bias to action, and your ability to turn an ambiguous question into a documented, defensible answer.



The Accounting Manager will:

 - Own technical accounting expertise, serving as the go-to resource for new or complex transactions — think revenue recognition (ASC 606), leases (ASC 842), stock compensation (ASC 718), business combinations, and capitalized software.

 - Lead our controls mapping work, connecting risks to controls, documenting how our processes run, and identifying gaps — building the internal control framework that lets us scale with confidence.

 - Bring a strong working knowledge of the month-end and year-end close, without owning it, so you can map controls and redesign processes with a real understanding of how they run.

 - Collaborate across Finance and other departments to deliver projects with cross-functional impact, and act as a resource for our Finance-owned tools.

 - Reimagine our accounting processes with AI, redesigning workflows around what Company-approved AI and automation tools make possible — building processes that are faster and better controlled, while applying professional judgement and human review to every output.



To be successful, you should have:

 - Your CPA designation, with strong knowledge of US GAAP; SEC reporting experience is strongly preferred.

 - Significant accounting experience, including time in public practice, with a track record of technical accounting research and documentation of process and controls.

 - Strong analytical skills, with the judgement to make decisions based on accurate, timely analysis.

 - Solid project management instincts — the ability to scope ambiguous work, sequence it, and drive it to the finish line on your own.

 - Coachability and adaptability, with the flexibility to thrive amid change and experimentation in a growing organization.

 - A genuine team player who collaborates widely, champions best practices, and rolls up their sleeves when it's all hands on deck.

 - Experience working with a SaaS company is an asset.

 - Previous IPO, S-1/F-1, or public company experience is a big plus.

 - Experience using NetSuite is a plus.

Supporting the Vice President, Environmental Monitoring & Facility Validation in building out and maintaining the quality systems that underpin environmental monitoring (EM) and facility validation (FV) services across the US laboratory network. The position provides quality systems and documentation support across the network.

The role is systems-facing. It gathers input from the quality systems (e-LIMS/eQMS), site quality representatives and from subject matter experts for each service line, drafts and maintains procedures, training materials, checklists, and quality documentation for review and approval, tracks actions through to closure, and prepares clear summaries and recommendations for the Vice President's consideration.

This is a growth position. It is intended for an experienced quality systems professional who is ready to take on network-wide scope for the first time, and it is structured to expand in responsibility as the environmental monitoring business line grows.

Responsibilities

• Draft, revise, and maintain environmental monitoring SOPs, work instructions, forms, and templates for review and approval, working to direction set by the Vice President, Environmental Monitoring.

• Work with designated subject matter experts for each service line, including cleanroom certification, routine environmental monitoring, EM performance qualification, water testing, compressed gas testing, and microbial identification, to capture technical requirements accurately in procedures and training materials.
• Develop and maintain a working understanding of the environmental monitoring equipment in use across the network, including but not limited to viable air samplers, particle counters, and compressed gas and dew point instrumentation; sufficient to support the quality and documentation requirements associated with their use.
• Build and maintain environmental monitoring training content, competency assessments, and associated records in coordination with site quality representatives.
• Support data integrity requirements for EM field data capture, review, and reporting, including 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
• Assist site quality representatives with environmental monitoring investigations, deviations, out-of-limit results, CAPAs, and change controls, providing documentation support and network context.
• Assist with accreditation, audit readiness, regulatory compliance, and data integrity requirements.
• Track quality initiatives, maintain records, and provide recommendations for process improvements.
• Escalate matters requiring direction, resolution, or site leadership engagement to the Vice President, Environmental Monitoring.
• Take ownership of discrete quality system workstreams assigned by the Vice President, Environmental Monitoring, and deliver them to agreed timelines.
• Apply GMP/GLP principles and the highest quality standards in all areas of responsibility.
• Support the incorporation of newly added laboratory sites into network EM quality systems as the business grows.
• Conduct all activities in a safe and efficient manner, and in compliance with company policies and applicable regulations.
• Perform other duties as assigned.

• Bachelor's degree in a scientific or quality-related field.
• 3+ years of experience in a GMP-regulated pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or laboratory environment.
• Experience with quality systems, SOP development, investigations, CAPAs, and training documentation.
• Familiarity with eQMS, LIMS, environmental monitoring, and applicable regulatory requirements.
• Strong organizational, communication, problem-solving, and project management skills.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and travel as needed.

Additional Preferences:

• Direct experience with environmental monitoring or cleanroom certification services, in either a contract laboratory or manufacturing setting.

The position is full-time, Monday-Friday, 8:00am-5:00pm, with overtime as needed. There is an expectation of approximately 10–25% travel to network laboratory sites. jobs.title: Chief of Staff
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Today, 1 in 5 children in the U.S. has a diagnosable mental health disorder, yet about half who need care never receive it. Handspring is a virtual mental health clinic for children, young adults, and families, and we've set out to rebuild this system from the ground up. We're a team of diverse, mission-driven people dedicated to making quality mental healthcare accessible to every young person and their family.



About the Role

We're hiring a Chief of Staff to work directly with our founders as a force multiplier for the company.

Handspring has raised $37M in total funding from leading investors and cared for more than 5,000 families. Right now, payer demand for our model keeps growing. The next few years will include launching new states, new care models, increasing payer partnerships, and building ambitious technology. The roadmap is simply too big for the founders to drive day-to-day anymore, and we need someone to step in and own this.

This is a high-trust seat at the center of the company. You'll build the analysis behind our biggest decisions, pick up the cross-functional work that doesn't yet have an owner, and make sure what gets decided actually gets done. You'll be in the room when decisions get made, and you'll leave with the follow-through on your plate.

This is not a pure strategy job. Some of the work is grunt work: cleaning up a spreadsheet or slides, chasing a signature, chasing down a denied claim. Nobody at Handspring is above that, founders included, and we're not hiring anyone who is. What you get in return is the closest possible view of how a healthcare company gets built.

The best person for this job brings order to ambiguity and closes every loop.

 

What You'll Do

 - Cross-functional Initiatives: Pick up the work that has no owner. We run constant experiments on patient acquisition, operations, and payer strategy. You'll run the ones that matter most, help figure out what's working, and get them repeatable before handing them off.

 - Strategic Analysis: Build the analysis behind our biggest decisions. The models that inform how we price, staff, expand, and invest: unit economics, workforce capacity, market entry, payer contract scenarios.

 - Financial Planning: Own the financial planning behind the business. Build and maintain the operating model, annual budget, and rolling forecast, tie headcount and spend to revenue plans, and support fundraising with the model and diligence materials.

 - Growth and Expansion: Support what we build and where we go next. Put together the business case for new service lines, from market sizing through financial model, and help coordinate the clinical, credentialing, growth, and payer workstreams behind a new state launch.

 - Board and Operating Execution: Pull together the board deck, investor updates, and the numbers behind them, and close out follow-ups after each meeting. Help establish and manage the processes for setting company goals, tracking progress, and keeping the leadership team aligned as we scale.



Who You Are

 - 4+ years of experience at a healthcare startup or in healthcare investing (VC, growth equity, or PE), investment banking, management consulting, corporate development, finance, strategy, or business operations, where you learned to structure ambiguity, solve complex problems, and work alongside senior executives.

 - We're based in New York City. Being in the NYC area and able to work from our office regularly is required.

 - Strong written and analytical communicator; you can turn a whiteboard conversation into a clear, well-structured document.

 - A reliable closer with superb follow-through; nothing you own gets dropped.

 - Deeply trustworthy and discreet; you'll handle sensitive information about people, finances, and strategy.

 - Comfortable with variety and ambiguity. The portfolio changes constantly, and you'll often be structuring the problem yourself.

 - Obsessed with company-building and healthcare. This job is too hard to do well if you're not.



Compensation and Benefits

 - Base salary: $150,000 to $175,000

 - Equity and Benefits
   
   

Why Join Handspring

 - Work side by side with the founders of a Series B healthcare company, with direct exposure to payers, finance, clinical operations, growth, and the boardroom

 - A mission that matters, expanding access to high-quality mental healthcare for young people

jobs.title: Senior Territory Account Executive, Central Eastern Europe - Digital Natives
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Location: Amsterdam, Netherlands or London, UK

About the Role

We are seeking a highly accomplished and strategic Account Executive to join our Central Eastern Europe (CEE) Digital Natives Sales team. In this advanced role, you will be pivotal in driving significant growth by leading comprehensive sales cycles within a portfolio of assigned enterprise-level clients, and strategically acquiring new logos. The ideal candidate possesses a deep blend of advanced sales acumen and sophisticated technical understanding, enabling them to lead engagements at all levels, from the C-suite to technical leaders (e.g., Head of/VP of Networking or Security).

As an Account Executive, you will consistently demonstrate advanced proficiency in all sales activities, ensuring highly accurate forecasting, proactive and strategic pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets. You will be a subject matter expert, speaking fluently about Cloudflare's products, features, benefits, and use cases across diverse customer segments. This role demands the ability to deeply understand complex customer IT Architectures, match them with relevant Cloudflare Reference Architectures, and orchestrate successful, large-scale platform sales. You will be a key driver of digital transformation for our customers, understanding their broader market trends and how Cloudflare uniquely enables their strategic initiatives.

What You'll Do

• Strategic Revenue Generation: Architect and execute advanced territory and account plans to consistently exceed multi-million dollar sales targets and annual quotas, with a strong focus on new business acquisition and expansion within complex enterprise environments.

• Expert Pipeline & Forecasting: Lead proactive and strategic pipeline management efforts, demonstrating a sophisticated understanding of sales cycles and customer buying processes. Deliver highly accurate forecasts, providing clear insights and strategic guidance to sales leadership.

• Deep Customer & IT Architecture Understanding: Develop a profound understanding of customers' IT architectures, including applications and third-party technologies. Architect and align Cloudflare Reference Architectures to customer environments, driving comprehensive platform solutions.

• Multi-Engagement Leadership: Orchestrate and manage multiple complex customer engagements simultaneously across various business units within an organization. Strategically connect disparate needs to strengthen Cloudflare's platform sale, actively involving and influencing technical C-level minus one executives.

• Virtual Team Leadership: Set clear direction and lead a virtual team of in-GEO specialists, Product Managers, Deal Desk, and Legal to collaboratively manage and close complex customer opportunities. Proactively identify and navigate through situations to address colleague and customer needs, escalating as appropriate to drive urgency and efficient delivery.

• Digital Transformation Authority: Act as an authority on digital transformation, understanding key drivers (e.g., new offering development, enhanced customer capabilities) and the broader market trends influencing these decisions. Position Cloudflare as a critical enabler of these transformations.

• Compelling Value Creation: Articulate highly compelling, strategic value propositions for Cloudflare's services, directly linking them to customer business outcomes and strategic objectives. Lead with a strong focus on the "why," communicating the whole picture to both internal and external stakeholders.

• Advanced Negotiation & Closure: Expertly lead and navigate complex contract negotiations, driving win-win scenarios for all parties. Demonstrate advanced closing skills across new business and expansion opportunities.

• Trusted Advisor & Coach: Build long-term, executive-level strategic relationships, ensuring deep customer adoption, retention, and expansion. Consistently provide clear, direct, and constructive feedback to team members, coaching them to improve communication, learn from mistakes, and enhance the quality of work. Share learnings proactively to build trust across the organization.

• Organizational Impact & Leadership: Consistently focus on the long-term needs of the team and the business, understanding how decisions impact other teams and openly sharing these insights. Leverage company-wide learnings to improve department and team execution. Serve as a leader within Cloudflare, making significant contributions while elevating the work of others by bringing diverse perspectives and strategic long-term thinking.

Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

• Fluency in English and one of the languages from the CEE (written and spoken).

• 6+ years of advanced experience selling complex technology solutions into Digital Native companies across CEE, with a significant track record of consistently exceeding multi-million dollar quota targets.

• Deep expertise and fluency in Cloud Networking, Security, and Edge Computing technologies, with an exceptional ability to articulate features, benefits, and use cases across diverse customer segments (e.g., SMBs, enterprise, vertical markets).

• Proven ability to deeply understand complex customer IT architectures and effectively map them to Cloudflare Reference Architectures for successful platform sales.

• Demonstrated success leading and influencing virtual cross-functional teams (e.g., Solution Engineers, Product Managers, Legal) to drive complex deals to closure.

• Exceptional strategic communication and presentation skills, with a focus on articulating the "why" and conveying the whole picture to executive leadership and technical decision-makers (C-level minus one).

• Advanced negotiation skills with a track record of closing large, complex, six-figure and multi-million dollar deals.

• Expert-level sales acumen: unparalleled proficiency in discovery, positioning, competitive selling, negotiation, closing, and expansion strategies within enterprise accounts.

• Authority on digital transformation trends and their impact on enterprise customers, with the ability to position Cloudflare as a key enabler of strategic business outcomes.

• Strong coaching and mentorship abilities, with a passion for helping colleagues grow and improve.

• Highly self-motivated, entrepreneurial, and resilient, thriving in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with a consistent focus on long-term goals.

• Proficiency in advanced sales and business intelligence platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Tableau, G-suite, MSFT suite, MEDDPICC framework application).

• Bachelor's degree required, with a technical background (e.g., engineering, computer science, MIS) highly preferred.

• Ability to travel as required to engage with key customers and internal teams.

Compensation

• For Netherlands based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €144,000 - €198,000.

This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare’s Sales Compensation Plan. The estimated annual salary range includes the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role under the Sales Compensation Plan.

Equity

• Performing supervised field tasks, such as geophysical data acquisition utilizing standard and advanced geophysical classification electromagnetic induction systems, real-time kinematic global navigation satellite systems, and simultaneous location and mapping with LiDAR positioning systems.
• Gathering geophysical data and other information to be used in the preparation of scientific reports and compiling and organize environmental data collected by others.
• Preparing basic data and scientific documents utilizing knowledge of natural sciences (geology and geophysics) to explain observations.

jobs.title: Principal Research Strategist (NYC)
jobs.description:
PRINCIPAL RESEARCH STRATEGIST.

Be the face of Conveo's Insight function in the US: the research expert our biggest clients call first, and the commercial partner who helps us win our largest deals.

 - Location: New York, in the office 3 to 4 days a week

 - Compensation: $180K to $250K base, depending on experience, plus equity


ABOUT CONVEO

Conveo is the AI research platform enabling fast, affordable, and high quality consumer / B2B research. Global brands like Unilever, Google, and Orange use our AI video interviewer to generate insights across marketing, product, and research teams.




THE CONTEXT

AI moderation is changing what research can do. Qual depth at quant scale, in days rather than months. Our US client base is growing fast, and the question our biggest clients now ask is no longer "does AI moderation work?" but "what can we do now that was never possible before?" Answering that question, rigorously and commercially, is how we win and grow our most important accounts.

That is why we're hiring a Principal Research Strategist for the US. You'll be the face of Conveo's Insight function in the market. Every major US client will know you. You'll touch all of them, their biggest projects, and their biggest initiatives. You'll work side by side with Sales on our largest deals, with Marketing to build our brand, with Product to invent new methodologies, and with our Research Impact team to crack the hardest client problems.

You’ll spend roughly 70% of your time winning and designing big client programmes with Sales, and ~30% on product, marketing and researcher support.

This is a role with a real say in the strategy of the whole business. It is not for someone looking for a 9-to-5. It's for someone who wants more impact than they've had at any company before.




YOUR MISSION


1. DESIGN RESEARCH THAT SETS THE STANDARD FOR AI MODERATION

You are the methodological authority. When a client has a hard research problem, you design the answer, and it is both innovative and rigorous.

 - Design methodologies for our clients' most important programs, especially ongoing listening programs and trackers

 - Bring quant rigor to AI-moderated research: sample composition, quotas, weighting, statistical testing, and consistency over time

 - Solve clients' most difficult research challenges within the context of Conveo's AI moderation platform

 - Combine approaches like MaxDiff, conjoint, price testing, JTBD, and A&U with AI moderation in ways that weren't possible before

 - Set the methodological bar for how Conveo research is designed, run, and reported


2. BECOME THE TRUSTED INSIGHT PARTNER TO OUR BIGGEST CLIENTS, AND HELP CLOSE OUR BIGGEST DEALS

You build relationships so close that clients come to you as their insight expert, whether the question is about Conveo or not.

 - Own senior relationships with insight leaders and executives at our largest US accounts, up to C-suite

 - Be involved in every major client's biggest projects and initiatives

 - Partner with Sales on our largest deals: discovery, solution design, pitching, and closing

 - Shape proposals that turn a first study into a multi-year, multi-team program

 - Spot expansion opportunities early and bring them to the commercial team


3. BUILD CONVEO'S BRAND AS THE MOST TRUSTED VOICE IN AI MODERATION

With Marketing, you make Conveo the name the US insights industry trusts when it comes to AI moderation.

 - Represent Conveo on stage at major industry conferences and events

 - Lead thought leadership: talks, webinars, articles, and points of view on the future of research

 - Publish research-on-research that proves the quality and validity of AI moderation

 - Build a personal profile in the US insights community that elevates Conveo with it


4. INVENT WHAT'S NEXT WITH PRODUCT AND RESEARCH IMPACT

You bring a creative, builder mindset to what research can become, and you raise the bar across the team.

 - Work with Product to build new features and invent brand-new methodologies that were never possible before

 - Bring the voice of our most sophisticated clients into the roadmap

 - Be the go-to resource for our Research Impact team: unblock client issues, solve the hardest problems, and level up the team's craft

 - Build our syndicated research offering: what it should look like, which topics we own, and how we commercialize it

 - Help drive the strategy of the entire Conveo business as part of the senior leadership group


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR


MUST-HAVES

 - 10+ years in research and insights, ideally across both agency and client side (not a requirement)

 - In-depth knowledge of quant and qual techniques, including sample composition, weighting, statistical techniques, MaxDiff, conjoint, price testing, and ongoing tracking

 - Strong command of research frameworks such as Jobs to be Done, unmet needs, A&U, and innovation research

 - Hands-on experience with AI moderation, a clear understanding of the methodology, and real conviction about its future

 - Extensive experience working with senior stakeholders up to C-suite level

 - A charismatic presenter, someone people naturally gravitate towards

 - Strong commercial instinct, with a track record of helping win or grow significant business


MINDSET

 - High agency, low ego

 - Startup energy: you want to build something, not maintain something

 - Creative and inventive: new methodologies excite you, and you don't wait for permission to try them

 - Rigorous without being rigid: you know when precision matters and when speed does

 - AI-native: you use AI tools every day and see where research is going before others do


NICE TO HAVE

 - An existing network among insight leaders at major US brands

 - A track record of speaking at industry events or publishing thought leadership

 - Experience at a start up


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

After 6 to 12 months:

 - Every major US client knows you by name, and their insight leaders call you first when they have a hard question

 - You have played a direct role in closing several of our largest US deals

 - At least one flagship listening or tracking program you designed is live with a major client

 - Conveo has a visible presence on the main stage at key US industry events

 - You've shipped at least one new methodology or feature with Product that clients are using

 - The Research Impact team solves hard problems faster and better because you're there

 - Our syndicated offering has a clear shape, a commercial model, and a first product in market or in pilot


WHY JOIN CONVEO?

At Conveo, you'll join a team that genuinely enjoys working, and spending time, together. We care about building real relationships, not just great products. That's why we run bi-annual team offsites where we disconnect, reset, and have fun.

 - Own a high-impact senior role at a hyper-growth, YC-backed AI company

 - Help define what great research looks like in the AI era, and be known for it

 - Direct access to founders and senior leadership, with a real voice in company strategy

 - Work with world-class enterprise clients 

 - Hybrid working: in the office 3 days a week in New York

 - Competitive compensation with meaningful equity upside

 - A culture built on taste, speed, ownership, and ambition

We are product-led and self-serve: customers find us, adopt us, and grow with us without an enterprise sales motion.

The Role

Own the technology behind how 5 million-plus people run their operations with Teamup.com, and lead its AI transformation. Teamup is a shared scheduling calendar that teams and operations worldwide use to put their people, equipment, and locations on one live schedule, on web, iOS, and Android. You will lead the engineering team and accelerate its shift to AI-driven, agentic engineering, and help shape the product.

The Opportunity

• A beloved platform of 5 million-plus monthly active users, in daily use worldwide

• Grow the product and expand its reach, with AI at the center of how Teamup builds and what it ships

• A flat organization of doers: a small, distributed team with the speed, ownership, and impact of a lean company You will join Teamup directly as a core member of the leadership team, reporting to the CEO. You will own the full technology strategy, engineering organization, product delivery, and platform architecture. The platform has to be reliable, the data has to be an asset, and the opportunity to create competitive distance through AI is real.

Responsibilities

• Accelerate the team's move to agentic engineering, raising shipping velocity while delivering the reliability users depend on

• Define and ship AI-powered products for Teamup users and their agents

• Lead the engineering team and own production end to end: priorities, code review, development cadence, releases, database changes, incident response, and the capacity and cost decisions behind the platform

• Be accountable for hosting and operating a global SaaS platform: infrastructure, availability, observability, backup and disaster recovery, and data protection

• Lead the product roadmap and prioritization, setting direction in the open with the CEO and leadership team, and formalize the product and engineering process

Requirements

• Led real AI adoption on a team that ships and runs live software, with outcomes to show for it

• 10+ years building and running software, with technology leadership at a large-scale, product-led SaaS company

• Mastery of a modern language and relational databases at scale. This is a hands-on role: code, database, and product work, not oversight

• Experience running the systems behind millions of users: reliability, security and compliance, performance, cost

• Based in the North America Eastern or Atlantic time zone, with regular morning overlap with a Europe-based team

Nice to Have

• Experience with calendaring, scheduling, and time zones

• Experience delivering single sign-on, automated user provisioning, ISO 27001, GDPR, and security reviews

Who You Are

• You build with AI every day because you want to, and you stay close to the code even as you lead

• You are fluent in both technology and product, and enjoy shipping with a small, high-talent team

Why TeamUp and Banyan

A permanent home. We buy, hold, and grow software companies for life. We don't resell. In a market where agentic AI is restructuring SaaS right now, permanence gives you the freedom to move faster: invest in AI-first engineering, AI-first product, and product-led growth, and make the decisions that companies on a three-to-five-year clock cannot afford to make.

Autonomy with backing. Product strategy, stack choices, team structure, delivery practices, AI strategy. These are yours. We operate with a collaborative, decentralized culture where the entrepreneurial spirit of each company stays intact. We provide capital, shared services, and a network of operating partners. We do not tell you how to run your product and engineering organization.

A personal approach. Banyan operates like a family office. We care about the companies we acquire, the people who built them, and the teams who run them.

Legacy and continuity. We preserve the brand, the identity, and the culture of the companies we acquire. You are building on a foundation that will be protected, never consolidated or stripped for parts.

A peer network. A community of portfolio company product and technology leaders navigating the same challenges: AI adoption, product-led growth, scaling teams, and building on established codebases. You are not solving these problems alone.

Additional Job Details

Stooping/Bending

Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.

Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.

Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.

Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting

Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.

Workers reach above 72 occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.

Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.

Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Hand Tasks

Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day.

Frequently activities require use of one or both hands.

Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists.

Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter.

Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes.

Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

Machines, Tools, Equipment, Work Aids

Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

Deliver product by car and then to door of customer.

Valid driver's license with safe driving record meeting company standards.

Access to an insured vehicle which can be used for delivery.

ESSENTIAL SKILLS

Navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area.

Must navigate adverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

Carrying

During delivery, carry pizzas and beverages while performing walking and climbing duties.

Driving

Deliver pizzas within a designated delivery area. A Team Member may make several deliveries per shift.

Walking

Delivery personnel must travel between the store and delivery vehicle and from the delivery vehicle to the customer's location.

Climbing

During delivery of product, navigation of five or more flights of stairs may be required.

WORK CONDITIONS

Exposure To

Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when delivering product, driving and couponing.

SENSING

Far vision and night vision for driving.

jobs.title: Driver and Facilities Associate
jobs.description:
Revivn is a profitable and rapidly growing company that helps enterprises manage their technology through our end of life software platform. We take electronic recycling one step further by repurposing hardware that still has remaining life and providing it to people who lack dedicated computer access and make it more affordable for people who may not be able to purchase new technology. Working with companies like Instacart, Adobe, Block, Etsy, Justworks, and Teach for America, we are changing the way companies view used technology with a new model that focuses on repurposing instead of recycling.

As a Driver at Revivn, you'll play a critical role in our mission to give new life to old technology. This position is much more than driving—you're one of the primary faces of Revivn, providing white glove service to our customers while ensuring the secure collection, transportation, and handling of enterprise IT assets.

You'll operate a 26-foot box truck to complete scheduled pickups throughout the New York City area and surrounding regions, averaging 7-10 collection trips each week. You'll regularly interact with building management, security personnel, and client representatives to coordinate pickups, maintain chain of custody, and deliver an exceptional customer experience.

When you're not on the road, you'll support warehouse and facilities operations by receiving and processing incoming hardware, preparing equipment for future pickups, maintaining inventory accuracy, and contributing to the overall efficiency of our operations.

This is an in-person position based in Brooklyn, NY in the Brooklyn Navy Yard. The schedule is Monday through Friday, 7:30am-4:00pm.

Responsibilities

• Safely operate 26-foot box trucks to transport IT equipment throughout the NYC area and regional locations.

• Coordinate and execute white glove pickups of enterprise IT equipment from customer offices, data centers, and commercial buildings.

• Serve as a professional representative of Revivn during every customer interaction, demonstrating excellent communication, professionalism, and sound judgment.

• Load, unload, secure, and transport unboxed electronics and other technology equipment while maintaining chain of custody and protecting customer assets.

• Assist with inventory tracking, including scanning, documenting, and accurately processing hardware as required.

• Support facilities operations, including equipment cleaning, hardware processing, and maintaining an organized warehouse.

• Help maintain inventory accuracy and prepare materials for shipment or customer collection.

• Follow all DOT regulations, company safety procedures, and vehicle inspection requirements.

Schedule & Travel Expectations

This position is primarily scheduled Monday through Friday from 7:30am to 4:00pm; however, flexibility is essential to meet customer pickup schedules.

• Overtime is regularly available and expected based on business needs.

• Some pickup routes require an earlier start time than the standard schedule.

• Regional trips may involve extended workdays, with drivers typically returning by or before 7:00pm.

• Occasional travel throughout NYC and surrounding regions is required.

• Candidates should be comfortable with varying daily schedules while maintaining a high level of professionalism and customer service throughout each trip.

What We’re Looking For

• Valid driver's license with a clean driving record.

• Minimum of 2 years of experience operating commercial vehicles, including box trucks (up to 26 feet) or larger.

• Comfortable driving throughout NYC and regional destinations.

• Strong customer service and communication skills with the ability to interact professionally with clients, building management, and security personnel.

• Experience working in customer-facing environments while representing an organization professionally.

• Ability to safely lift, move, and transport equipment weighing 50 pounds or more.

• Comfortable standing, walking, bending, and performing physical work throughout the day.

• Strong attention to detail with the ability to accurately handle inventory and follow operational processes.

• Self-motivated, dependable, and able to work independently with minimal supervision.

• Working knowledge of DOT rules and regulations.

If this sounds like you, apply! If you don’t meet all of the qualifications but think you could be a match, we’d still love the chance to review your application.

We embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive environment. At Revivn, we encourage people from all ages, abilities, and experiences to apply. Revivn does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, ancestry, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or family status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, pregnancy or caregiver status, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

This may vary depending on living location and market rate.

jobs.title: Field Service Mechanical Technician
jobs.location: Ashburn, Virginia, United States; Atlanta, Georgia, United States; Dallas, Texas, United States; Fremont, California, United States; Jacksonville, Florida, United States; Phoenix, Arizona, United States
jobs.description:
At IEM, we’re not just building innovative electrical distribution systems, we’re shaping the future. IEM is dedicated to delivering world-class solutions for complex power needs. After 75 years, we continue to push the boundaries of what’s possible. Whether you’re an experienced professional or just starting out, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, grow, and make a lasting impact on industries that power the world’s most dynamic markets.

PURPOSE OF POSITION:

The purpose of the Field Service Mechanical Technician is to perform the installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of busway systems and mechanical installations at customer sites. This position participates in corrective field actions related to quality improvement, manufacturing remediation, and warranty work. The role also assists with commissioning and startup, including installation of IEM equipment components and subassemblies, primarily in data centers and industrial applications.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:

This position has no direct supervisory responsibilities.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

• Execute the installation, inspection, and commissioning of electrical busway systems and mechanical components at customer sites.

• Work as part of mechanical field service teams to ensure work is performed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with specifications, industry standards, and OEM guidelines.

• Report project milestones and goals to coordinate project timelines and logistics.

• Perform onsite troubleshooting, diagnostics, and repairs of electrical and mechanical systems to ensure installed equipment functions properly.

• Participate in corrective field actions related to quality improvement, manufacturing remediation, and warranty items.

• Assist with commissioning and startup of IEM equipment at customer sites, including installation of components and subassemblies.

• Maintain accurate reports on installations, inspections, service activities, and required follow up actions.

• Ensure compliance with health, safety, and environmental regulations during installation and service activities.

• Support on the job training of field service technicians and service team members, providing technical mechanical guidance and reinforcing IEM quality standards.

• Stay current with advancements in busway and mechanical systems and contribute to process improvements in the field.

• Collaborate with engineering and project management teams to resolve design, installation, and operational issues.

• Perform installation and modification of electrical or mechanical components and subassemblies, including panelboard interiors, circuit breakers, bus bars, switchgear section doors and subpanels, metering components, power cabling, and control wiring.

• Provide technical support to field service management and commercial sales teams, answering installation questions within their expertise and referring issues requiring additional technical direction to the Mechanical Lead.

• Confirm schematics are correct and required materials are available before arriving onsite.

• Coordinate with technical project managers and manufacturing facilities to resolve product or commissioning issues identified by IEM or reported by customers. Identify additional field resources and replacement parts needed.

• Prepare and distribute complete service reports, project closeout paperwork, and other required documentation.

• Prepare and submit all customer field trip service and startup reports weekly for review and recordkeeping.

• Perform other duties as assigned by management.

COMPETENCIES:

• Collaboration: Partners effectively with project teams, sales, engineering, manufacturing, field personnel, and customers to resolve issues and meet project requirements.

• Communication: Clearly conveys technical information, installation requirements, service findings, and project updates through discussions and written reports.

• Critical Thinking: Evaluates complex mechanical and electrical issues to identify practical troubleshooting, repair, and process improvement solutions.

• Accountability: Takes ownership of field work quality, safety, documentation, and follow-up actions to ensure commitments are completed accurately.

• Organizational Skills: Coordinates project resources, materials, schedules, and service reports while managing multiple tasks and priorities.

• Adaptability: Responds effectively to changing site conditions, project priorities, and complex field service challenges.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

• Associate or bachelor’s degree in electrical or mechanical engineering, or related field experience.

• 1 year of experience in field service, electrical busway, or mechanical systems required; experience with an OEM preferred.

• Strong understanding of busway systems, electrical codes, electrical-mechanical systems, and troubleshooting techniques.

• Ability to read and interpret electrical and mechanical drawings, schematics, blueprints, and mechanical assembly drawings.

• Proficiency with hand and power tools and a solid understanding of safety protocols.

• Strong communication and customer service skills, with the ability to work collaboratively with IEM project teams, sales, engineering, key stakeholders, and customers.

• Proficiency in report writing and Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook preferred.

• IEM employee training experience and the ability to implement field process improvements preferred.

• Experience with electrical testing equipment, including multimeters and insulation resistance testers, preferred.

• OEM certification in busway systems or mechanical installations preferred.

• Knowledge of NFPA, NEC, and other relevant standards for electrical and mechanical installations preferred.

PHYSICAL/MENTAL/ENVIRONMENTAL: Physical Demands: Activities: Lifting: Sitting – 30% Walking/Standing – 70% Must be able to lift and carry up to 50lbs. Vision, Travel, Mental Demands, Environment: Prolonged periods of computer use and other tasks requiring close visual attention, such as reviewing documents or detailed materials. Extensive travel (up to 80%) may be required to IEM manufacturing facilities, regional field offices and vendor sites. Requires the ability to interpret, analyze, research, and handle multiple tasks simultaneously. Must be able to troubleshoot complex electrical and mechanical issues, coordinate field activities, and manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment. Work duties will be performed in a combination of office settings and field/site locations.

Why Join IEM

At IEM, you’ll join a team that powers some of the world’s most ambitious projects. We’re engineers, makers, and problem-solvers who thrive on tackling complex challenges and delivering solutions that keep industries moving forward. If you’re driven, collaborative, and ready to make an impact, we’d love to hear from you. Your creativity and passion can help us achieve great things—come be part of the journey.

Learn more about IEM at https://www.iemfg.com

We offer comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support our employees' well-being, growth, and long-term success. View a snapshot of our benefits at https://www.iemfg.com/careers

Recruiting Scams

Beware of recruiting scams. IEM never charges candidates fees, and all recruiter emails come from an @iemfg.com address. If you suspect fraudulent activity, do not share personal information and report it to us at iemfg.com/contact

Non-Discrimination Statement

IEM does not discriminate against any applicant based on any characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Regional Service Manager
jobs.description:
Build the Future with Us — EquipmentShare is Hiring a Regional Service Manager

At EquipmentShare, we’re not just filling a role — we’re assembling the best team on the planet to build something that’s never been built before. We’re on a mission to transform an industry that’s been stuck in the past by empowering contractors and communities through innovative technology, real-time support, and a team that truly cares.

We’re hiring a Regional Service Manager at our rental facility in Cincinnati, OH, and we’re looking for someone who’s ready to grow with us, bring energy and drive to their work, and help us build the future of construction. This position will be responsible for leading a team of Heavy Equipment Maintenance Technicians (Mechanics).

Schedule: Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM

Primary Responsibilities

As a Service Manager, you’ll use our tech to create, assign, and monitor work orders, track machine service intervals, order parts, and diagnose issues faster by pulling data from hundreds of makes and models. With real-time information at your fingertips, you can determine the root cause and corrective action for each issue quickly, enabling you to work smarter, not harder.

• Coordination and supervision of quality performance of our equipment mechanics and service personnel

• Scheduling repairs for customer and company owned rental equipment

• Maintain and nurture existing customer relationships to ensure that our customers are 100% satisfied with the level of service and support they are receiving from EquipmentShare and are being kept up-to-date about new or additional ways in which EquipmentShare can help improve their business

• Promptly respond to and resolve customer inquiries, requests, complaints or other communications

• Employee training and development and maintaining a safe work environment

• Other duties, assigned as needed

Why EquipmentShare?

Because we do things differently — and we think you’ll feel it from day one. We’re a people-first company powered by cutting-edge technology. That means our proprietary T3 platform doesn’t just run our business — it also makes your job easier, safer, and more connected. Whether you’re behind the wheel, under the hood, leading a branch, or closing deals — tech supports you, and you drive us forward.

We’re a team of problem-solvers, go-getters, and builders. And we’re looking for teammates who take pride in doing meaningful work and want to be part of building something special.

Perks & Benefits

• Monthly Family Dinner Night — We treat you and your family to dinner every month, because family comes first. (An employee favorite!) *restrictions apply

• Competitive compensation: Base salary plus Company Profit Sharing Plan

• Company provided truck

• Full medical, dental, and vision coverage for full-time employees

• 401(k) and company match

• Generous PTO + paid holidays

• Gym membership stipend + wellness programs (earn PTO and prizes!)

• Annual tool and boot reimbursements for those in applicable jobs

• Company events, food truck nights, and monthly team dinners

• 16 hours of paid volunteer time per year — give back to the community you call home

• Career advancement, leadership training, and professional development opportunities

• Access to industry leading diagnostic tools

About You

You want to be part of a team that’s not just changing an industry for the sake of change — we’re transforming it to make it safer, more secure, and more productive. You bring grit, heart, and humility to your work, and you’re excited about the opportunity to grow within a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

We’re looking for people who:

• See challenges as opportunities

• Embrace change and continuous improvement

• Bring energy, effort, and optimism every day

Skills and Qualifications

Required Skills/Abilities:

• Industry knowledge (this can be in the rental industry or a related construction field), innovative and dependable. Ideally three years of maintenance and service experience.

• Strong interpersonal and problem solving skills.

• Adaptable to the fast pace of a growing company and be able to quickly educate themselves about and stay up-to-date on the latest EquipmentShare products and services.

• Competitive, but thrive in a team oriented environment. Preference will be given to applicants with experience and/or a background in the construction industry.

• Superior customer service, teamwork and verbal/written communication skills

Education and Experience:

• High School diploma, Trade school certificate preferred

• Experience in field service, maintenance and repair preferred

• Experience leading maintenance teams

• Valid driver's license with acceptable driving record. Must be at least 21 years old to operate company vehicle

Physical Requirements:

• Must be able to move, stand, stoop and bend freely

• Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds at times

• This is a safety sensitive position and any offer of employment will be contingent on passing a 10 panel drug screen

A Workplace For All

At EquipmentShare, we believe the best solutions come from a team that reflects the world around us. Our initiative — A Workplace For All — is rooted in the belief that we must work together to solve some of the toughest problems in construction. That means attracting, developing, and retaining great people from all walks of life.

We value different backgrounds, talents, and perspectives. We want you to feel like you belong here — because you do.

EquipmentShare is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

Employment is contingent on passing a background check. Additionally, some roles require passing a drug test, depending on the job responsibilities.

jobs.title: Financial Analyst, FP&A – Marketing
jobs.description:
About Us

SharkNinja is a global product design and technology company, with a diversified portfolio of 5-star rated lifestyle solutions that positively impact people’s lives in homes around the world. Powered by two trusted, global brands, Shark and Ninja, the company has a proven track record of bringing disruptive innovation to market and developing one consumer product after another has allowed SharkNinja to enter multiple product categories, driving significant growth and market share gains. Headquartered in Needham, Massachusetts with more than 4,100 associates, the company’s products are sold at key retailers, online and offline, and through distributors around the world.

AI at SharkNinja

At SharkNinja, we’re building an AI-native culture. We’re not waiting for the future; we’re creating it. Our people are expected to experiment boldly, adopt new tools, and continuously raise what’s possible to create meaningful impact for our consumers. If you believe the best way to do your job hasn’t been invented yet, you’ll fit right in.

Marketing is the engine of how SharkNinja operates and grows, and you will be a core part of the finance team that makes the numbers clear, accurate, and ready to act on.

At SharkNinja, our mission is to positively impact people's lives every day in every home around the world. We bring that mission to life through bold innovation, creative, quality, and viral content, a relentless focus on consumers, and an Outrageously Extraordinary mindset that challenges conventional thinking.

The Financial Analyst, FP&A – Marketing role sits at the forefront of the company's growth. You will help the team decide where the next dollar of marketing investment goes, which channels earn more, and which bets are worth testing. Leaders will come to you for clean, reliable answers, and over time for a point of view.

You will work on the team that manages the Global Marketing function: consolidating regional media plans and results, partnering with leaders across all parts of the marketing funnel, building and presenting business cases, analyzing performance, and supporting key decision making. You will balance hands-on analysis with a growing view of the business, navigate messy data and tight deadlines, and deliver improvements across multiple workstreams. You will embody our Relentless Drive for Edge by seeking better ways to analyze performance and challenge assumptions, and bring an Insatiable Impatience for Action, turning analysis into quick, useful answers as part of a collaborative team delivering Outrageously Extraordinary results.

What you'll do

Planning, reporting, and controls

• Run monthly actuals-versus-forecast analysis for media, marketing, samples, and affiliates, explaining variances across the channels and businesses.

• Consolidate regional media and marketing investment results into one company view with consistent report outs.

• Build the reporting packages and dashboards that leaders use to make investment decisions.

• Be a steward for financial controllership by partnering with accounting, reviewing accruals, and approving spend within the budget.

Business partnership

• Work with marketing, media, and program owners to understand what is driving the numbers.

• Bring questions and a first view to the team early, so the answer is ready when leaders ask.

• Build new views of marketing cost and performance that leaders have not had before: new metrics, deeper analytics, and cleaner P&L cuts.

• Support new business launches and build the investment plans to deliver them.

• Challenge the way things are done, and build new ways to save time and deliver value. Encourage the team to do the same.

• Take on ad hoc analysis, and follow it through to a clear answer.

Building with AI and automation

• Use AI tools to clean data, draft variance commentary, and build first-pass analyses quickly.

• Pull, clean, and model data yourself, and build repeatable processes.

• Drive improvement: continually move manual and repetitive work into automation.

What you bring

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field.

• 1–3 years of FP&A, accounting, or finance analysis experience.

• Advanced Excel, including formulas, pivot tables, and clean modeling, plus visualization tools, ERP systems, or data management tools.

• Experience in consumer products, retail, e-commerce, or media. Marketing or affiliate program background is a plus.

• Hands-on AI fluency: you use AI tools in your own workflow and can show what you built.

• Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain a number in plain language.

How you'll work

• Details make the difference: the consolidation ties out, and you can show why.

• Speed: you give a quick first answer, then make it better.

• Curiosity: you ask why the number moved, not only what it is.

• Drive: you take on the next task and own the outcome.

• Scrappy builder: you find a faster way to do the work and show the team how it works.

Salary and Other Compensation: The annual salary range for this position is displayed below. Factors which may affect starting pay within this range may include geography/market, skills, education, experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

The Company offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements: medical insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts (HSA) with company contribution, 401(k) retirement plan with matching, employee stock purchase program, life insurance, AD&D, short-term disability insurance, long-term disability insurance, generous paid time off, company holidays, parental leave, identity theft protection, pet insurance, pre-paid legal insurance, back-up child and eldercare days, product discounts, referral bonus program, and more.

Pay Range

$58,100—$105,300 USD

Our Culture

At SharkNinja, we don’t just raise the bar—we push past it every single day.  Our Outrageously Extraordinary mindset drives us to tackle the impossible, push boundaries, and deliver results that others only dream of. If you thrive on breaking out of your swim lane, you’ll be right at home.

What We Offer

We offer competitive health insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, employee stock purchase options, wellness programs, SharkNinja product discounts, and more. We empower your personal and professional growth with high impact Learning Programs featuring bold voices redefining what’s possible. When you join, you’re not just part of a company—you’re part of an outrageously extraordinary community. Together, we won’t just launch products—we’ll disrupt entire markets.

At SharkNinja, Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion are vital to our global success. Valuing each unique voice and blending all of our diverse skills strengthens SharkNinja’s innovation every day. We support ALL associates in bringing their authentic selves to work, making an impact, and having the opportunity for career acceleration. With help from our leadership, associates, and our community, we aim to have equity be a key component of the SharkNinja DNA.

Learn more about us:
Life At SharkNinja
Outrageously Extraordinary

SharkNinja Candidate Privacy Notice

• For candidates based in all regions, please refer to this Candidate Privacy Notice.

• For candidates based in China, please refer to this Candidate Privacy Notice.

• For candidates based in Vietnam, please refer to this Candidate Privacy Notice.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, or any other class protected by legislation, and local law. SharkNinja will consider reasonable accommodations consistent with legislation, and local law. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, please contact SharkNinja People & Culture at accommodations@sharkninja.com

jobs.description:
At AbbVie, our business strategies are centered around the patients at the core of everything we envision. The Patient Support Programs Lead will be responsible for overseeing all of AbbVie’s Patient Support Programs, as well as coordinating multiple support functions and activities for the patient’s in-field team. Critical thinking and influence in diverse patient strategies, initiatives and educational interactions would be essential capabilities for this role. This position will report to the Patient Relations Manager and will work cross-functionally with the different Brand Teams, Functional Areas, and Business Partners in designing, implementing, and measuring the effectiveness of key patient solutions and services.

Responsibilities

• Lead AbbVie Care Specialists and Patient Advocates and provide guidance and support, including training, mentoring, and effective feedback to foster a culture of continuous learning and engagement within the team.
• Implement and monitor metrics to measure the effectiveness and impact of Patient Programs, identify trends and patterns, and make data-driven recommendations for improvements and cost-savings opportunities.
• Establish and maintain a robust system for tracking and reporting Patient Programs metrics, including key performance indicators, progress towards goals, among other relevant business intelligence.
• Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and ethical standards in the management and monitoring of AbbVie Patient Programs.
• Utilize strong analytical, negotiation, and problem-solving skills to effectively address any challenges or barriers for the success of Patient Programs initiatives.
• Develop an advanced comprehension of the overall healthcare landscape that encompasses treatment access and affordability to provide guidance and support to the patient’s in-field team.
• Define the messaging and positioning for Patient Programs, ensuring alignment with overall brand strategy, timelines, budgets, resourcing, and deliverables.
• Development of all Patient Programs resources (digital/printed materials and tools) by effectively leading the creative agency in the concept design, realization, and internal material review process.
• Connect regularly with key stakeholders, including the Affiliate Management Team, Brand Team Leaders, IFT, Team Members and External Business Partners, to assess Patient Programs status and any relevant business decision.
• Lead and/or collaborate in meetings, workshops, trainings, and conferences to maintain the cross-functional teams updated on the latest trends and developments in patient engagement, compliance, and quality systems.
• Manage a team of field personnel.

Significant Work Activities:

• Frequent to continuous computer usage (greater or equal to 50% of the workday) is required

• Licensed U.S. Professional Engineer (PE or SE).

• Experience with BIM ACC (Revit), ETABS, RISA, RAM, SAP2000, Safe, etc.
• Experience with precast concrete systems, steel design, seismic design, and foundation systems.
• Demonstrated experience with low embodied carbon materials and sustainable structural design approaches.

Preferred Qualifications:

jobs.title: Security Operations Responder
jobs.description:
ABOUT TIDE

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:

• Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs

• Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing

• Over $300 million raised in funding

• 3,000 Tideans globally

• Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026

• We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Tide Security Engineering team is made up of three core areas: Product Security, Identity, Threat Detection & Response

Product Security consists of application and cloud security experts. Their mission is to protect the products we build, covering everything from secure design reviews to threat modelling and penetration testing, ensuring security is embedded from the ground up.

Threat Detection & Response (this role!) focuses on protecting the company by building a robust detection and automation platform. We’re proactive in our defence, constantly hacking ourselves to improve our security posture and staying ahead of emerging threats. Our goal is to make Tide resilient against the ever-evolving threat landscape.

Identity is responsible for managing Tide's staff identity platform, ensuring that access to systems and infrastructure is secure, seamless, and aligned with modern security practices. The team uses strategies like zero trust, multi-factor authentication, and granular role-based access controls to safeguard our internal operations.

While each area has its own focus, collaboration is key - it's why we share the same Slack channel and hold our standups together as one cohesive team, ensuring alignment and seamless communication across all security functions.

As a Security Operations Responder, you’ll be on the front line of defending Tide. Your primary focus is actively investigating threats through our security data lake and SOAR platform – but we don’t want anyone working the same alert by hand twice. Your goal is to make investigation effective at scale: cutting manual effort through automation, and working hand-in-hand with our Detection Engineering team to improve the true positive / false positive efficacy of what lands in the queue.

When the security queue is empty, you’ll be building – automations, enrichment and your own detections. An open mind and a curious approach are key: every investigation is a chance to make the next one faster and sharper.

As a Security Operations Responder, you’ll be:

Investigating and responding to threats (your primary focus)

• Actively triaging and investigating security alerts and threats through our security data lake and SOAR platform, across AWS, GCP, SaaS (such as Google Workspace and Okta), internal applications and employee endpoints (Windows, macOS).

• Driving every investigation to a clear, well-evidenced outcome – establishing scope, impact and root cause, and taking containment and remediation actions quickly and confidently.

• Leading the response to complex or high-severity incidents where needed, coordinating across security, IT and engineering teams through containment, remediation and recovery.

• Documenting investigations clearly and consistently, and contributing to the runbooks and investigation standards the whole team works to.

Scaling investigation through automation & Improving detection efficacy

• Reducing manual investigation by building SOAR playbooks, security automations and services – from data enrichment and context gathering through to automated response, such as removing phishing emails from employee mailboxes. We want you to run with the “anything is possible” mantra.

• Spotting repetitive work in the queue and turning it into automated workflows, so the team’s time goes on the investigations that genuinely need human judgement.

• Identifying gaps in log sources, parsing and enrichment in the data lake, and working to close them so investigations have the visibility they need.

• Feeding investigation outcomes back to the Detection Engineering team – flagging noisy rules, tuning false positives and highlighting coverage gaps – to continuously improve TP/FP efficacy.

• Tracking investigation metrics (such as MTTD, MTTR, TP/FP rate and automation coverage) and using them to prioritise where to improve next.

Building when the queue is clear

• Writing, testing and shipping your own detections alongside Detection Engineering, following our test-driven, detections-as-code practices.

• Proactively hunting for sophisticated threats across our infrastructure, using threat intelligence and lessons from past investigations to stay ahead of attackers.

• Building or enhancing internal tools that streamline investigation, improve data visibility and increase response efficiency.

• Sharing knowledge and mentoring other members of the team, raising the bar for how we investigate and respond.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• Significant hands-on experience in security operations, incident response or threat investigation, ideally in a cloud-native environment.

• Strong investigative instincts and log analysis skills at scale, with the ability to query a security data lake or SIEM fluently – strong knowledge of one of the following: Splunk, Scanner, Sentinel, SecOps.

• Strong understanding of modern attack and defence techniques which apply to Cloud (AWS, GCP), SaaS (such as Google Workspace and Okta) and desktop (Windows and macOS) environments, and the ability to map activity to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.

• Strong experience in security automation, from writing scripts (e.g. Python) to creating end-to-end automated workflows. Familiarity with SOAR platforms and automating investigation and response tasks.

• Experience writing or tuning detections, and a clear view of what separates a high-fidelity alert from a noisy one.

• Calm, methodical judgement during live incidents, including knowing when and how to escalate.

• An open mind and a curious approach – you enjoy pulling on threads, and you don’t stop at “false positives” without understanding why.

• Hands-on attitude and the ability to drive solutions to completion.

• Passion for passing on knowledge to fellow colleagues.

• Excellent spoken and written communication skills, including clear investigation write-ups for both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Bonus points if you have a repository showcasing automations, detections or tooling you’ve built.

WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN

Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:

• Competitive Compensation – competitive salary.

• Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.

• Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.

• Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.

• Health Insurance – Private health insurance with Bulgaria Zdrave, including extra dental care.

• Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.

• Volunteering & Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.

• Learning & Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.

• WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.

• Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office.

• Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.

• Fully Covered Multi Sports Card – Granting access to hundreds of gyms and pools across Bulgaria.

• Monthly Food Vouchers – Monthly food vouchers to enjoy your favorite meals with Edenred +.

• Snacks & Meals – Daily breakfast spread with all-day coffee, tea, and juices.

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.

Disclaimer

It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. Please be aware that:

• Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.

• All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel.

• Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide.co email address.

• Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.

If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide.co
Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.

Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy.

Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice.
