This is a role for someone who wants to own the technical vision for how Strava's social features work under the hood. You'll drive major modernization efforts across critical services, partner with product teams to ensure platform capabilities are ready when they need them, and shape how we approach social platform development for years to come.

We follow a flexible hybrid model that translates to more than half of your time on-site in our San Francisco or Denver office — three days per week.




WHAT YOU’LL DO:

 - Set the technical direction for Strava's social platform services and build the roadmap that balances long-term architectural investments with near-term product delivery.

 - Act as tech lead for a small pod of engineers, facilitating team processes like quarterly planning, sprint ceremonies, and cross-team coordination.

 - Solve tough technical problems and lead small teams to execute those solutions, even if it means stepping outside your usual domain.

 - Drive modernization and migration efforts for critical platform services, evolving our stack to meet the needs of the product roadmap and Strava's growing athlete base.

 - Partner with product teams to inform the roadmap to proactively identify upcoming needs and have the right capabilities available at the right time.

 - Own a strategy for technical investment across the social domain, ensuring critical services meet reliability, performance, and cost standards.

 - Design, build, and review the systems that back Strava's most-used social features, working across Ruby, Scala, Go, MySQL, Redis, Cassandra, Kafka, and Kubernetes.

 - Mentor engineers on the pod and across the Strava tech team.




WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO THE TEAM:

 - 10+ years of professional backend/server engineering experience, with a track record of setting technical direction.

 - Experience leading technical projects involving multiple engineers: scoping work, breaking it down, coordinating delivery across a team.

 - Experience acting as a tech lead, facilitating team processes and driving roadmaps.

 - Strong system design skills for distributed systems at scale: making architecture decisions, defending trade-offs, and thinking about how a system needs to evolve over multiple years.

 - Proficiency in at least one of Strava's backend languages (Ruby, Scala, Go, Java) with comfort picking up others.

 - Experience with distributed systems technologies like Kafka, Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud infrastructure (AWS).

 - Experience with relational and NoSQL databases in production (we use MySQL, Redis, and Cassandra).

 - A genuine interest in leading the team to prioritize the right work, and deliver it well. You’re interested in more than just putting your head down on an assigned project.



We're not looking for 100% coverage on all of these — if you match most of them, we'd love to hear from you:

 - Experience with feed systems, social graphs, or recommendation/ranking systems.

 - Experience with large-scale system migrations (e.g., moving a critical service from one language/framework to another).

 - Familiarity with server-driven UI patterns.



For information on benefits, please click here https://docs.google.com/document/d/e/2PACX-1vTkFMPz3eCjd0FgQ28VWnK4d2BEnzGyaSFGwATR-dQdBb9HxZgay6kboqnT0-V-qaBDzSvYIzI76vT5/pub.




WHY JOIN US?



Movement brings us together. At Strava, we’re building the world’s largest community of active people, helping them stay motivated and achieve their goals.

Our global team is passionate about making movement fun, meaningful, and accessible to everyone. Whether you’re shaping the technology, growing our community, or driving innovation, your work at Strava makes an impact.

When you join Strava, you’re not just joining a company—you’re joining a movement. If you’re ready to bring your energy, ideas, and drive, let’s build something incredible together.

Strava builds software that makes the best part of our athletes’ days even better. Just as we’re deeply committed to unlocking their potential, we’re dedicated to providing a world-class, inclusive workplace where our employees can grow and thrive, too. We’re backed by Sequoia Capital, TCV, Madrone Partners and Jackson Square Ventures, and we’re expanding in order to exceed the needs of our growing community of global athletes. Our culture reflects our community. We are continuously striving to hire and engage teammates from all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives because we know we are a stronger team together.

jobs.location: Amsterdam, North Holland, Netherlands; Berlin, Berlin, Germany; London, England, United Kingdom; New York, NY, United States; Toronto, Ontario, Canada; Warszawa, Masovian Voivodeship, Poland
jobs.description:
The role

HelloFresh manages approximately €1.7B in annual direct procurement spend across ingredients and packaging, covering markets in the EU, US, Canada, ANZ, and the UK. This role builds the cost intelligence capability for Global Procurement. You will create the analytical models and frameworks that give the business clear visibility into what ingredients really cost: where those costs come from, how they move, and where the opportunities lie. Your work will give regional teams the insight they need to make well-grounded decisions and to track progress against the group's cost reduction ambitions. This is a role for a senior procurement professional who is comfortable with detailed analysis and who can explain complex numbers simply to senior leaders and to colleagues in markets. You will be recognized as the go-to expert on cost across the team.

What you’ll do

• Develop a harmonized cost measurement methodology with Finance and regional procurement teams, so that ingredient savings are defined, measured, and reported consistently across all markets.

• Build should-cost models and total cost of ownership frameworks for priority categories, breaking unit price into its drivers (origin, processing method, logistics, certification, and shelf life), and use them to identify savings and inform sourcing decisions.

• Track ingredient price drivers across markets, including contract prices, actual prices, and market inflation, and identify overlap across brands to find rationalization and consolidation opportunities.

• Report progress against the group's ingredient cost reduction target to senior leadership, explaining root causes rather than just variances, and help build the governance needed to sustain this over time.

You are...

• An analytical professional who builds models that hold up to scrutiny from Finance and senior leadership.

• Commercially minded: you look at total value, not just unit price, and you understand what drives cost in food and packaging.

• A clear communicator who turns complex analysis into a simple story that regional teams can act on.

• Collaborative: you build alignment with Finance, procurement, and market teams through influence rather than authority.

• Self-directed: you manage several analyses at once and take ownership from the question through to the recommendation.

You have...

• 5+ years in procurement, cost analysis, or consulting in a global food, retail, or consumer goods business.

• Hands-on experience building should-cost models or total cost of ownership frameworks, and using them to influence real commercial decisions.

• Experience measuring cost and savings across multiple markets, including the common pitfalls such as inconsistent methods, inflation effects, and volume mix.

• Experience with food, ingredient, or packaging categories, including origin, certification, and specification considerations.

• Fluent in English. Bonus if fluent in French, German, or Dutch. Comfortable working across time zones, with the ability to travel up to 20%.

Nice to have...

• Familiarity with sustainability certification schemes and their cost implications.

• Experience with commodity price risk or hedging frameworks.

You'll get…

If based in New York or Toronto:

• Competitive salary & retirement savings plan with company match

• Generous parental leave & PTO policy, plus paid holidays

• Flexible health, dental, and vision plans

• Up to 75% discount on HelloFresh subscription

• Emergency child and adult care services

• Snacks & monthly catered lunches

If based in Berlin or Warsaw:

• Competitive salary and attractive local benefits package

• Flexible working arrangements and generous vacation and parental leave in line with local market practice

• Discounts of up to 75% on HelloFresh, Green Chef, and Factor boxes

• Annual learning & development budget

• Health & wellbeing program

If based in London:

• Competitive salary and benefits package in line with UK market practice

• Flexible and hybrid working arrangements

• Generous annual leave and parental leave policy

• Up to 75% discount on HelloFresh subscription

• Annual learning & development budget

If based in Amsterdam:

• Competitive salary and attractive local benefits package

• Flexible and hybrid working arrangements, with travel allowance in line with Dutch market practice

• Generous annual leave and parental leave in line with local law

• Discounts on HelloFresh, Green Chef, and Factor boxes

• Annual learning & development budget

After submitting an application our team will review this and get back to you within 5 business days.

jobs.title: Senior Protocol Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Senior Protocol Engineer to join our Rollup team. This is a hands-on, full-time engineering role focused on building and scaling our Bitcoin-secured Layer 2 rollup on Rootstock. This is a protocol role: you’ll work directly on the chain on topics such as sequencing, block derivation, consensus and finality, bridge and proof system. You will join a small team of senior engineers with high ownership. You will design, build, test and operate core components, and you will take part in the technical decisions of the project.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Design, build and maintain core protocol components: execution and consensus clients, sequencer, block derivation and batch submission to the parent chain.

• Work on the bridge and the proof system: deposits, withdrawals, cross-layer messages and state validation.

• Maintain a large open source codebase: learn how its parts work together, make changes that are safe for a live network, and keep the code easy to evolve.

• Review code, write design docs and RFCs, and take part in architecture decisions.

• Test and debug a distributed system: unit to adversarial tests, local devnets, reorgs, node desync and performance problems.

• Deliver and operate releases on public chains: upgrades, hard forks, monitoring and incidents, etc.

• Collaborate with Product, DevOps and Security to plan and ship each release.

WHAT YOU BRING

Must have

• 5+ years of professional software engineering, with at least 2 years in blockchain core or protocol development (node clients, consensus, etc.).

• Solid production experience in mainstream languages (for example Go, Rust or Java).

• Deep knowledge of blockchain internals and the EVM: consensus, P2P networking, state and storage, transaction lifecycle, JSON-RPC, etc.

• Experience working effectively in large codebases you did not write.

• AI-assisted development is a core part of your work, while owning what you deliver.

• Autonomy and ownership: you help define the work, not only execute assigned tasks.

• Good English, spoken and written, since the team is international and remote.

Nice to have

• Professional experience with Go and/or Rust.

• Hands-on experience with Ethereum Layer 2 rollups (optimistic or ZK).

• Understanding of rollup design: sequencing, data availability, derivation, finality, etc.

• Contributions to open source blockchain clients or rollup stacks.

• Experience with fault proof systems or validity proofs.

• Knowledge of Bitcoin and EVM compatible chains.

• Experience with Docker, cloud providers, Prometheus and Grafana.

• Able to read and review Solidity (bridge and system contracts).

ROOTIES BENEFITS

At RootstockLabs, we don’t just offer a job, we offer a community. Here’s what you can expect when you join us:

• Competitive compensation package and unique benefits designed to support your growth and well-being.

• 100% Remote Work from Europe & Latin America, with access to global CoWorking spaces.

• Work-Life Balance: Paid vacation and sick leave days

• Continuous Learning: Access to training programs, language courses, and learning sponsorship annually.

• Unique Projects: Work with cutting-edge blockchain technology in a global, diverse team.

ABOUT ROOTSTOCKLABS

RootstockLabs is a key contributor to Rootstock, Bitcoin's Financial Infrastructure for lending, yield, and onchain capital markets. We build and commercialize the institutional infrastructure that turns Bitcoin into productive capital.

• What we do: Develop and commercialize Bitcoin-backed lending, tokenized real-world assets, and onchain financial strategies

• Who we work with: Leading custodians, asset managers, and financial institutions

• Why it matters: Rootstock is secured by 80%+ of Bitcoin's hash power and has run with 100% uptime since 2018 (bringing Ethereum-style programmability to the world's hardest money).

• Proof it works: 200+ dApps live on Rootstock, from BTCFi protocols like Sushiswap and Oku to institutional names like Mercado Bitcoin, Animoca Brands, and Paystand

jobs.description:

Our product types include biologics and small molecules, cytotoxics, highly potent compounds, diluents for reconstitution and vaccines – which are all directly injected into patients worldwide.  As such, there is a strong emphasis on quality and continuous improvement at Simtra.  We hold ourselves to the highest quality and regulatory standards.

While our primary focus is cGMP manufacturing, we offer many support services including formulation and development, lyophilization optimization, global regulatory support and secondary packaging.  Our teams are driven to help clients scale, innovate and bring life-changing medicines to patients worldwide.

Make it TOGETHER – We work as one, respecting each voice and tapping into our unique strengths across teams—so we can solve problems in new ways.

jobs.title: Business Development Manager (Junior/Mid level) - Albany, NY
jobs.description:
Please note that this is a hybrid position based in New York, with travel required for industry events and customer meetings.

While we welcome all applications, this role does not offer relocation assistance. We encourage applications from candidates who are local to New York State or are able to relocate independently.






ABOUT ROCKET SCIENCE GROUP

Rocket Science Group is a games-industry company built around four specialist studios: Atomic Theory, Terminal Velocity, Multiplay and Space Rangers. We help studios and publishers build, launch and run their games, from co-development and platform engineering to game server hosting. Our new Firehouse office in Schenectady is the home of our growing presence in North America.






THE ROLE:

We're looking for a hunter. This role is about opening new doors: finding, engaging and winning new customers for RSG, with Multiplay at the core of what you sell. You'll own your pipeline from first outreach to signed deal, working closely with our studio teams to shape solutions that customers actually need.

We care more about who you are than what your resume says. We don't hire for a title or a number of years. We hire for hunger.

This role is open to junior, mid or senior level, please see below for more expectations on these levels. 




WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 - Hunt new logos: build and work your own pipeline of new customers, mainly for Multiplay's game server hosting and related services

 - Run high-volume, high-quality outbound prospecting every day, across LinkedIn, email, phone and events

 - Run discovery conversations that uncover what a prospect really needs, then bring in the right RSG experts to shape the solution

 - Drive deals from first contact to close, including proposals, pricing conversations and negotiation

 - Keep HubSpot clean and current, so your pipeline and activity are always visible

 - Represent RSG at industry events and in the communities where our customers spend time




WHAT WE VALUE:

 - Hunter Mentality: You have the drive, curiosity and nerve to open conversations with people you don’t know, and you get energy from winning new accounts against the odds.

 - Intrinsic Motivation: You do the work because you want to be great at it, not because someone is watching.

 - Experience: Ideally, you’ve trained in a true hunter sales environment, where you thrived or learned a lot. New customers won or pipeline you built yourself is a strong plus. If you’re earlier in your career and have the hunger, we’ll train you.

 - Resilience: You’re curious and coachable, and comfortable hearing no and coming back sharper.

 - Communication: You’re a clear, confident communicator who builds trust quickly with technical and commercial buyers alike.




THREE LEVELS, THREE SETS OF EXPECTATIONS

We're hiring at junior, mid or senior level. The hunter mentality is the same at every level; what we expect you to bring grows with it.

Junior Business Development Manager

 - Shows clear hunter skills: drive, curiosity and the nerve to open conversations with people you don't know

 - No track record needed; we'll train you

 - Genuine affinity with games, with AI, and with at least one other industry relevant to RSG

Intermediate Business Development Manager

 - Has taken a first step in an industry relevant to RSG

 - Shows signs of commercial success in a hunter role: new customers won, pipeline you built yourself

 - Ready to run your own deals with light support

Senior Business Development Manager

 - Relevant experience in our core industry, games; experience in game hosting is a definite plus

 - Brings a relevant network that RSG cannot reach or isn't reaching today

 - Fully understands what RSG and its studios do, and can sell across them

 - A true self-starter and a born hunter who builds pipeline without being told




YOU MAY ALSO HAVE:

 - Affinity with the games industry: you play, you follow it, or you've sold into it

 - Affinity with industries outside games, such as media, entertainment, simulation or enterprise tech

 - Experience selling technical services, infrastructure, cloud or software development

 - Knowledge of HubSpot




WHAT WE CAN OFFER:

 - Hybrid Working Arrangement: The chance to build something new from our new Schenectady office as we grow in North America. 

 - Competitive Salary, Commission and Benefits Package: Your health and wellbeing is important to us, so we offer a variety of benefits including: 
   
   - Competitive commission package 
   
   - Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
   
   - 401(k) Retirement Plan with Employer Matching

About the role

We're looking for a Staff Product Designer to shape how DashPass delivers more value through affordability and new benefits. You'll join the Affordability pod within New Benefits, turning emerging customer needs into experiences that make everyday purchases more accessible and membership more valuable.

This is a hands-on role with room to define the problem, set direction, and build. You'll work directly with product, engineering, research, analytics, and business partners to identify opportunities, test new concepts, and bring them to market. You'll connect a longer-term vision to the next experiment, staying close to the interaction, visual, and implementation details that make an experience feel simple and considered.

We're building a team of designers who combine deep craft with the ability to bring ideas to life. You'll use AI throughout your workflow to explore possibilities, build working prototypes, and shorten the path from an idea to a shipped experience. Your judgment will shape both what we build and how the team builds it.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

• Set direction in an emerging space. Turn customer insights, business goals, and incomplete inputs into a clear point of view, product briefs, and a sequence of experiments and launches.

• Influence what gets built. Build alignment with product and engineering leaders, shape priorities across the pod and adjacent teams, and resolve tradeoffs between customer value, feasibility, and business impact.

• Own the work from concept through launch. Move between problem framing, exploration, prototyping, and implementation, taking initiative to close gaps and keep the work moving.

• Deliver a high bar for craft. Create intuitive flows, precise visual design, and thoughtful interactions that make benefits and savings easy to understand and use, with accessibility and consistency built in.

• Build with AI. Use AI-assisted design and coding to make realistic prototypes, test ideas with customers, and contribute product improvements alongside engineers. Create reusable tools and workflows that help teammates move faster while preserving quality.

Technical Project Lead, AI Delivery

Team: Client Services

Prolific

Prolific isn’t just enabling AI innovation – we’re redefining it. While foundational AI technologies are becoming commoditized, Prolific’s human data infrastructure provides the high-quality, diverse data required to train the next generation of AI models. Through our platform, we empower researchers and companies to access a global, ethically curated participant base, ensuring cutting-edge AI research and training grounded in inclusivity and precision.

The Role

We’re hiring a Technical Project Lead to deliver some of Prolific’s most important and complex AI client programmes. You’ll own client engagements end to end, working directly with clients to understand what they’re trying to achieve and turning their requirements into successful human data programmes. This is a hands-on role in a fast-moving area of AI, where requirements can change quickly and you’ll need to be comfortable with ambiguity and getting into the detail.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Own end-to-end delivery of complex AI projects, from understanding requirements and shaping the delivery approach through to execution and completion.

• Act as the primary point of contact for your clients, building strong relationships and communicating clearly and consistently throughout the project.

• Translate complex or evolving requirements into clear scopes, delivery plans, success criteria and practical solutions.

• Partner with Sales, Operations, Product and Engineering to coordinate resources and solve delivery challenges.

• Stay close to execution, spotting risks early and working through problems directly to keep delivery on track.

• Own and track key delivery metrics, including quality, timelines, budgets and profitability, and use project data to improve outcomes.

• Improve how we deliver AI projects by developing scalable processes, tools and ways of working as our client base grows.

What You’ll Bring to the Role

• 3-6+ years of experience managing complex client projects or programmes, ideally in AI/ML, human data, data services or another technical environment.

• A solid understanding of AI technologies and the AI/ML development lifecycle, including data collection, annotation, evaluation or validation.

• Strong client-facing skills, with experience building trusted relationships and communicating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Experience turning complex or ambiguous requirements into clear, executable plans and successful outcomes.

• A hands-on approach to problem-solving, with the ability to get into the detail, identify what’s going wrong and drive solutions forward.

jobs.title: Director of Marketing
jobs.description:
At Monument, we’re building a vertical software platform for the self-storage industry. This is a rare opportunity to reinvent a $50 billion market from the ground up.

Monument is a B2B SaaS platform built specifically for the self-storage industry. Our comprehensive solution integrates every essential feature operators and third-party managers need to run their self-storage businesses — from customer acquisition and payment processing to inventory management, physical access, move-ins and move-outs, delinquency management, and advanced reporting and analytics.

As Monument’s Director of Marketing, you are our first marketer. You report to the CEO and build the function from zero. Our core buyer is the self-storage operator running 10–100 facilities who wants one platform instead of ten vendors. We win on product and on relationships; your job is to make Monument the obvious choice before Sales ever picks up the phone, and to keep the right operators close until they are ready to buy.

The responsibilities below are the full charter for marketing at Monument, not a day-one checklist. You’ll start as a hands-on builder and sequence the work with the CEO, beginning with the priorities that have the biggest impact on pipeline and revenue. As the function scales, you’ll shape the headcount plan and build the team that takes on more of this charter, growing into a player-coach along the way.

What You’ll Own

• The message. Positioning for each market segment we sell to, the messaging hierarchy the go-to-market team uses, the category story for why Monument, and our competitive positioning, all grounded in research you run yourself.

• The map of the market. The HubSpot prospect database that is Monument’s single source of truth for our total addressable market of operators, third-party managers, and institutional owners. You own its structure and its content, building on the data we already have and keeping it current as trade show lists and new sources come in.

• Content marketing. Monument’s voice in the industry and the evidence behind it. Client case studies with hard numbers. A thought-leadership program that keeps the CEO and leadership team in front of operators: LinkedIn, trade press, podcasts, and conference stages. Aggregated, anonymized data and trends from the platform. A customer advocacy program that builds a reference bench and drives reviews on the software review sites operators check (G2, Capterra, and the like).

• Product marketing. Launches for major features, the demo narrative, and the battlecards and collateral (materials and presentations) that Sales walks in with. Value-based messaging for the core platform and every add-on module. Release announcements, roadmap updates, and QBR materials with Client Success, with shipped capabilities and roadmap always clearly separated. Co-marketing with our integration partners.

• Lifecycle marketing. You own the nurture journey end to end: every operator who is not ready to buy stays in a journey you designed, with content you wrote and a re-engagement signal that hands them back to Sales. Around it, you build lead scoring and routing with MQL and SAL definitions agreed with Sales, write the outbound sequences Sales runs, publish a regular operator newsletter, and own marketing’s HubSpot setup.

• Inbound marketing. Monument’s website and the path to Book a Demo. Answer-engine optimization, so that when an operator asks an AI assistant which platform to choose, Monument is in the answers. Small paid tests on Facebook, Reddit, and LinkedIn to learn which channels and messages reach operators, scaled only behind what the tests prove.

• Events marketing. The strategy—not the logistics—behind Monument’s hosted events and trade shows, including booth and presentation materials, and pre- and post-show outreach that converts.

Who You Are

• You have 5+ years of B2B SaaS marketing experience, including at least 2 years owning a marketing function or program end to end.

• You’ve been the senior marketer on a three- to ten-person B2B SaaS marketing team, the person their marketing leader relied on to ship, and you’re ready to own the function yourself. You’ve managed AI agents, vendors, and contractors, and you know how to get a lot done without a large team.

• You’ve personally done the work, not just managed it, across at least three of the areas above.

• AI-fluent, not AI-curious. You use Claude, ChatGPT, or similar tools daily to research, draft, analyze, and build. You can show us a workflow you automated and explain what you kept doing by hand and why.

• A creative communicator. You can turn a messy explanation of a product feature into a message an operator repeats to a peer, in whatever format lands: a one-liner, a visual, a short video, a slide. AI helps you draft; your judgment decides what’s worth saying. You’ve shipped positioning that Sales actually used, and case studies customers agreed to put their name on.

• You have hands-on HubSpot Marketing Hub expertise: nurture workflows, lead scoring, lifecycle stages, lists, and reporting. You bring a working toolkit beyond HubSpot (design, video, social scheduling, analytics, AEO tracking, and AI agents) and the judgment to pick tools that earn their place.

• You have a portfolio of content marketing and thought leadership you wrote or directed: case studies, guides, website copy, and social posts.

• You run on evidence. You would rather listen to twenty recorded sales calls than guess at a message, and you bring numbers to the Monday meeting.

• Based in DFW or willing to relocate. This is an in-person role in our Addison office, Monday through Friday.

Nice-To-Haves

• Experience in self-storage, proptech, property management, or real estate software - or a track record of learning a niche industry fast enough to earn credibility with its operators.

• Hands-on experience building marketing workflows with AI agents.

• You’ve also worked as a first or only marketer.

• You have won on message and proof against competitors with more name recognition, and you can explain how.

• Experience marketing to mid-market and enterprise buyers, including third-party managers and private-equity-backed owners.

Compensation

• Base Salary: $150,000 - $180,000

• Bonus Potential: 15% of Base

• Total Cash Compensation Potential: $172,500 - $207,000

• Meaningful equity; you share in the upside you help create

• Medical, Dental, and Vision

• 401k plan

This role is onsite. You will be expected to work from our Dallas, TX (Addison) office five days per week.

jobs.description:
Liquid Personnel is recruiting Senior Social Worker for its client's Children & Families - Support & Protection Team at Isle of Wight.

This is an excellent opportunity for qualified Social Workers with a strong background in children's safeguarding, child protection and statutory social work to join a service focused on protecting vulnerable children and supporting families. You will undertake assessments, identify safeguarding concerns, manage complex cases and work directly with children and families to reduce risk and improve outcomes.

The role requires confident practitioners who can work effectively in a demanding environment, make sound professional decisions and collaborate with multi-agency partners.

About our client:

Its Children's Services department is focused on strengthening safeguarding, improving early intervention and ensuring children receive the right support at the right time.

The Council has been developing its Children's Social Care services through its Multi-Agency Safeguarding Hub (MASH) and Referral & Intervention Service, creating opportunities for Social Workers to deliver timely assessments and meaningful interventions.

The Council promotes a collaborative, strengths-based approach, with an emphasis on reflective supervision, professional development and improved outcomes for children and families.

What will your responsibilities be?

• Undertake comprehensive Child and Family Assessments to identify children's needs, risks and protective factors.

• Manage complex child protection and safeguarding cases.

• Conduct Section 47 enquiries where there are concerns that a child may be suffering or at risk of significant harm.

• Develop and implement effective child protection and support plans.

• Work directly with children, parents and families to promote positive and sustainable change.

• Assess risk and make evidence-based decisions to safeguard children.

• Attend and contribute to Child Protection Conferences, Child in Need meetings and multi-agency discussions.

• Work collaboratively with police, health professionals, education and other safeguarding partners.

• Ensure accurate and timely case recording, assessments and reports.

jobs.title: Control Room Operator

We are a fast-growing, purpose-driven, global energy company specializing in delivering sustainable wood bioenergy solutions. We are the world’s largest producer of sustainable wood pellets, which provide a low-carbon alternative to fossil fuels.

The Control Room Operator is responsible for monitoring the status of all plant systems on a continuous basis. The operator will respond to alarms by taking appropriate corrective actions and procedures and ensure that the plant meets its generating requirements while operating safely and efficiently.
The operator will also monitor activities and ensure the smooth functioning of systems and equipment. To succeed in this role, these individuals require an understanding of control room operations, the ability to prepare accurate records, and a range of other technical and soft skills.

Responsibilities

• Operate plant functions from the control room.

• Manage chip feed system, fuel feed system, furnace, dryer system, primary and secondary sizing and pellet presses.

• Act as overall contact for plant operations.

• Monitoring: Checking indicator screens and signal lights, and monitoring production rates and system statuses. Monitor spark detection equipment. Manage and monitor various levels and feed rated to ensure continuous plant operation.

• Adjusting: Translating signals into production realities and adjusting production line processes. Operate computers, monitors and corrects operational values.

• Maintaining: Maintaining working schedules, equipment temperature, and safety standards

• Resolving issues: Assess and adjust accordingly to criticality of potential malfunctions and equipment failures, and using technical skills to resolve problems

• Communicating: Communicating with team members and responding to calls for assistance. Multi-task with equipment alarms and radio commands/communication.

• Strong aptitude in math; ability to use addition, subtraction, multiplication and division to perform flow, pressure, performance and meter calculations

• Ability to work both independently and in a team environment

• Knowledge of generating unit operation, engineering, or maintenance practices

Qualifications

• Ability to understand and follow written and verbal job instructions.

• Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and written procedures.

• Be able to use basic hand tools.

• Must possess basic computer & math skills.

• Able to learn how to operate HMI touch screens.

Preferred Qualifications - What Sets You Apart

• High school diploma or GED.

• Experience in wood products, furnace/dryer operations, or similar manufacturing environment

• High attention to detail.

• Ability to work under stressful conditions.

• Problem solving skills.

• Prior experience working in a Control Room

Working conditions

• Must be able to work in outdoor environments and occasionally in temperatures above 100 degrees and below 32 degrees

• Willing and able to work in a hot, humid, cold and noisy industrial environment

• Willing and able to maintain strict adherence to safety rules and regulations, to include wearing safety equipment.

• Occasionally walk on slippery or uneven surfaces.

• Ability to work shift assignments up to 12 hours that include weekends, nights or rotating shifts.

Physical requirements

• Willing and able to perform tasks such as lifting, walking, climbing, stooping, standing, pushing and/or pulling for up to twelve (12) hours a day

• Willing and able to work around moving equipment and machinery

• Willing and able to pull and lift, up to 50 lbs.

• Be comfortable climbing ladders, conveyors, working at heights and on steel grating.

• Ability to safely and successfully perform the essential job functions consistent with the ADA and other federal, state and local standards, including meeting qualitative and/or quantitative productivity standards.

jobs.title: Brand & PR Manager
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Brand & PR Manager to join our team and play a crucial part in creating and developing the most exciting, vibrant and culturally connected destination in the city with two packed out restaurants and bars; one of which is a brand-new concept for 2027 plus a lively all-year events and partnerships programme.

Reporting to the General Manager, you’ll lead our brand communications and partnership strategy, with a strong focus on F&B, you’ll drive the critical path and opening strategy for our new restaurant, build incredible relationships with our Hox Friends community, you’ll act as the guardian of brand values, and you’ll be the curator of the guest experience and a series of programming & partnerships. You’ll constantly be looking for opportunities to improve the experience and raise awareness of the F&B concepts for guests and locals – from the tiny day-to-day details to the newsworthy big ideas, you’re always-on, spotting issues and opportunities and coming up with creative ideas, partnerships, offers and packages to encourage people to choose The Hoxton in Poblenou.

What you’ll do…

• Ensure the hotel, our restaurants and bars and our event spaces are embraced and visited by locals, nationals and internationals alike
• Concept and drive the strategy for the new restaurant space, looking at how we make noise at launch and then create a ‘must-visit’ strategy for locals and in-house guests
• Generate content and manage our local restaurant social media channels with strategic input from our central comms team and support from a brand coordinator and potentially from an agency
• Deliver against the room and restaurant/bar commercial targets and work closely with the F&B operations, sales and revenue teams on ideas, offers and packages to achieve them
• Create a strong and vibrant lobby culture to attract guests and make them loyal to the brand, frequenting the lobby space throughout their week
• Create a strong, smart and creative programming to develop La Cava space along with strong local or global partnerships
• Drive innovative thinking that delivers on brand and business goals – ensuring The Hoxton is a hotspot, whether that’s for somewhere to work, eat, drink, rest or play
• Own the guest journey (Hotel, F&B, The Apartment), ensuring every touch point (touch, see, hear, feel) is on brand and delivering personal and innovative experience
• Own and manage our local PR strategy, working with The Hoxton European PR team to ensure the hotel, restaurants, bars and event spaces are always top of mind for media and influencers; as well as driving awareness of other Hoxton properties and hotels to the Spanish media market.
• Build a community of loyal Hox guests and fans – Hox Friends, Social Influencers, local professionals and opinion leaders - who support our communications strategy by constantly talking about and visiting The Hoxton and our restaurants.
• Develop local partnerships and activations in the hotel and city that reach new audiences, spread the word and help to position the brand in a new market.
• Be responsible for local communications including writing and creating emails and delivering local content for our editorial platform, The Localist on The Hoxton website.
• Manage the local annual marketing and graphic design budgets, working with the GM to plan, track and manage all spend.
• Create design briefs for any and all local collateral and campaigns to submit to our central Ennismore graphic design team.

What we’re looking for…

• Someone proactive and creative and able to work independently but likes being sociable & collaborative too
• Must be fluent in Spanish and English, additional languages will be highly valuable
• Someone who is very passionate about F&B marketing with strong working knowledge on how to partner successfully with F&B operations teams both on property and via external partners
• Experience and connections in Barcelona’s foodie scene with the ability to build awareness, reputation and hype for our new destination restaurant so it is buzzing from morning to night, every day
• A creative thinker who has a track record building F&B concepts and driving lifestyle brands but also delivering business results in the Spanish market
• Ability to work across the entire marketing mix, with loads of PR experience and a little black book of media contacts
• Someone who can not only make F&B and cultural partnerships happen or pull-off talked about events but can also think strategically about tactical marketing ideas to drive bookings & covers
• A great communicator who can copy write, manage local social media channels and email databases, growing them to become vital comms channels for us to talk to our fans & audience
• A personal network of strong local and international contacts in industries including F&B, art, design, fashion, music, tech, wellness who will be Hox Friends, brand partners and regular guests at The Hox.
• Someone who will collaborate and ensure they follow a detailed briefing process with our central Ennismore teams, including graphic design, digital marketing and communications
• A conceptual, out-of-the-box thinker, who makes brave choices and inspires others to do the same
• You’re looking for a place where you can be you: no clones in suits for us
• You’re not precious. We leave our egos at the door and help get things done
• You’re up for doing things differently and trying (almost) everything once
• You want to be part of a team that works hard, supports each other and has fun along the way

What's in it for you...

• A competitive salary and eligibility to participate in our discretionary bonus scheme

• The opportunity to lead the Brand function for an exciting hospitality concept that is relatively new to Barcelona (and Spain)
• Lead marketing direction on a new, exciting F&B concept that will resonate with locals, IHG and city wide
• Join an innovative, fast-growing, international group that’s committed to not just building new hotels but building a global brand
• The chance to challenge the norm and work in an environment that is both creative and rewarding.
• Become part of a team that’s very passionate about creating great hospitality experiences and building a portfolio of brands
• It’s ok not to be Ok, we have a confidential hotline for any support you require about anything and a network of mental health first aiders
• Enjoy a free night at The Hoxton and a meal for two when you first start with us.
• Goes without saying, but we’ll feed you when on shift
• Great discounts across the entire Ennismore family
• Lots of opportunity to progress and switch it up as part of a global family of brands.
• Extra time off to volunteer with one of our partner charities
• Regular team get togethers, from our team drinks to our parties – we know how to have a good time!
• An annual diversity and inclusion calendar of events creating opportunities for you to learn, celebrate and make a positive impact

More about us...

The Hoxton is a series of open-house hotels, each in a neighbourhood that we love. Ever since we opened our first hotel in Shoreditch, we’ve never just been about offering a bed for the night. Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner closely with Client Success, Trading, Product, and internal leadership to deliver strong client outcomes, retain business, and unlock growth.

 - Established relationships within Publicis Groupe or strong knowledge of its agencies, investment teams, and buying structures.

 - Demonstrated ability to generate new business, grow existing accounts, and consistently deliver against revenue goals.

jobs.title: Senior Information Security Internal Auditor
jobs.description:
Strength in Trust

OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.

The Challenge

We are seeking an experienced Internal Auditor and ISO management-systems subject matter expert to lead audit readiness and continuous improvement across our Integrated Management System (IMS). This person will bring deep, hands-on experience with ISO 9001, ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 42001, and the broader portfolio of applicable ISO audits, including privacy, cloud security, and business continuity standards such as ISO/IEC 27701, ISO/IEC 27017, ISO/IEC 27018, and ISO 22301. The role will also provide clear governance for our Quality Management System (QMS), PIMS, AIMS, and integrated management system.

This role partners across the business to make our controls practical, auditable, and consistently operated. It also leads the operating rhythm of the IMS committee, prepares teams for internal and external audits, and represents the organization with confidence and sound judgment. The right person is highly organized, self-directed, and persistent about closing the loop—from finding through evidence, owner, due date, and verified resolution.

Your Mission

• Own the internal audit program for applicable ISO standards and management systems, including risk-based planning, audit execution, reporting, corrective actions, and follow-up validation.

• Serve as a subject matter expert across the applicable ISO audit portfolio, including ISO 9001, ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 42001, and related privacy, cloud security, and business continuity standards. Support the evolution and integration of our QMS, PIMS, AIMS, and broader IMS.

• Own QMS governance, including process ownership and accountability, quality objectives and metrics, documented information, nonconformities, corrective actions, and management review. Ensure governance is effective, auditable, and connected to operational performance.

• Lead and coordinate the IMS committee: establish agendas, prepare decision materials, track actions and owners, escalate overdue items, and maintain clear records of decisions and outcomes. Coordinate QMS management review and related governance activities with the appropriate leaders and process owners.

• Own and improve management-system policies and supporting standards, procedures, and guidance. Write clear, maintainable policy documents that accurately reflect applicable requirements and how the organization operates.

• Maintain audit-ready management-system documentation, including scope, policies, procedures, control mappings, risk and opportunity registers, objectives, metrics, management reviews, and evidence repositories.

• Translate standards, policies, and auditor requests into clear, testable technical requirements for Research & Development (R&D) teams, including engineering, product, and cloud stakeholders. Partner with those teams to define practical control implementation, ownership, evidence, and validation criteria.

• Help control owners produce evidence that is relevant, complete, current, and traceable to the control being tested.

• Coordinate certification and surveillance audits, customer assurance activities, and auditor requests. Serve as a credible point of contact who can explain the system, evidence, and rationale clearly.

• Evaluate evidence gaps early. Distinguish between a documentation issue, an operating failure, and a control-design gap; assess impact; agree on corrective actions; and track them through verified closure.

• Apply sound professional judgment when evidence is incomplete or an auditor’s interpretation is unclear. Ask for the basis and scope of requests, challenge unsupported conclusions respectfully, identify appropriate alternative evidence where valid, and document limitations, risks, and remediation transparently. Do not misrepresent evidence or bypass requirements.

• Drive corrective and preventive action (CAPA) processes, root-cause analysis, and lessons learned so issues are addressed sustainably rather than simply closed on paper.

• Partner with Security, Privacy, AI Governance, Quality, Engineering, Product, Legal, and business teams to embed management-system requirements in day-to-day SaaS operations.

• Identify opportunities to simplify controls, reduce duplicative evidence collection, automate recurring activities, and strengthen trust with customers, auditors, and other stakeholders.

• Provide leadership with concise, accurate reporting on audit readiness, findings, recurring themes, overdue actions, and management-system performance.

Success in this role looks like

• Internal and external audits are well planned, teams understand what is expected, and evidence is organized, current, and traceable.

• IMS committee decisions translate into assigned, monitored, and completed actions; unresolved risks and overdue items are escalated promptly.

• Findings are addressed at their root cause, with corrective actions validated for effectiveness.

• PIMS, AIMS, quality, and information security requirements are integrated where appropriate, with clear ownership and minimal unnecessary duplication.

• Audit discussions are fact-based and constructive: valid requirements are met, ambiguous or unsupported requests are clarified, and evidence limitations and remediation are documented honestly.

• The organization strengthens its operational discipline and earns trust through a management system that reflects how the business actually works.

You Are/Have

• Extensive, hands-on experience managing or auditing ISO-based management systems in a technology or SaaS organization.

• Deep working knowledge of ISO 9001 and ISO/IEC 27001, with meaningful experience implementing, operating, or auditing ISO/IEC 42001 and AI management systems.

• Experience governing a QMS, including management review, quality objectives, process ownership, documented information, nonconformity handling, and corrective action.

• Experience with privacy information management systems (PIMS), AI management systems (AIMS), and integrating multiple standards into a coherent IMS. Experience auditing applicable standards such as ISO/IEC 27701, ISO/IEC 27017, ISO/IEC 27018, or ISO 22301 is valued.

• Demonstrated experience leading internal audits and supporting external certification, surveillance, or recertification audits from planning through findings closure.

• Strong command of audit methodology, risk-based sampling, evidence sufficiency, control design and operation, nonconformity classification, root-cause analysis, and corrective-action validation.

• Exceptional policy-writing skills and the ability to turn complex standards into concise, clear, maintainable policies and supporting procedures.

• Proven ability to translate compliance requirements into actionable, testable technical requirements for R&D teams, and to work collaboratively with engineers and product teams to operationalize them.

• Ability to interpret standards and convert requirements into clear control expectations, workable processes, and evidence guidance for non-auditors.

• Experience coordinating cross-functional governance forums or management review committees, with disciplined action tracking and follow-through.

• Excellent organization and time management; able to independently manage competing audit cycles, evidence requests, deadlines, and stakeholders without losing detail.

• Clear, confident communication and negotiation skills, including the ability to challenge auditor requests or conclusions respectfully and support positions with objective evidence and documented rationale.

• A pragmatic, service-oriented approach: you help teams meet requirements while keeping the system credible, proportionate, and aligned to real business operations.

• Relevant lead auditor or lead implementer training/certification for one or more applicable ISO standards is strongly preferred.

Extra Awesome

• Experience with ISO/IEC 27701, ISO 22301, ISO/IEC 27017, ISO/IEC 27018, SOC 2, or related assurance frameworks.

• Experience with SaaS control environments, cloud operations, software development lifecycles, and distributed cross-functional teams.

• Familiarity with GRC, audit-management, evidence-collection, or workflow-automation platforms.

• CISA or similar certification

Our Commitment to You

About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

Your Role:

You’re a seasoned technician who knows your craft – and at Lucid Motors, you’ll get the chance to take it to the next level. As a Senior Service Technician, you’ll work on one of the most advanced electric vehicles in the world. You’ll lead by example, share your expertise, and help shape a high-performance service culture.

• Perform advanced diagnostics, maintenance, and repairs on Lucid vehicles

• Support and mentor junior technicians – your experience makes the difference

• Use modern software to document your work with precision

• Carry out certified high-voltage repairs, safely and professionally

• Communicate with customers and deliver a true premium experience

• Take ownership of quality, efficiency, and cleanliness in the workshop

• Step in wherever your knowledge and advice are needed

What You Bring:

• Completed vocational training as Automobil-Diagnostiker EFZ or equivalent Swiss-recognized advanced certification

• 5–7 years of practical experience in professional automotive repair, including work with high-voltage vehicles, preferably premium vehicles

• Deep diagnostic experience in mechanical and electrical systems, including CAN architecture and electronic fault tracing

• High Voltage Level 3 Certification (FHV Stufe 3) – including live work authorization (Arbeiten unter Spannung)

• Proven experience using diagnostic software and workshop systems (e.g., OEM-specific, Bosch, Snap-On)

• Familiarity with inspection, maintenance, and wear part replacement in line with OEM standards

• Valid Class B driver’s license

• Fluent in German (spoken and written), working knowledge of English

• Confident with Microsoft Office applications and willing to learn internal platforms (e.g., DMS)

Why Lucid?

• Work on a vehicle that’s setting new standards in design and technology

• Join a dynamic, international team with real start-up energy

• Get access to top-tier training in high-voltage systems, diagnostics, and more

• Be part of something bigger – not just fixing cars, but shaping the future

• Competitive pay, modern tools, and real opportunities to grow

Lucid Motors is committed to maintaining a safe and trustworthy environment. As such, a background check may be required during the hiring process. This will be performed in line with European data protection laws, and candidates will be informed and asked to provide consent before the check is conducted.

Compensation & Benefits: Lucid offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance; life and disability coverage; paid time off; paid holidays, paid sick leave; and a 401(k) retirement plan. Hourly/non-exempt employees accrue up to 120 hours paid time off, and salaried/exempt employee accrue up to 160 hours paid time off.  Eligible employees may also participate in Lucid’s equity program and/or a discretionary annual cash incentive program. Incentive and equity awards, if applicable, are determined based on individual performance, role scope, market considerations, and overall company results, in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans.

Equal Opportunity: At Lucid, we believe diversity strengthens everything we build. Lucid Motors is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing an inclusive workplace for all. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable state or federal laws and regulations.

Accessibility: Lucid Motors is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need any accommodation to participate in the application process, please contact us at TA-Operations <@> lucidmotors.com. This email address is designated solely for accommodation requests and is not monitored for job applications or resume submissions. To be considered for employment, all applications must be submitted through the Lucid Motors Careers website.

Candidate Data Privacy: By submitting your application, you understand and agree that your personal data will be processed in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice.

To all recruitment agencies: Lucid Motors does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to Lucid Motors. Lucid Motors is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

jobs.title: Director of Platform Engineering [gn] Data Intelligence Platform
jobs.description:
Actian is the company behind the Data Intelligence Platform — an enterprise solution that helps organisations discover, govern, and trust their data at scale. Our platform connects metadata, data lineage, data quality, and business context into a single knowledge graph, enabling enterprises to turn raw data into reliable decisions. We operate globally, move fast, and build for the long term.
Software engineering is being redefined. The engineers who will shape the next decade of product development are not the ones who write the most code — they are the ones who know how to think clearly, ship confidently, and use every tool available to them, including AI, to multiply their impact.
The Actian Data Intelligence Platform helps teams find, understand, and use AI-ready data under clear governance. It connects metadata, data lineage, data quality, and business context into a single knowledge graph, so enterprises can turn raw data into reliable decisions — the trusted foundation that AI agents increasingly depend on to work. We operate globally, move fast, and build for the long term.
The Data Intelligence Platform has to deploy, operate, and pass audits in every one of the environments our customers run — public cloud, private cloud, and on-premises. We are standing up a dedicated platform team to make that possible, and we are hiring the leader who will build it.
This is a hands-on director role. You will stand up and lead a newly formed platform team, hire and grow it, and build alongside it from day one: you will design the platform services, write infrastructure code, and set the engineering standards the rest of engineering relies on.
We are an AI-first engineering organization, and in this role AI is how the work gets done. AI agents run operational tasks, AI accelerates the team's own engineering, and AI replaces tools we pay for today but no longer need. You will also build the infrastructure that runs the AI and ML workloads inside our product.

jobs.title: Technical Integrations Manager
jobs.description:
At Vio  http://Vio.comwe believe booking accommodation should feel smart, fair, and effortless — never overwhelming or unclear.

As one of the world’s fastest-growing travel tech platforms, we help millions of users make smarter travel decisions by comparing stays across 100+ booking sites — so they can find the perfect place, at the best price, anywhere in the world. We cut through the noise and complexity of hotel and vacation rental booking, surfacing real value with clarity, transparency, and full support. No tricks. No confusion. Just great stays — booked with confidence. With operations in 100+ markets and growing fast, our mission is to reshape how people discover and book accommodation through technology travelers can trust.

We are looking for an experienced Technical Integrations Manager to join our Supply Integrations team and help us onboard new hotel suppliers, keep 70+ live integrations healthy, and be the technical voice our partners talk to.

Vio connects to hotel suppliers through APIs: wholesalers, bed banks, hotel chains, and connectivity platforms. The Supply Integrations squad builds and runs those integrations. You will join a second Technical Integrations Manager and a team of backend engineers, reporting to the squad's Engineering Manager. This is a hands-on technical role, not a coordination role: you own each integration in your portfolio from the first look at a partner's API documentation through implementation, QA sign-off, launch, and live operations. You decide when an integration is good enough to go live, and you are the person a partner's representative emails when something looks wrong.

What you will do:

 - Assess new partner APIs: read the documentation critically, make test calls, find the gaps and limitations before our engineers hit them, and document what we need from the partner.

 - Run technical onboarding with partners: credentials, environments, communication channels, and everything an engineer needs to start on day one.

 - Act as the single technical point of contact for both partners and engineers during implementation, answering questions and unblocking issues fast.

 - Own pre-launch quality: test search, booking, cancellation, and modification flows end to end; verify prices, availability, and tax and fee breakdowns; and sign off on go-live. No integration launches without your approval.

 - Watch the live portfolio: use dashboards and alerts to catch throttling, error spikes, and data-quality drift early, investigate, fix what is in reach (configuration, CMS, small pull requests), and work with partners on the rest.

 - Keep a per-supplier incident history, spot recurring patterns, and drive the automation and process changes that remove manual work.

 - Maintain the integrations roadmap with the Engineering Manager, Product, and Partnerships, and keep stakeholders informed on progress and risks.

 - Continuously improve our integration lifecycle checklist based on what each launch teaches us.
   
   

Who you are:

 - You have 3+ years in a partner-facing technical role, such as technical integrations manager, integration or solutions engineer, technical account manager, or connectivity manager, and have owned a portfolio of live API integrations.

 - You are comfortable in Postman or similar software, not afraid of JSON and XML payloads, and can tell from a response what is wrong with it. Logs and dashboards are tools you reach for, not something you ask engineers to check.

 - You read API documentation critically and can assess technical viability.

 - You write clearly and briefly. A partner engineer can act on your email without a call.

 - You manage many parallel threads without dropping follow-ups and are resourceful when a partner is slow or the documentation is incomplete.

 - You improve processes rather than repeat them: you have built checklists, templates, or automation that made your previous team faster.

 - Hotel distribution experience (rate types, board codes, merchant vs agency models) is a strong plus; we will teach it to someone with the skills above.
   
   

Why join us now?

 - We are one of the most innovative and fastest-growing accommodation booking platforms in the world today, having grown our bookings 30x between 2017 and 2025, and catering to the needs of over 100 million unique visitors worldwide each year. We do that by harnessing the power of advanced algorithms and an innovative suite of power features and managed to overcome the corona crisis remarkably fast https://medium.com/viodotcom/how-to-survive-refocus-thrive-again-as-a-travel-startup-in-corona-times-c656ef748a10;

 - The mobile applications (iOS https://apps.apple.com/us/app/vio-com-book-hotel-deals/id1639101398 and Android https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.vio.mobileapp&hl=en_US&gl=US) we launched in 2023 are already a big success, reaching 5 million installs with great customer reviews, as we are beginning to build Vio  http://Vio.comas the brand for value-seeking travellers worldwide;

 - We are a passionate and diverse team of tech enthusiasts and creatives with a commitment and focus on the traveler above all else - and it shows in our industry-leading TrustPilot score https://www.trustpilot.com/review/vio.com;

 - We place huge importance on rewarding our employees for the value they generate by giving Stock Appreciation Rights https://medium.com/viodotcom/why-findhotel-offers-share-appreciation-rights-sar-1b688867d8c4 to all employees.

Do you want to know if Vio http://Vio.com is the right place for you? Find out by reading about the attitude that thrives at  https://medium.com/viodotcom/who-are-we-looking-for-at-findhotel-cf1ccc1dce8cVio.  http://Vio.com

What we offer:

 - Plenty of chances to learn and grow within an open, diverse culture which promotes knowledge sharing, trust and transparency;

 - A great compensation package, perks and benefits (including significant stock appreciation rights);

 - Flexible time off (take as many holidays as you need) and a chance to work remotely;

 - You will be part of a highly international team https://medium.com/viodotcom/2021-our-people-in-numbers-b72145c3fa9b that enjoys working, eating and playing together in one of the best office locations in Amsterdam;

 - We value good food and offer catered lunches from various cuisines, great coffee, and the occasional barbecue in our garden;

 - We enjoy getting together to celebrate our wins with company events in Amsterdam and abroad;

 - A budget for your dream home office;

 - Access to free mental health support via OpenUp https://openup.com/.
