jobs.title: Senior Marketing Operations Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT ALEPH

Aleph is an AI-native platform for Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), an established software category with a multi-billion market but no clear winner. We’re trying to solve a problem many finance teams are super familiar with: data scattered across a million systems, endless spreadsheets and way too much time spent getting numbers to line up instead of actually using them to make decisions.

Aleph was founded by Albert Gozzi and Santiago Perez De Rosso, two technical founders with backgrounds from Stanford and MIT and experience working at top-tier companies such as Google, Microsoft and Bain & Company. We’re backed by top VCs (Khosla Ventures, Bain Capital Ventures, YC, Picus Capital), and work with customers like Webflow, Notion, Zapier, Y Combinator and many others.

We are hiring remotely across the Americas (United States, Canada, LATAM).

 


🔍 WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're hiring a Senior Marketing Operations Engineer to build and own the systems, data and automations behind how Aleph generates, routes and measures marketing pipeline. You'll join RevOps, a small team that builds the infrastructure our go-to-market teams run on, and you'll be Marketing's main partner for everything Ops.

You’d join the team that put our sales team in the future: the CRM fills itself after every call, AI agents in Slack answer questions about any deal, a cheat sheet for the day’s meetings lands every evening, and reps get reminded of the follow-ups they promised. Marketing is next, and most of it is still a blank page: attribution, lifecycle, campaign infrastructure, and the agents the marketing team will use every day.

This is a hands-on builder role. You'll design how marketing data flows, ship agentic workflows the marketing team uses every day, and own what you build end to end, from spotting the need to keeping it running in production.

 


🧑‍💼 WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

 - Own marketing reporting and the infrastructure behind it. Attribution the whole company trusts, campaign and funnel reporting Marketing doesn't have to ask for, and the pipes that keep it accurate, from HubSpot to the warehouse to the board deck.

 - Build agentic workflows for the marketing team. Inbound lead research and triage, campaign performance digests, content-to-pipeline signals: whatever removes toil or makes the team smarter, shipped in our stack and used every week.

 - Design the marketing data model. Lifecycle stages, campaign and UTM taxonomy, lead scoring, and one definition of marketing-sourced pipeline that Sales and Finance accept.

 - Be Marketing's point of contact for ops. Campaign operations, webinar and event flows, email and nurture infrastructure, outbound and ad-platform plumbing, with the same service bar we hold for Sales.

 - Own the stack. You will have creative freedom to improve the tech stack. We are continuously evolving and are not afraid to change things and, once in a while, break something.
   
    


📋 WHAT YOU BRING

 - Marketing ops depth. 4+ years in RevOps or Marketing Ops, including 2+ years owning marketing operations end to end: the marketing side of the CRM, lead lifecycle, attribution and reporting. HubSpot fluency is a strong plus.

 - Technical depth. You were writing and shipping code before AI could do it for you, and it shows in how you work: you can tell when generated code is wrong, and you know the difference between a prototype and something that runs unattended. Today you build with Claude Code, Cursor and n8n, and you've shipped at least one LLM-powered workflow that a business team actually uses reliably.

 - You've built infrastructure that scaled. Data models, integrations, monitoring, failure modes. You're at home in a terminal and you know where your code runs and how to get to it: servers, environments, an SSH tunnel when that's what it takes. You've run systems other people depended on, and you know what breaks at 5x the volume.

 - Analytical range. You reason about code, funnel models and compensation plans with the same rigor, and you can hold your own in an attribution debate with Sales and Finance.

 - Operating partner, not order taker. You spot what the marketing team needs before they ask, write things down, and own the outcome rather than the ticket.

 


🛠️ TECH STACK

You're familiar with most of this, or you can learn it quickly:

 - CRM and marketing automation: HubSpot (Marketing and Sales Hub), Default for lead routing, Amplemarket for outbound, Webflow for our website

 - Channels: LinkedIn, Meta, Google and Reddit ads; webinars and events

 - Data: BigQuery as the warehouse; Aleph itself for GTM dashboards and reporting

 - Automation and AI: n8n, Python and Claude (Claude Code, agents, skills, MCP). We mostly build rather than configure

 - Where it all lands: Slack. Alerts, approvals, slash commands and bots live where the team already works

 - Everything else: Fathom for calls, Linear for work, GitHub for code

While this is a remote-first opportunity, we're focusing on candidates within the Americas to better align with our working hours as a team. 

Aleph is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. Aleph makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

jobs.title: Immediate Dean of School Culture (High School)
jobs.description:
OVERVIEW

The Dean of School Culture is responsible for creating, implementing, and sustaining a safe, structured, and positive school culture that supports scholar achievement and staff success. The Dean leads the execution of school-wide behavior systems, coaches culture team members, partners with school leadership, and ensures the discipline practices align with KIPP Jax Regional expectations, district policies, state regulations, and restorative practices. The Dean of School Culture sits on the administration team, reports directly to the Principal, and is coached by the Senior Manager of School Culture. This role is a 12 month role.

The Dean of School Culture is the main point of contact for parents and guardians regarding behavior and school cultural expectations, and the primary contact person for all acute discipline and culture concerns.

In addition, they will support teachers to effectively develop a strong classroom culture and model for student behavior management systems. They will work with scholars and families to improve student behavior to ensure academic success in the classroom. Finally, they will develop and encourage a positive staff culture.

A successful Dean of School Culture is passionate about supporting our scholars, adapts to changes, and cultivates productive relationships with all stakeholders within our community, including faculty, scholars, and families. While ensuring accurate documentation with state, district, and KIPP Jacksonville.

This role is available at KIPP Bold City High School (1440 N. McDuff Ave)

This role has a start date of early December.

SPECIFIC DUTIES

DSC role and responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:

(1) School Culture

• Lead and plan advisory, community, and town hall meetings, and implement values integration and character development within the classroom community.
• Be highly present and visible during school hours, relentlessly ensuring the school has a strong culture.
• Proactively circulate throughout classrooms and hallways during the day to gain valuable context on student behavior and help support positive school culture.
• Create structures and expectations for increasing student independence in the classroom and throughout the school.
• Lead breakfast, lunch, dismissal, and other transitional experiences and whole-school operations.
• Ensure consistent implementation of school-wide culture systems.

(2) Student Discipline

• Model positive interactions with scholars, families, and staff, as well as a variety of ways to handle misbehavior and disruptions.

• Recognize and celebrate exemplary student achievement and behavior, communicating with families of scholars regularly.

• Assist with contacting families regarding attendance

• Serve as the point of contact for discipline/culture issues; in this role,
• Reinforce the effective use of school-wide behavior plans and individualized scholar behavior plans as guided by the Code of Conduct (in conjunction with the Social Worker/Guidance Counselor).

• Serve as a resource for teachers to determine the best ways to develop student management techniques, especially as it relates to concerns of discipline, relationships with scholars, and school culture.

• Collaborate with the school social workers to support at-risk and in-crisis scholars

• Provide scholars in crisis with a space and strategies to cope, and/or improve in-class behaviors

• Serve as the coordinator and leadership point person for student removals/in-school or out-of-school suspensions

• Communicate with families of scholars in crisis regularly, and collaborate/problem-solve the best ways to address student behaviors and support student needs

(3) Teacher Coaching and Professional Development

• Plan, implement, and provide ongoing professional development and feedback to all staff, focusing on building positive student relationships, student culture, and classroom community.
• Conduct classroom observations and follow up with targeted feedback and support for teachers that help them to become even more effective teachers; be available to work with teachers to problem-solve areas of classroom discipline, behavior, and culture/community difficulty
• Collaborate with the Leadership Team to plan summer training and professional development full-days and half-days during the school year
• Communicate teacher performance to the principal, highlighting teachers in need of principal coaching due to insufficient performance.
• Organize summer training and professional development days
• Recognize and celebrate staff professional growth and success.

(4) Data and Compliance

• Track Threat Management Documentation
• Oversee implementation of the Student Code of Conduct.
• Process referrals in DeansList and FOCUS.
• Track office referrals, ISS, OSS, SESIR incidents, and subgroup behavior trends.
• Monitor bi-weekly culture data and identify intervention priorities

COMPENSATION

• The starting annual salary for this position is $62,000

• Individual-level health benefits, including medical, dental, and vision
• Individual short-term and long-term disability insurance
• 403(b) retirement program with a company match
• To support professional practice and growth, all teachers and coaches receive individualized coaching and professional development *Please note these offerings are subject to change year-to-year

REQUIREMENTS

• Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university.

• Three (3) years of teaching experience.
• Strong experience in behavioral intervention and management techniques.
• Possesses a deep commitment to both racial and educational equity for all children
• An uncompromising belief that all students can learn
• KIPP Public Schools Jacksonville believes that our staff will represent our core values—high expectations, a growth mindset, commitment to team, trust, joy, and sustainability. We search for established educators who embody them.
• Passing a background check, as required by law.

In accordance with Florida House Bill 531, this position requires a background screening through the Care Provider Background Screening Clearinghouse. For more information regarding the screening process, education, and awareness, please visit the official website at: https://info.flclearinghouse.com

HIGHLY PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience being a Dean of Students
• Experience with implementing restorative practices in a school setting
• Experience working in an urban public school or charter school setting (i.e. a paraprofessional, a substitute, a tutor, or a similar role)
• Experience working with students at the middle school or high school level
• Experience following the District Code of Conduct and the referral processing procedures

APPLY

Please complete an application and upload a resume via our job board. No applicants will be considered that submit resumes through other job postings.  Link here: https://careers.smartrecruiters.com/KIPP/jacksonville

If you're a current KIPP Jax team member, you should:

1) Inform your current manager of your interest in the role and

2) Complete the online application

QUESTIONS

If you have questions about this position, please email Lashawnda at landerson@kippjax.org. Please understand that resumes and/or cover letters are not accepted via email and you will be redirected to apply via the website.

KIPP Jacksonville Public Schools is committed to a policy of equal treatment for all individuals applying for employment at our schools. KIPP Jacksonville Public Schools does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, gender, handicap, age, religion, sexual orientation or national or ethnic origin.

jobs.title: Office Manager – Plumbing & HVAC (Remote, Housecall Pro)
jobs.description:
About Offshore Launch:

Offshore Launch is a business and growth operations firm helping home service owners scale their operations.

We design, build, and staff business and revenue operations so the shop runs on clear process, technology and data - so owners can work on the business instead of being trapped inside it.

We are a people-centered agency with a passion for leaving every employee and client in a better position than we found them.

Why Join Offshore Launch?

• Impact the growth and success of small and medium-sized businesses.

• Work in a people-first, remote environment that values career growth.

• Access comprehensive benefits that include HMO, PTO, transparent bonus, raise and career pathways - with an overall emphasis on teamwork, collaboration, and work/life balance.

• Contribute to a culture that values partnership, service, and excellence.

Who We Serve

This is a remote, full-time position supporting a fast-growing plumbing and HVAC company in New Jersey. The company handles a wide range of work: plumbing repairs, drain and sewer work, water heaters, boilers, furnaces, heat pumps and mini-splits, gas lines and water treatment. It serves homeowners across several counties, with same-day and emergency service. You’ll work US Eastern business hours.

The owner runs a team of field technicians and is busy growing the business. Day to day, you’ll be the person who keeps the office running: phones, scheduling, dispatch, estimates, invoices and follow-up. The company is moving its operations onto Housecall Pro now. You’ll start with a newly set-up system, written SOPs and the full support of our team, and you’ll help shape how the office works from the start. As the company grows, you may also train and lead a new office team member.

This role is for someone who wants to own the office and run it without waiting to be told what to do next.

What you’ll own

• The phones. You’re the first voice customers hear. Answer incoming calls and book service calls, emergencies and estimates, calmly and professionally. Offer financing and membership options when they fit.

• Scheduling and dispatch. Book and dispatch jobs for a team of technicians in Housecall Pro, and fit in same-day and emergency calls. Keep customers updated on arrival times so the owner doesn’t have to step in.

• The estimate pipeline. Follow up on every open estimate until it’s won or declined, and keep the pipeline current so the owner always knows where each job stands.

• Invoicing and collections. Send invoices as soon as jobs are done, and follow up on receivables so nothing ages without action.

• Clean system data. Keep Housecall Pro accurate: job details, technician time, material costs and receipts, job photos, lead-source tags and routine price catalog updates. Make sure the technicians use the app the right way.

• Permits and compliance. Track and coordinate permits, certificates of insurance and town requirements as the owner directs.

• Vendors. Coordinate with the bookkeeper, marketing agency and payroll provider using documented processes.

• Reporting. Send the owner a regular report on calls, bookings, the estimate pipeline, jobs completed and receivables.

• SOPs and team growth. Follow the office SOP library and keep it updated. When the company adds office staff, train and supervise them using the SOPs.

How you’ll be measured

• 95% or more of calls answered

• Every new lead contacted within 5 minutes

• 75% or more of qualified leads booked

• Arrival-window and “on the way” texts sent on every job

• Every open estimate followed up on time, per the SOP, until it closes

• Invoices sent the day the job is completed

• Receivables kept within target, with nothing aging without action

• Housecall Pro data complete and accurate enough that the owner can trust the reports

• Permits, insurance certificates and vendor tasks done on time, every time

You’ll succeed here if you have

• 2 or more years in office management, dispatch, customer service or operations coordination, ideally in plumbing, HVAC or other home services

• Hands-on experience with Housecall Pro, or with ServiceTitan, Jobber, FieldPulse or a similar platform

• Experience dispatching a team of several technicians, including same-day and emergency calls

• Excellent spoken English and a confident, warm phone presence

• A strong follow-up habit. You chase estimates and invoices without being reminded.

• The ability to juggle phones, schedules and follow-ups at the same time without dropping anything

• Comfort working independently for a busy owner

• Availability to work US Eastern business hours, full-time

Nice to have

• Experience with Housecall Pro specifically

• Spanish speaking

• HVAC experience (seasonal demand, maintenance plans, equipment installs)

• Experience offering financing or selling membership plans on the phone

• Experience coordinating permits or certificates of insurance

• Experience training or supervising a CSR or a small office team

• Experience helping a team move to a new field service platform

Compensation & Benefits (to be provided by Offshore Launch):

• Up to $1600/mo depending on experience

• Guaranteed annual bonus of one month's salary

• Performance-based annual bonus up to 1.5x one month's salary contingent on quarterly performance scores

• Comprehensive health benefits, including dependents: health, life, vision and dental insurance.

• 16 days PTO

Note:

The Client is not involved in compensation or benefits. As an employee of Offshore Launch, all compensation and benefits are to be provided by the Agency.

Please note that we anticipate a response from candidates within 24 hours of our outreach. If we do not receive a reply within this timeframe, we will assume that you are no longer interested in pursuing this opportunity.

jobs.title: Copy of Commercial Manager
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking a Commercial Manager to be based in our Baltimore, MD office to support the B&P Tunnel Replacement (BPTR) Program among other project opportunities available at AECOM.

AECOM is the delivery partner for Amtrak on the BPTR Program that will upgrade a ten-mile section of the Northeast Corridor (NEC), America’s busiest passenger rail line. The delivery partner team is responsible for supporting Amtrak with overseeing the full breadth of the program. The scope of services includes program management, design oversight, construction oversight, commissioning oversight, program controls, and commercial and capacity building.  The Program will also include delivery of new roadway and railroad bridges, new rail systems and track, and a new ADA-accessible West Baltimore MARC station.

The Commercial/Contracts Manager will oversee the administration and performance of the Design Joint Venture (DJV) contract(s). This role ensures effective contract management, compliance, and communication throughout the design phase and contract closeout. The position requires regular attendance at the Integrated Project Office (IPO). The ideal candidate will have strong design management experience combined with commercial and contractual expertise to manage complex issues and facilitate collaboration across teams.

Key Responsibilities

• Administer contract(s) ensuring compliance and performance
• Manage contract modifications, change orders, and claims resolution
• Serve as primary interface for commercial and contractual challenges during design progression

jobs.title: Office Manager – Plumbing & Heating (Remote, Jobber)
jobs.description:
About Offshore Launch:

Offshore Launch is a business and growth operations firm helping home service owners scale their operations.

We design, build, and staff business and revenue operations so the shop runs on clear process, technology and data - so owners can work on the business instead of being trapped inside it.

We are a people-centered agency with a passion for leaving every employee and client in a better position than we found them.

Why Join Offshore Launch?

• Impact the growth and success of small and medium-sized businesses.

• Work in a people-first, remote environment that values career growth.

• Access comprehensive benefits that include HMO, PTO, transparent bonus, raise and career pathways - with an overall emphasis on teamwork, collaboration, and work/life balance.

• Contribute to a culture that values partnership, service, and excellence.

Who We Serve

This is a remote, full-time position supporting an established, highly rated plumbing and heating company in New Hampshire. The company mostly serves homeowners: everyday plumbing repairs, water heaters, boilers, furnaces and gas lines, plus some remodels and light commercial work. You’ll work 7:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. US Eastern Time.

The owner is a licensed plumber who works in the field every day alongside an apprentice. Right now he answers every call, text and email himself, often while he’s on a job. You’ll take that off his plate. You’ll be the person who keeps the office running: phones, scheduling, estimates, invoices, permits and follow-up. The company already uses Jobber and QuickBooks Online. You’ll start with a newly reviewed and improved Jobber setup, written SOPs, and full support from our team. You’ll help build how a professional office works for this business.

This role is for someone who wants to own the office and give every customer a polished, professional experience without waiting to be told what to do next.

What you’ll own

• The phones and the lead inbox. You’re the first voice customers hear. Answer incoming calls and book service calls, repairs and estimates calmly and professionally. Watch the shared inbox and website form leads, and follow up first thing each morning on anything that came in after hours.

• Scheduling and dispatch. Schedule and dispatch jobs in Jobber around the owner’s day in the field. Send every customer an arrival window and an “on the way” text so nobody is left wondering.

• The estimate pipeline. Follow up on every open estimate until it’s won or declined, and keep the pipeline current so the owner always knows where each job stands.

• Invoicing and collections. Send invoices and payment links through Jobber as soon as jobs are done. Handle deposit and progress billing on remodels. Follow up on unpaid balances so nothing sits without action.

• Clean system data. Keep Jobber accurate: job details, time tracking, material costs, lead-source tags and routine price catalog updates. Make sure Jobber and QuickBooks Online stay in sync.

• Permits and insurance certificates. Track and coordinate permits for plumbing and gas work across local towns, some online and some in person. Request certificates of insurance from the insurance agent when commercial customers need them, as the owner directs.

• Vendors. Coordinate with the bookkeeper, CPA, payroll provider (ADP) and the website and marketing agency, following documented processes.

• Reporting. Send the owner a regular report on calls, bookings, the estimate pipeline, jobs completed and receivables.

• SOPs and organization. Follow the office SOP library and keep it updated as the business changes. Help move the office from scattered texts and local files to organized, shared systems.

How you’ll be measured

• 95% or more of calls answered during business hours

• Every new lead contacted within 5 minutes during business hours, and after-hours leads contacted by the start of the next business day

• 75% or more of qualified leads booked

• Arrival-window and “on the way” texts sent on every job

• Every open estimate followed up on time, per the SOP, until it closes

• Invoices sent the day the job is completed

• Receivables kept within target, with nothing aging without action

• Jobber data complete and accurate enough that the owner can trust the reports

• Permits, insurance certificates and vendor tasks done on time, every time

• About half of the role handled on your own by day 30, and all of it by day 60

You’ll succeed here if you have

• 2 or more years in office management, dispatch, customer service or operations coordination, ideally in plumbing, HVAC or other home services

• Hands-on experience with Jobber, or with Housecall Pro, ServiceTitan, FieldPulse or a similar platform

• Experience with QuickBooks Online, especially invoicing and payments

• Excellent spoken English and a confident, warm phone presence

• A strong follow-up habit. You chase estimates and invoices without being reminded.

• The ability to juggle phones, schedules and follow-ups at the same time without dropping anything

• Comfort working on your own for an owner who is on job sites most of the day

• Availability to work 7:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. US Eastern Time, full-time

Nice to have

• Experience with Jobber specifically

• Experience with heating work (boilers, furnaces, gas) or plumbing service

• Experience coordinating permits or certificates of insurance, especially with local town offices

• Experience with remodel billing (deposits, progress payments)

• Experience with ADP or working with a bookkeeper

• Experience helping a small business move from owner-run, informal processes to a professional office setup

Compensation & Benefits (to be provided by Offshore Launch):

• Up to $1600/mo depending on experience

• Guaranteed annual bonus of one month's salary

• Performance-based annual bonus up to 1.5x one month's salary contingent on quarterly performance scores

• Comprehensive health benefits, including dependents: health, life, vision and dental insurance.

• 16 days PTO

Note:

The Client is not involved in compensation or benefits. As an employee of Offshore Launch, all compensation and benefits are to be provided by the Agency.

Please note that we anticipate a response from candidates within 24 hours of our outreach. If we do not receive a reply within this timeframe, we will assume that you are no longer interested in pursuing this opportunity.

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
Halo is a technology company building the future of haircare for all textures. We create category-defining products built for the complexities others overlook.

We're building HaloBraid, the world's first braid-assist device. It helps stylists finish braids five times faster, flawlessly and gently. This is one of the hardest unsolved problems in robotics, applied to a $270B salon services industry, and integrating computer vision, compliant fiber manipulation, and novel mechanisms.

Billions of hours are spent braiding hair each year; HaloBraid gives that time back. We're moving from R&D into deployment with salons, and we're backed by leading investors.


YOU WILL

 - Own the design and development of electrical systems and subsystems for HaloBraid, through pilot builds and production.

 - Design, prototype, and validate electronics, including circuit design, schematic capture, PCB layout, board bring-up, and debugging.

 - Develop and integrate sensing, motor control, power distribution, and other electronics for a complex electromechanical system.

 - Collaborate closely with mechanical, firmware, and systems engineers to make architecture decisions and resolve integration challenges.

 - Build rigorous test and validation processes, using experiments and data to evaluate performance, reliability, and design tradeoffs.

 - Design for manufacturability, cost, reliability, and safety, supporting supplier engagement, pilot builds, and production handoff.

 - Troubleshoot complex hardware issues, identify root causes, and drive solutions from prototype through production.


YOU HAVE

 - 5+ years of experience designing and developing electronics for physical products, ideally with experience bringing products into production.

 - Strong fundamentals in analog and digital circuit design, PCB layout, board bring-up, and hardware debugging.

 - Experience designing electronics for electromechanical systems, including sensors, actuators, motors, and embedded controllers.

 - Proficiency with electrical design tools and hands-on lab equipment, including oscilloscopes, multimeters, and logic analyzers.

 - A track record of owning electrical designs from initial concept through prototyping, validation, and production readiness.

 - Strong system-level judgment and the ability to evaluate tradeoffs across electrical, mechanical, firmware, cost, and reliability requirements.

 - A rigorous approach to experimentation, troubleshooting, and data-driven decision-making.

 - Comfort working in a fast-moving hardware environment where designs evolve through testing and iteration.


DESIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE (OPTIONAL BUT THE MORE, THE BETTER)

 - Experience with motor control, motion systems, or precision robotics.

 - Experience with embedded firmware development in C/C++ and microcontroller interfaces.

 - Familiarity with signal processing, feedback control systems, or sensor integration.

 - Experience with EMC/EMI, electrical safety, and product certification.

 - Experience with DFM/DFT, PCB assembly, contract manufacturers, and production test development.

 - Experience developing consumer electronics or other compact, high-reliability electromechanical products.

 - Experience mentoring engineers or helping establish electrical engineering best practices.


WORKING STYLE

 - User-centric. You want to build things people actually use and love.

 - Low ego, adaptable, collaborative.

 - A fast, honest iterator. You learn through testing and user feedback, and you follow through on what you suggest.

 - Driven by the mission. A hard, unsolved robotics problem that gives millions of people their time back is your idea of a good challenge.

 - A clear communicator. You can explain complex technical decisions and work effectively across disciplines.


BENEFITS OF WORKING WITH US

What You’ll Do

What You’ll Get to Build

jobs.title: Senior Digital Strategist Contractor
jobs.description:
Velir is an established mid-sized agency with a top-tier portfolio of clients, ranging from the world’s largest non-profits to Fortune 500 brands. As of 2023, Velir acquired Brooklyn Data Company, a premier data and analytics consultancy focused on leadership, process improvement, implementation, and advanced analytics.

At Velir, we believe people are our greatest asset. Our culture is built on a foundation of trust, collaboration, and continued improvement. We strive for excellence in everything we do, embracing challenges as opportunities for growth. Our success is driven by a shared passion for making a positive impact on our customers, our communities and each other. We are a remote first company that offers competitive pay and excellent benefits.

Overview

Velir is seeking an experienced Senior Digital Strategy Consultant to support digital strategy, customer experience, marketing, and commerce engagements. This contract role is ideal for a versatile strategist who combines strong research and analytical skills with practical experience helping organizations improve digital experiences and business performance.

You will work across clients and industries, including associations, nonprofits, and B2B and B2C organizations. Engagements may involve digital strategy and planning, customer and market research, user testing, commerce and path-to-purchase strategy, customer journey optimization, and personalization strategy.

We're looking for someone who can move comfortably between research, strategic analysis, client workshops, and executive-level recommendations. You should be able to quickly understand a client's business, identify meaningful opportunities, develop clear recommendations, and communicate findings in compelling, client-ready deliverables.

You should also bring hands-on experience using advanced AI techniques in strategy work, including synthetic research, AI-assisted benchmarking, and structured synthesis of research and customer insights. We value strategists who use AI to improve research quality and efficiency while critically evaluating results and validating findings against reliable evidence.

You'll collaborate with Velir's Strategy, Experience Design, Data, Technology, and Customer Success teams. Depending on the engagement, you'll independently lead defined strategy workstreams or support a broader team.

Responsibilities

Research, Insights & Analysis

• Conduct qualitative and quantitative research to understand customer needs, market dynamics, competitor positioning, digital trends, and business opportunities.

• Perform competitive benchmarking, digital experience assessments, and industry best-practice research across marketing, content, and commerce experiences.

• Analyze website performance, user behavior, customer journeys, and other available data to identify opportunities and inform recommendations.

• Synthesize research findings into clear insights, strategic implications, and prioritized recommendations.

• Develop research frameworks, interview guides, assessment criteria, and other tools to support structured discovery and analysis.

AI-Enabled Research & Strategic Analysis

• Conduct synthetic research and AI-assisted audience simulations to explore potential needs, behaviors, pain points, and experience scenarios, clearly distinguishing hypotheses from validated customer findings.

• Use AI-assisted benchmarking to systematically assess competitors and leading digital experiences across customer journeys, content, marketing, personalization, and commerce capabilities.

• Apply AI to synthesize interviews, customer feedback, market intelligence, research, and digital performance data to identify patterns and strategic opportunities.

• Create structured prompts, multi-step AI research workflows, and reusable assessment frameworks that improve consistency, speed, and depth of analysis.

• Evaluate AI-generated findings for accuracy, bias, source credibility, and methodological limitations; corroborate material conclusions before incorporating them into client recommendations.

Digital Experience & Business Strategy

jobs.title: Senior Customer Service Advisor
jobs.description:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.



Department Description   

Operations in banking like in every other firm is established to carry out all the day-to-day transactions of the business. The Operations function within Allica has wide-ranging responsibilities supporting the customers of all product lines (Commercial Mortgages, Asset Finance, Deposits and Payment Account with aligned card activity), alongside our own internal stakeholders. We are particularly focused on the following, ensuring that the bank adheres to all relevant Regulatory requirements and our own internal policies and procedures at all times:



 - Slick digital account opening, and in life servicing.

 - Customer contact via telephony, email and in-app communications.

 - Payment and reconciliation activity.

 - Treasury operations.

 - Customer due diligence through Know Your Customer, Know Your Business.

 - Lending pipeline management.

 - Quality assurance and control.

 - Issue resolution.

 - Effective record keeping and data management.

 - Support of all change initiatives.
   
   

Role Description

The Customer Service Advisor will be responsible for 1st line customer service support for the Bank’s Retail and SME customers via Chat (Online) and Telephony, together with Back Office activities to support the smooth running of the function.

They will be the focal point for customers – delivering exceptional service whilst living our values and speaking a language our customers will understand and understanding the business and banking challenges our customers face.



Principal Accountabilities

• To field inbound communications from customers – either over voice, chat or social media – to action their requests, resolve their issues and manage complaints through to resolution.

• You’ll be responsible for case management, and this may include outbound customer communications, payments and letter writing.

• Some of the key exceptions you’ll be dealing with will include KYC, complaints, vulnerable customers, deceased/power of attorney cases and SME customers who might have complex needs.

• To proactively identify areas for process improvement and to seek new and innovative ways to better serve the customer. 

• To live and breathe the Bank’s values, representing the Bank to customers and speaking to customers in a way that resonates.

• To support other teams as appropriate, where customer communication or engagement is required.



Personal Attributes & Experience

 - Strong customer service experience, having worked in customer facing and or telephone service roles.

 - Experience using core banking systems and familiar with the use and application of social media as a form of interaction.

 - Experience in dealing with complex complaints and in taking ownership of customer concerns through to resolution.

 - Experience of core processes (e.g. account opening, servicing and closing, payments processing, complaint handling, KYC case referrals, general enquiry management)

 - Experience in working with workflow / task management tools

 - Knowledge of financial services rules and guidelines

 - Excellent oral and written skills as they will be constantly communicating with customers

 - Quickly react and adapt to stressful and difficult situations

 - Enthusiastic and articulate, whilst being motivated by a need to help people

 - A problem solver and can create positive customer outcomes in diverse situations

 - Conform to our ethical standards and conduct

 - Perform administrative tasks related to the customer interaction

 - Deliver outstanding customer service as measured through customer satisfaction KPIs

 - Manage and monitor service providers for customer quality

 - Drive customer service innovation and continuous improvement of process to deliver better customer outcomes

 - Act as an ambassador/advocate for Customer within the Bank

 - Adhere to quality control requirements and ensure compliance with policy



Working at Allica Bank

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

 - Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

 - Options for flexible working

 - Regular social activities

 - Pension contributions

 - Discretionary bonus scheme

 - Private health cover

 - Life assurance

 - Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave



Don’t tick every box?

Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!

Flexible working

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

Diversity

We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

jobs.title: IT Support Specialist (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
ABOUT FOCUSED ENERGY

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A - the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry  we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies. 

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

 


YOUR ROLE

As IT support specialist, you will be the primary point of contact for day-to-day IT support across our Berlin and Darmstadt offices, keeping employees connected, equipped, and secure so they can focus on building fusion technology. You will own the full IT support lifecycle at both sites, from ticket resolution and device management to onboarding and security compliance.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Lead the device lifecycle for Windows and macOS endpoints: imaging, configuration, inventory tracking, and patching.

 - Prioritise and resolve hardware, software, and connectivity issues across Berlin and Darmstadt, proactively and independently.

 - Execute onboarding and offboarding IT tasks, including accounts, access provisioning, device readiness, and timely revocation, in close coordination with People Operations.

 - Enforce the security baseline by ensuring MFA coverage, completing access reviews, and maintaining patch compliance under IT security policy and GDPR.

 - Keep IT documentation and self-service FAQs current, and identify recurring issues with proposed root-cause fixes.

 - Support improvement projects such as cloud device management migration, DLP implementation, and EDR rollout, and escalate scope or security issues early to the Senior IT Manager.




WHO YOU ARE

 - You have solid IT support fundamentals in hardware, software, networking, and endpoint security, with hands-on experience in both Windows and macOS.

 - You are experienced with Microsoft 365 (Exchange, Teams, SharePoint) and an MDM platform such as Intune.

 - You understand identity and access management and MFA solutions, and you work confidently in ticketing systems such as Jira, Confluence, or Box.

 - You have working knowledge of GDPR as it applies to IT operations in Germany and follow ITIL-aligned practices for incident and request management.

 - You have basic scripting skills (PowerShell or similar) and a root-cause mindset that favours proactive maintenance over firefighting.

 - You take ownership without waiting to be asked, follow up without prompting, and communicate fluently in German and English.

 


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

 - Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

 - Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

 - Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

 - Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

 - Vacation Days: We support your work-life balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

 - Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

 - Retirement Plan: If you decide for a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

 - Equipment: We offer state-of-the-art Windows or Apple Laptops. In addition, you will receive a keyboard, mouse and headset so you are fully equipped from day 1.

 - Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

 - Mobility with NAVIT: We partner with NAVIT to support your flexible commuting needs whether it’s a public transportation ticket, taxi rides or car-sharing you choose what fits your lifestyle.

 - Fitness with Wellhub: We care about your health. Get access to a wide range of gyms, fitness studios and wellness services across Europe through our partnership with Wellhub.

 


Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/anthropic/jobs/4669581008

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the Team

Our team is organized around the north star goal of building an AI scientist – a system capable of solving the long term reasoning challenges and basic capabilities necessary to push the scientific frontier.

About the role

As a Research Engineer on our team you will work end to end across the whole model stack, identifying and addressing key infra blockers on the path to scientific AGI. Strong candidates should have familiarity with elements of language model training, evaluation, and inference and eagerness to quickly dive and get up to speed in areas they are not yet an expert on. This may include performance optimization, distributed systems, VM/sandboxing/container deployment, and large scale data pipelines. Join us in our mission to develop advanced AI systems pushing the frontiers of science and benefiting humanity.

Responsibilities:

• Design and implement large-scale infrastructure systems to support AI scientist training, evaluation, and deployment across distributed environments

• Identify and resolve infrastructure bottlenecks impeding progress toward scientific capabilities

• Develop robust and reliable evaluation frameworks for measuring progress towards scientific AGI.

• Build scalable and performant VM/sandboxing/container architectures to safely execute long-horizon AI tasks and scientific workflows

• Collaborate to translate experimental requirements into production-ready infrastructure

• Develop large scale data pipelines to handle advanced language model training requirements

• Optimize large scale training and inference pipelines for stable and efficient reinforcement learning

You may be a good fit if you:

• Have 6+ years of highly-relevant experience in infrastructure engineering with demonstrated expertise in large-scale distributed systems

• Are a strong communicator and enjoy working collaboratively

• Possess deep knowledge of performance optimization techniques and system architectures for high-throughput ML workloads

• Have experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) and orchestration at scale

• Have proven track record of building large-scale data pipelines and distributed storage systems

• Excel at diagnosing and resolving complex infrastructure challenges in production environments

• Can work effectively across the full ML stack from data pipelines to performance optimization

• Have experience collaborating with other researchers to scale experimental ideas

• Thrive in fast-paced environments and can rapidly iterate from experimentation to production

Strong candidates may also have:

• Experience with language model training infrastructure and distributed ML frameworks (PyTorch, JAX, etc.)

• Background in building infrastructure for AI research labs or large-scale ML organizations

• Knowledge of GPU/TPU architectures and language model inference optimization

• Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP) at enterprise scale

• Familiarity with VM and container orchestration.

• Experience with workflow orchestration tools and experiment management systems

• History working with large scale reinforcement learning

• Comfort with large scale data pipelines (Beam, Spark, Dask, …)

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$350,000—$850,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: G2i - Senior/Staff Software Engineer | AI Task Creation
jobs.description:
FROM SILVER.DEV

Estamos ayudando a los de G2i a conseguir trainers y task creators para laboratorios de AI, que incluyen a OpenAI y SpaceX.

Las tareas son unidades de trabajo para entrenar a los modelos y se paga por tarea completada efectivamente. Las tareas toman entre 1 y 2 días en completarse, y los creadores de tareas más efectivos llegan a completar más de 30 tareas mensualmente.

El trabajo es async y lo podés manejar a tu tiempo, pero sí requiere varias horas de trabajo y onboarding. Presten atención a las instrucciones de G2i. Pueden aplicar directamente con ellos en este link https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/g2i/4f17a3e9-d8bc-4f42-b02f-adbfc30c0e45?utm_source=silver, o aplicar en nuestra plataforma y nosotros manejamos su aplicación.

Pueden escuchar a Gabriel Greenberg directamente sobre el trabajo en el siguiente Loom:








ABOUT THE ROLE

G2i is hiring senior and staff-level software engineers to build the coding tasks a frontier AI lab uses to train its models. Each completed task pays $1,000 USD.

Most AI training work is annotation: engineers pick up a task someone else wrote and evaluate it. This role is one step earlier. You design and build the tasks themselves, which takes a different skill set from typical product engineering.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design and build realistic, challenging software engineering tasks that frontier models will be trained and evaluated on

 - Write tasks across codebases of very different sizes, from a few files to large multi-service projects

 - Work mainly in TypeScript, Python and Go

 - Revise your tasks based on feedback from G2i reviewers and team leads until they meet the lab's quality bar

 - Work mostly on your own, with support from reviewers and a shared engineer channel

 


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're hiring two kinds of engineers. Both are welcome to apply.

 1. Engineers who have built AI training tasks before (top priority). You've designed and built tasks or environments for training models at a frontier lab or a data lab. Contractor experience counts. What matters is that you built tasks, not only annotated, reviewed or evaluated tasks someone else wrote.

 2. Very strong senior, staff or principal engineers who haven't done this yet. You have deep, hands-on skill in TypeScript, Python and/or Go, and you learn new kinds of work fast. You may need a few extra days in training to learn the format, and that's expected.

For both profiles:

 - Senior to principal-level engineering experience

 - Strong code reading and writing skills, without relying on AI tools

 - Clear written English, since tasks and reviewer feedback are written

 


PAY

You're paid per completed task, not by the hour.

 - Training project: if you pass, you're paid $600 USD and join the core team.

 - Each completed task after training: $1,000 USD

Based on early internal data, top performers finish 1 to 2 tasks a day, mid-level performers about 1 every other day, and others 1 to 2 a week. A task usually takes 4 to 10 hours.

If you don't pass the training, it doesn't count against you for other G2i AI projects. Those may open to you separately.

 


HIRING PROCESS

There are no live technical interviews. The steps are:

 1. Apply through the link below.

 2. Take-home assessment. It's designed to take about 90 minutes. Taking 4 to 6 hours is fine and won't lower your score, because quality matters more than speed. It doesn't expire, but the sooner you finish it, the sooner you can start.

 3. Background check. This usually takes 24 to 48 hours in the US and Canada. In some countries it can take more.

 4. Offer. It's usually sent within a day after your background check clears.

 5. Training project. You build one task with guidance from reviewers and team leads. You have up to 7 days. Engineers who have built tasks before often finish in 1 to 2. If you pass, you're paid $600 and join the core team. If you don't, you're out of this project, and it's unpaid.

 


HOURS AND CONTRACT

 - Contract: independent contractor, fully remote. Either side can end it at any time.

 - Hours: 40 a week is ideal. Part-time is welcome: 20 a week is preferred, and 10 is the minimum.

 - Schedule: flexible. You can work any day of the week, and some overlap with North American time zones is preferred.

 - Keep your current job: you don't need to leave a full-time role to join part-time.

 - Length: this is a project-based engagement, not a permanent role. When it ends, G2i often has other frontier AI projects available.

The Senior Producer, Video joins Harvey's Creative Operations team to lead end-to-end video production that brings the Harvey brand to life across campaigns, social series, product storytelling, and customer narratives. The team sits within Harvey's creative studio and partners with designers, motion artists, and cross-functional marketing stakeholders to produce high-quality visual content at startup speed. You'll work with the Creative Directors leading video and the Content & Social team every day, turning their ideas and roadmap into realistic production plans and helping get finished work out on time. The role includes regular travel for shoots.

 - Support production across Harvey's video slate from brief through delivery. That includes recurring social series, executive content, event coverage, product launches, use-case explainers, and brand campaigns. You'll often juggle several projects at once on one- to two-week turnarounds, and lead smaller productions yourself.

 - Take in briefs from Creative Directors and Content & Social leads, and coordinate with Product Marketing, Brand, Comms, and Events to secure inputs. Ask the questions that clarify objectives, audience, and deliverables, flag gaps before they become problems, and plan shoots around every channel version and cutdown.

 - Source, book, and coordinate production agencies, freelance crews, editors, and post vendors, and help grow the vendor roster as the program scales.

 - Support shoots in the studio, at the office, on location, and at events, with executives and non-professional talent. That covers preparing interview subjects, locations, permits, talent releases, call sheets, equipment, travel, and on-set logistics.

Liquid Personnel is an equal opportunities employer. Liquid Personnel Ltd is acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy. * Terms and conditions apply to our bonus schemes.

jobs.title: FP&A Manager
jobs.description:
About Nexthink

Nexthink is a global leader in Digital Employee Experience (DEX) management software. Our platform enables organizations to proactively monitor, analyze, and improve the digital experiences of employees, helping businesses enhance productivity, optimize technology investments, and drive operational excellence.

As Nexthink continues to scale globally, we are looking for a highly analytical and commercially minded FP&A Managerto partner with our business functions and play a key role in executive, Board of Directors, and investor reporting.

About the Role

Reporting to the Director FP&A, the FP&A Manager will serve as a strategic finance business partner to global business functions while supporting corporate FP&A activities, including financial performance analysis, Board reporting, and investor communications.

This role combines business partnering, financial modeling, SaaS performance analytics, and executive-level storytelling. The successful candidate will translate complex financial and operational data into actionable insights, challenge business assumptions, and help leadership make informed capital allocation decisions.

The position requires strong analytical capabilities, commercial judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate effectively with senior executives.

Key Responsibilities

1. Finance Business Partnering

• Serve as the primary FP&A business partner to leadership of assigned business functions, supporting strategic planning, budgeting, forecasting, and performance management.
• Own the financial plan for the supported function, including headcount, personnel expenses, program and non-personnel spending, and other strategic investments.
• Partner with business leadership to evaluate resource allocation, investment priorities, and spending efficiency across geographies, teams, and programs.
• Develop and monitor functional KPIs and efficiency metrics relevant to the supported area.
• Analyze investments against business outcomes such as bookings, ARR growth, and profitability to assess effectiveness and inform future investment decisions.
• Provide monthly and quarterly variance analysis, identify emerging risks and opportunities, and recommend corrective actions.
• Support business cases for incremental investments, hiring plans, and strategic growth initiatives.

2. Board of Directors & Investor Reporting

• Support the preparation of monthly and quarterly financial reporting packages for executive leadership, the Board of Directors, and investors.
• Develop clear, concise, and insightful presentations covering financial performance, operating trends, business KPIs, and strategic initiatives.
• Translate financial results and operational performance into compelling executive-level narratives, highlighting key drivers, trends, risks, and opportunities.
• Support the preparation of annual operating plans, long-range financial plans, and financial outlooks for Board and investor discussions.
• Partner with Accounting, Treasury, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, and other Finance teams to ensure accuracy, consistency, and integrity of reported information.
• Support investor information requests, ad hoc financial analyses, and reporting requirements associated with the company's ownership and financing structure.

3. Corporate FP&A & Financial Analysis

• Support consolidated financial forecasting, annual budgeting, and long-range strategic planning.
• Develop financial models to evaluate business performance, growth scenarios, operating leverage, and investment returns.
• Perform detailed analyses of revenue growth, profitability, expense trends, headcount, and cash flow.
• Identify opportunities to improve forecast accuracy, financial visibility, and resource allocation.
• Drive improvements in financial reporting, KPI standardization, and planning processes.
• Leverage financial systems, BI tools, and automation to enhance reporting efficiency and analytical capabilities.
• Drive AI and system automation across FP&A, identifying and implementing AI-enabled tools, workflow automation, and system integrations that streamline forecasting, reporting, and variance analysis.
• Support strategic initiatives, such as M&As, tracking strategic investments and ROIs.
• Back up for other FP&A work streams as needed.

Required

• Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field.
• 10 years of progressive experience in FP&A, corporate finance, strategic finance, or a related analytical function.
• Strong financial modeling skills, including integrated forecasting, scenario analysis, and financial performance analysis.
• Solid understanding of SaaS business models, recurring revenue metrics, and growth economics.
• Demonstrated experience partnering with business leaders to influence financial and operational decisions.
• Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills, with the ability to prepare polished, executive-level presentations.
• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
• Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and deliver high-quality results under tight deadlines.
• Strong attention to detail, combined with the ability to see the broader strategic picture.

Highly Preferred

• Prior experience in finance business partnership in a B2B SaaS environment.
• Experience in a high-growth SaaS, enterprise software, or technology company.
• Experience preparing executive, Board, or private equity investor reporting packages.
• Experience with Workday Adaptive Planning, NetSuite, Salesforce, Power BI, or similar financial and analytical platforms.
• Experience driving AI and system automation in finance, such as AI-enabled analysis, workflow automation, or system integrations that improve planning and reporting.
• Experience working in a global, multi-entity organization.
• Experience in a private equity-backed environment.

What Success Looks Like

• Strategic business partnership: Business leadership views Finance as a trusted partner in investment decisions, rather than simply a budget-monitoring function.
• Data-driven capital allocation: Business investments are evaluated consistently based on financial performance, business impact, and expected returns.
• High-quality executive reporting: Board and investor materials provide accurate, insightful, and decision-oriented analysis with clear financial narratives.
• Forecasting excellence: Financial forecasts are reliable, transparent, and supported by well-understood business drivers.
• Continuous improvement: Reporting and planning processes become increasingly automated, scalable, and efficient.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who combines the analytical rigor of a strong FP&A professional with the commercial mindset of a strategic business partner.

The ideal candidate is intellectually curious, comfortable challenging assumptions, capable of navigating ambiguity, and skilled at turning data into actionable business insights. They can move seamlessly between detailed financial models and high-level executive presentations, communicating effectively with both operational leaders and senior stakeholders.

We are the pioneers and trailblazers of a global IT Market Category (DEX) that is shaping the future of how the world works, giving our customers’ IT Teams total digital visibility across their enterprise. Our innovative solutions integrate real-time analytics, automation, and employee feedback across all endpoints. This enables our IT teams to solve complex technical challenges, create ever more productive workplaces, and deliver happy, satisfied employees in the digital workplace.

With over 1000 employees across 5 continents, Nexthink operates as One Team, connecting, collaborating and innovating to continuously grow. We call our employees ‘Nexthinkers’ and our commitment to diversity, inclusion, and equity is second to none. We currently have over 75 nationalities working with us, from all cultures and backgrounds, speaking many different languages.

If you are looking for a change and like a nice atmosphere, lots of challenges, and having fun while working, this is a great opportunity for you! Check what we offer:

• 💼 Permanent Contract and a competitive compensation package.
• 📍 Amazing centrally located offices near the Bernabeu Stadium.
• 🩺 Private Health Insurance (Sanitas) and daily meal vouchers of 11 EUR will be entirely covered by us.
• 🏡 Hybrid work model balancing office and remote work, with a structured approach for new hires to foster connections and onboarding.
• 🏖️ Flexible Hours and unlimited vacation (employees have unlimited paid time off on top of the 23 days of holidays we offer) plus 3 company-paid volunteer days.
• 🤸 Up to 25 EUR per month for a gym subscription.
• 🛴 Flexible compensation plan for childcare & public transportation.

• 🚚 We offer a relocation package to people who are coming from another country.

Please note that not all the benefits listed above are available for temporary, contract, and internship roles. To ensure you have the most up-to-date information, we recommend checking with your Recruitment Partner.

Total Rewards @ Nexthink

At Nexthink, we offer one of the most comprehensive and generous benefits plans.  Your total rewards compensation package includes base salary and may also include a commission or performance bonus plan.  We provide our US employees with 100% covered company benefits that consist of health, dental, vision as well as access to life insurance, long-term disability, and accidental death/personal loss coverage.

In addition, we offer:

• 🏖️ Flexible Hours and unlimited vacation (employees have unlimited paid time off on top of the 15 days of holidays we offer), 11 company-paid holidays, and 3 extra days for volunteering.
• 🏡 Hybrid work model that balances office and remote work, with structured onboarding to foster connections and team integration.
• 📚 Free access to professional training platforms to explore your interests and enhance your skills.
• 🍼 Up to 16 weeks of paid leave for birthing parents/primary caregivers, 6 weeks for secondary caregivers.
• 💰 Plan for the future with a 401(k) plan featuring up to 4% company matching contributions, vesting immediately, to grow your retirement savings.
• 📣 Bonuses for referring successful hires after three months of continuous employment.

Base salary ranges are determined by country, role, level, experience, and skills. The range displayed on each job posting reflects Nexthink’s good faith determination of the minimum and maximum targets for new hire salaries across all US locations. Individual pay is determined by related factors, including job skills, experience, and relevant education or training, which may impact a final offer. jobs.description:
Bish Enterprises is seeking a highly organized, proactive, and dependable Executive Assistant to support our Chief Operating Officer (COO).

This role is much more than traditional administrative support. The Executive Assistant will help the COO manage priorities, organize information, coordinate communication, track commitments, and keep important projects and follow-ups moving across the company.

The right person will become a trusted administrative partner who can anticipate needs, manage multiple priorities, communicate professionally, and independently close open loops without requiring constant direction.

You should be comfortable working in an environment where priorities can change quickly, interruptions happen, and follow-through matters.

Key Responsibilities

Executive & Calendar Support

• Manage and maintain the COO's calendar, appointments, meetings, and scheduling priorities.
• Coordinate and confirm phone calls, Teams/Zoom meetings, appointments, and other commitments.
• Identify scheduling conflicts and help prioritize the COO's time.
• Make sure the COO has the documents, notes, links, background information, and other materials needed before meetings.
• Coordinate travel, accommodations, itineraries, events, and related logistics.
• Help keep the COO prepared for upcoming meetings, deadlines, commitments, and responsibilities.

Email, Communication & Follow-Up

• Help organize and maintain the COO's email inbox and communications.
• Track requests, commitments, deadlines, and follow-up items.
• Draft, format, proofread, and review emails, correspondence, reports, presentations, quotes, and other materials.
• Communicate professionally with employees, customers, vendors, industry partners, nonprofit organizations, and other external contacts.
• Make sure promised information and follow-ups are completed.
• Screen and appropriately direct incoming communications.
• Maintain professional relationship continuity on behalf of the COO.

Project & Team Coordination

• Follow up with team members across administration, sales, marketing, production, engineering, and other departments.
• Track project deliverables, deadlines, open questions, responsibilities, and next steps.
• Follow through on outstanding items until they are resolved.
• Help maintain accountability across projects and departments.
• Take clear meeting notes and turn discussions into organized action items.
• Keep project information, notes, and supporting documents organized.
• Update customer records, notes, CRM information, and project information when requested.

Administrative & Business Support

• Prepare presentations, reports, correspondence, meeting materials, and other documents.
• Organize and maintain electronic files and records.
• Conduct basic research and organize information for executive review.
• Assist with internal and external meetings, events, conferences, and speaking engagements.
• Provide administrative support for industry associations, nonprofit initiatives, and other organizational activities.
• Handle confidential and sensitive information with professionalism and discretion.
• Assist with changing business and executive priorities as needed.

What Success Looks Like

A strong Executive Assistant at Bish does more than complete assigned tasks.

You should be someone who:

• Takes ownership of responsibilities and follows through.
• Notices when something is incomplete and works to resolve it.
• Keeps commitments, deadlines, and follow-ups from falling through the cracks.
• Understands what is urgent, what can wait, and when clarification is needed.
• Learns processes quickly and becomes increasingly independent.
• Takes useful notes and remembers recurring expectations.
• Communicates clearly and professionally with different personalities and departments.
• Is comfortable respectfully following up with coworkers and executives.
• Can manage interruptions and changing priorities without losing organization.
• Identifies practical solutions instead of simply reporting problems.
• Pays close attention to details while still understanding the larger priority.
• Can work independently without needing constant supervision.
• Knows when to take initiative and when to ask for direction.
• Is reliable, discreet, and trusted with sensitive information.

Required

• At least 2 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Administrative Assistant, Office Administrator, or in a closely related support role.
• Strong organizational and time-management skills.
• Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
• Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
• Demonstrated reliability and follow-through.
• Ability to manage multiple responsibilities, deadlines, and changing priorities.
• Ability to work independently and take ownership of responsibilities.
• Strong judgment and discretion when handling sensitive or confidential information.
• Professional communication skills when interacting with executives, employees, customers, vendors, and external partners.
• Strong proficiency with Microsoft 365, including:OutlookWordExcelPowerPointTeams
• Strong computer skills and the ability to learn new systems quickly.
• Legally authorized to work in the United States.
• Able to work on-site at our Giltner, Nebraska location.

Preferred

• Experience directly supporting a COO, CEO, business owner, entrepreneur, or senior executive.
• Experience managing executive calendars and email inboxes.
• Experience coordinating projects across multiple departments.
• Experience with CRM systems.
• Experience with project-management tools such as Smartsheet, Trello, Asana, or similar platforms.
• Experience in sales support, marketing, public relations, business operations, or customer communication.
• Experience coordinating travel, conferences, events, or speaking engagements.
• Spanish language skills.
• Interest in agriculture, manufacturing, agricultural equipment, sustainability, or mission-driven organizations.

Agricultural experience is helpful but not required. We are more interested in finding someone who can learn quickly, understand the business, and become a reliable and increasingly independent partner to the COO.

Schedule

• Full-time position.
• Approximately 30–40+ hours per week, depending on workload and business needs.
• Primarily weekday business hours.
• Some flexibility may be required for meetings, events, travel, deadlines, harvest season, or time-sensitive priorities.
• This position is fully on-site in Giltner, Nebraska.

Benefits

Eligible full-time employees may have access to:

Benefit eligibility may vary based on employment status.
