jobs.title: Associate, Country Programs - LAC
jobs.location: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
jobs.description:
The Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet (Global Energy Alliance) The Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet (Global Energy Alliance) works for a world where everyone has access to affordable, reliable, clean electricity and the means to use it to improve their lives. Our Alliance builds transformative public, private, philanthropic partnerships to end energy poverty and accelerate green economic opportunity. Founded in 2021 by The Rockefeller Foundation, IKEA Foundation, and Bezos Earth Fund, we design innovative projects/programs, unlock finance, strengthen institutions and transform markets, delivering progress anchored in deep community engagement. By uniting actors across the value chain, from households to heads of state, we go beyond individual projects to drive lasting systems change. With work in more than 30 countries across Africa, Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, our Alliance aims to reach 1 billion people with clean electricity, prevent 4 billion tons of carbon emissions and create or improve 150 million jobs.

Position Overview

The Global Energy Alliance is seeking an Associate, Country Programs to support the development and delivery of high-impact energy initiatives across Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC).

Working as part of the regional team, the Associate will help advance the Alliance's mission to expand access to reliable, affordable and sustainable electricity. This includes unlocking economic opportunities through productive uses of energy (Powering Opportunity) and supporting the development of modern, resilient and sustainable electricity systems (Grids of the Future). This role will identify promising projects, build strategic partnerships and coordinate delivery across priority countries, working closely with governments, development partners, local organisations and the private sector.

This is an exciting opportunity for a proactive, entrepreneurial professional who is passionate about the Alliance's mission and driving meaningful change across the region. The ideal candidate will be a natural collaborator and relationship-builder, with strong analytical and project management skills, a hands-on approach and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Key Accountabilities

Strategy and Project Development

• Identify, evaluate and recommend potential projects, partnerships, grantees and contractors, developing proposals and scopes of work to support their delivery.

• Contribute to refining regional strategies by identifying emerging opportunities, addressing implementation challenges and recommending improvements based on evidence and lessons learned.

• Support the development and implementation of country-level strategies, workplans, budgets and timelines, identifying and assessing project opportunities aligned with the Alliance's regional priorities.

Partnership Development and Country Engagement

• Support country managers in building and maintaining relationships with key stakeholders, including governments, utilities, multilateral development institutions, local organisations and private sector partners.

• Work closely with technical experts, country delivery leads and implementing partners to coordinate activities, resolve challenges and ensure alignment with regional and global priorities.

• Support the planning and delivery of stakeholder engagements, workshops and events, including preparing presentations, briefing materials and talking points for leadership.

Project Delivery, Grant and Contract Management

• Coordinate the implementation and oversight of projects, grants and contracts, ensuring partners and contractors deliver high-quality outputs against agreed objectives, budgets and timelines.

• Support grant and contract management processes, including due diligence, approvals, reporting and compliance with internal policies and procedures.

• Monitor project progress, identify risks and implementation challenges, and work with relevant teams and partners to develop practical solutions.

Results, Learning and Fundraising Support

• Track project performance and results, working with partners and internal teams to ensure accurate and timely reporting of qualitative and quantitative impact.

• Capture lessons learned, case studies and evidence of impact to inform programme improvements, organisational learning and external communications.

• Support fundraising and donor engagement by preparing proposals, reports, presentations and other materials that demonstrate the progress and impact of LAC initiatives.

Qualifications, Experience and Competencies

Essential Qualifications and Experience

• A Bachelor's degree in a relevant field.

• A minimum of four years of relevant professional experience, preferably in energy transition, international development, management consulting or development partnerships in Latin America and the Caribbean.

• Experience identifying, assessing and proposing project development opportunities.

• Experience supporting project implementation and management, including coordinating stakeholders, monitoring progress and managing deliverables.

• Experience building and maintaining partnerships with governments, development organisations, NGOs or private sector stakeholders.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and Portuguese.

• Understanding of electrification, energy access, renewable energy systems and the energy transition in Latin America and the Caribbean.

Desirable Qualifications and Experience

• A Master's degree in Engineering, International Development, Public Policy or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience in management consulting.

• Professional proficiency in Spanish.

• Experience working with multilateral development institutions, philanthropic organisations or community-based organisations.

• Experience with productive uses of energy, energy-enabled livelihoods or economic development initiatives.

Behavioural Competencies

• Strategic, analytical and entrepreneurial: Able to identify opportunities, assess complex challenges, prioritise effectively and develop practical, innovative solutions.

• Highly organised and results-driven: Demonstrates strong project management skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities, meet deadlines and deliver high-quality work.

• Collaborative and influential: A natural relationship-builder and effective communicator works effectively across diverse teams and stakeholders, and confidently presents ideas and recommendations.

• Proactive and adaptable: A self-starter with a hands-on approach, sound judgement and the flexibility to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

• Diversity, Equity and Inclusion: Committed to the Alliance's mission and to advancing diversity, equity and inclusion in all aspects of their work, valuing diverse perspectives and challenging conventional thinking through evidence and constructive dialogue.

This is an exempt, one-year, fixed-term position with the potential to extend and an annualized starting salary of $85,000-$100,000, commensurate with experience. The Global Energy Alliance provides a comprehensive benefits package including a robust paid time off plan of 28 days annual leave in addition to org-wide end-of-year-office closure, 401(k) retirement plan with 10% employer contribution, $1,000 annually for work-from-home expenses and $100 monthly for use for transit.

This position could be based in our NYC or DC office. GEA prides itself on being a flexible employer and employees typically operate on a hybrid schedule that includes 2-3 days in office per week.

We operate from a strong commitment to equity, diversity, and inclusion in everything we do. It is not only the right thing to do – we could not make an impact without our team members' diverse perspectives and experiences. We expect all Global Energy Alliance employees to contribute by developing their unique perspectives and talent, challenging conventional wisdom through evidence and reason, and amplifying marginalized voices.

Global Energy Alliance is committed to the principles of equal employment opportunity and compliance with all federal, state, and local laws concerning employment discrimination, including the Americans with Disabilities Act. To this end, the organization ensures equal opportunity to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, age, gender, sexual orientation, religion, marital status, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, lawful alien status, physical, mental, and medical disability, veteran status, or liability for service in the United States Armed Forces.

Global Energy Alliance is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Hardware Validation & Automation Student
jobs.description:
A leading Industrial AI company, Augury helps the world’s manufacturers leverage real-time production insights and data to drive new levels of efficiency. By combining predictive and prescriptive technology with operational data and customized AI agents, production teams can improve uptime, reduce costs, and maximize yield and capacity. Our mission is to transform how people and machines work together to push the boundaries of human productivity.

About the role

We’re looking for a Computer / Electrical engineering student to join our IoT Validation & Automation team.

You’ll help operate our hardware validation lab and grow into building the automation that powers end-to-end HW/FW testing across Augury’s IoT platforms.

You’ll work hands-on with real lab equipment, write and extend Python/Robot Framework tests, and collaborate with Hardware, Embedded Firmware, Linux, and System Engineering.

No prior industry experience is required — we care about strong fundamentals, curiosity, and the drive to learn in a real production lab.

What you’ll do

• Support IoT hardware test and validation: automated tests, diagnostic tooling, and lab processes.

• Help maintain lab infrastructure: test benches, measurement equipment, calibration workflows, and tools.

• Operate lab assets such as SpectraQuest rigs, magnetic Helmholtz coils, power analyzers, and RF chambers — with mentorship.

• Execute regression, stress, performance, and multi-revision hardware tests as part of the validation pipeline.

• Develop and maintain automated end-to-end test scripts (Python, Robot Framework).

• Contribute to lab automation software and pipelines (Python, Jenkins, Docker, Git).

• Work with automation infrastructure: APIs, SSH interfaces, databases, and CI/CD flows.

• Help validate gateways, sensors, mobile, connectivity, and HW/FW integration scenarios.

• Work with hardware, firmware, software, and system engineers on validation workflows.

• Write and improve lab procedures, validation notes, and equipment documentation.

• Support root-cause investigations and reliability improvements.

What you bring

• Currently studying Computer Engineering / Electrical Engineering.

• At least 3 semesters remaining before graduation.

• Comfortable working AI-native: uses AI coding/assistant tools as part of how you learn, write, and debug — while still owning the fundamentals.

• Solid software fundamentals: Python preferred (scripting / OOP coursework or personal projects).

• Coursework or strong interest in signal processing, sensors, or embedded/IoT systems.

• Comfort learning Linux/Unix, command-line tools, and SSH.

• Interest in networking and wireless concepts (Wi-Fi, BLE, cellular — classroom level is fine).

• Curiosity about physical hardware and lab work; willingness to learn electronic test equipment.

• Strong problem-solving, attention to detail, and ability to work independently with guidance.

• No prior industry experience required.

Nice to have

• Academic lab experience (electronics, DSP, communications, or mechatronics labs).

• Familiarity with test automation ideas or frameworks (Robot Framework or similar).

• Knowledge of IoT-related protocols: BLE, MQTT, SSH.

• Personal projects involving hardware, Raspberry Pi/Arduino, sensors, or automation scripts.

• Any exposure to CI tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions) or containers (Docker).

Technologies you’ll work with

Python, Robot Framework, Patrol, Jenkins, Docker, SSH, Git, Postman, MongoDB, Google Cloud Platform, Azure, logic analyzers, RF chambers, Helmholtz coils, spectra/vibration analyzers, power analyzers, and other electronic test equipment.

Benefits

• Hybrid student role in Haifa (~100 hours/month, 2 days in office + remote).

• Hands-on exposure to industrial IoT hardware and real validation infrastructure.

• Mentorship from experienced validation and automation engineers.

• Meaningful ownership of automation work that ships into CI and lab practice.

• A path to grow into advanced validation, automation, and systems roles.

To apply

Please include your CV, grades transcript, and a short note on relevant coursework, lab work, signal-processing/software projects, or personal automation projects.

The company’s powerful, purpose-built platform makes it easy for businesses to create, manage, and scale an ecosystem of partnerships with the brands and communities that customers trust to make purchases, get information, and entertain themselves at home, at work, or on the go. Your role at Impact.com:

We are seeking a talented Gen AI engineer with a passion for creating and maintaining AI agents and generative features in our applications.  You will focus on creating, testing and maintaining prompts; monitoring answer quality; adding content to search indexes to facilitate retrieval augmented generation (RAG); and integrating with new APIs to enhance the agent’s capabilities.

Your work will enable our client users to work more efficiently and promote more relationships being created and becoming successful and better performing in our partnerships marketplace.

• Enhance the capabilities of the agent by integrating with additional Impact or external APIs (via function calling / actions).

• Enhance the agent’s analytics capabilities with new integrations exposing additional data sets.

• Enhance the knowledge of the agent by adding more context to its search index.

• Create tools and processes for monitoring, and then monitor the agent’s answers’ quality and correctness.

• Leverage reinforcement learning (RLHF), adapter tuning or other methods to further tune the model beyond leveraging prompts, examples, and context.

• Evaluate using new LLMs with the agent as they become available.

• Work with the squad’s full stack engineer to expose new features in the user interface, and deploy the agent or point content generation capabilities throughout our apps.

• Work closely with product managers to identify new features and enhancements, estimate level of effort, prototype, implement and deploy.

• Interface with our Google solutions team to clarify gaps in documentation, report bugs or unexpected behavior, submit feature requests, or get help when evaluating a product or feature.

• Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in AI and machine learning, and continuously explore new techniques and technologies to enhance our product offerings.

What You'll Have:

• Technical Expertise:

• Understanding of LLM/GPT concepts

• Proficiency in prompt engineering.

• Proficiency with Python

• Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker) and/or sql query writing.

• Experience with machine learning frameworks/libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Apache MLlib, or Scikit-learn is a plus.

• Experience working in Google’s (GCP) environment is a plus.

• Proficiency with Javascript/Typescript or Java/Scala is a plus.

• Experience in and understanding of marketing/advertising industry is a plus.

• Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

• Team Player: Ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional team environment.

• Adaptability: Willingness to learn new skills and technologies, and to adapt to the evolving needs of the business.

• Experience: At least 1 year working in Generative AI, or extensive and demonstrable personal projects (be prepared to show in Kaggle, Github, OpenAI, etc; to demo and describe in detail, answer questions and defend critiques)

• Previous experience in a startup or fast-paced environment is a plus.

Nice to have:

Important notes: This is a fixed-term opportunity for 3 months with an option to extend. While this opportunity is remote, we are prioritizing candidates who reside in CST and EST time zones.



In one year you’ll know you were successful if…

 - You’ve led Deal Desk coverage for sales to Crypto exchanges, financial technology (“fintech”) and/or payment solutions customers and support sales goals, materially de‑risking coverage during high volume and high stress deal strategy

 - You’ve driven data‑backed analytics and pricing frameworks that have shifted approvals and pricing from intuition to objective guardrails and precedent.

 - You have been the go‑to commercialization partner for Legal, Product, Services, and Finance on non‑standard SKUs and new offerings within both SaaS and on-prem environments turning ambiguous edge cases into repeatable processes.

 - You have demonstrated clear leadership capability through mentorship, enablement, and conflict‑resolution maturity, particularly in leading team member onboarding and embodying Chainalysis leadership principles such as Coach & Empower and Strong Convictions, Loosely Held.

 - You’ve developed in-depth knowledge of Chainalysis licensing and pricing models to provide deal structuring and quoting support to our global sales teams

 - You’ve become the expert creative problem solver who finds a way to meet customers’ needs while adhering to our company’s overall strategy

 - You perform price / discount realization analysis, combined with relevant deal context, and present executive level summaries with actionable recommendations to key business approvers

 - You provide both tactical and strategic guidance to our Sales teams by coaching on contract objection-handling techniques, alternative contract options, and best practices to help close deals

 - You function as point of contact and subject matter expert / project manager for Sales on deal pricing matters and questions related to common customer requests regarding deviations from Chainalysis standard operational processes, infosec standards, and SLA/engineering positions.

 - You look for opportunities to create meaningful partnerships with the field and other stakeholders (enablement, training, QBR participation, etc.)

 - You’ve built analytics, KPIs and business processes relevant to pricing, and use performance insights to drive improvements and share key learnings with executive-level leadership

 - You partner with regional leadership to prioritize and organize projects and deals for critical deadlines at customer and for month-end, quarter-end, and year-end

 - You collaborate with the Sales Enablement team to create training content for your region to ensure Sales is informed on new products, best practices and regular updates to policies, etc.

 - You create, maintain and innovate with respect to an ongoing knowledgebase of common issues arising during deal cycles.

 - You establish key plays for the Deal Desk team and ensure they are enabled to be the most creative and effective they can be.



A background like this helps:

 - Strong experience within a Deal Desk role for 5-7 years, but also including related processes such as sales operations & enablement, finance, and/or legal, with specific experience around deal structuring/quoting complex SaaS transactions for a fast-growing multinational company

 - Analytical mindset and recognized competency for in depth analysis and modeling

 - Leader in key stakeholder activities assigned from cross-functional projects or programs, including the gathering, analyzing, prioritization, and complexity categorization of business requirements

 - Solid understanding of the Quote to Order stages within the Lead to Cash lifecycle with Salesforce CRMs

 - Working knowledge with revenue recognition (GAAP, ASC 606)

 - Salesforce, Salesforce CPQ is required

 - Experience leading a team is preferred, with extensive experience in one-on-one mentoring and coaching sessions with team members of all levels.

 - Must be comfortable representing the company to customers in negotiations and resolving customer satisfaction issues

 - Advanced written, verbal, and interpersonal skills in order to effectively communicate policies and procedures to all levels of staff and management, particularly the ability to explain complex concepts clearly and concisely across all levels of the organization

 - Excellent collaboration, reinforces alignment with business partners and managers.

 - Excellent planning, time management, communication, decision making, presentation, organization, and interpersonal skills.Strong attention to detail, quantitative and communication skills

 - Ability to work in a fast paced, high pressure environment and jump in on operational troubleshooting often and as needed

 - Strong Google Suite/Microsoft Suite skills

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.



You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. You will report directly to the CEO. The role has no direct reports: you lead the program and the creator relationships, not a team.

We are looking for a hands-on professional who understands both the relationship-building and commercial sides of creator marketing.



What You'll Do

jobs.title: Field Officer
jobs.description:
Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you'll help us achieve it

We are looking for field officers to manage product rollouts as we launch our business in one of these regions in Cameroon: Yaoundé. You will also represent Wave, oversee our distribution and marketing, interact with and recruit users, and conduct interviews with individuals about their needs and concerns related to money transfer and financial services.

In this role, you'll:

• Identify and build a local agent network and guarantee the agent network is fully trained on applications, the contents of the contract before signing, rebalancing options, fraud management, etc.

• Recruit target users and onboard them on the use of Wave products

• Collaborate with Field Officers in different locations to progress the adoption of Wave products

• Ensure agent quality and compliance with legal and policy requirements.

Ensure all agents are well-branded and well-equipped. Monitor the cash and float availability at agent locations.

• Manage risk through routine visits to report emerging issues and assess agents' performance in your territory.

• Identify underperforming agents, close them, recover Wave items and equipment, and ensure that branding material is removed.

• Be the primary contact for all agency networks acquiring Wave products in your territory.

• Champion excellent customer service among distributors and agents within your territory.

Requirements

• Fluent French, with ideally a good command of one additional local language.

• Medium English Level.

• At least 2 years of relevant work experience, specifically managing an agent network in Cameroon, including a minimum of 1 year of experience managing field-based teams

• Familiar with at least one of the regions listed.

Key details

• Location: This is a field role. You will be based in Yaoundé and may travel to other field locations across the country based on business needs.

• Contract type: 6-month fixed-term contract.

• Work authorization in Cameroon is required.

• We offer generous health insurance for yourself and your dependents.

• Airtime reimbursement.

• Food allowance.

You might be a good fit if you

• Are excited about working in the field, as this is a largely field-operations role.

• Detail-oriented and seek to achieve excellence in everything you do.

• Are a clear and proactive communicator, able to independently follow through on tasks, and able to manage team priorities effectively.

• Enjoy teamwork, but also know how to work well independently.

• Are intellectually curious, creative in the way you go about tackling problems, and embrace failure as a means to spark innovation and growth.

• Communicate effectively and often, both in writing and in person, to the point of over-communication.

• Demonstrate tenacity and a willingness to go the distance to get something done.

• Are tech-savvy: comfortable navigating Excel and onboarding new tools.

Our team

• We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world.

• We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most.

• We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production.

• We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021. Our world-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa.

• We are on Y Combinator's top companies by revenue.

How to apply

Fill out the form below, and upload a resume in English and a cover letter describing your interest in Wave and the role.

We review applications frequently and recommend that you apply to the role that most closely aligns with your skills, experience and career goals.

Wave is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Summernaut Program - AI & Management Consulting (Value Engineering) Summer Intern
jobs.description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team

Talented individuals start in the Summernaut program, a summer internship program for 10 weeks, from June 1st to August 7th in our Raleigh office.

Our Value Engineers (VE) are the trusted advisors for the end-to-end customer value journey and work at the intersection of technology and business. Value Engineers partner with sales and customers to create compelling solutions and prototypes within the Celonis software to solve critical business problems.

As a team, we enjoy working in a fast-paced environment and share a sense of belonging to a community that is eager to learn and grow together. Our team culture is based on building trust, continuous development, and improvement through coaching and mentoring. You will report to a Value Engineering Orbit Program Manager based in the Raleigh office.

The Role

You’ll get the opportunity to work with real life projects within the North American market.

The Summernaut program is a unique experience designed to highlight client engagements, mentorship, and a strong team culture where we rely on each other to collaborate, develop, and achieve goals together. During your internship, you will apply your analytical and technical skills to develop foundational Value Engineering (VE) competencies. You will gain hands-on experience in working with clients, understanding their challenges, and supporting solution development—helping you build a strong foundation for a future career at Celonis.

The work you’ll do:

• Support Value Engineering teams in analyzing business challenges and identifying how Celonis can help customers optimize their processes.

• Learn and apply Celonis Process Intelligence platform by working on internal projects, assisting with customer presentations, and exploring process improvement opportunities.

• Gain hands-on experience with Celonis technology, including SQL and PQL, to build basic analyses and reports.

• Shadow customer engagements, workshops, and technical discussions to understand the Celonis approach to process mining and execution management.

• Contribute to internal knowledge-sharing, creating best practices, templates, and documentation to support the Global VE team.

• Develop core consulting skills, including problem-solving, storytelling with data, and presenting insights to stakeholders.

The qualifications you need:

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a comparable STEM-related field

• Nice to have: previous internship, project work, or academic experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a similar field

• Exposure to at least one of the following technologies: SQL, R, Microsoft Power BI, Tableau, Python, or another data analytics software/programming language

• Familiarity with AI tools and interest in AI applications to solve business problems

• Passion for technology, data, and problem-solving, with an interest in how data-driven insights impact businesses

• Strong analytical and creative thinking skills, with a curiosity for applying technology to business challenges

• Eager to collaborate with teams and build relationships in a fast-paced, innovative environment

• Enthusiastic about presenting ideas and findings, with a willingness to develop communication and storytelling skills

• Excited to learn new technologies, such as Celonis, and apply them in real-world business scenarios

• Self-motivated, proactive, and open to continuous learning and feedback

• Fluent in English, both written and verbal

• Available for full-time (40hr/week) internship during June, July and August.

• Based in Raleigh for the duration of the internship

Visa sponsorship is not offered for this role.

What Celonis can offer you:

• Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.

• Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.

• Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.

• Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.

• Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.

• Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.

• Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.

• Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.

• Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

Celonis Inclusion Statement:

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

Your Privacy:

Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools

We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.

The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.

jobs.title: Advanced Social Worker - Disabled Children's Services
jobs.description:
Liquid Personnel is recruiting Advanced Social Worker for its client's Disabled Children's Services Team at Devon.

This is an excellent opportunity for an established Social Worker with substantial post-qualification experience to take on a senior practice leadership role within a specialist children's service. Working closely with the Team Manager, you will provide professional leadership, supervision and guidance to colleagues while supporting the effective day-to-day operation of the team. You will work with children and families with complex needs, ensuring assessments, interventions and support plans are evidence-based, effective and focused on achieving positive outcomes. You will also play an important role in mentoring and developing colleagues, promoting good social work practice and constructively challenging areas where improvements are needed.

What will your responsibilities be?

• Provide professional leadership, guidance and support to Social Workers and colleagues within the team.

• Support the Team Manager with the day-to-day operation and effective delivery of the service.

• Undertake and oversee complex social work assessments involving disabled children and their families.

• Work closely with families to identify needs, strengths and appropriate support arrangements.

• Develop, implement and review effective care and support plans.

• Work collaboratively with health professionals, education services and other multi-agency partners.

• Provide professional supervision, coaching and mentoring to colleagues.

• Support the development of evidence-based and high-quality social work practice.

• Identify training and development needs and contribute to workforce improvement.

• Challenge poor practice constructively and promote continuous service improvement.

• Ensure children and families receive appropriate interventions and support.

• Promote safeguarding, equality, inclusion and positive outcomes for disabled children and young people.

Benefits:

• Accommodation/Commuter Allowance: £150 per week, subject to eligibility criteria

Qualifications & Experience:

To be successful in this role you must have,

• A recognised Social Work qualification.

• Current registration with Social Work England.

• Minimum of 3 years' post-qualification experience (PQE).

• Substantial experience working within Children's Social Care.

• Experience working with children and families with complex needs.

• Experience within a multi-agency social care environment.

• Proven experience mentoring, coaching and supporting professional colleagues.

• Evidence of substantial post-qualification training and professional development.

• Experience providing professional leadership and contributing to team development.

• Ability to identify and challenge areas of practice requiring improvement.

• Strong knowledge of safeguarding, assessment and social work practice.

Why Liquid Personnel?

• Free DBS and compliance service

• Twice weekly payroll and ‘Faster Pay’ service, getting you paid more quickly

• Access to exclusive roles that aren’t available from other agencies

• Free access to Liquid’s exclusive social work training and CPD portal

• Your own dedicated consultant with extensive social work knowledge

• Access to a wide selection of social work positions across the UK

• “Refer a Friend” bonus – get £500 for each social worker you refer who we successfully place*

• “Find your own job” bonus – get £250 for bringing your own position to us *

Liquid Personnel is an equal opportunities employer. Liquid Personnel Ltd is acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy. * Terms and conditions apply to our bonus schemes.

Reasonable Adjustments:

If you consider yourself to have a disability or require any reasonable adjustment during the recruitment process or within the workplace, please highlight this at the earliest opportunity by contacting our team. With this information, we will provide appropriate support to you throughout the process and into your work placement.

We are unable to support or accept applications from candidates who are residents within the Red or Amber list of the Code of practice for the international recruitment of health and social care personnel in England, based on the World Health Organisation (WHO) Workforce Support and Safeguard List.

jobs.location: Marlton, New Jersey; Remote, United States
jobs.description:
At JetBrains, code is our passion. Since we started in 2000, we have strived to make the most effective developer tools on earth so developers can learn fast and make amazing things happen – with code. Customer Success Engineers (CSE) are technical points of contact for JetBrains customers. They work with the JetBrains product teams and customers to ensure that the products meet the needs of our enterprise users, helping our products retain their position as the best on the market.

Many of our customers begin with a set of strategic projects that grow into sizable partnerships. We are looking for Customer Success Engineers to build great technical relationships with our customers and grow JetBrains' business. We care deeply about our customers' success and the quality of our work. In addition to having a passion for working with others, the ideal candidate will be able to deepen our relationships with customers and serve as a technical advisor to them.

In this role, you will:

• Work closely with JetBrains Account Executives.

• Help customers adopt JetBrains products and services to achieve desired business outcomes. This responsibility may include whiteboarding and assisting with the development of architecture or providing support for overcoming technical and cultural barriers to adoption.

• Manage the technical relationships for a portfolio of accounts, and partner with other members of the account team to define and implement the account strategies.

• Be the customers’ advocate within JetBrains, representing them to the Support and Product Engineering teams, as well as other groups.

• Recommend product enhancements based on your customer experiences and the feedback you receive.

• Help product teams present and evaluate new product ideas to the customers in your portfolio.

• Act as a trusted technical advisor to customers, staying up to date on the ever-evolving state of technology both within JetBrains and in the field at large.

• Work with Sales to facilitate account expansions by developing short-term and long-term account plans that meet customer needs.

We will be happy to have you on our team if you have:

• Proven experience in technical consulting, technical customer success, or other customer-facing technical roles.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills

• Hands-on knowledge of AI/LLMs in the field of software development.

• A passion for continually improving the customer experience.

• Exceptional presentation skills for demonstrating JetBrains products to customers.

• The ability to quickly identify and address technical and business challenges related to software development tooling.

• The ability to convey technical concepts to customers of all technical backgrounds.

• Comfort in a fast-paced and dynamic working environment.

• Experience working in or with large software development teams.

• A collaborative and team-focused mentality, with a willingness to take initiative.

• Experience in software development, QA, IT, DevOps, ML, or any related IT field – the wider the variety of fields, the better.

• Self-direction and resourcefulness.

• The ability to travel approximately 25% of the time.

jobs.title: Senior Media Buyer (Meta & TikTok) — DTC
jobs.description:
Location: Remote, United States
Commitment: Full-time, 9 AM–5 PM EST
Engagement: Senior independent contractor
Compensation: Fee negotiated based on experience and engagement model
Works directly with: CEO



About Our Client

Our client is a growing US-based direct-to-consumer brand in the travel and commuter accessories space, with a revenue run rate exceeding $10M. The company sells backpacks, carry-on gear and accessories through Shopify and TikTok Shop.

The company is building its internal marketing function, with paid acquisition as one of its key growth pillars. Its primary paid channels are Meta and TikTok.



The Role

You will own hands-on paid acquisition across Meta and TikTok. This is an operator role: you personally manage advertising accounts, make budget and optimization decisions, and turn creative performance data into clear direction for the Creative Strategy Lead.

This is not a people-management position. You are expected to remain directly involved in campaign execution, optimization and performance analysis.

You will work closely with Creative Strategy. They lead concepts, briefs and the cross-channel creative roadmap. You own account structure, delivery, asset-level analysis and testing execution. Together, you review results and decide what to iterate, scale or stop.



Responsibilities

Paid Media Strategy and Account Ownership

 - Develop and execute DTC acquisition strategy, campaign architecture and channel allocation across Meta and TikTok.

 - Independently make and own campaign and optimization decisions within approved budgets.

Creative Performance Analysis and Testing

 - Analyze performance at the individual creative level: hooks, formats, messages, concepts, fatigue, delivery patterns and conversion outcomes.

 - Design and execute rigorous creative tests: isolate variables, document hypotheses and results, identify scalable winners.

 - Provide specific, evidence-based recommendations to Creative Strategy.

Budget Management and Profitable Scaling

 - Allocate and scale spend with discipline against CAC, ROAS, MER, new-customer acquisition and contribution margin.

 - Understand how creative quality affects account efficiency and scaling capacity.

Campaign Execution, Diagnosis and Recovery

 - Launch and optimize campaigns, bidding, automation, pacing and experiments.

 - Diagnose underperformance, including creative fatigue, offer or landing-page issues, tracking limitations and delivery shifts.

 - Develop and execute recovery plans, measure outcomes and apply learnings to future campaigns.

Platform Expertise

 - Stay current on meaningful changes in Meta and TikTok advertising systems, including Meta Andromeda and evolving automated campaign and creative-delivery capabilities.

 - Evaluate the operational impact of these changes, test useful adaptations and explore additional channels when performance data supports expansion.



Requirements

 - Personally managed at least $500K per month in DTC/e-commerce paid media spend, directly making budget allocation and optimization decisions. $1M+ per month under direct control is preferred.

 - Proven expertise in creative-performance analysis and testing at scale, including asset-level patterns, creative fatigue, diversification, test design and commercial impact.

 - Hands-on Meta and TikTok expertise, including current delivery, attribution, bidding and automation systems.

 - Practical understanding of Meta Andromeda and the ability to adapt campaign structure, creative testing and optimization strategies to platform changes.

 - Demonstrated ability to maintain acceptable acquisition efficiency while scaling, with strong command of CAC, ROAS, MER and contribution margin.

 - Documented examples of performance decline, root-cause diagnosis and recovery, including creative-driven interventions.

 - Experience translating paid-media findings into actionable creative recommendations while collaborating with a separate creative-strategy owner.

 - Independent DTC commercial judgment and repeatable campaign and testing systems.

 - Based in the United States.



How Success Is Measured

 - Testing quality and throughput: Clear hypotheses, meaningful variations, documented outcomes and evidence-based decisions to iterate, scale or stop.

 - Creative contribution: Identifying winners, detecting fatigue, improving the creative mix and connecting asset-level learning to business results.

 - Budget ownership and economics: Disciplined allocation and scaling evaluated through CAC, MER, ROAS and contribution margin in context.

 - Performance recovery: Timely root-cause diagnosis, decisive corrective action and measurable results.

 - Platform mastery: Informed adoption or rejection of meaningful Meta and TikTok changes.



Why This Role

 - Own meaningful DTC media investment across Meta and TikTok, with real responsibility for performance decisions at scale.

 - Work directly with the CEO and Creative Strategy, turning creative testing and platform insights into commercially effective acquisition.

 - Contribute to the development of a growing consumer brand's marketing function.

 - Explore new acquisition channels when the evidence supports expansion.



Hiring Process

 1. Initial screening with OnHires

 2. Interview with the CEO

 3. Practical assessment

 4. Assessment review with the CEO

jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Lisbon, Portugal

About the Role:

Do you thrive in a high performance role, solving complex problems and interacting with people? Are you passionate about helping customers and are a standout colleague? Cloudflare is seeking a Technical Support Engineer to join our team PAYGO. You will work with our customers on a variety of technical support issues as well as the Technical Operations team that is responsible for running our global distributed network. This is a position where you will learn the inner workings of Cloudflare's technology and gain a deeper understanding of internet technologies. You will provide support on our Application Performance and Developer Platform products.

Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience:

• You thrive in a high performing team environment

• You take ownership and make sure you solve the customers issues.

• You drive the case to the finish line.

• You are familiar with Developer Platform products

• You have previous experience working as part of a team in a customer-facing role

• You have experience solving HTTP, DNS, SSL, Cache and other networking-related problems

• You understand how the Internet works

• You have a solid grasp of problem-solving with command line tools (curl/dig/traceroute/tcpdump)

• You have experience working in a support role.

• You are comfortable communicating through various support channels and always put the customer first (Emails, Live Chats, Phone calls and virtual meetings)

• You are a motivated self-starter and always looking to expand your existing skill set

Bonus Points

• You are fluent in German, Japanese, French, Spanish, Portuguese or Mandarin

• You are familiar with Cloudflare and have a site actively using our platform

• You are familiar with Nginx, Apache, IIS or any other web servers

• You are committed to gaining a deeper understanding of the following technologies: DNS / CDN - Cache / SSL / Cloudflare Workers

• You have worked with PostgreSQL, MySQL, MS SQL or other database servers

• You have experience with Cloudflare Workers and/or JavaScript

• You have experience with Video encoding and streaming solutions

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

• For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary of €28,000-39,000.

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

jobs.title: Senior Partner Analyst
jobs.description:
About Rocket Travel by Agoda

Rocket Travel by Agoda is a travel technology company founded in 2012 under our flagship consumer facing product, rocketmiles.com. Since then, we have evolved to partner with some of the largest consumer travel brands in the world creating white-label solutions that allow customers to earn and redeem miles and points for booking hotels, rental cars, flights and activities. Our global partnerships range from world-class airlines to international banks to large-scale shopping platforms.  We help our partners develop successful go-to-market strategies through marketing expertise and data to support their overall growth.

We attract customers from every corner of the globe with a seamless user experience that's built in-house from ideation to finished product: our team includes front- and back-end developers, customer service, data analysts, designers, marketers, accountants, partnership sales, and managers.

Rocket Travel by Agoda is dedicated to creating a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where everyone has the opportunity to reach new heights in their career, and expand their knowledge working alongside talented, dedicated colleagues. We encourage all applicants with a touch of wanderlust to apply to our team, as we work toward helping our travelers reach the vacation of their dreams.

As a Partner Manager at Rocket Travel, you will:

• Support the growth and performance of an Enterprise partnership in the Americas, combining strong relationship management with rigorous data analysis and commercial strategy.

• Analyze complex partner, customer, product, and financial data to identify trends, diagnose performance opportunities, and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations.

• Turn data into a compelling story. Build partner-facing narratives that connect performance insights to specific actions, opportunities, and strategic priorities.

• Develop executive-level business reviews and partner presentations that simplify complex information, highlight the “so what,” and drive alignment around decisions and next steps.

• Identify the drivers behind partner performance, going beyond topline results to understand customer behavior, conversion, engagement, product performance, and commercial impact.

• Develop recommendations for campaigns, placements, and product improvements based on performance data, customer behavior, and experimentation.

• Proactively benchmark the competitive landscape to understand how partner products are positioned and identify new features, experiences, or opportunities for evaluation.

• Manage the partner marketing calendar and ensure customer service and other stakeholders are prepared for promotions and campaigns.

• Partner with Finance on billing reconciliation and use commercial and financial analysis to ensure the accuracy and health of partner economics.

• Be scrappy. We’re a small team and often wear many hats. Problems will not always arrive neatly defined. You will be expected to structure ambiguous questions, determine what the data is telling you, and turn those insights into action.

About you:

• You have a bachelor’s degree in business, data analytics, or a related quantitative or business field.

• You have 5+ years’ experience in advanced Excel, SQL and/or BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI.

• You are a strategic, analytical thinker who is comfortable working with large and complex datasets and turning them into simple, compelling business narratives.

• You understand how to summarize complex concepts and craft win-win strategies with partners.

• You are comfortable working with tools such as Excel and business intelligence/visualization platforms and can independently interrogate data rather than relying solely on pre-built reporting.

• You have impeccable attention to detail, taking end to end ownership and quality control in all projects.

• You are commercially minded and understand how customer behavior, product experience, marketing performance, and partner economics connect to overall business results.

• You are a strong communicator who can challenge, influence, and build credibility with senior internal and external stakeholders through evidence-based recommendations

• You balance analytical rigor with strong relationship management. You understand that the goal is not merely to report the data, but to use it to influence partner decisions and drive measurable growth

• You work well cross-functionally and are able to communicate effectively with others of varying backgrounds and areas of expertise.

Rocket Travel by Agoda is dedicated to creating a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where everyone has the opportunity to reach new heights in their career. We encourage all applicants looking to expand their knowledge working alongside talented, dedicated colleagues to apply to our team.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
The Business Analyst (BA) is a key link between business stakeholders and technical teams within Global IT. The role is responsible for understanding business needs, gathering and documenting requirements, analyzing processes, and translating those requirements into functional solutions. Business Analysts support the full solution lifecycle, from requirements gathering and workshops through testing (UAT/SIT), deployment, and post-implementation support, ensuring that delivered solutions meet business expectations and organizational objectives.

The team supports a broad portfolio of ERP, EPM, reporting, and transformation initiatives, including Oracle EBS, cloud transformation, Power BI, finance-related projects, and emerging technology initiatives. The team is expanding due to resource movements to other strategic projects, creating a need for additional Business Analysts to support delivery priorities and maintain project momentum.

What Success Looks Like

Business Analysts are expected to:

• Gather, analyze, and validate business requirements from a variety of stakeholders.
• Facilitate workshops and discussions to identify solutions and improvements.
• Create functional specifications, user stories, workflows, and acceptance criteria.
• Act as the bridge between technical teams and business users throughout project delivery.
• Support testing activities and ensure solutions are delivered according to business needs.
• Build strong relationships with stakeholders and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.

Please submit English CV for the application.

What We Are Looking For:

While ERP, SAP, Oracle, EPM, or finance process experience can be beneficial, the hiring managers are primarily looking for candidates with outstanding soft skills, strong communication abilities, curiosity, and a proactive mindset. They have strong technical expertise within the team and are confident in developing technical knowledge internally when the right attitude and potential are present.

The ideal candidate will demonstrate:

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
• An inquisitive mindset and the ability to ask the right questions.
• A self-driven approach with a desire to learn and develop new skills.
• Confidence working with both business and technical stakeholders.
• Ownership of requirements throughout the end-to-end project lifecycle.
• Business level English skill

Learning & Development Opportunities

The team places a strong focus on development and knowledge sharing. New hires will receive support from experienced Business Analysts, Solution Engineers, and subject matter experts. There are opportunities to gain exposure to Oracle technologies, cloud solutions, ERP modernization programs, and future-focused initiatives, including AI-related projects. Internal training resources and certification paths are available to help employees build both functional and technical expertise.

Working Environment

The role is based in Spain and offers significant flexibility. While candidates can eventually work remotely, new joiners, especially those with less experience as an IT Business Analyst, are expected to spend time on-site during their first few months to accelerate learning, collaboration, and knowledge transfer. Experienced candidates may be given greater flexibility from the outset.

Why Join This Team?

This is an excellent opportunity for Business Analysts who enjoy working in a global environment, partnering with stakeholders across functions, and contributing to large-scale transformation initiatives. The team values fresh perspectives, continuous learning, strong communication, and collaboration, making it an attractive environment for professionals looking to develop their BA career while gaining exposure to enterprise-level technologies and business processes.

Why SGS?

• Global and very stable company, world leader in the TIC (Testing, Inspection and Certification) industry.
• SGS university and Campus for continuos learning options.
• Multinational environment where you will work with colleagues from multiple continents.
• Benefits platform.

Join Us: At SGS we believe in innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.  We offer a supportive and inclusive work environment that encourages professional growth and personal development.

jobs.title: Cloud Security Engineer
jobs.description:
About Sand

Sand Technologies is a global Physical AI company using data and AI to make critical industries work better. We partner with governments, cities and enterprises to improve how essential systems operate across healthcare, water, energy, telecommunications and infrastructure.

Our work delivers proven real-world impact. We have built AI systems that help manage London’s water supply, supported telecom network planning across hundreds of cities, and developed digital healthcare platforms serving tens of millions of people across Africa. From intelligent command centers to AI-powered infrastructure platforms, we help organizations sense, analyze and act in complex environments.

Our people are ambitious, curious and relentlessly practical. Our teams work alongside clients in the field, solving hard problems and deploying solutions that last. With colleagues across Africa, Europe, the UK and the US, we operate across the full stack - from research and engineering to deployment and capability building.

Our mission is simple: to harness AI to solve humanity’s most pressing challenges.

About the role

Sand Technologies is standing up its security engineering capability, and you'll be engineer #1, working directly with the Director of Cyber Security. We are looking for a candidate with subject matter expertise in implementation and management of cloud security across AWS, Azure, and GCP.

This is a hands-on role, with an opportunity to have a deep impact on audits, executive metrics, and the security of a live AI product. Most junior security roles are ticket queues. This one is a program build: you'll touch three clouds, a modern Microsoft security stack, audit evidence for four frameworks, and the security posture of a shipping AI product — with direct mentorship from a security director and visible impact into executive reporting from your first quarter.

What you’ll do

• Serve as second responder on security incidents across Sand: fraud, phishing, endpoint, identity, shadow IT, and cloud, running evidence collection, triage, containment coordination, and lessons learned

• Operate and tune our security stack: Microsoft Defender for Cloud/Endpoint, Intune, Sentinel, and vulnerability scanning across a multi-account AWS organization, GCP, and Azure

• Build and maintain the vulnerability data pipeline: raw exports from cloud-native tools, deduplication by unique CVE, finding-age and SLA computation, and the feeds behind our security metrics

• Run tooling validations — side-by-side parity testing when we transition platforms, with evidence that stands up to audit

• Partner with infrastructure/DevOps teams on remediation: container base-image hygiene, registry lifecycle policies, exposure management, and verifying closure on the next scan

• Track remediation SLAs, support exception and risk-acceptance workflows, and keep runbooks and process documentation current

• Build detection in Microsoft Sentinel: onboarding and tuning log sources across email, identity, endpoint, SaaS, and cloud

• Embed security gates in CI/CD pipelines and stand up telemetry for new environments

• Contribute evidence to Cyber Essentials, ISO 27001, SOC 2, and ISO/IEC 42001 readiness workstreams

• In your first 90 days you will:

• Own the weekly vulnerability data pipeline end-to-end (exports → dedup → SLA math → metrics feed)

• Complete one tooling parity validation with documented, audit-ready evidence

• Ship one structural remediation with the infrastructure team (e.g., registry lifecycle policies) and verify closure by scan

• Stand up telemetry on one new cloud environment from zero

• Step into the second-responder seat: run one incident or tabletop end to end, with documented lessons fed back into the runbooks

Who you are

• grounded by at least 5-7 years of professional cloud/DevOps experience and at least 2–4 years in security engineering, cloud/DevOps with a security focus, or security operations

• Working proficiency in at least one major cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and hunger to learn the other two

• Scripting for automation — Python preferred; comfort with REST APIs and structured data (JSON/CSV); KQL or SQL a plus

• Understanding of vulnerability management fundamentals (CVE/CVSS, scanning vs. remediation, SLA-driven programs) and a calm, methodical approach to incident response

• Clear writing and the ability to explain a finding to an engineer and its risk to an executive

• Self-direction — you'll have a director's guidance, not a script

Preferred experience

• Hands-on time with Microsoft Defender / Sentinel, or Qualys

• Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code exposure

• Container security (ECR/AKS image scanning, lifecycle policies)

• Cyber Essentials, ISO 27001, SOC 2, or ISO/IEC 42001 evidence experience

• Relevant certifications: SC-200, AZ-500, Security+ (or equivalent demonstrated skill)

How we work

Due to the highly collaborative and internationally distributed nature of our work, successful candidates must be comfortable operating in small teams while contributing to larger, globally coordinated efforts. A strong sense of ownership, self-motivation and discipline in maintaining clear and consistent communication through virtual collaboration tools and video conferencing is essential.

jobs.title: Gestor de Soluções de Dívida
jobs.description:
Gestor de Soluções de Dívida da Banca de Investimento. Gerir operações de dívida ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida da transacção, assegurando que as necessidades dos clientes são satisfeitas e que os indicadores-chave de desempenho (KPI) financeiros individuais são alcançados.

Funções Essenciais

Cumprir as políticas, sistemas, processos e procedimentos aplicáveis, garantindo a conformidade com todos os requisitos relevantes em matéria de risco, regulamentação e controlo empresarial do área de Banca Corporativa e de Investimento (“CIB”).

Orientar os membros da equipa, promovendo uma melhor compreensão e aplicação das normas, procedimentos e produtos.

Contribuir para a concretização da cultura pretendida, através de uma liderança adequada da equipa, inspirando e assegurando o desenvolvimento das pessoas em linha com as necessidades em evolução do mercado, dos clientes e do sector.

Desenvolver, manter e expandir uma rede de partes interessadas externas relevantes, mantendo-se a par dos desenvolvimentos à medida que a base de clientes evolui, de forma a contribuir para o acesso direccionado a oportunidades de mercado para a carteira de clientes atribuída.

Implementar e monitorizar os requisitos de dados necessários para acompanhar tendências, com o objetivo de expandir o pipeline da Banca de Investimento e posicionar o CIB como o banco de referência para o crédito.

Em colaboração com a equipa de Banca Corporativa, construir e gerir relações com os clientes e liderar os compromissos com os mesmos, prestando aconselhamento especializado, apresentando perspectivas relevantes e propondo as melhores soluções de financiamento nos sectores da Energia e das Infraestruturas, com vista à captação de novos negócios.

Gerir a concretização dos objectivos e a implementação de soluções de financiamento nas áreas da Energia e das Infraestruturas, prestando orientação no local de trabalho e liderando e gerindo eficazmente a equipa, através da disponibilização de feedback e da promoção do desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional, com o objetivo de reforçar as competências da equipa.

Avaliar, monitorizar e elaborar relatórios sobre o desempenho financeiro das transacções atribuídas, de forma a apoiar um controlo financeiro eficaz. Contribuir para a elaboração de relatórios regulares, nomeadamente semanais e mensais, bem como relatórios pontuais, de modo a facilitar a tomada de decisões e a definição de prioridades.

Monitorizar o fluxo de transacções e os indicadores de risco de uma carteira de transacções atribuída, com vista à gestão de empréstimos em incumprimento, à limitação de violações de risco e à garantia de que as alterações no risco e na exposição são adequadamente geridas, tendo em consideração as tendências macroeconómicas.

Assumir a responsabilidade e liderar a contrução de modelos financeiros, bem como testar a sua fiabilidade e validade, para estruturar eficazmente as Soluções de Dívida nos sectores da Energia e das Infraestruturas. Esta responsabilidade inclui a finalização da documentação de apoio, nomeadamente circulares, memorandos de oferta, cartas de compromisso, termos de referência e suplementos de preços, garantindo que todas as Soluções de Dívida estão alinhadas com as necessidades dos clientes e com as condições comerciais, de risco e regulamentares do CIB.

jobs.title: Técnico de Rede e Infraestrutura
jobs.description:
Prestar serviços abrangentes de apoio técnico em infraestruturas de rede para as tecnologias empresariais, incluindo a infraestrutura de rede, de modo a garantir um ambiente de TI fiável e seguro. Melhorar e aperfeiçoar continuamente as soluções de conectvidade existente, de modo a garantir que sejam robustas, eficientes e que cumpram os mais elevados padrões.

Funções Essenciais

Diagnosticar e resolver problemas técnicos relacionados com componentes de infraestrutura de rede, conectiviidade com servidores, redes, sistemas de armazenamento e plataformas de virtualização. Tratar incidentes, realizar análises das causas profundas e implementar medidas corretivas sob asupervisão de especialistas seniores na área.

Desempenhar tarefas abrangentes de administração de rede, incluindo a instalação, configuração e manutenção de switches, routers, sistemas operativos de servidores, bases de dados e outro software de infraestrutura.

As responsabilidades incluem atualizações de software e hardware, patches e correções, garantindo uma segurança robusta do sistema e otimizando o desempenho para obter a máxima eficiência.

Monitorizar o desempenho da infraestrutura de rede e identificar oportunidades de otimização. Implementar ferramentas de monitorização, analisar métricas de desempenho e auxiliar na implementação de melhorias para aumentar a fiabilidade e a eficiência da rede.

Assegurar que os componentes da infraestrutura de rede cumprem as políticas e normas de segurança. Implementar proativamente medidas de segurança, realizar auditorias de segurança exaustivas e participar em avaliações abrangentes de vulnerabilidades para mitigar eficazmente os riscos e reforçar a segurança geral da rede.

Prestar serviços técnicos especializados para apoiar projetos de conectividade através da implementação ativa de soluções de infraestrutura de rede data Center e filiais. As responsabilidades incluem a implementação de novo hardware e upgrade de IOS, o teste rigoroso das configurações e a prestação de orientação técnica especializada durante as fases de planeamento e execução dos projetos.

Contribuir para a documentação meticulosa das configurações da infraestrutura de rede, procedimentos e passos de resolução de problemas, de modo a garantir clareza e continuidade nas operações técnicas.

Colaborar eficazmente com as equipas de TI e stakeholders, incluindo equipa de suporte aplicacional, administradores de sistemas e programadores de aplicações, para resolver problemas complexos e garantir a integração perfeita dos componentes da infraestrutura.

Interagir de forma decisiva com os utilizadores finais e as partes interessadas internas para prestar assistência técnica e resolver problemas de forma rápida e eficaz, enfatizando a comunicação proativa para antecipar necessidades e prevenir potenciais problemas.

Resolver incidentes e problemas rapidamente, encaminhá-los para o nível seguinte de suporte quando necessário e coordenar a prestação de suporte para garantir que a restauração do serviço cumpra os acordos de nível de serviço. Enfatizar a resolução proativa de problemas para antecipar e abordar potenciais problemas antes que se agravem.

Realizar exercícios de recuperação de desastres, de acordo com as orientações do regime de Gestão da Continuidade de Negócios (BCM), com o apoio de especialistas técnicos.

Manter uma vantagem competitiva, manter-se a par das tendências tecnológicas do setor, das melhorias e dos desenvolvimentos futuros em infraestruturas, tais como a Infraestrutura de Próxima Geração (NGI).

Manter e atualizar continuamente os conhecimentos sobre o domínio técnico relevante das TI, incluindo tecnologias emergentes como a Inteligência Artificial (IA), a Aprendizagem Automática (ML) e a Blockchain, bem como tendências de infraestrutura como a Computação em Nuvem e a Computação de Periferia, etc.
