jobs.title: Creative Strategy Lead (Remote, US)
jobs.description:
Hiring Partner: OnHires, on behalf of our client
Employment: Full-time · Remote · United States
Schedule: Monday–Friday, 9-to-5
Compensation: 100,000-120,000 per year



About Our Client

Our client is a growing US-based direct-to-consumer brand specializing in bags, backpacks, travel accessories, and everyday carry products.

As the company expands its product portfolio and builds out its in-house marketing capabilities, it is looking for a Creative Strategy Lead to take ownership of performance creative strategy and establish a structured, insight-driven creative testing process.

This is a newly created role reporting directly to the CEO, with the opportunity to shape how the brand develops, tests, and improves its advertising creative.



The Role

We are looking for a hands-on Creative Strategy Lead who combines strong consumer understanding, original creative thinking, direct-response storytelling, and performance analysis.

You will own the creative process from customer research and concept development through scripting, briefing, creative direction, testing, and iteration.

Your primary focus will be paid advertising creative, particularly across Meta, TikTok, and other relevant acquisition channels, while collaborating with the teams responsible for organic social and creator partnerships.

This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports. You will personally develop creative concepts, hooks, scripts, and briefs while working with creators, editors, and designers who produce the final assets.

You will collaborate closely with Paid Media, Social Media, and Creator Partnerships specialists, each of whom retains ownership of their respective functions.



Key Responsibilities

Creative Research & Concept Development

 - Research customer motivations, purchasing behavior, pain points, objections, product use cases, and competitor positioning.

 - Turn consumer insights into original advertising concepts, messaging angles, hooks, scripts, and visual directions.

 - Develop creative variations tailored to different audiences, platforms, and stages of the customer journey.

 - Identify opportunities to communicate product benefits through compelling direct-response storytelling.

Performance Analysis & Creative Testing

 - Own and continuously improve the creative testing roadmap, with paid performance as the primary focus.

 - Develop clear testing hypotheses, prioritize creative experiments, and document results and learnings.

 - Analyze creative-level performance alongside Paid Media specialists, using metrics such as hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CVR, and CAC where relevant.

 - Translate performance insights into stronger concepts, messaging, scripts, and creative iterations.

 - Connect creative decisions to customer acquisition, conversion, and commercial outcomes.

Creative Briefing & Production Direction

 - Personally write creative briefs, advertising scripts, hooks, and production guidelines.

 - Translate creative concepts and testing hypotheses into clear, actionable instructions for creators, editors, and designers.

 - Direct the creative development process from initial concept through final asset review.

 - Review completed assets for messaging accuracy, creative quality, product representation, and alignment with testing objectives.

 - Provide specific, actionable feedback to improve creative execution.

Creative Systems & Collaboration

 - Establish repeatable workflows connecting consumer research, creative development, production, testing, and iteration.

 - Maintain clear creative priorities and an organized testing roadmap.

 - Collaborate with Paid Media, Social Media, and Creator Partnerships teams to align creative strategy with channel objectives.

 - Improve creative quality, production efficiency, and the consistency of performance-driven decision-making.



What We're Looking For

Required Experience & Skills

 - Proven hands-on performance creative strategy experience with DTC brands selling physical consumer products, including ownership of creative concepts, testing, and performance-driven iteration.

 - Recent experience developing paid advertising creative for e-commerce or direct-to-consumer products.

 - A portfolio demonstrating personally developed creative concepts, hooks, scripts, and briefs, ideally supported by testing insights and measurable commercial outcomes.

 - Strong consumer research skills and the ability to translate customer insights into compelling advertising concepts.

 - Excellent direct-response copywriting, storytelling, and creative judgment.

 - Demonstrated experience developing and executing structured creative testing programs.

 - Ability to interpret creative performance data and use findings to guide subsequent creative decisions.

 - Experience briefing and directing UGC creators, video editors, designers, and other creative production partners.

 - Ability to take ownership of creative strategy while remaining actively involved in hands-on execution.

 - Strong collaboration and communication skills, including professional English proficiency.

Nice to Have

 - Experience working in-house with a physical consumer-product DTC brand.

 - Background in lifestyle, fashion, accessories, travel products, outdoor gear, or related consumer categories.

 - A track record of sustained ownership, long-term contributions, and measurable creative improvements within a brand or client account.

We value demonstrated expertise, the quality of your work, and your ability to drive meaningful creative improvements over job titles alone.



What Success Looks Like

 - A consistent pipeline of original, differentiated advertising concepts grounded in customer research.

 - A structured and prioritized creative testing roadmap with documented hypotheses, results, and learnings.

 - High-quality, production-ready scripts and briefs that enable efficient creative execution.

 - Clear, actionable creative direction and feedback for production partners.

 - Continuous, evidence-based improvements in creative performance.

 - Strong collaboration between creative strategy, paid media, and creator teams.

 - Creative decisions that contribute to customer acquisition efficiency, conversion, and business growth.



Why Join

 - Own the creative strategy function: Take responsibility for building and improving the brand's performance creative process.

 - Direct access to the CEO: Have a voice in creative priorities and work closely with the person setting the company's direction.

 - Make a measurable impact: Connect your ideas and creative testing decisions to real commercial results.

 - Stay hands-on: Focus on creative thinking, research, scripts, testing, and execution rather than people management.

 - Help shape a growing DTC brand: Work with an expanding portfolio of products designed for travel, work, and everyday life.

 - Help build the in-house marketing function: Join a growing team and shape how creative strategy operates as the brand scales.



Hiring Process

 1. Introductory interview with an OnHires recruiter.

 2. Interview with the CEO.

 3. Practical case assignment.

 4. Follow-up discussion of the assignment.

jobs.title: Senior Accountant (w/m/d) - AI-native Steuerkanzlei
jobs.description:
DEINE ROLLE

Als Senior Accountant bei Skalar verantwortest du die Buchhaltung und Abschlüsse unserer Mandanten: schnell wachsende und mittelständische Unternehmen. Die Routine übernehmen unsere Agenten. Du prüfst, was sie liefern, und löst Sonderfälle sauber. Du baust Prozesse auf, triffst fachliche Entscheidungen, löst Probleme von Mandanten systematisch und entwickelst mit unseren Engineers die Lösung, die danach für alle Mandate läuft.

Du arbeitest fachlich direkt mit unseren Steuerberater:innen, Tax-Operations-Kolleg:innen und Softwareentwickler:innen zusammen. Was du im Alltag lernst und gestaltest, fließt direkt in unsere Prozesse zurück und trägt mit unseren Agenten wesentlich zum Erfolg der Firma bei. Du führst kein Team, du trainierst Agenten: Jede Prüfregel, die du definierst, läuft über alle Mandate. Dein Hebel ist das System, nicht die Teamgröße.




DEINE AUFGABEN




LAUFENDE BUCHHALTUNG & ABSCHLÜSSE

 - Du verantwortest Qualität und Abschlussreife eines Mandantenportfolios: FiBu, HGB-Abschlüsse, USt-Meldungen. Der Agent bucht, du entscheidest fachlich die Grenzfälle.

 - Monats- und Jahresabschlüsse nach HGB: Abgrenzungen, Rückstellungen, Anlagevermögen, Abstimmungen. Du prüfst, entscheidest und bringst sie bis zur Abschlussreife für unsere Steuerberater.

 - Umsatzsteuer: UStVA und ZM validieren, Sonderfälle wie Reverse Charge, OSS und Drittland entscheiden und als Regel festhalten.


PROZESSE, DATEN & AUTOMATISIERUNG

 - Validierung automatisierter Buchungen und Meldungen: Du definierst Prüfregeln, misst Fehlerquoten und verbesserst Regeln und Prompts laufend.

 - Du findest, wo Zeit verloren geht, und baust mit unseren Engineers die Automatisierung.


TEAM & MANDANTEN

 - Vertretung unserer Leads für Jahresabschluss und Finanzbuchhaltung, inklusive Freigaben

 - Du verantwortest die Mandantenbeziehung zu Buchhaltungs- und Abschlussthemen, vorbereitet und unterstützt durch KI

 - Steuerliche Fragen erkennst du früh und gibst sie buchhalterisch aufgearbeitet an unsere Steuerberater: Sachverhalt, Zahlen, deine Einschätzung
   
   


DAS BRINGST DU MIT

 - 6–10 Jahre Erfahrung in der Buchhaltung, davon mindestens 3 Jahre mit Verantwortung für die Buchhaltung in einem Start-up oder Scale-up, idealerweise in mehr als einem Unternehmen

 - Sicherheit in Monats- und Quartalsabschlüssen sowie in der Jahresabschlussvorbereitung nach HGB

 - Sehr gute Steuerkenntnisse, vor allem in Umsatzsteuer (inkl. internationaler Sachverhalte), mit Grundlagen in Ertragsteuern im Abschlusskontext und im Verständnis von Lohnbuchungen

 - Du hast Buchhaltungsprozesse selbst umgebaut: Systemwechsel, Schnittstellen (Bank, Payment, ERP) nach DATEV oder manuelle Schritte automatisiert. Du kennst DATEV und andere Buchhaltungs-Tools und weißt, wo Daten brechen.

 - KI im Alltag: Du nutzt Tools wie Claude täglich, hast Buchhaltungsvorgänge automatisiert und formulierst Anforderungen so, dass Engineers sie bauen können.

 - Die Fähigkeit, Buchhaltung für Nicht-Buchhalter:innen verständlich zu erklären

 - Ausbildung oder Studium mit Schwerpunkt Rechnungswesen oder Steuern

 - Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau und gutes Englisch (Unternehmenssprache)

 - Mindestens 3 Tage pro Woche im Münchner Office, für schnellere Abstimmung und Dynamik im Team


VON VORTEIL

 - Berufsexamen (Steuerberater:in, Bilanzbuchhalter:in IHK, Steuerfachwirt:in) ist ein Plus. Was zählt, ist dein fachliches Urteil, nicht der Titel.

 - Kanzlei- oder WP-Erfahrung, IFRS oder Konzernbilanzierung
   
   


DAS BIETEN WIR DIR

 - AI-natives Setup: Du baust den Buchhalter-Job der Zukunft. Die Agenten, die du heute trainierst, machen morgen die Routine. Du entscheidest, was sie lernen.

 - Das Tooling, das du brauchst: Was fehlt, beschaffen wir oder unsere Softwareentwickler:innen bauen es mit dir

 - Kurze Wege: Verbesserungen setzen wir schnell um, oft noch am selben Tag

 - Klarer Karrierepfad mit transparenten Kriterien und Gehaltsentwicklung

 - 28 Urlaubstage
   
   


WIR BAUEN DIE STEUERKANZLEI DER ZUKUNFT

Radikal einfach. Hochautomatisiert. 100% mandantenfokussiert.

Wir denken Steuerberatung komplett neu: einfach, schnell und transparent für Mandanten und Kanzleiteam. Wo andere Kanzleien mit manuellen Prozessen und langen Wartezeiten kämpfen, bauen wir ein digitales, proaktives, KI-gestütztes Erlebnis. Repetitive Aufgaben laufen weitgehend von selbst, und es bleibt Zeit für Beratung, Sonderfälle und smarte Lösungen.

Der Unterschied zu anderen „Digitalkanzleien“: Über die Hälfte unseres Teams sind Softwareentwickler:innen. Deine Kolleg:innen bauen die Tools, die dir im Alltag helfen, für deine Probleme und nicht von der Stange.

Wir sind ein erfahrenes Team aus Steuerberatern, Buchhaltern, Digital-Unternehmern und Softwareentwicklern mit einem Exit-Track-Record von 140 Mio. €, finanziert mit 12 Mio. € von führenden Investoren. Mit dir gemeinsam wollen wir eine der führenden Kanzleien Deutschlands aufbauen.

jobs.title: Agent Liquidity Admin Manager
jobs.location: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo
jobs.description:
Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you'll help us achieve it

We're looking for a resourceful and proactive Agent Liquidity Admin Manager to support the effective management of liquidity operations across the country. You will help implement liquidity strategies, monitor cash availability across the agent network, and ensure that field operations run smoothly.

In this role, you'll;

Liquidity Management and Operations

• Monitor liquidity levels nationwide, and identify potential shortages or imbalances.

• Support Regional Liquidity managers in their daily operations

• Use data to drive decision-making in the Liquidity department.

• Interact with the product team for areas of improvements in working procedures/tools

• Detailed oriented with a key mastering of data management.

• Support the implementation of liquidity strategies and operational plans to meet team objectives and key results (OKRs).

• Identify priority areas and develop practical solutions to address liquidity challenges across the agent network.

• Conduct field research and investigations to understand operational challenges and improve liquidity management.

• Help ensure that liquidity-related activities are completed efficiently and that operational issues are addressed promptly.

• Record documents and classify the relevant information to support our daily operations.

Team Management and Development

• Lead a Liquidity Admin officer and support a team of field liquidity staff, including, Regional Liquidity Managers, Premium Cash Officers and assistants

• Serve as the main control tower for liquidity Operations

• Coordinate daily activities, provide operational guidance, and ensure that team members meet their objectives.

• Work with People Operations to recruit and onboard team members, providing the necessary training materials and guidance on operational best practices.

• Monitor team performance, identify development needs, and provide appropriate support.

• Promote clear and timely communication within the team and across relevant departments.

Risk Management and Reporting

• Monitor daily team activities to identify potential misconduct, theft, or operational risks, and escalate concerns promptly.

• Prepare regular weekly and monthly reports on team performance, activities trend, liquidity operations, and key challenges.

• Use spreadsheets, charts, and other reporting tools to analyze performance and support data-driven decisions.

• Document processes and develop materials that support consistent and sustainable liquidity operations.

Stakeholder Management and Continuous Improvement

• Build and maintain effective working relationships with banking partners, Cash In Transit companies, and other relevant stakeholders.

• Identify operational bottlenecks and prioritize the issues that have the greatest impact on team performance.

• Support the development and continuous improvement of liquidity processes, tools, and documentation.

Key details

• Location: You'll work from our office in Kinshasa and may travel to field locations.

• Contract Type: Permanent.

• Our salaries are competitive and calculated using a transparent formula.

• We offer generous health insurance for yourself and your dependents.

• We support working parents - we offer generous parental leave policies (26 weeks for mothers and 4 weeks for fathers) and subsidized childcare when you return to work.

• We help you live your fullest life now- we subsidize gym memberships and fitness classes.

• Airtime reimbursement.

• Free food and a beautiful office space

Requirements

• 5 years of experience in liquidity management or a closely related operational role.

• Proven experience managing and supervising field teams, preferably in agent operations, cash management, or cash-in-transit operations.

• Strong understanding of mobile money liquidity management and the challenges of maintaining sufficient cash and electronic value across an agent network.

• A bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in Finance, Accounting, Business Management, or a related field.

• Strong Excel skills, including the ability to analyze operational data, build reports, and interpret trends.

• Strong French proficiency, with the ability to communicate clearly and effectively with field teams and stakeholders. English is an added advantage.

You might be a good fit if you

• Understand the liquidity challenges of a rapidly growing agent network and know how to maintain adequate liquidity across multiple locations.

• Have extensive experience in cash-in-transit operations and mobile money liquidity management in the field.

• Have led teams responsible for the efficient day-to-day operations of an agent network.

• Demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving skills, using data to identify trends and inform decisions.

• Are skilled at documenting processes, sharing knowledge, and developing operational best practices.

• Are adaptable, resourceful, and willing to test new approaches, learn quickly, and improve existing processes.

• Communicate proactively and consistently, both verbally and in writing.

• Approach problems from first principles and look for practical, sustainable solutions.

• Consider the needs of agents and customers when designing or improving processes.

• Demonstrate ownership, tenacity, and a willingness to follow through until problems are resolved.

• Can balance field execution, team supervision, risk management, and reporting in a fast-growing environment.

Our team

• We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world.

• We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most.

• We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production.

• We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021. Our world-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa.

• We are on Y Combinator's top companies by revenue.

How to apply

Fill out the form below, and upload a resume in English and a cover letter describing your interest in Wave and the role.

We review applications frequently and recommend that you apply to the role that most closely aligns with your skills, experience and career goals.

Wave is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT MESHY:

Headquartered in Silicon Valley, Meshy is the leading 3D generative AI company on a mission to Unleash 3D Creativity by transforming the content creation pipeline. Meshy makes it effortless for both professional artists and hobbyists to create unique 3D assets—turning text and images into stunning 3D models in just minutes. What once took weeks and cost $1,000 now takes just 2 minutes and $1.

Our world-class team of top experts in computer graphics, AI, and art includes alumni from MIT, Stanford, and Berkeley, as well as veterans from Nvidia and Microsoft. Our talent spans the globe, with team members distributed across North America, Asia, and Oceania, fostering a diverse and innovative multi-regional culture focused on solving global 3D challenges. Meshy is trusted by top developers, backed by premier venture capital firms like Sequoia and Granite Asia, and has successfully raised nearly $400 Million in funding.

Meshy is the market leader, recognized as the No.1 in popularity among 3D AI tools (according to 2024 A16Z Games) and No.1 in website traffic (according to SimilarWeb, with 10 Million monthly visits). The platform boasts over 12 Million users and has generated 100 Million models.

Founder and CEO Yuanming (Ethan) Hu earned his Ph.D. in graphics and AI from MIT, where he developed the acclaimed Taichi GPU programming language (27K stars on GitHub, used by 300+ institutes). His work is highly influential, including an honorable mention for the SIGGRAPH 2022 Outstanding Doctoral Dissertation Award and over 2,700 research citations.


ABOUT THE ROLE:

We are looking for a creative, strategic, and highly organized Social Media Manager to grow and strengthen our presence across social platforms.

In this role, you will help shape how our brand shows up online, create engaging content, manage day-to-day publishing, and build meaningful relationships with our audience. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to translate company updates, product stories, industry trends, and community moments into relevant social content.

The ideal candidate combines strong editorial judgment, platform fluency, creative instincts, and a practical understanding of how social media supports brand awareness, community engagement, and business growth.




BASIC INFORMATION

 - Job Type: Full Time Employee

 - Location: Sunnyvale, CA

 - Compensation: 
   
   Base Salary: USD $120k - $200k


WHAT YOU’LL DO:

 - Manage the company’s day-to-day presence across relevant social media platforms.

 - Develop and maintain a consistent social content calendar aligned with broader company priorities.

 - Create, edit, and publish compelling written, visual, and short-form video content.

 - Translate product updates, company milestones, customer stories, and industry developments into accessible social narratives.

 - Maintain a consistent brand voice while adapting content to different platforms and audiences.

 - Monitor conversations, respond to relevant comments, and help build an engaged online community.

 - Identify timely cultural, industry, and platform trends that create relevant opportunities for the brand.

 - Collaborate with marketing, communications, product, design, and other internal teams on campaigns and announcements.

 - Coordinate with creators, partners, customers, and community members on collaborative content when appropriate.

 - Track content performance, identify meaningful insights, and continuously improve execution.

 - Support social media coverage for launches, events, partnerships, and other key company moments.

 - Help maintain clear publishing workflows, content standards, and brand guidelines.

 - Monitor potential reputational issues and escalate sensitive conversations when necessary.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

 - 4+ years of experience managing social media for a brand, technology company, creative business, agency, or similarly fast-moving organization.

 - A portfolio or examples of social content and campaigns you have personally developed or managed.

 - Strong writing and editing skills with excellent attention to tone, clarity, and detail.

 - Experience creating content across multiple formats, including copy, graphics, video, and community-focused posts.

 - Strong understanding of major social platforms, audience behavior, and evolving content formats.

 - Good creative judgment and the ability to recognize content that feels timely, relevant, and authentic.

 - Ability to turn complex products or ideas into clear and engaging social stories.

 - Comfortable managing multiple projects, deadlines, stakeholders, and approval processes.

 - Data-informed mindset with experience using social media analytics to evaluate and improve content.

 - Proactive, resourceful, and comfortable taking ownership in a fast-paced environment.

 - Strong collaboration and communication skills.

 - Experience in technology, AI, gaming, design, creator tools, or digital products is a plus.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - The company maintains a consistent, high-quality, and recognizable social presence.

 - Social content clearly communicates the brand’s value, personality, and key company moments.

 - Audience engagement and brand visibility improve over time.

 - Internal teams have a reliable partner for social storytelling and distribution.

 - Social performance insights are translated into practical improvements in content and execution.


HOW TO APPLY

Please submit your résumé along with:

 - A portfolio or links to social accounts, campaigns, or content you have managed.

 - Two or three examples of content you are particularly proud of.

 - A brief explanation of your role in creating or managing those examples.

 - An example of how you adapted one story or campaign for different social platforms.


OUR VALUES:

 - Brain: We value intelligence and the pursuit of knowledge. Our team is composed of some of the brightest minds in the industry.

 - Heart: We care deeply about our work, our users, and each other. Empathy and passion drive us forward.

 - Gut: We trust our instincts and are not afraid to take bold risks. Innovation requires courage.

 - Taste: We have a keen eye for quality and aesthetics. Our products are not just functional but also beautiful.


WHY JOIN MESHY?

 - Opportunity to work with a talented and passionate team at the forefront of AI and 3D technology.

 - Flexible work environment

 - Opportunities for fast professional growth and development.

 - An inclusive culture that values creativity, innovation, and collaboration.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Authentication & Authorization (OAuth/OIDC)
jobs.description:
A career that’s the whole package!

At Conga, we’ve built a community where our colleagues can thrive. Here you’ll find opportunities to innovate and support growth through individual and team development, all within an environment where every voice is heard.

Conga lines up commercial operations so companies run as connected, smarter businesses. By unifying the people and processes that drive commerce, Conga aligns pricing, quoting, contracting, rebates, and communications so teams stay in sync and buyers keep moving forward. The result is trusted decisions, consistent buyer experiences, and profitable growth. More than 10,000 customers worldwide, including over 50% of the Fortune 100®, trust Conga when commercial complexity is high and global impact is on the line.

Opportunity Overview

This Senior Software Engineer role sits within Conga’s B2B Platform Engineering, Core Services organization. It focuses on building security, identity, access management, and reporting capabilities that are foundational to all Conga B2B products.

You will also be a key technical contributor to the Advantage Platform effort, building secure and reusable integration patterns between B2B and Advantage. This role is for a hands-on engineer who enjoys working deep in identity protocols and token flows, and who wants to build shared security services used across Conga’s platform ecosystem.

What You’ll Do

• Design, build, and maintain platform-level identity services, including authentication and authorization systems.

• Implement and extend OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, and token-based authentication flows, including token issuance, validation, refresh, and revocation.

• Build and evolve role and permission models and policy-driven access control used across multiple products.

• Develop external and internal facing reports used for adoption, consumption, and monitoring the platform.

• Turn architectural direction and technical designs into secure, production-ready implementations.

• Develop RESTful APIs and service contracts that multiple product teams consume.

• Implement tenant-context propagation and service-to-service authentication and authorization across distributed systems.

• Build secure, scalable, and highly available services that meet strict security, performance, and reliability requirements.

• Work with the Advantage Platform team to implement secure integration patterns between B2B and Advantage, including shared authentication capabilities.

• Work with Architecture and Product Security to apply security patterns, standards, and controls, and to address threat modeling findings in code.

• Contribute to an Agile, CI/CD-based environment with a focus on automation, testability, and observability.

• Participate in code reviews and design reviews, sharing secure coding practices with teammates.

• Investigate and resolve incidents in security-sensitive services, including root cause analysis and durable fixes.

• Help build reusable authentication and authorization capabilities that support AI-driven product experiences.

What We’re Looking For

• Strong hands-on experience building and operating identity and access management services in enterprise SaaS environments.

• Deep, practical knowledge of OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, JWT and other token-based authentication, and common flows such as authorization code with PKCE and client credentials.

• Experience implementing role-based and permission-based access control, and policy-driven authorization models.

• Experience building backend systems in a modern language (for example Java, C#, Python, Scala, TypeScript, or Rust).

• Strong experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs with multiple consumers.

• Solid experience with SQL and the data stores that back platform services.

• Working knowledge of authentication flows, multi-tenancy, and tenant-context handling in distributed systems.

• Strong understanding of software design patterns, distributed systems, and platform tradeoffs.

• Solid grasp of secure coding practices and common identity-related vulnerabilities, such as token misuse, session handling flaws, and privilege escalation.

• Experience delivering features end to end, from design through testing, deployment, and production support.

• Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to document technical decisions and collaborate with Architecture, Security, Product, and other engineering teams.

Preferred / Bonus Experience

• Experience with identity providers or platforms such as Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Okta, Auth0, Keycloak, or Ping.

• Experience with SCIM, federation, SSO, and MFA implementations.

• Experience with PaaS offerings (Azure, AWS, GCP) and containerized, orchestrated environments (Docker, Kubernetes).

• Experience with Azure SQL Server.

• Familiarity with cloud-native security patterns, mTLS, and service-to-service communication.

• Exposure to DevOps and SRE practices for platform services (monitoring, alerting, automation).

• Experience designing, developing, and maintaining PowerBi reports.

• Familiarity with Databricks.

What This Role Enables at Conga

• Hands-on ownership of security-critical identity and access capabilities that support the B2B portfolio.

• Secure integration between the B2B and Advantage platforms.

• Reusable authentication and authorization patterns for cross-platform product and AI experiences.

• Greater consistency in identity, tenant context, permissions, and service-to-service access across Conga platforms.

• Impact across multiple product teams and engineering organizations.

• Close alignment with Architecture and long-term platform strategy.

• A growth path toward staff-level or technical leadership roles.

• A chance to shape Conga’s security posture, engineering standards, and platform foundations.

Did we pique your interest?

If this sounds like the kind of job you would love in the kind of environment where you would thrive, please click apply. We'd love to hear from you!

Preferred Resume Format

We accept resumes in any format, we suggest using PDF or plain text. These formats help ensure that your resume’s formatting remains intact, making it easier for our recruiters to review your application promptly.

Don’t meet every requirement for the role?

Studies have shown that women and members of ethnic minorities are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Conga we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You just might be the right candidate for this or other roles.

Additional Information

Conga is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, parental or pregnancy status, marriage and civil partnership, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We understand interviewing can be stressful for those with disabilities. If reasonable accommodation is needed to allow you to show us your best self, please let your recruiter know as soon as possible. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Conga is not open to third party solicitation or resumes for our posted FTE positions. Resumes received from third party agencies that are unsolicited will be considered complimentary.

Conga's Applicant Privacy Statement

The information you provide during the application process will be used in accordance with Conga’s Applicant Privacy Statement (https://conga.com/applicant-privacy-statement). By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree to the terms outlined in this privacy statement.

jobs.title: Commercial counsel
jobs.description:

WRITER is the AI platform built for the world’s most ambitious marketing and revenue teams, bringing the frontier of AI to the people who drive enterprise growth. With WRITER, autonomous agents work across the buyer journey, continuously executing on market signals and enterprise intelligence to grow revenue faster. We’re looking for a commercial counsel who thrives on deal-making and loves turning legal complexity into business clarity. You’ll be drafting and negotiating SaaS agreements that power our growth and keep our partnerships strong. If you’re energized by fast-paced negotiations with large enterprise companies, curious about cutting-edge technology, and excited to join a small-but-mighty team that values creativity and collaboration (all with a sense of humor and low ego) then, this may be the role for you. Come help us redefine what it means to be an in-house legal team - and have fun doing it.

 - Review and negotiate inbound and outbound commercial contracts, including inbound and outbound SaaS licensing agreements, strategic partnership agreements, data processing agreements and other important contracts with our enterprise customers and suppliers.

🍩 Benefits & perks (US Full-time employees)

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive - Federal
jobs.description:
About Delinea:
Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. It supports both static and ephemeral access, letting teams apply Zero Standing Privilege where risk demands it without replacing existing infrastructure.



Position Summary

This remote position requires a motivated self-starter who will be responsible for all net new sales into the Intelligence Community agency accounts. Because the work happens where the mission happens, this role requires an active TS/SCI clearance with a CI or full-scope polygraph.

Based in a specific geographic area, the candidate may be required to travel approximately 30-40% throughout the assigned territory to visit customers, attend trade shows or field events, and for internal meetings such as sales kick-offs or quarterly business reviews. 

With our strong promote-from-within philosophy, successful performance in this role will provide career advancement opportunities to those seeking to take their sales careers to the next level.

What You'll Do:

 - Create and personalize a territory plan for the assigned territory and agencies, built around the federal fiscal year and appropriations cycles.

 - Prospect to and create contacts across assigned agencies, their components, and program offices and effectively communicate back to Delinea leadership what is needed to continue to support this community.

 - Proactively pursue existing leads who have expressed interest in our technology.

 - Collaborate with and engage the right Delinea technical experts to provide an accurate and compelling story on our products’ strengths and capabilities to win deals.

 - Consistently meet/exceed sales targets.

 - Maintain an accurate forecast of sales pipeline, commit and best case.

 - Cultivate and manage relationships with federal resellers, distributors, and systems integrators, and transact through GSA MAS, SEWP, and agency-specific contract vehicles.

 - Leverage Delinea’s executives, and their networks, to gain access to prospective clients.

 - Never stop learning! Continue to hone your craft and build your expertise in Cybersecurity.

What You'll Bring:

 - 5+ years as an enterprise software sales executive, including direct experience selling into U.S. Federal agencies.

 - This role requires an active TS/SCI clearance with a CI or full-scope polygraph.

 - Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university preferred or equivalent work experience.

 - Working knowledge of federal procurement processes for these agencies that include but are not limited to contract vehicles, FedRAMP authorization levels, ATO timelines, and the federal zero-trust mandate under OMB M-22-09.

 - Experience cultivating and controlling complex sales cycles with multiple stakeholders within the agencies.

 - Track record of success in identifying, cultivating and closing six figure+ transactions.

 - Ability to conduct both executive level presentations and high-level technical presentations.

 - Excellent written and oral communication and presentation skills.

 - Demonstrated ability to build and land a differentiated value proposition.

Bonus if you have:

 - An established book of business within Intelligence Community and/or FSI community

 - Experience selling cybersecurity solutions to Intelligence agencies

Why work at Delinea? 

 - We're passionate problem-solvers helping the world's largest organizations protect what matters most: their human and machine identities.

 - We invest in people who are smart, self-motivated, and collaborative.

 - What we offer in return is meaningful work, a culture of innovation and great career progression.



At Delinea, our core values are STRONG and guide our behaviors and success:

 - Spirited - We bring energy and passion to everything we do

 - Trust - We act with integrity and deliver on our commitments

 - Respect - We listen, value different perspectives, and work as one team

 - Ownership - We take initiative and follow through

 - Nimble - We adapt quickly in a fast-changing environment

 - Global - We embrace diverse people and ideas to drive better outcomes

We believe weaving these core values into our day-to-day actions, and our process for hiring, evaluating, and promoting employees, helps us cultivate a work environment that embraces collaboration and camaraderie.

We take care of our employees. We offer competitive salaries, a meaningful bonus program, and excellent benefits, including healthcare insurance, as well as pension/retirement matching, comprehensive life insurance, an employee assistance program, time off plans, and paid company holidays. 

Delinea is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type with regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Upon conditional offer of employment, candidates are required to complete comprehensive criminal background check, verification of education, and verification of employment, per employment policy. In addition, all publicly posted social media sites may be reviewed.

jobs.title: Senior Professional Services Consultant- DSPM
jobs.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Senior Professional Services Consultant – Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) to join our Professional Services team. This is a Hybrid (work location: Mohali ) role, reporting to the Manager , Professional Services  in the Professional Services (Solution Consulting) department. Sitting at the intersection of strategic enterprise consulting and forward-deployed engineering, you will serve as the primary technical authority and end-to-end delivery owner for our enterprise DSPM customers across financial services, public sector, retail, SaaS, and beyond. As organizations navigate AI-accelerated threats, cloud-first transformation, and sprawling multi-cloud data estates, you will turn complexity into clarity. You will architect, deploy, and optimize DSPM solutions alongside the broader Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform—driving expanded cloud-estate visibility, accurate sensitive-data inventory, reduced identity and credential exposure, and AI governance. Beyond traditional consulting, this role requires strong hands-on technical depth: you will configure complex data connectors, customize data classification pipelines, resolve production-level identity and integration challenges, and bridge real-world customer deployments directly with Core Engineering and Product Management.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

• Own the Technical Lifecycle & Solution Architecture: Serve as the primary technical leader for named enterprise accounts, designing and executing complex, highly regulated DSPM deployments across multi-cloud, hybrid, and air-gapped environments.

• Drive Ecosystem Integration & Strategic Outcomes: Integrate DSPM capabilities seamlessly with ZIA, ZPA, ZDX, and the broader Zero Trust Exchange to deliver measurable security value, including sensitive-data discovery, shadow AI risk reduction, and over-privileged access remediation.

• Lead High-Touch Executive & Technical Engagements: Conduct strategic workshops, technical discoveries, and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), translating complex technical findings into actionable, executive-grade risk summaries and security roadmaps.

• Execute Hands-On Data, Identity, & Workflow Engineering: Configure data connectors across major public clouds and data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery), manage enterprise identity/IAM permissions, and build downstream SIEM/ticketing integrations.

• Unblock Deployments & Shape Product Roadmap: Partner with Core Engineering to resolve complex production escalations, support pre-sales/POV engagements, and translate customer feedback into prioritized platform improvements.

Who You Are (Success Profile)

• Thrive in ambiguity, navigating dynamic environments with confidence to build clear paths forward and transform complex challenges into structured, impactful solutions.

• Act like an owner, bringing an intrinsic bias for action and accountability while moving seamlessly between high-level strategy and detailed technical execution.

• Problem-solver at core, energized by tackling complex architectural hurdles and committed to delivering high-impact, practical solutions.

• High-trust collaborator, dedicated to collective team success and fostering a culture of open, candid feedback to build enduring trust across sales and delivery organizations.

• Customer-obsessed mindset, maintaining deep empathy for internal and external stakeholders to anchor every architectural recommendation in real-world customer success.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

• Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain

• Over 8 years of experience in high-impact, customer-facing roles (Professional Services, Architecture Consulting, TAM, or Escalation Engineering) successfully managing and securing enterprise-level accounts.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Keebo automatically optimizes cloud data warehouses for Snowflake and Databricks to control compute costs without hurting query performance. Our platform learns each customer's workloads and adjusts warehouse settings in real time, so data teams don't have to. We're venture-backed, built on years of database and machine learning research, and fully remote.

About the Opportunity

We're an AI-first engineering team. We use agents across design, implementation, review, and testing, and we hold their output to the same standard as any other pull request: read it, question it, and reject it when it's wrong. We adopt new tools and processes quickly, and we drop what isn't working.

As a Senior Data Engineer, you'll design and scale the data pipelines and machine learning infrastructure behind our platform. You'll use AI to multiply your own output and the team's, and work directly with product and machine learning engineers to turn customer data into models and features that ship.

You Will

• Design and build reliable data pipelines that process large volumes of customer warehouse data

• Build and run the machine learning operations infrastructure that takes models from training to production: feature pipelines, training jobs, deployment, and monitoring

• Own data quality and data modeling, so the data behind our models and customer-facing features is accurate and trustworthy

• Use AI coding tools effectively by writing clear specs and context, running agents on parallel workstreams, and reviewing their output critically

• Build shared AI workflows, guardrails, and review standards that make everyone move faster

• Evaluate new tools and models, and share the worthy ones with the team

• Write architecture docs that explain what we're building, the tradeoffs, and why

• Understand customer needs and decide what's worth building

• Mentor engineers, including on working effectively with AI coding tools

You Have

• 5+ years of data engineering or software engineering experience, including time at an early-stage startup (Seed through Series B)

• Deep experience building and scaling production data pipelines, batch and streaming. Particularly with orchestration tools such as Dagster, Airflow, or Temporal

• Hands-on machine learning operations experience: deploying, monitoring, and retraining models in production

• Strong data modeling and architecture skills, and a track record of keeping data quality high as volume grows

• Deep experience with AI coding agents, and examples of how to scale their use across a team

• The judgment to catch AI output that is wrong, incomplete, or risky, especially with customer data, and the habit of adapting as tools change

• Sound tradeoffs: you know when to ship something simple and when reliability, data integrity, or architecture can't wait

• Proven expertise in SQL and Python

• Experience with cloud platforms, workflow orchestration, containers, and automated deploy pipelines

• Clear, collaborative communication, especially in writing: you explain what matters and why

• Persistence and a constructive attitude when things break or plans change

Bonus Points

• Experience with data cloud platforms, especially Snowflake or Databricks

• Hands-on experience applying machine learning techniques such as time-series forecasting, regression, anomaly detection, or reinforcement learning

• Experience building AI agents, agent tooling, or Model Context Protocol servers

• Knowledge of query optimization or workload analysis

• Working knowledge of Java, Go, or Javascript

Compensation and Location

The base salary is $170,000 to $200,000 for US-based candidates, plus equity. The role is fully remote and open to candidates living in the United States with authorization to work there. Visa support will not be provided. Core hours align with US Eastern Time.

What we Offer

Working with a world-class team of researchers and engineers in machine learning to turn Al algorithms into scalable and automated cloud products

For full-time positions:

• Equity

• Medical, dental, and vision benefits

• 401(k) retirement program

• Home office stipend

• Paid time off and paid parental leave

• The latest AI tools, and freedom to try new ones

Identity Verification

We verify every candidate's identity and location through on-camera interviews, ID verification, and a background check. Equipment ships only to your verified address. Misrepresenting your identity, location, or work history ends your candidacy or employment. Keebo complies with US sanctions and export control laws.

Keebo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. We strive to create a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected. We encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

SOFTWARE ENGINEER, MODEL ROUTING & INFERENCE

As a Software Engineer on the Model Routing & Inference team at SpaceXSI, you'll build the inference platform that powers every AI interaction in the product. This team owns the full inference path: making Cursor's AI faster, more reliable, and more cost-effective at a scale few teams in the world get to operate at. Every agent session, every tab completion, and every chat message flows through your stack.



RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Build and evolve our inference gateway, a single abstraction over every provider's API semantics, so model onboarding becomes a config change

 - Design intelligent cross-provider failover so no single provider outage causes user-visible degradation

 - Design routing backpressure and admission control so traffic spikes don't cascade into providers
   
   

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

 - Experience building high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems (e.g., inference serving, traffic routing, or real-time data pipelines)

 - Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, math, or scientific discipline; OR 2+ years of professional experience building software in lieu of a degree
   
   

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - Comfortable reasoning about cost/performance tradeoffs at scale (GPU utilization, provider economics, capacity planning)

 - Strong software engineering fundamentals and enjoying shipping production systems that handle millions of requests
   
   

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

 - If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 2-3 short technicals. After, we'll schedule an onsite in our office, where you'll work on a small project, discuss ideas, and meet the team

Annual Salary:

$140,000 - $225,000 USD

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

jobs.title: Outpatient Regional Sales Director - East
jobs.description:
About Us

Hyperfine, Inc. (Nasdaq: HYPR) is the groundbreaking health technology company that has redefined brain imaging with the Swoop® system—the first FDA-cleared, portable, ultra-low-field, magnetic resonance brain imaging system capable of providing imaging at multiple points of care in a healthcare facility. Our mission is to revolutionize patient care globally through transformational, accessible, clinically relevant diagnostic imaging. Learn More

About The Role

Job Title: Outpatient Regional Sales Director

Location: East Coast

SUMMARY:

The Hyperfine Outpatient Regional Sales Director (RSD) is responsible for driving sales of Hyperfine products into their defined geographical territory. The RSD will be calling into settings outside the hospital, including neurology offices, freestanding outpatient clinics, and concierge/longevity practices. The RSD is responsible for developing their territory plan, building strategic relationships, and driving revenue opportunities in a capital sales and rental/lease environment.  The RSD must be ready to sell disruptive technology and coach / lead customers through a change management process for both business transformation, patient care, and outpatient workflows.  Finally, the RSD will introduce customers to Hyperfine products, define customer needs, recommend product solutions, and own field based commercial activities to achieve or exceed sales quota.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Develop and own the territory plan to achieve quota / revenue growth goals, which will include both tactical and strategic thinking / planning.

• Be disciplined to a defined sales process and lead generation process, including specific KPI’s that will be measured weekly, monthly, and quarterly to support sales success.

• Collaborate with team members across the Hyperfine organization to share best practices and support a cohesive sales approach.

• Be always the Directly Responsible Individual (DRI) or quarterback for the customer while the sales process is underway and throughout the customer lifecycle to deliver successful outpatient programs.

• Manage a complex sale with multiple work streams moving simultaneously and in a proper choreography that leads to system / unit sales of Swoop.

• Experience selling into private practices and be an expert in clinical use cases, brain health applications, and delivering clinical and practice value for outpatient customers. Must be able to learn complex information quickly to apply those learnings in the sales process.

• Proven success selling clinically to physicians, while also selling financially to practice managers and orchestrating conversations with ancillary service partners (i.e. financing, teleradiology) to support successful implementation and program launch.

• Support live events such as demonstrations and conferences by managing logistics, driving customer awareness, and working with other commercial teams.

• Partner with Inside Sales to follow up on leads to find new customers, support product demonstrations through scheduling, follow-up, and ongoing funnel management activities.

• Partner with commercial and internal stakeholders (ex. product, marketing, clinical sciences, clinical applications, customer success) to share feedback, identify trends, and make introductions that result in increased value for the customer and Hyperfine.

• You are required to utilize CRM tools, such as Salesforce on a daily and weekly basis to report regional customers, accounts, and sales activities and metrics.

• Provide reports as required by leadership (monthly, quarterly, annually)

• Travel within the defined region to meet customers in person as often as needed.

• When required, travel outside of your region to attend company and industry events.

• Account for expenses and adhere to company expense policy.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILL:

• Mission driven, committed, and highly motivated to achieve sales goals

• Strong prospecting, territory development, and consultative selling skills

• Ability to articulate the clinical and business value of new technology, including practice economics, workflow, reimbursement, and cash-pay considerations

• Excellent professional communication, presentation, and negotiation skills

• Process driven and organized with a commitment to timely follow up both internally and externally

• Resilient and adaptable, with the ability to drive adoption of disruptive technology and new models of care.

• Strong customer engagement and management skills

• Fluency in CRM, BRM, MS office suite, G-Suite or iWork, web-based documentation/sharing, and web conferencing

• Knowledge of neurology, outpatient clinical workflows, and care pathways.

• Intellectually curious

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:

• Bachelor’s degree

• 6+ years medical device sales experience

• Experience selling capital equipment to private practices

• Experience with market development for cash-pay or elective procedures

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

• Available nights, weekends, and holidays as business needs require.

• Ability to speak, write, and use all office equipment including scanner and printer, phone, and computer.

• This position requires frequent regional travel to customer sites, events, and meetings that may be accomplished via air, train, and vehicle transportation, including overnight stays in a hotel.

• Must possess a valid driver's license and maintain a clean driving record.

• Must have consistent access to a personally owned vehicle that is well-maintained and in good working condition.

• Ability to transport company materials (e.g., demo equipment, collateral) as needed.

• Reimbursement for mileage and allowable business-related expenses will follow company policy

The annual base salary for this position is $140,000 plus commission. This position is also eligible to participate in Hyperfine's equity plans. Individual compensation packages are based on various factors unique to each candidate including skill set, relevant experience, qualifications, location, position level, and other job-related reasons.

Work Authorization: Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the United States. Hyperfine participates in E-Verify to confirm employment eligibility in accordance with federal law. We are unable to provide or assume employment visa sponsorship, now or in the future.

Agency Resumes: We are not accepting resumes from recruitment agencies. Any unsolicited resumes submitted by an agency will be considered the property of Hyperfine and will not be subject to any fees or charges if the candidate is hired.

jobs.title: Outpatient Regional Sales Director - West
jobs.description:
About Us

Hyperfine, Inc. (Nasdaq: HYPR) is the groundbreaking health technology company that has redefined brain imaging with the Swoop® system—the first FDA-cleared, portable, ultra-low-field, magnetic resonance brain imaging system capable of providing imaging at multiple points of care in a healthcare facility. Our mission is to revolutionize patient care globally through transformational, accessible, clinically relevant diagnostic imaging. Learn More

About The Role

Job Title: Outpatient Regional Sales Director

Location: West Coast

SUMMARY:

The Hyperfine Outpatient Regional Sales Director (RSD) is responsible for driving sales of Hyperfine products into their defined geographical territory. The RSD will be calling into settings outside the hospital, including neurology offices, freestanding outpatient clinics, and concierge/longevity practices. The RSD is responsible for developing their territory plan, building strategic relationships, and driving revenue opportunities in a capital sales and rental/lease environment.  The RSD must be ready to sell disruptive technology and coach / lead customers through a change management process for both business transformation, patient care, and outpatient workflows.  Finally, the RSD will introduce customers to Hyperfine products, define customer needs, recommend product solutions, and own field based commercial activities to achieve or exceed sales quota.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Develop and own the territory plan to achieve quota / revenue growth goals, which will include both tactical and strategic thinking / planning.

• Be disciplined to a defined sales process and lead generation process, including specific KPI’s that will be measured weekly, monthly, and quarterly to support sales success.

• Collaborate with team members across the Hyperfine organization to share best practices and support a cohesive sales approach.

• Be always the Directly Responsible Individual (DRI) or quarterback for the customer while the sales process is underway and throughout the customer lifecycle to deliver successful outpatient programs.

• Manage a complex sale with multiple work streams moving simultaneously and in a proper choreography that leads to system / unit sales of Swoop.

• Experience selling into private practices and be an expert in clinical use cases, brain health applications, and delivering clinical and practice value for outpatient customers. Must be able to learn complex information quickly to apply those learnings in the sales process.

• Proven success selling clinically to physicians, while also selling financially to practice managers and orchestrating conversations with ancillary service partners (i.e. financing, teleradiology) to support successful implementation and program launch.

• Support live events such as demonstrations and conferences by managing logistics, driving customer awareness, and working with other commercial teams.

• Partner with Inside Sales to follow up on leads to find new customers, support product demonstrations through scheduling, follow-up, and ongoing funnel management activities.

• Partner with commercial and internal stakeholders (ex. product, marketing, clinical sciences, clinical applications, customer success) to share feedback, identify trends, and make introductions that result in increased value for the customer and Hyperfine.

• You are required to utilize CRM tools, such as Salesforce on a daily and weekly basis to report regional customers, accounts, and sales activities and metrics.

• Provide reports as required by leadership (monthly, quarterly, annually)

• Travel within the defined region to meet customers in person as often as needed.

• When required, travel outside of your region to attend company and industry events.

• Account for expenses and adhere to company expense policy.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILL:

• Mission driven, committed, and highly motivated to achieve sales goals

• Strong prospecting, territory development, and consultative selling skills

• Ability to articulate the clinical and business value of new technology, including practice economics, workflow, reimbursement, and cash-pay considerations

• Excellent professional communication, presentation, and negotiation skills

• Process driven and organized with a commitment to timely follow up both internally and externally

• Resilient and adaptable, with the ability to drive adoption of disruptive technology and new models of care.

• Strong customer engagement and management skills

• Fluency in CRM, BRM, MS office suite, G-Suite or iWork, web-based documentation/sharing, and web conferencing

• Knowledge of neurology, outpatient clinical workflows, and care pathways.

• Intellectually curious

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:

• Bachelor’s degree

• 6+ years medical device sales experience

• Experience selling capital equipment to private practices

• Experience with market development for cash-pay or elective procedures

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

• Available nights, weekends, and holidays as business needs require.

• Ability to speak, write, and use all office equipment including scanner and printer, phone, and computer.

• This position requires frequent regional travel to customer sites, events, and meetings that may be accomplished via air, train, and vehicle transportation, including overnight stays in a hotel.

• Must possess a valid driver's license and maintain a clean driving record.

• Must have consistent access to a personally owned vehicle that is well-maintained and in good working condition.

• Ability to transport company materials (e.g., demo equipment, collateral) as needed.

• Reimbursement for mileage and allowable business-related expenses will follow company policy

The annual base salary for this position is $140,000 plus commission. This position is also eligible to participate in Hyperfine's equity plans. Individual compensation packages are based on various factors unique to each candidate including skill set, relevant experience, qualifications, location, position level, and other job-related reasons.

Work Authorization: Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the United States. Hyperfine participates in E-Verify to confirm employment eligibility in accordance with federal law. We are unable to provide or assume employment visa sponsorship, now or in the future.

jobs.title: Tech Lead, Applied AI - Evals
jobs.description:
ABOUT MERCOR



Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. Millions of domain experts on the platform are paid over $4 million per day to train frontier AI models. Mercor's APEX benchmark family measures AI's real-world impact on professional work. Mercor Enterprise brings this same infrastructure to Fortune 500 companies: helping companies capture how their best people actually work, translating that expertise directly back into agents.

 

Mercor is creating a new category of work where expertise powers AI advancement. Achieving this requires an ambitious, fast-paced and deeply committed team. You’ll work alongside researchers, operators, and AI companies at the forefront of shaping the systems that are redefining society. Mercor is a profitable Series C company valued at $10 billion. We work in-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices.

About the Role

Mercor’s evals product helps frontier labs and enterprises understand how their models perform on real work. Labs use it to decide what to train next, and enterprises use it to decide which models and agents to trust. It runs evals at scale, grades every result and explains why a model fails. The team also runs APEX, Mercor's family of benchmarks built with domain experts to measure how well frontier models do professional work in fields like law, finance and consulting. Its public leaderboard ranks the latest models, and its results appear in model cards across the industry.

As the Tech Lead on the Evals team, you will own the evals product end to end. You will decide what the team builds next and stay hands-on in the code. The hard problems are in grading open-ended professional work reliably, keeping results reproducible as models and tasks change, and running long agent tasks at scale. The work is becoming as much a research problem as an engineering one.

This role grows with the platform, from evals into post-training and new product areas. You will help turn the failures we find into data that improves models.



What You'll Do

 - Own the evals flywheel and its direction: Set the architecture and roadmap, and make the tradeoff calls in design reviews.

 - Lead the product customers use to evaluate models: Ship the APIs, data models and UI that labs and enterprises use to run evals and compare models.

 - Power APEX launches: Build the systems that run every new frontier model on APEX and publish correct, defensible results to the public leaderboard.

 - Explain why models fail: Build failure analysis that links each failure pattern to the exact steps that went wrong.

 - Set the quality bar for evals: Calibrate graders against expert judgment and decide when a grader or agent change is ready to ship.

 - Keep production healthy: Make sure the product stays reliable and its compute costs stay in check.

 - Work directly with customers: Lead pilots with labs and enterprises and bring what you learn back into the roadmap.

 - Grow the team: Hire and mentor engineers, and manage the people on the team.



What We Are Looking For

 - Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or a related field

 - 5+ years building and running backend systems in production, with time at senior or staff level

 - Strong full-stack skills in a modern backend language (Python, Go or TypeScript) and a frontend framework such as React

 - A track record of owning a platform or product area end to end, including leading the team that built it

 - Strong product sense that starts from what the user needs

 - Experience building data-heavy products: data models, APIs and views over large volumes of results

 - Excellent written and verbal communication with engineers, researchers and customers

 - Comfort with ambiguity and a habit of shipping iteratively



Benefits

 - Bi-annual performance bonus structure

 - Generous equity grant vested over 4 years

 - Up to $15k Relocation bonus

 - $10K housing bonus (if you live within 0.5 miles of our office)

 - $1.5K monthly stipend for meals

 - Free Equinox membership

 - $200 monthly laundry reimbursement

 - $200 monthly personal wellness reimbursement

 - Health, Dental, Vision insurance

Let’s Shape the Future, Together

At ASM, you will have the opportunity to learn, contribute, and grow while helping create a safer and more sustainable workplace. Bring your curiosity, ideas, and passion for making a difference, and help us shape what’s next.

Apply today to be part of what’s next.

Meet Upside:

We created Upside to transform brick-and-mortar commerce. Our technology uses the sophistication of online retail—profit measurement, attribution, and incrementality—to provide users with more value on their everyday purchases and brick-and-mortar businesses with new, profitable customers. We’ve helped millions of users earn 2 to 3 times more cashback than any other product, and hundreds of thousands of brick-and-mortar businesses earn measurable profit. Billions of dollars in commerce run through the Upside platform every year, and that value goes directly back to our retailer partners, the consumers they serve, and important sustainability initiatives.



The Impact You'll Make

Upside is adding a Senior Account Manager to own a mixed book of grocery retailers, a set of strategic mid-market accounts plus a tail of smaller (SMB) accounts, in our fast-growing grocery vertical. In this role you'll run high-touch, data-driven management for the mid-market accounts and a lighter, playbook-driven motion for the SMB tail, flexing your approach to each account's value. Reporting to the AVP of Account Management, you'll work with analytics, product, marketing, and operations teams to ensure retailer value and support business growth.



What You'll Do

 - Work with retailers from onboarding through long-term account management across a mixed mid-market and SMB book, building trust throughout the partnership.

 - Improve retention through platform education and relevant data: customized decks and reviews for mid-market, templated and repeatable for the SMB tail.

 - Tier and prioritize across the book, deciding where deep, custom attention earns its keep and where a standardized motion is the better call.

 - Identify and close expansion opportunities and long-term agreement conversions across the book.

 - Predict and address concerns before they lead to churn risk, including spotting at-scale patterns across the SMB tail, not just one account at a time.

 - Maintain account health at multiple levels, including senior executives of mid-market accounts, with a right-sized cadence for the SMB tail.

 - 5+ years of client-facing experience, including ownership of mid-market accounts; Bachelor's degree required.

 - Comfort managing a larger, mixed-tier book, prioritizing ruthlessly and flexing touch model by account value.

 - Strong analytical skills that translate analysis into relatable, compelling talking points and stories.
