jobs.title: Social Media Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
ABOUT FOCUSED ENERGY

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A - the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry  we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies. 

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.




YOUR ROLE

Sharing this story with the world is just as important as the science and engineering behind it.

We're looking for a creative, proactive, and digitally savvy Social Media Manager to build and grow our social media presence, starting with LinkedIn. As our first dedicated social media hire, you'll have the opportunity to establish our social media strategy, develop a consistent content engine, and bring Focused Energy's innovations, people, and progress to life for audiences around the world.

You'll work closely with our Communications team and subject-matter experts across science, engineering, and business to turn complex technical developments into engaging, accessible content. From employer branding and thought leadership to company milestones and community engagement, you'll help shape how the world sees and connects with Focused Energy.

This is an exciting opportunity to build something from the ground up, take ownership of growing digital channels, and help amplify the story of a company working at the forefront of clean energy innovation.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own Our Social Media Presence: Lead the day-to-day strategy, planning, and execution of Focused Energy's LinkedIn presence, including content development, publishing cadence, and channel growth.

 - Build a Scalable Content Strategy: Establish and maintain an editorial calendar, repeatable content formats, and workflows that keep our social channels consistent, engaging, and aligned with company priorities.

 - Bring Our Story to Life: Partner with the Digital Content Creator and internal subject-matter experts to transform complex scientific, technical, and business developments into compelling content that resonates with external audiences.

 - Drive Employer Branding and Thought Leadership: Develop content that highlights our people, culture, technical expertise, company milestones, partnerships, and innovations to strengthen our reputation and support talent attraction.

 - Grow and Engage Our Community: Manage day-to-day community interactions, responding to followers, candidates, partners, and other audiences in a timely, authentic, and on-brand manner.

 - Explore New Opportunities: Evaluate emerging platforms and additional social channels, making recommendations on where and how Focused Energy should expand its digital presence.

 - Measure and Optimize Performance: Track key social media metrics, analyze audience engagement and content performance, and use insights to continuously improve our strategy, formats, and publishing approach.

 - Support Campaigns and Key Initiatives: Coordinate social media activity around company announcements, events, product and technology milestones, partnerships, and recruiting campaigns.

 - Maintain Brand and Content Standards: Ensure all published content reflects Focused Energy's voice, brand identity, and communication standards, working with the appropriate stakeholders to validate scientific accuracy and manage sensitive topics.

 - Support Paid and Organic Social Activity: Execute organic social initiatives and contribute to paid social campaigns within approved strategies and budgets.




WHO YOU ARE

 - You have a degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, Digital Media, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 - You bring hands-on experience managing social media channels for a company, brand, startup, or organization, with a strong understanding of LinkedIn and its role in B2B marketing, employer branding, and thought leadership.

 - You have a strong grasp of social media strategy, content marketing, audience engagement, and the platform mechanics that drive visibility and growth.

 - You're an excellent writer and storyteller who knows how to turn complex ideas, technical information, and company updates into clear, engaging content for external audiences.

 - You have experience building editorial calendars, managing publishing schedules, and creating repeatable content processes that balance proactive planning with real-time opportunities.

 - You're comfortable using social media scheduling, publishing, and analytics tools to monitor performance, report on results, and optimize content. Experience with LinkedIn Campaign Manager or similar paid social platforms is a plus.

 - You bring a creative mindset and an eye for what makes content relevant, compelling, and shareable, with an understanding of how visual and video content can strengthen social storytelling.

 - You're proactive and self-directed, comfortable building a function from the ground up while keeping leadership informed and seeking alignment on larger strategic decisions.

 - You're a strong collaborator who can build relationships across different teams, engage subject-matter experts, and make it easy for colleagues to contribute their knowledge and stories.

 - You demonstrate sound judgment and attention to detail, particularly when communicating technical developments, company progress, and potentially sensitive information publicly.

 - You're curious, adaptable, and excited by the opportunity to help tell the story of a company pushing the boundaries of science, technology, and clean energy.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

 - Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

 - Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

 - Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

 - Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

 - Vacation Days: We support your work-life-balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

 - Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

 - Retirement Plan: If you decide for a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

 - Equipment: We offer state-of-the-art Windows or Apple Laptops. In addition, you will receive a keyboard, mouse and headset so you are fully equipped from day 1.

 - Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

 - Mobility with NAVIT: We partner with NAVIT to support your flexible commuting needs whether it’s a public transportation ticket, taxi rides or car-sharing you choose what fits your lifestyle.

 - Fitness with Wellhub: We care about your health. Get access to a wide range of gyms, fitness studios and wellness services across Europe through our partnership with Wellhub.

 


Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, benefits.

jobs.title: Principal, Client Relations
jobs.description:
Hut 8 brings exceptional people together to solve the world’s most consequential problems at the intersection of energy and technology. Today, that means building infrastructure for AI at a pace and scale without precedent. Tomorrow, it could mean powering a new era of innovation through robotics, advanced manufacturing, or an industry that does not yet exist. Whatever the technology demands, our ambition holds: to build the defining physical infrastructure company of our generation.

We look for thinkers and builders with the rigor, humility, and ownership to solve problems at this scale. They start from zero and choose truth over tradition. They back the best idea, whatever its source. They bet on themselves and embrace the hard truths that force them to grow. Our commitment is to keep the path from idea to execution short, trust them with critical decisions and the work that follows, and surround them with colleagues whose curiosity extends beyond their expertise.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Role Overview

Own customer-facing project management from lease execution through Ready for Service (RFS), serving as the central link among the customer, Hut 8 Commercialization, Asset Management, Engineering and Construction, and the general contractor. The role covers the development, construction, commissioning, and delivery period; at RFS and project closeout, customer and site responsibility transitions to Asset Management.

Roles and Responsibilities

• Serve as the customer's primary point of contact for all design, engineering, construction, commissioning, and delivery matters through RFS.

• Act as the day-to-day integrator across the customer, internal Hut 8 teams, and the general contractor.

• Maintain ground-level knowledge of the project — design development, construction sequencing, RFIs, submittals, schedule dependencies, open issues, and change orders — by working directly with Hut 8 and contractor engineering and construction teams.

• Own customer-initiated change requests end to end: intake, clarification, technical scoping, internal coordination, cost and schedule impact assessment, pricing, customer approval, implementation tracking, and closeout.

• Evaluate and communicate the downstream effects of proposed changes on cost, schedule, design, procurement, commissioning, and contractual commitments.

• Ensure change orders and customer requests follow the processes established under applicable EPC, general contractor, engineering, and lease arrangements; escalate deviations to the appropriate internal owner.

• Translate customer requirements into clear direction for internal and contractor teams, and translate technical and schedule information into clear updates for the customer and Commercialization team.

• Provide the customer with regular, accurate updates on design, engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, schedule, open decisions, and risks.

• Prepare for and lead recurring customer project meetings, maintaining action logs, decision records, and issue trackers with accountability for follow-ups.

• Maintain a single source of truth for customer requests, project commitments, lease-driven delivery obligations, amendments, change-order history, approvals, and communications.

• Identify and escalate issues that could affect RFS, customer expectations, commercial terms, project economics, or long-term operability of the asset.

• Coordinate project closeout and formal handoff to Asset Management at RFS, including final change-order documentation, delivery of project records, confirmation of open items, and transfer of customer, contractual, and operational history.

• Following handoff, transition to the next development or construction-stage customer project.

ABOUT YOU

• 5 to 10 years of experience in project management, construction management, owner's representation, or customer delivery, including direct experience within data center environments.

• Strong working knowledge of EPC and general contractor processes, including design development, RFIs, submittals, procurement, construction sequencing, commissioning, change management, and project closeout.

• Able to work in the details with engineering and construction teams while communicating clearly with customers and internal stakeholders.

• Experience assessing and communicating the cost, schedule, technical, contractual, and operational impacts of proposed project changes.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to manage key customer stakeholders and translate between technical and commercial audiences.

• Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple decisions, timelines, approvals, and work-streams across one or more active projects.

• Proactive in identifying risks early, driving cross-functional resolution, and maintaining accountability across internal and external teams.

• Familiarity with data center leases, EPC agreements, construction contracts, and change orders strongly preferred.

ABOUT THE WORK ENVIRONMENT

This role is in office at our corporate headquarters in the Brickell area of Miami, Florida. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

jobs.title: Senior Product Recruiter
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Recruiting at Brex

Recruiting is where every career at Brex begins. We are the first point of connection for future builders and leaders, helping candidates see what is possible. We partner with leaders across the company to find exceptional talent and build high-performing teams. We move quickly, think strategically, and take pride in a thoughtful, welcoming candidate experience from the first contact. We shape the culture at Brex by hiring the designers who define how our products look, feel and function.

What you'll do

Partner with product leaders to understand team needs and role requirements, and keep hiring goals aligned for Product roles. Source, engage and assess strong product talent through multiple channels, supporting the recruitment lifecycle from outreach to onboarding. Build pipelines for current openings and for upcoming hiring needs, with a focus on attracting diverse product talent. Track key hiring metrics, flag where candidates drop off, and help improve recruiting effectiveness. Work with the team to keep evaluation fair and consistent, and represent Brex in the product community, including events and social platforms.

Where you'll work

This role will be based in our San Francisco office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work.

Responsibilities

• Lead sourcing and outreach for Product roles, using recruiting platforms, product communities and social networks.

• Screen profiles for product sense, strategy and execution, and cross-functional collaboration.

• Work with product leaders to calibrate the product bar and hiring profile, with guidance from senior recruiters on strategy.

• Schedule and coordinate interviews, including profile reviews and product case exercises, for a high-quality candidate experience.

• Give hiring managers regular updates on pipeline health and progress.

• Keep candidate data accurate and up to date in recruiting systems and dashboards.

• Contribute ideas to improve recruiting processes, inclusive hiring and candidate experience.

• Help promote Brex's employer brand in the product community.

Requirements

• At least 2 years of experience recruiting or sourcing for technical roles ideally in-house, in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

• Solid sourcing skills and familiarity with AI tools, recruiting platforms and product talent networks.

• Ability to review product profiles and understand product sense and how product teams work, and willingness to learn more.

• Clear communication, relationship-building and stakeholder skills.

• Comfort with recruiting data: reads basic metrics and suggests improvements.

• Ability to manage several searches at once with guidance on priorities.

Bonus points

• Experience recruiting product managers across Product, Growth or Platform.

• Exposure to compensation and market data for product roles.

• Interest or experience in employer branding for the product community.

• Experience hiring across multiple geographies (US, Canada, LATAM).

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $126,550 - $158,200. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Brex LLC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Capital One, N.A.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

Our Approach to Flexible Work:

Combining purposeful in-person collaboration with flexibility, our focus is to optimize performance and drive connection for moments that matter.

jobs.title: Allocation Coordinator

jobs.title: Principal, Mechanical SME
jobs.description:
Hut 8 brings exceptional people together to solve the world’s most consequential problems at the intersection of energy and technology. Today, that means building infrastructure for AI at a pace and scale without precedent. Tomorrow, it could mean powering a new era of innovation through robotics, advanced manufacturing, or an industry that does not yet exist. Whatever the technology demands, our ambition holds: to build the defining physical infrastructure company of our generation.

We look for thinkers and builders with the rigor, humility, and ownership to solve problems at this scale. They start from zero and choose truth over tradition. They back the best idea, whatever its source. They bet on themselves and embrace the hard truths that force them to grow. Our commitment is to keep the path from idea to execution short, trust them with critical decisions and the work that follows, and surround them with colleagues whose curiosity extends beyond their expertise.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Mechanical Systems Expert is Managed Services' expert embedded in a data center build - supporting design review and commissioning to ensure cooling systems are operable and maintainable at turnover. Every design decision eventually becomes someone's 3 a.m. problem; this role reviews the design and witnesses the testing on behalf of that person.

Some of the key responsibilities you should expect are the following:

Operability Design Review

Review mechanical and cooling designs - chilled water plants, air and liquid cooling systems, CDUs, CRAHs, heat rejection, water treatment - through an operations lens: maintenance access and laydown, isolation and redundancy behavior, degraded-mode operation, instrumentation adequacy, and failure-mode consequences. File review comments that change designs, not just document concerns.

Construction-Phase Verification

Walk mechanical installations at key milestones: pipe routing and support, valve access, equipment clearances, insulation quality, and cleanliness/flushing protocol compliance - catching operability problems while they're still cheap to fix.

Commissioning Witness

Witness Level 3-5 commissioning of mechanical systems: functional performance tests, staging and failover sequences, failure scenarios, and integrated systems testing. Drive operational issues into the Cx log with clear acceptance criteria and verify closure personally.

Turnover Readiness

Verify mechanical turnover packages: O&Ms, as-builts, valve tags and system labeling, water treatment baselines, spare parts and consumables lists, and PM program inputs (frequencies, procedures, vendor contacts). Validate training actually equips operators to run the plant.

Operations Transition Support

Support early operations stabilization post-turnover: alarm tuning input, setpoint refinement, and first-months troubleshooting alongside the operations team.

Program Feedback

Feed operational lessons into Hut 8 mechanical design standards and the next project's basis of design.

ABOUT YOU

What we're looking for:

- 8+ years in critical facilities mechanical operations, commissioning, or chief-engineer-track roles.

- Deep hands-on knowledge of chilled water plants, hydronic systems, and data center cooling topologies - air-cooled, water-cooled, and liquid/direct-to-chip.

- Level 1-5 commissioning fluency from the witness/operations side, including integrated systems testing.

- Sharp eye for maintainability in design reviews: access, isolation, and instrumentation gaps.

- Turnover documentation rigor - you read the O&M before signing for it.

- Comfortable embedded with a construction team while holding the operations line.

- Water treatment and cleanliness protocol experience for critical hydronic systems.

- CFC/EPA certifications, trade licensure, or engineering degree all welcome paths.

ABOUT THE WORK ENVIRONMENT

- Full time on-site in St. Francisville, LA.

jobs.title: Research Associate 1
jobs.description:
Position Overview:

We are seeking a highly motivated and skilled Research Associate I to join our dynamic team in the sample management. In this role, you will be responsible for the management of biological samples, ensuring their integrity, overseeing quality control, and supporting research projects that rely on biological specimens. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in bio sample management, research methodologies, and data analysis, with an interest in contributing to cutting-edge scientific research.

Key Responsibilities:

• Sample Collection and Processing: Oversee the collection, preparation, and processing of biological samples (e.g., blood, tissue, saliva, DNA) in accordance with established protocols and best practices. Maintain proper documentation and labeling of samples, ensuring traceability from collection to storage.

• Sample Storage and Management: Ensure proper storage conditions (e.g., temperature, humidity) for various types of biological samples, including cryopreservation and ambient storage. Implement inventory management procedures to track and organize samples, utilizing database systems and laboratory management software (e.g., FreezerPro, LabArchives). Ensure the samples are appropriately cataloged and accessible to researchers in a timely manner.

• Database Management and Data Analysis: Manage and update the sample database, ensuring accuracy and compliance with sample tracking and research needs. Assist in data analysis and reporting, including the creation of sample inventory reports and performance metrics. Collaborate with the research team to retrieve and prepare data for research publications or grant proposals.

• Regulatory Compliance and Quality Control: Monitor and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, including HIPAA, IRB guidelines, and biorepository-specific SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures). Implement quality control procedures to ensure sample integrity and that all processes meet accreditation standards (e.g., CAP, ISO, CLIA). Assist in preparing for audits and inspections, ensuring documentation and records are up to date.

• Collaboration with Researchers: Work closely with internal and external research teams to understand sample requirements, providing expert guidance on sample availability, quality, and suitable use. Support researchers by preparing and distributing biological samples for experiments and studies. Provide expertise in biorepository protocols, best practices for sample handling, and troubleshooting of issues related to sample collection or storage.

• Research Support: Assist in the design and execution of research projects involving the biorepository’s sample collection and management processes. Contribute to scientific publications, presentations, and other research outputs, providing data and insights from biorepository-managed samples.

• Continuous Improvement and Training: Proactively identify areas for process improvement in sample management and recommend strategies to enhance operational efficiency. Stay current with advancements in biorepository management, biosample storage technology, and related regulatory guidelines. Mentor and train junior staff or technicians on best practices in sample handling and database management.

Qualifications:

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Biological Sciences, Biotechnology, Molecular Biology, or a related field (preferred).

• Experience: 0-2 years of experience in a laboratory or biorepository setting, with a focus on sample management, biospecimen processing, and quality assurance. Familiarity with biorepository software and data management tools (e.g., FreezerPro, LabArchives, LabWare, snowflake based database, LIMS, is highly desirable.

• Skills: Strong understanding of biological sample management, including tissue processing, cryopreservation, DNA/RNA extraction, and cell culture. Knowledge of regulatory compliance (HIPAA, GxP, CLIA, IRB). Proficiency in data analysis and database management (e.g., Excel, SPSS, R). Excellent organizational skills with keen attention to detail and accuracy. Ability to troubleshoot technical issues and provide practical solutions. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with researchers and other staff. Experience with laboratory equipment (e.g., freezers, liquid nitrogen tanks, centrifuges) and ensuring proper calibration and maintenance. Experience in SQL, Python Plus.

Working Conditions:

• This position involves working in a controlled laboratory environment with exposure to biological samples, chemicals, and laboratory equipment.

• Candidates must adhere to strict biosafety protocols and wear appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) as required.

• An occasional evening, weekend, or holiday hours may be necessary depending on project

The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.

Remote USA

$23—$25 USD

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

For more information, visit www.natera.com.

Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.

All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

jobs.title: Radiation Safety Officer (RSO)
jobs.description:
Thanks for your interest in Oklo!  We are searching for a Radiation Safety Officer (RSO) to join our team.

This position will be on-site in Idaho Falls, Idaho.

Position Description

Oklo Isotopes is building scalable U.S. radioisotope production capabilities in facilities dedicated to producing essential isotopes for healthcare, space, industry, research, and defense applications. In February 2026, Oklo’s Idaho Radioisotopes Laboratory (IRL) located in Idaho Falls received its Material Possession License from the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) to take a leading role in the manufacturing and distribution of beneficial radioisotopes in the U.S.

We are seeking a Radiation Safety Officer (RSO) to serve as the technical authority for radiation protection activities at the IRL. This role is designed for an experienced Certified Health Physicist (CHP) or an equivalently seasoned radiation protection professional who brings strong technical judgment, operational leadership, and deep expertise in radiation safety program implementation.

The Radiation Safety Officer owns the Radiation Protection Program for IRL and is responsible for ensuring safe, compliant, and efficient radiological operations in support of isotope production, laboratory operations, radioactive material handling, and facility readiness activities. This role combines strategic program leadership with hands-on operational engagement and provides significant influence over facility operations, licensing activities, operational readiness, and long-term safety culture.

Specific responsibilities may include:

• Serve as the designated Radiation Safety Officer with technical authority and accountability for the IRL Radiation Protection Program in accordance with NRC requirements, applicable State regulations, and site procedures.

• Establish, maintain, and enforce radiation protection standards, radiological controls, and operational procedures using sound health physics principles.

• Provide technical oversight and guidance for radioactive material handling, isotope production activities, contamination controls, radioactive waste management, and radiological work planning.

• Lead, mentor, and develop radiation protection personnel, technicians, and operational staff to maintain strong field execution and radiological safety culture.

• Perform and oversee complex radiological evaluations including shielding analyses, dose assessments, contamination control strategies, ALARA planning, and radiological work reviews.

• Integrate radiation protection requirements into facility modifications, operational procedures, commissioning activities, and infrastructure upgrades.

• Serve as the primary technical interface with regulatory authorities during inspections, audits, licensing activities, and regulatory communications.

• Help prepare, review, and approve regulatory documentation, license amendments, corrective action plans, radiological procedures, and radiation safety training programs.

• Lead investigations of radiological events, abnormal occurrences, and operational issues including root cause analysis and corrective action development.

• Support operational readiness, emergency preparedness, and commissioning activities associated with IRL operations.

• Partner with operations, engineering, maintenance, laboratory, and leadership teams to align radiation protection strategies with operational goals and long-term facility objectives.

• Promote operational excellence, procedural compliance, industrial safety, and a strong nuclear safety culture.

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Health Physics, Nuclear Engineering, Radiochemistry, Chemistry, Physics, or a related technical discipline.

• Minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible experience in health physics, radiation safety, or radiological operations within regulated nuclear, isotope production, laboratory, or industrial environments.

• Demonstrated experience implementing and managing radiation protection programs in regulated radiological environments.

• Experience leading or supervising technical staff, including mentoring, training, and professional development.

• Strong working knowledge of NRC regulations, radiation protection principles, ALARA practices, contamination controls, and radiological work planning.

• Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with regulators, senior leadership, and multidisciplinary technical teams.

• Strong technical writing, organizational, problem-solving, and operational decision-making skills.

Bonus Qualifications:

• Certified Health Physicist (CHP) strongly preferred.

• Experience supporting radioisotope production facilities, hot cell operations, gloveboxes, or nuclear laboratory environments.

• Experience supporting startup, commissioning, or operational readiness activities.

• Experience interfacing with NRC inspectors, Agreement State regulators, or external regulatory agencies.

• Familiarity with radioactive material transportation, waste management, and laboratory radiological controls.

Competencies

We are looking for an RSO that is:

• Passionate about unleashing beneficial isotopes

• Committed to operational excellence and nuclear safety culture

• Willing and able to learn quickly

• Eager to work on a dynamic team, receive constructive feedback, and grow with us

• Willing to think differently and do things in new ways

• Comfortable in a fast-paced, highly iterative startup environment

• Excited to think creatively, critically, and reflectively about the problems they are solving

• Willing to propose novel and creative solutions to technical and operational problems

• An excellent writer who can write in modern active voice, so make your cover letter compelling and write it well!

• Detail-oriented and committed to procedural compliance and technical rigor

• Capable of exercising sound judgment and decision-making in radiological and operational environments

Who you are:

A startup person: You aren't driven by titles or hierarchy, and prefer efficiency to excess process. You don't need or expect to have a lot of guidance but you enjoy working in a fast-paced team. If you prefer the culture and feel of a large organization, that is great, but you likely won’t enjoy working with us! There is plenty of important work and plenty of good opportunities with organizations like that.

Motivated: You are self-motivated. You bring an enthusiasm to the team, and imbue a sense of passion that goes beyond clocking in and clocking out. This isn’t about a fake or arbitrary “pieces of flair” mentality or lack of work-life balance! It is about being a part of the vision and feeling a part of reaching team goals.

A team-player: Oklo genuinely is a team. We aren’t about taking credit for ourselves, and we aren’t about pushing blame to others. We do incredible things because we work as a team.

An excellent communicator: We need a person who is not only technically competent but also a clear and upbeat communicator.

Creative: Being creative means that when things fall outside clear scopes or processes or problems arise without clear solutions, you are able to identify it as well as invent ways to solve a problem or fill a need without micromanagement. The successful person in this job will not only be creative, but also enjoy being creative and solving open-ended problems which may change day-by-day.

Detail-oriented: This focus is a big part of excellence, consistency, and quality. Excellent grammar and spelling matter for both good communication as well as the image of the company that we put forward.

About Oklo travel requirements:

Oklo requires remote employees to travel to headquarters (Santa Clara, CA) twice a quarter annually, based on business or team needs, including attendance at team meetings, off-sites, and other company events or gatherings. For the first two weeks of onboarding, employees are required to be in person at headquarters in Santa Clara, CA.

Remote with frequent travel to site as needed may be considered.

About Oklo compensation:

Salary: $120,000-$170,000

Oklo offers flexible time off, equity, bonuses, competitive pay, 401(k), health insurance (with employer contribution), HSA, FSA, flexible work hours, wellness credits, and other benefits.

This position may involve access to information subject to U.S. export control laws. Only applicants who meet the definition of a U.S. person under applicable laws may be eligible.

About Oklo Inc.: Oklo Inc. is developing fast fission power plants to deliver clean, reliable, and affordable energy at scale; establishing a domestic supply chain for critical radioisotopes; and advancing nuclear fuel recycling to convert nuclear waste into clean energy. Oklo was the first to receive a site use permit from the U.S. Department of Energy for a commercial advanced fission plant, was awarded fuel material from Idaho National Laboratory, and submitted the first custom combined license application for an advanced reactor to the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission. Oklo is also developing advanced fuel recycling technologies in collaboration with the U.S. Department of Energy and U.S. National Laboratories.

#CHOP: Oklo’s Values
Collaboration: We go further, together. We bring diverse perspectives, listen actively, and build trust through transparency and respect. We work across disciplines, sharing ownership to turn complex challenges into shared successes.
Humility: We are team players who act for the good of the company and for the world. We are focused on our mission, not personal recognition.
Ownership: We take pride in what we do and how we do it. We are proactive in finding solutions and see tasks through  to completion. We are committed to delivering on our promises to provide clean, reliable, and affordable energy.
Pathfinding: We chart new ground where no path exists by approaching challenges with curiosity, courage, and creativity while navigating ambiguity.

Candidates should be aware that employment may be contingent upon successful completion of a drug screening, and employees may be subject to drug testing at any time in accordance with company policy and applicable laws.

Recruitment Fraud Disclaimer

Oklo is aware of recent recruitment fraud attempts targeting job seekers. Please be cautious of anyone claiming to represent Oklo who does not contact you from an official Oklo email address.

All legitimate communications from our recruiting team— including application updates, interview requests, and job offers — will come exclusively from an @oklo.com email. Oklo will never ask for sensitive personal information, payments, or account credentials during the hiring process.

If you receive suspicious outreach or have concerns about the authenticity of any communication claiming to be from Oklo, please contact us through the official channels listed on our website.

Stepful is a workforce platform redefining how America's largest health systems build, train, and retain their talent. Since our founding in 2021, Stepful’s trained over 32,000 practice-ready healthcare workers.


Layering onto our successful direct-to-consumer training, Stepful partners with leading healthcare institutions to address the growing national shortage of healthcare workers. We’re improving access to quality healthcare for everyone, everywhere, and improving access to healthcare career ladders for those who need them most.


Our students form the talent pipelines for major employers such as NY-Presbyterian, Mt. Sinai, HCA, Providence, CVS, and Walgreens. We have partnerships with half of the top 10 health systems in the US and are in process with many more.


Stepful is backed by Y Combinator, Reach Capital, and AlleyCorp, with a recent $55M Series C led by Oak HC/FT https://www.stepful.com/post/stepful-announces-55m-series-c-to-scale-its-ai-powered-training-platform-across-the-healthcare-workforce. We were named the #1 EdTech company in the U.S. by TIME for 2025 https://www.stepful.com/post/stepful-named-1-edtech-company-in-us-top-10-globally-times-2025-list.



Our values:

 - Care first: We do whatever it takes for our students to succeed.

 - Learn quickly: We test, learn with data, and iterate.

 - Build together: We win when we rely on each other.

The opportunity:

This role is ideal for instructors who are interested in supporting existing cohorts as substitute instructors when coverage is needed, while also being considered for future cohort teaching opportunities as new classes launch.

 

Stepful’s instructor-led programs are designed to support students every step of the way, from preparing for CRCST certification to launching successful careers in the sterile processing field. We’re looking for educators who are excited to deliver high-quality online instruction, foster student confidence, and help learners succeed in a virtual classroom environment.



This is a fully remote, part-time, 1099 contract role.

 - Teach highly-engaging, live, virtual classes over Zoom four times a week
   
   - Classes are held Mon - Thurs, during afternoon hours in EST timezone

 - Provide ongoing support, troubleshoot issues, and prepare and plan for future modules, as needed

 - Support students in understanding Sterile Processing concepts across CRCST exam domains

 - Assess student understanding through assignments, quizzes, and in-class participation

 - Provide timely feedback and targeted remediation to students who are struggling academically or with confidence

 - Document student progress, attendance, and performance in Stepful systems

 - Collaborate with Stepful’s learning team to ensure alignment with program goals and student needs

 - Offer insights to improve the student experience and curriculum delivery



What you’ll bring:

 - 3+ years of professional experience as a Sterile Processing technician

 - Experience teaching, training, tutoring, or instructing students or staff

 - Comfortability teaching live online classes over Zoom

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable using LMS platforms and virtual teaching tools

 - Ability to follow a standardized curriculum while adapting explanations to different learning styles

 - Commitment to inclusive, accessible, and career-focused healthcare education

 - Ability to work 10 hours per week per class, Monday - Thursday



Bonus points if:

 - You have experience teaching Sterile Processing or CRCST exam preparation courses

 - You have experience supporting diverse, underserved, or non-traditional student populations

 - You have experience with online or hybrid education programs

 - You have familiarity with competency-based education



Interview Process:

 - Intro Call with Talent Team

 - Case Study Assignment

 - Final Interview with Hiring Manager


The hourly pay rate for this opportunity is $30.00/hour. Individual pay may vary from the target range and is determined by a number of factors including experience, internal pay equity and other relevant business considerations.



Stepful is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

--

In light of recent hiring scams, if you're selected to move onto the next phase of our hiring process, a member of our Talent Acquisition team will reach out to you directly from an @stepful.com email address to guide you through our interview process.

jobs.title: Financial Accountant
jobs.location: NZ: Wellington: Xero One (19-23 Taranaki St)
jobs.description:
The role and its impact

We're looking for a Financial Accountant to help deliver quality financial information and drive continuous improvement across our Accounting team. You'll be a key contributor to Xero's month-end close process, supporting our financial reporting requirements as a listed issuer. This role is an opportunity to work across multiple aspects of accounting—from balance sheet reconciliations to technical accounting support—while building relationships throughout our business.

 

In this role, you'll develop expertise across the full accounting cycle and take ownership of driving process improvements. You'll have the chance to challenge the status quo, leverage emerging tools responsibly to reduce manual effort, and make a real impact on how we operate. Your work will support Xero's external disclosures, employee equity schemes, and strategic financial projects that help us supercharge small business globally.

 

The team and how they connect

Our Group Accounting team owns accounting functions across Xero worldwide and works closely with Finance, Tax, Treasury, and FP&A. The team is collaborative and supportive, with regular connection points both in-person and virtually. You'll join a diverse team that values professional scepticism, creative problem-solving, and genuine partnership.

 

The team is currently working on

 - Month-end close process and balance sheet reconciliations using integrated finance systems

 - Half-year and annual reporting cycles, including audit support and external disclosures

 - Process improvements and automation opportunities across accounting workflows

 - Implementation of AI tools and emerging technologies to streamline manual processes and improve financial data quality

 

Where and how you can work

This role is based in Wellington, with our accounting team split across Australia and New Zealand. We're flexible with how you work—with office space available and regular team connection days. We balance focused work time with collaborative moments, so you'll have the autonomy to do your best work while staying connected to the team.

 

Here are some of the things we're looking for

 - You'll bring strong technical accounting knowledge, with a Chartered Accountant qualification (or on your way to one).

 - You demonstrate an eye for process improvement and a genuine enthusiasm for finding efficiencies—not just completing tasks, but questioning how things could work better.

 - You have excellent attention to detail, alongside the ability to analyse financial results, spot trends, and communicate your findings with clarity.

jobs.title: Launch Engineer, Fluid Systems (Starship)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

LAUNCH ENGINEER, FLUID SYSTEMS (STARSHIP)

Aggressively paced, constantly evolving, results-focused, real-as-it-gets engineering positions available for the ambitious. We design, build, activate, modify, improve, and maintain the fluid systems that fuel the most powerful rocket in the world. Aimed at pivoting and fixing issues every day, you can plan on having your skills put to the test, having hardware you designed, made, and installed the same day in a development-focused environment. From tens of thousands of gallons per minute of cryogens to tens of pounds per second of high-pressure gas, we develop clever solutions to meet the needs of a demanding launch and test program both today and in the future.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Analyze, design, and build systems that support critical rocket launches and testing

• Cradle-to-grave project ownership through hosting design reviews, project decision justification, equipment procurement, and coordination and assistance of the construction of your ideas

• Design modular hardware capable of being manufactured at volume for future launch sites across the world

• Apply interdisciplinary engineering skills in fields of system-level process design and initial sizing, detailed pressurized fluid and thermal analysis, structural engineering, materials, and component selection, and cost/schedule optimization

• Work directly with technicians and support groups to build your designs, and fix real-world problems on the fly

• Maintain a tight feedback loop with the launch operations team to rapidly alter plans as necessary to meet tight deadlines

• Activate and troubleshoot equipment to achieve design objectives and iterate system maintenance strategies to reduce future downtimes

• Independently evaluate complex problems and arrive at solutions to seemingly impractical problems that best support the program

• Hands-on approach to tackling daily field projects necessary to keep the company launching rockets

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in physics, mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, aerospace engineering, or other engineering discipline

• 1+ years of hands-on build or design experience (internship, club, and competition team experience qualifies)

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Ability to work independently as well as part of a team, take initiative, and communicate effectively

• Ability to rapidly change roles/responsibilities while maintaining a high sense of urgency in a high-paced, challenging work environment

• Willingness to perform other related duties to ensure an efficient and effective work environment

• Experience with quick thinking and problem-solving in stressful situations

• Experience solving challenges posed by short deadlines

• Strong fundamental intuition of fluid and/or structural/mechanical systems

• Creativity to imagine and design for reliability, efficiency, and maintainability from scratch

• General hands-on experience with machining, welding, and other fabrication techniques is a plus

• Experience with instrumentation, testing, data review and analysis, verification against a model

• 3+ years of mechanical, fluids, or thermal design experience in an industrial setting or equivalent

• Experience with high-pressure and cryogenic fluid systems and components

• Experience producing drawings for welders and machine shop fabrication

• Collaborative team player, eager to find the best solution while balancing cost and schedule

• Acute attention to detail, ability to see interactions with other systems to avoid problems

• Intermediate skill level using CAD (NX a plus)

• Ability to verify designs with simplified hand calculations; experience in finite element analysis (FEA) or computational fluid dynamics (CFD) is a plus

• American Society of Mechanical Engineers (ASME) piping and pressure vessel design experience

• Creative and passionate approach to addressing opportunities and challenges, and an enthusiastic, self-motivated, positive can-do attitude

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Ability to respond to emergencies to support priority projects, missions, and launches

• Ability to work extended hours and weekends as needed; flexibility is required

• Ability to work in extreme outdoor environments when needed – heat, cold, wind, rain, etc.

• Ability to work in an environment requiring exposure to fumes, odors, and noise

• Working conditions may be in tight quarters and physical dexterity is required

• Ability to perform job duties that require standing, kneeling, crouching, twisting upper body, working in cramped positions in small openings, and climbing hand over hand

• Ability to lift heavy objects up to 25 lbs. unassisted

• Ability to work on ladders, lifts, and at elevated heights (up to 300 feet) with proper personal protective equipment (PPE)

• Stand: Up to 6 hours per day

• Sit: Up to 6 hours per day

• Push/Pull: Up to ≤ 50 lbs. (unassisted) 15 minutes or less per day

• Overhead reach: Up to 3 hours per day

• Walk: Up to 10 hours per day

• Lift/Carry: Up to ≤ 25 lbs. (unassisted) 15 minutes or less per day

• Climb (ladder/stairs): Up to 1 hour per day

• Kneel/Crouch: Up to 3 hours per day

• Upper body twist: Up to 3 hours per day

• Ability to work in temperatures over 80 degrees 6 hours or greater per day

• Candidate must be capable of safely working at heights (up to 500ft), in confined spaces, operating heavy equipment and machinery, and performing the physical requirements of the job listed in the job description. Candidate may be required to complete a pre-employment questionnaire and/or physical to confirm these capabilities, which may include a medical history review

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

jobs.title: Principal, Field Manager CXQC
jobs.description:
Hut 8 brings exceptional people together to solve the world’s most consequential problems at the intersection of energy and technology. Today, that means building infrastructure for AI at a pace and scale without precedent. Tomorrow, it could mean powering a new era of innovation through robotics, advanced manufacturing, or an industry that does not yet exist. Whatever the technology demands, our ambition holds: to build the defining physical infrastructure company of our generation.

We look for thinkers and builders with the rigor, humility, and ownership to solve problems at this scale. They start from zero and choose truth over tradition. They back the best idea, whatever its source. They bet on themselves and embrace the hard truths that force them to grow. Our commitment is to keep the path from idea to execution short, trust them with critical decisions and the work that follows, and surround them with colleagues whose curiosity extends beyond their expertise.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a Field Manager, CXQC, Principal to support the testing, verification, and turnover of critical infrastructure systems across our data center and mission-critical facility portfolio. This is a hands-on, field-oriented role responsible for executing commissioning programs from pre-functional testing through integrated system verification. The role is project-based, which means assignment locations will vary — candidates must be comfortable with travel and potential relocation to support active project sites across our growing footprint.

Some of the key responsibilities you should expect are the following:

• Execute pre-functional, functional, and integrated system commissioning activities across mechanical, electrical, and controls systems

• Support startup and commissioning of critical infrastructure including UPS systems, generators, switchgear, PDUs, CRAC/CRAH units, chillers, and BMS/EPMS platforms

• Document commissioning activities, test results, deficiencies, and resolutions in accordance with project commissioning plans

• Coordinate closely with general contractors, subcontractors, equipment vendors, and the owner's engineering team to sequence and execute commissioning activities

• Conduct site observations to verify installations are complete and compliant with design drawings and specifications prior to testing

• Identify field deficiencies and work with the project team to drive timely resolution before milestone dates

• Support and ensure readiness for operational turnover

• Maintain accurate, detailed commissioning records including test reports, punch lists, and equipment start-up logs

• Enforce safety protocols and ensure compliance with site-specific safety plans and OSHA standards during all commissioning activities

• Communicate daily progress, issues, and schedule risks to the appropriate project stakeholders

ABOUT YOU

• 2–5 years of hands-on experience in commissioning, startup, or field engineering within data centers, mission-critical facilities, or large-scale infrastructure projects

• Working knowledge of mechanical, electrical, and controls systems common to mission-critical environments (UPS, generators, switchgear, cooling, BMS/EPMS)

• Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, single-line diagrams, and equipment submittals

• Strong understanding of commissioning documentation requirements including test scripts, punch lists, and turnover packages

• Experience coordinating with multiple trades and subcontractors on active construction sites

• Comfortable operating in fast-paced, milestone-driven project environments with shifting priorities

• Detail-oriented with strong written and verbal communication skills — able to produce clear field reports and communicate issues effectively to project stakeholder

• Willingness and ability to travel to project sites; relocation may be required based on project assignment

• OSHA 10 or OSHA 30 certification preferred

• Experience with mission-critical infrastructure commissioning (power, cooling, fiber, telecom) is a strong plus

• Must possess and maintain a valid driver's license; active passport preferred for potential international project assignments

ABOUT THE WORK ENVIRONMENT

This role is project-based and will be assigned to active data center construction and commissioning sites within Hut 8's portfolio. Assignment locations will vary and candidates should expect regular travel with the possibility of extended on-site presence or relocation depending on project needs. Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Automation Test Engineer to design, build, and maintain automated test suites for a consumer data-processing platform. The platform includes an Angular and Spring Boot management application, batch pipelines, and Oracle-backed workflows. You will own end-to-end UI automation, regression and smoke suites, and the containerized test infrastructure that runs them in CI/CD.

Roles and Responsibilities

UI and End-to-End Automation

• Design and maintain Playwright E2E test suites for Angular screens, covering navigation, forms, grids, filters, exports, and button-driven actions.
• Build page objects, screen orchestrators, and centralized locator libraries so tests stay maintainable as screens change.
• Maintain legacy Selenium WebDriver regression and smoke suites, and plan their migration to Playwright where it adds value.
• Validate role-based access and LDAP-protected screens across environments.

Unit, Component, and API Testing

• Write and review Jest unit tests for Angular components and services, using MSW (Mock Service Worker) to mock backend APIs.
• Maintain JUnit 5 and JaCoCo test coverage for Spring Boot REST controllers, services, and repositories.
• Create API-level checks for REST endpoints, including request validation, error handling, and session behavior.
• Maintain BDD scenarios with Behave for batch and data-validation workflows.

Regression, Smoke, and Data Validation

• Develop and run regression and smoke suites that validate production-readiness after each release.
• Write Oracle SQL to verify data completeness, reconciliation, and business-rule outcomes after batch runs.
• Validate job submission, status transitions, and output files produced by KSH-orchestrated pipelines.
• Maintain test datasets and environment setup and teardown routines for repeatable runs.

Test Infrastructure and CI/CD

• Build and maintain Docker images for Playwright, Maven, and regression test runners.
• Integrate test suites into GitHub Actions workflows, including pull request gates and release-branch checks.
• Maintain Bash and KSH scripts for test orchestration, environment preparation, and report collection.
• Publish test reports and coverage to SonarQube and manage test artifacts through Artifactory.
• Support test execution across Dev, QA, UAT, and production-like environments.

Quality Strategy and Collaboration

• Define test strategies, risk-based coverage plans, and acceptance criteria with product owners and developers.
• Triage failing tests, distinguish test defects from product defects, and drive root-cause analysis.
• Track coverage, flakiness, and defect trends, and act on them to improve suite reliability.
• Review automation code from peers and mentor engineers on test design and framework practices.

Document test strategies, framework usage, and execution procedures

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of professional experience in test automation for web and backend systems.
• Hands-on experience with Playwright (any language binding) for E2E UI automation, or strong Selenium WebDriver experience with a willingness to adopt Playwright.
• Solid experience with Jest or a similar JavaScript/TypeScript unit testing framework, including mocking with MSW or equivalent.
• Experience with JUnit 5 and Maven or Gradle for Java-based test suites.
• Working knowledge of Docker for containerized test execution.
• Experience with GitHub Actions or a similar CI/CD platform.
• Strong SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, and reconciliation queries; Oracle experience preferred.
• Proficiency with Linux and shell scripting (Bash or KSH) for test orchestration.
• Solid understanding of test design techniques, regression strategy, and defect lifecycle management.
• Clear written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Angular applications and their testing patterns.
• Experience with Spring Boot applications and JaCoCo coverage reporting.
• Familiarity with Behave (BDD) or Cucumber.
• Experience with Selenium Grid or cloud-based browser execution.
• Experience with SonarQube, Artifactory, or similar quality and artifact tooling.
• Exposure to performance testing tools such as JMeter, Locust, or k6.
• Knowledge of consumer panel data, retail measurement, or analytics-delivery platforms.
• Familiarity with GitHub Copilot or other AI-assisted test-generation tools.

Our Benefits

• Flexible working environment
• Volunteer time off
• LinkedIn Learning
• Employee-Assistance-Program (EAP)

jobs.title: Chip Simulation Software Intern
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Senior Strategic Account Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
About MISUMI Americas

MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.

Impact In This Role

As the Senior Strategic Account Marketing Lead at MISUMI Americas, you will work side by side with the sales reps who own your assigned accounts. You will take their account plans, what customers are telling us, and our revenue goals, and turn them into practical, creative marketing campaigns. These campaigns should spark engagement, create and move deals forward, and strengthen customer relationships.

This is not a role for a single-channel specialist. You will build and lead growth plans for each account, using both hands-on and large-scale tactics. These include customer visits, lunch-and-learns, direct mail and swag, executive outreach, events, targeted email and nurture programs, paid ads, sales support materials, and account-specific content. You do not have to create every asset or run every channel yourself. You do need to pick the right mix, bring in the right partners, and see the work through to results you can measure.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Become a trusted, proactive marketing partner to the Account Executives and sales leaders for a named portfolio of Strategic and Key Accounts. Maintain a regular operating cadence with each seller to understand account priorities, opportunities, whitespace, risks, and next steps.

• Translate account plans, account research, buyer and buying-group insights, intent signals, opportunity data, and customer engagement into focused account-growth strategies and quarterly activation plans.

• Own the end-to-end planning, orchestration, and execution of 1:1, 1:few, and 1:many account marketing programs. Select the right mix of high-touch and scalable tactics based on the account objective, buying stage, audience, and expected impact.

• Develop creative, practical account plays that help Sales earn attention and create momentum. Examples include customer-office visits, lunch-and-learns, executive meetings, local customer experiences, direct mail and swag, targeted events, customer workshops, outbound support, account-specific content, and digital nurture programs.

• Partner with Lifecycle, Performance Marketing, Field and Events, Content, Product Marketing, Design, Sales Development, and external vendors to activate cohesive campaigns. Write clear briefs, establish ownership and timelines, resolve blockers, and ensure every program is delivered to a high bar.

• Work with Web, Lifecycle and Performance Marketing to create and optimize targeted email, nurture, retargeting, paid media, landing-page, and audience programs for assigned accounts when those tactics will advance the account objective.

• Drive customers and prospects to MISUMI Americas events and create thoughtful pre-event, onsite, and post-event account plans that convert event participation into meaningful sales follow-up and pipeline progress.

• Work with Content and PMMs to build the sales enablement required for each activation, including messaging, outreach guidance, follow-up plans, templates, snippets, talking points, and clear seller actions. Ensure Sales understands the plan and follows through.

• Manage assigned program budgets and vendors with an ROI mindset. Test, learn, reallocate investment, and know when to stop, revise, or scale an account play.

• Use Salesforce, Marketo, Reachdesk, Sigma, intent data, account engagement data, and other available signals to identify opportunity, prioritize investment, and measure impact. Maintain a clear view of account engagement, buying-group reach, opportunity creation and progression, pipeline, conversion, velocity, win rate, and revenue influence.

• Share account-level learnings, results, and recommendations with Sales and Marketing. Turn successful plays into repeatable programs and quickly address underperforming tactics.

• Execute directly when speed and quality require it. This role is expected to be a hands-on operator, not solely a strategist, coordinator, or requester of work from other teams.

• Travel to customer offices, MISUMI Americas events, industry events, and internal meetings when in-person engagement can accelerate an account objective.

How We’ll Measure Success

Success in this role is measured by business impact and sales-partner effectiveness, not campaign activity alone. In the first year, this person will:

• Establish productive working relationships and a clear account-growth cadence with the sellers for their assigned Strategic and Key Accounts.

• Deliver account plans and integrated activations that are directly tied to seller priorities, customer needs, and pipeline goals.

• Increase meaningful engagement with priority contacts and buying groups, create or advance qualified opportunities, and contribute to pipeline progression, opportunity velocity, win rate, and revenue across the supported portfolio.

• Build repeatable, data-informed account plays that combine high-touch experiences with scalable lifecycle and performance tactics.

• Earn a reputation with Sales and Marketing for creativity, responsiveness, sound judgment, operational follow-through, and measurable impact.

What Makes This Role Different

This role sits at the intersection of account strategy, field execution, digital activation, and sales partnership. It is not limited to digital marketing, paid media, event production, project management, or account research. Candidates must bring broad marketing judgment and be comfortable moving between customer-facing experiences, account-specific campaigns, and scaled programs.

The role owns the account marketing strategy, activation plan, cross-functional orchestration, seller adoption, and performance readout for the assigned portfolio. Channel and functional teams provide their specialized expertise; this role brings those capabilities together into the right account solution and owns the outcome.

Desired Traits

• 8+ years of B2B marketing experience in account-based marketing, strategic account marketing, field marketing, demand generation, or a closely related revenue-marketing role.

• Demonstrated experience partnering directly with enterprise, strategic, or key-account sellers to build and execute account plans that contributed to pipeline, opportunity progression, and revenue.

• Proven ability to develop and execute integrated campaigns across both high-touch and digital channels, including customer events or experiences, direct mail or gifting, sales outreach support, email or nurture, paid or performance programs, and content.

• Track record of taking programs from insight and strategy through detailed execution, optimization, and performance reporting.

• Strong commercial judgment and comfort prioritizing a portfolio of accounts against revenue opportunity, sales priorities, and expected return on investment.

• Customer-facing confidence and experience representing Marketing in seller and customer conversations, including onsite engagements when appropriate.

• Excellent cross-functional project leadership. Able to write clear briefs, align stakeholders, build realistic workback plans, resolve ambiguity, and keep multiple time-sensitive programs moving.

• Analytical fluency and experience using CRM, marketing automation, account engagement, and intent data to make decisions and measure results. Salesforce and Marketo experience strongly preferred.

• Strong written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.

• Comfort in a fast-moving environment where the right play is not always obvious and initiative matters.

• Ability to travel up to 25% within the U.S. for customer-office visits, MISUMI | Fictiv events, industry events, and internal meetings.

Preferred Traits

• Experience marketing to complex B2B buying groups in a technical, industrial, manufacturing, or supply-chain environment.

• Experience with ABM platforms, intent-data tools, audience development, and account-level reporting.

• Experience producing or supporting executive programs, customer workshops, lunch-and-learns, field events, and direct-mail or gifting programs.

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

Physical Traits

The physical demands described here are representative of those an employee must meet to successfully perform the essential functions of this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform these functions.

While performing the duties of this role, the employee routinely is required to sit, walk, talk, hear, use hands to keyboard and handle objects, and occasionally stoop, kneel, crouch, twist, crawl, reach, and stretch.

Ability to travel up to 25% within the U.S. for customer-office visits, MISUMI Americas events, industry events, and internal meetings in Oakland, CA and Schaumburg, IL.

Perks and Benefits

• Competitive medical, dental, and vision insurance

• 401K plan

• Parental leave programs

• Paid volunteer days

• And much, much more!

Salary Range: $130,000 to $160,000 per year, based upon experience

Interested in learning more?  We look forward to hearing from you soon.

We’re actively seeking teammates who:

• Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company.

• Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team.

• Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth.

• Have an ‘always learning’ mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins.

• Help us continue to build a world-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates

We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.

Inclusion & Diversity:

H&M Fashion USA, Inc. – Maki Assessment Tool:

We use an online assessment tool called Maki for skills-based selection of applicants for sales advisor positions within some of our stores. Maki is not an automated decision-making tool. Rather, it is a tool that uses an AI-created avatar to present to you a set of multiple-choice questions. These questions are prepared by the H&M hiring team to assess candidates’ ability to perform the duties of the position for which they are applying. The assessment calculates your total score based on predefined point values provided by our H&M team. The hiring team will review your whole application, including your assessment score, to decide whether to advance each candidate to the next stage. Doing the assessment is optional. If you choose to complete the assessment, your score will be one factor that the hiring team considers.

If you have any difficulties or concerns with the online assessment method, you can request an alternative method of assessment by contacting recruitment_support@hm.com. Choosing an alternative method will not affect your chances of being considered for the position, nor does any assessment method provide an advantage or disadvantage in the selection process. You will have the opportunity to provide optional feedback immediately after the assessment and you may always ask questions.

We do not sell the information captured in the questionnaire and do not use any personal information to train any AI models. Our applicant tracking system provider has access to this information but is contractually prohibited from using it for any other purpose.
