jobs.title: Regional CDL A Driver
jobs.description:
Position Overview

Safely operate a company commercial motor vehicle (CMV) on established routes to deliver and unload products while providing outstanding customer service to Domino’s store locations. This position may also include yard duties, such as shuttling tractors and trailers, repositioning trailers within the yard, and backing trailers to dock doors.

Responsibilities and Duties

Drive, Deliver, and Unload Product

•    Safely operate assigned trucks on designated routes to deliver products to Domino’s stores, either independently or as part of a team. Overnight travel may be required.

•    Safely unload dough trays and products using side or rear lift gates, transfer dough to dollies as needed, and handle roll carts with rear lift gate systems.

•    Verify dough, trailer, and store cooler temperatures at each stop and ensure delivery accuracy.

•    Rotate existing inventory and place delivered products in the appropriate cooler areas.

•    Return empty trays, cages, and carts to the Supply Chain Center.

•    Reposition and secure remaining products, trays, and carts within the trailer after each delivery.

•    Deliver professional customer service and address customer concerns promptly.

•    Perform additional duties as assigned, including warehouse support, trailer loading, yard operations, or other business-related tasks.

•    Comply with Domino’s policies and procedures, including the Transportation Safety policy, DrOP Manual, Department of Transportation (DOT) regulations, and applicable local, state, and federal laws.

•    Adhere to Domino’s uniform and appearance standards.

Administrative and Safety Compliance

•    Verify and secure loads prior to dispatch.

•    Ensure required safety equipment is present and in proper working conditions before dispatch.

•    Conduct pre-trip and post-trip inspections and perform basic vehicle maintenance, including refueling, visual inspections, and reporting maintenance concerns.

•    Complete required safety training, testing, and meetings by established deadlines.

•    Comply with electronic logging device (ELD) and DOT requirements.

•    Maintain accountability for assigned vehicle, product, and equipment.

•    Complete required documentation, including DVIRs, trip sheets, load assessment forms, and other records, in compliance with company policies and DOT regulations.

•    Accurately record all hours worked using the Company timekeeping system in accordance with Company policies and procedures.

•    High School Diploma or GED required.

•    Must be at least 21 years of age.

•    Minimum six months of verifiable CMV driving experience; one year preferred.

•    Valid Class A Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) with Air Brake endorsement required.

•    Must maintain a valid DOT Medical Certificate.

•    Must maintain eligibility to operate a Company vehicle by meeting all Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) requirements.

•    Strong navigation skills and proficiency using GPS and route-planning applications.

•    Effective time management and organizational skills.

•    Excellent communication and customer service skills.

•    Must successfully pass a DOT physical examination.

•    Must successfully pass a background check every three years in accordance with Company policy.

•    Must successfully complete and pass required drug screenings and submit to required screening and testing when scheduled, where applicable.

•    Must be able to work around yeast and flour

Physical Requirements & Working Conditions

Must be able to stand, walk, and climb stairs for extended periods; regularly lift 50 lbs., push, and pull products and equipment weighing up to 500 lbs.; and perform repetitive physical tasks throughout the workday. Frequent bending, kneeling, twisting, reaching, and climbing in and out of tractor-trailer cabs.

Must be able to safely operate and maneuver hand trucks, liftgates, and other material-handling equipment in support of loading, unloading, and delivery activities.

Work is performed in a variety of environments, including refrigerated areas (33°F to 38°F), outdoor settings in varying weather conditions, and loud machinery and equipment. Drivers must safely perform job duties in accordance with Company safety policies and procedures and wear all required personal protective equipment (PPE).

Dispatch Time:  drivers dispatch out from 4:00 p.m. to 2:00 a.m.

Domino's offers:

• Positive work environment!
• Competitive wages
• Paid Holidays and Vacation
• Benefits on first day of employment!
• 401k matching contributions
• 15% off the purchase price of stock
• Company bonus
• Safety bonus
• Referral bonuses

jobs.title: Global Hotel Partnerships Manager (East Coast based)
jobs.description:
With millions of diners, 70,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable, part of Booking Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most – their team, their guests, and their bottom line – while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion.

Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture.

About the Job

We are seeking a high-impact relationship builder to own and grow OpenTable's most strategic hotel partnerships worldwide. As the Global Hotel Partnerships Manager, you will be the primary architect of OpenTable's relationships with the world's leading hotel brands and management groups — sitting at the critical intersection of business development, product evolution, and global operations.

You will manage a portfolio of high-value, Tier-1 hotel partnerships, leading complex global negotiations, driving adoption of OpenTable's technology suite, and ensuring our products are seamlessly integrated into the world's most prestigious hotel portfolios. Success in this role means growing revenue and retention through a consultative, data-driven approach while serving as the connective tissue between partner executives, their technical teams, and OpenTable's internal functions.

This is a remote position, with a preference for candidates based on the East Coast. The role requires up to 25% domestic and international travel.

Responsibilities

• Act as the primary relationship owner for Tier-1 global hotel partners (e.g., Marriott, Hilton, Four Seasons, IHG), overseeing relationship health, retention, and revenue growth across regions.

• Lead end-to-end negotiation and contracting for global service agreements, co-marketing contracts, and technical addendums, structuring terms that maximize strategic value across diverse markets.

• Develop and execute profitability and revenue strategies that exceed growth and retention goals — including auditing financial structures such as rebate programs and implementing pricing models that increase average partner revenue.

• Drive global adoption of high-value features and products, including OpenTable Pro, Private Dining Instant Booking, and Automated Guest Codes.

• Serve as the bridge between partner technical teams and OpenTable Engineering to deploy API products (e.g., Sync, CRM, Booking), and navigate enterprise-level security audits, SSO implementation, SOC 2 reporting, and complex data privacy requirements.

• Build consensus across cross-functional teams (Product, Engineering, Legal, Finance, Sales Ops) to align contract terms, product requests, and account plans, and provide end-to-end support for product releases and the subsequent go-to-market strategy.

• Prepare and lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and "Year in Review" performance audits for C-suite stakeholders, and design sales enablement and training materials that equip leadership and account management with hotel expertise.

• Represent OpenTable at major industry trade shows and conferences, presenting on topics meaningful to the global travel and hospitality industry.

• Own the administrative side of the partnership, including documentation of client engagement in Salesforce, stewardship of hotel-specific resource sites, and strategic communication flows.

• The role requires up to 25% domestic and international travel.

Minimum Qualifications

• 5+ years of relevant experience in account management, strategic partnerships, or business development, ideally within the hospitality or travel technology sector.

• Proven track record of owning and growing a portfolio of high-value accounts or partners against pre-set objectives.

• Exceptional relationship-building skills, with the ability to cultivate internal and external stakeholders at the Executive and VP levels.

• Technical literacy: comfort discussing API infrastructure, data mapping, and system integrations fluently with engineering teams.

• Strong analytical rigor, using data to build business cases and resolve technical or business roadblocks.

• Self-starter who is comfortable taking full ownership in an unstructured, forward-thinking environment, with strong time management and comfort handling administrative tasks.

• College degree required.

Preferred Qualifications

• Global mindset, with experience working within and representing a global organization across multiple time zones and cultures.

• Deep industry knowledge of the hospitality and hotel-technology ecosystem.

• Experience navigating ambiguous legal and financial structures and complex, multi-stakeholder procurement processes.

• Proficiency in Salesforce, Google Suite, and Microsoft Office.

• This is a remote position, with a preference for candidates based on the East Coast.

Benefits and Perks

• Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year

• Focus on mental health and well-being:

• Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth

• Company-paid subscription to Headspace

• Annual company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)

• Paid parental leave

• Generous paid vacation + time off for your birthday

• Paid volunteer time

• Focus on your career growth:

• Development Dollars

• Leadership development

• Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings

• Travel Discounts

• Employee Resource Groups

• Competitive retirement and health plans

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer, Launch Mount/Tower (Starship)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

MECHANICAL ENGINEER, LAUNCH MOUNT/TOWER (STARSHIP)

As a mechanical engineer, you will develop the Starship Tower, Launch Mount, and test stands from system architecture through design, analysis, manufacturing, integration, activation, and operations. You will design welded structures, large-scale mechanisms, electromechanical and fluid-power actuators, and hydraulic and cryogenic systems that support stage testing, vehicle stacking, propellant loading, T-0 release, catching both stages, and rapid safing for reflight. In a program built on fast iteration, the launch mount and tower team’s goal is a ZERO-refurbishment pad that can launch one vehicle and be ready to launch again immediately.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Drive hardware development for systems within the Starship tower, launch mount and test stands from basic architecture through design, analysis, scheduling, manufacturing, activation, and operational phases

• Own design and manufacturing of mechanisms, actuation systems, fluid systems, and large structures

• Perform structural, dynamic, thermal, and fluid analysis as necessary to determine requirements and to optimize the design of these systems

• Work closely with software and operations engineers to develop the concept of operations for launch mount systems with the goal of developing robust, fault-tolerant systems and software that perform every time in the varying extreme conditions of a launch environment

• Collaborate with engineers designing the Starship and Super Heavy vehicles to determine how the tower, launch mount, and vehicle can work together most effectively

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline

• 1+ years of experience with CAD and FEA software packages

• 1+ years of experience with mechanical or fluid systems design, analysis, and hands-on assembly (internship or project team experience qualify)

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Master’s degree in engineering or a related technical discipline

• 3+ years of professional experience in mechanical design and analysis

• 2+ years of hands-on project experience with complex mechanical systems, preferably as a lead

• Solid understanding and application of GD&T and manufacturing techniques

• Demonstrated understanding of structural analysis and failure modes of complex mechanical systems and weldments

• Self-motivated with strong organizational, written, and oral communication skills

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Tower and launch mount hardware is typically built in tight quarters at high elevations, and physical dexterity is required

• Ability to work extended hours and weekends as necessary

• Stand: Up to 6 hours per day

• Sit: Up to 6 hours per day

• Push/Pull: Up to ≤ 50 lbs. (unassisted) 15 minutes or less per day

• Overhead reach: Up to 3 hours per day

• Walk: Up to 10 hours per day

• Lift/Carry: Up to ≤ 25 lbs. (unassisted) 15 minutes or less per day

• Climb (ladder/stairs): Up to 10 hours per day

• Kneel/Crouch: Up to 3 hours per day

• Upper body twist: Up to 3 hours per day

• Ability to work in temperatures over 80 degrees 6 hours or greater per day

• Candidate must be capable of safely working at heights (up to 500ft), in confined spaces, using an air purifying respirator, operating heavy equipment and machinery, and performing the physical requirements of the job listed in the job description Candidate may be required to complete a pre-employment questionnaire and/or physical to confirm these capabilities, which may include a medical history review

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

jobs.location: Nashville, Tennessee; Atlanta, Georgia; Louisville, Kentucky
jobs.description:
Paychex is reimagining how businesses manage their workforce by bringing payroll, HR, benefits, and advisory services together into a single connected HCM platform. As Paychex and Paycor come together, we're combining innovative technology, data-driven insights, AI, and human expertise to help organizations work smarter, support their people, and achieve better business outcomes. This is an exciting time to join our team as we continue to invest in innovation, simplify client experiences, and shape the future of work. At Paychex, you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, make a meaningful impact, and be part of something bigger as One Paychex.
Overview

Helps manage our PEO workers' compensation program by implementing safety and risk control services to our PEO client base via onsite and telephonic communication. Provide guidance to clients on safety laws, accident prevention, inspection, and record-keeping requirements. In addition, assist sales and underwriting departments with determination of safety standards and support in the underwriting review process of potential clients. Provides a valuable safety services to our PEO clients assisting them in controlling workplaces injuries to ensure continued client workers' compensation profitability.

Responsibilities

• Performs on going risk and safety management service to PEO clients to ensure they are complying with prior safety recommendation and safety action plan via onsite and telephonic communication. Provides clients with guidance on applicable OSHA and government regulations to promote safe work environments. Review Workers’ Compensation class code assignment at client and employee levels to ensure appropriate classification and wage level to ensure adequate premium collection.
• Performs initial client workers’ compensation and safety orientations to inform the clients of the risk services provided and to discuss the client’s responsibilities in the PEO relationship. Compares the business operations to those provided during the initial underwriting process to confirm classification and to determine if the risk level of the company is within Paychex risk appetite.
• Conducts on-site prospect assessments to gather additional workers’ compensation risk management information to aid in the underwriting decision process of new PEO prospects.
• Develops client and site specific Safety Program Manuals for PEO clients to assist them with controlling workplace injuries and complying with state and federal regulations.
• Monitors client’s workers’ compensation claim experience and perform accident investigations as requested. Works with PEO client companies to implement corrective measures to mitigate the exposure.
• Conducts client/ management/supervisory safety training to mitigate workplace exposure and to support Occupational Safety and Regulatory Compliance. Act as the client’s management resource regarding Risk Management topics issues to assist clients with managing their safety programs.
• Documents the results of all client interactions in accordance with department guidelines.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Digital Distribution
jobs.description:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Senior Manager, Digital Distribution
San Mateo, CA | Hybrid (quarterly onsite weekly syncs)

Role Summary:

The Direct-to-Consumer (D2C) division is responsible for PlayStation Store’s digital content distribution strategy and revenue growth. Within this, the Digital Games Monetization (DGM) team plays a critical role in shaping the commercial strategy, optimizing content performance, and driving engagement across the PlayStation ecosystem.

The Senior Manager, Digital Games Monetization will be instrumental in developing and executing commercial strategies that maximize revenue and digital share for independent publishers. This role requires a data-driven, entrepreneurial, and commercially focused individual who understands content and customer lifecycle planning. The ideal candidate will be comfortable leveraging insights and data to drive business decisions, and working collaboratively across cross-functional teams, including working directly with our most strategic publishers.

This is a unique opportunity to contribute to PlayStation’s digital growth by applying data-informed strategies, innovative monetization techniques, and forward-thinking commercial plans!

What You’ll Be Doing:

• Own and execute digital monetization strategies for the platforms most strategic publishers, focusing on revenue growth, engagement, and lifecycle planning.

• Develop and optimize customer lifecycle strategies, ensuring key titles have strong visibility, promotional support, and long-term commercial success.

• Leverage data and insights to inform pricing, promotional strategies, and content roadmaps that maximize sales and engagement.

• Create and manage rolling product lifecycle plans for key titles, ensuring they align with broader DGS business objectives.

• Partner with key publishers to secure content for PlayStation Store promotions, live service initiatives, and new release roadmaps.

• Analyze market trends, player behavior, and competitive insights to refine digital sales strategies and uncover new revenue opportunities.

• Drive collaboration between internal teams, including Global Partner and Developer Relations, Marketing, Store Operations, and Data Analytics—to ensure seamless execution of monetization strategies.

• Support forecasting and business performance analysis, delivering data-backed recommendations to leadership on portfolio trends and opportunities.

• Monitor and optimize digital storefront visibility and merchandising strategies to improve content discoverability and conversion.

• Contribute to the evolution of PlayStation Store’s best practices, sharing insights that enhance monetization strategies across the business.

What We’re Looking For:

• 7+ years of experience in digital retail, gaming, or digital entertainment industries.

• Proven ability to analyze data and apply insights to drive revenue growth and business strategy.

• Strong commercial acumen, with experience in digital content sales, pricing, and promotions.

• Deep understanding of content lifecycle planning and how customer behavior evolves over time.

• Entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to identify opportunities and drive innovative monetization strategies.

• Ability to manage multiple projects and balance priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Demonstrated leadership experience, including coaching, mentoring, or directly managing team members, with the ability to balance strategic leadership and hands-on execution.

• Experience working cross-functionally, influencing internal and external stakeholders to align on shared business objectives.

• Excellent communication and negotiation skills, with a proactive and results-driven approach.

• Familiarity with digital distribution platforms and industry trends in gaming and entertainment.

• Ability to travel internationally, as needed.

#LI-SF1

At SIE, we consider several factors when setting each role’s base pay range, including the competitive benchmarking data for the market and geographic location.

Please note that the base pay range may vary in line with our hybrid working policy and individual base pay will be determined based on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location.

In addition, this role is eligible for SIE’s top-tier benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, matching 401(k), paid time off, wellness program and coveted employee discounts for Sony products. This role also may be eligible for a bonus package. Click here to learn more.

jobs.title: Senior Payroll Systems Specialist
jobs.location: NZ: Wellington: Xero One (19-23 Taranaki St)
jobs.description:
The role & impact

Payroll only feels simple when the systems behind it work well. In this role, you'll own the platforms, integrations and reports that keep payroll running reliably for Xeros across Australia, New Zealand, the US, Canada and the UK. You'll look after configuration and access, turn what the Pay team needs into clear requirements, and see each change through from testing to launch.

You'll also help us rethink how payroll work gets done. By tracing recurring errors back to their cause and redesigning whole workflows with automation and AI (with people still checking the results), you'll cut manual reconciliation and give the Pay team time back. The Pay team stays accountable for payroll operations and policy, while you own the systems and technical delivery that support them.



The team & how they connect

You'll join the PX Systems team in Employee Lifecycle and Experience, a new team that's shaping how it works as it grows. You'll be the team's payroll specialist, alongside colleagues who look after our other people systems. Day to day, you'll work closely with Pay, Finance, Technology and our vendors, sharing context openly and making technical topics easy for everyone to follow.



Initially, the role will focus on

 - Mapping our payroll systems, integrations, access and controls across ADP, Infinet Cloud, Ramco, Tray and Workday, so everyone shares one clear picture of what's working and what isn't.

 - Agreeing a ranked backlog with Pay, Finance, Technology and vendors, including existing Workday items.

 - Fixing a recurring issue or high-friction workflow early, then showing what improved and how it will be supported.

 - Reducing manual reconciliation and journal errors using automation and AI tools such as Claude, Glean, Rovo and Jira Service Management automation.



Where and how you can work

This role is hybrid and based in Melbourne, Sydney or Wellington. There are no set office days, so you and your team will agree a rhythm that suits you and the work. As a new team, you'll have a real say in how we collaborate, both in person and online.



Here are some of the things we are looking for

 - You bring hands-on payroll systems experience, from configuration and administration to technical support, plus a good grasp of how payroll processes, controls and system dependencies fit together.

 - Tracing a data flow from end to end comes naturally to you, whether that's mapping integrations, troubleshooting errors or finding the root cause so problems stay fixed.

 - You'll Go Bold by rethinking whole workflows rather than patching single steps, using automation and AI where they help and keeping people in the loop for checks.

 - Explaining technical changes in plain language and keeping Pay, Finance, Technology and vendors on the same page is how you Go Together.

 - To Go Further, you take system changes from requirements through testing, documentation and launch, and build reports that people can trust.

 - Understanding payroll in more than one of our regions (Australia, New Zealand, the US, Canada or the UK) helps, and familiarity with ADP, Infinet Cloud, Ramco, Tray or Workday is a bonus.



Apply even if your experience isn't a perfect match! At Xero, we hire based on your skills, passion, and the unique perspective you can bring to enhance our culture and team.



Xero uses AI to help screen applications based on job-related qualifications. These tools assist our recruiters but do not make automated hiring decisions. A real human recruiter reviews all candidates before any hiring action is taken.

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer, Data Centers - Remote (U.S.)
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking to hire a highly skilled Senior Mechanical Engineer for the Data Center and Mission Critical team for our east region. The ideal candidate for this position should be familiar with the tech sector, mission critical and data center industry, understanding the requirements of scale, speed, and consistency in data centers.

This position offers the flexibility of a remote work schedule and can be based from a variety of locations in the US where AECOM has an office.

Although the position is primarily remote periodic travel may be required for client meetings, key project milestones, onsite collaboration sessions, or other business‑critical activities. Travel is expected to be occasional and scheduled in advance

AECOM is a leader in the global data center consulting industry with robust teams in the Americas, Europe, Africa, Asia, and Australia.  In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with our teams around the world on high-profile, fast-paced data center projects for global clients.  This is a hands-on, client-facing role with an opportunity for upward career mobility.

Responsibilities, required experience, and qualifications are summarized below:

Responsibilities:

• Data Center Heat Rejection and HVAC System Design: Developing and designing Heat Rejection and HVAC systems specifically tailored for data centers, considering factors such as type of cooling requirement as air cooled or direct fluid cooled, associated cooling loads, future flexibility of the system to accommodate variable heat distribution scenarios, phased construction and operation, airflow management, humidity control, system redundancy providing concurrent maintainability, energy efficiency, and compliance with industry standards and best practices.
• Cooling System Selection: Selecting appropriate air/water side cooling systems for data centers, including Fan wall units, computer room air handlers (CRAHs), chilled water systems, DX systems and CRAC units, in-row cooling, and containment solutions, based on the specific cooling requirements of the data center and the criticality of the equipment.
• Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) Analysis: Conducting internal CFD simulations to optimize airflow distribution, transient period analysis, identify hotspots, and ensure efficient cooling throughout the data center. Conducting external CFD on individual buildings and/or campus-wide to simulate effects of different electrical and mechanical components on each other and effects on design day selection criteria capacity of each component. For both types, prepare and/or direct preparation of models and analyse the results to recommend design modifications and optimize the Heat rejection and HVAC system performance. Coordinate the required changes and resulting effects with other trades on project.
• Redundancy and Fault Tolerance: Designing HVAC systems with redundancy and fault-tolerant features to ensure continuous operation of the data center in the event of equipment failure or maintenance activities. This includes the design of backup cooling systems, automatic switchover mechanisms, and monitoring systems.
• Heat Load Calculation and Capacity Planning: Performing heat load calculations for data centers to determine the cooling requirements based on the IT equipment, power density, anticipated growth, and phasing of the construction and operational steps. Conducting capacity planning to ensure the HVAC system can accommodate future expansions and upgrades. Performing HVAC loads for admin and common sections of the facility.
• Energy Efficiency and Sustainability: Implementing energy-efficient HVAC design strategies, such as utilizing economizers, variable speed drives, energy recovery systems, and optimizing airflow management techniques, to minimize energy consumption and support sustainability initiatives.
• Air Quality and Filtration: Ensuring the data center's air quality is maintained at optimal levels by designing appropriate filtration systems and implementing air quality monitoring mechanisms. Addressing concerns related to particulate matter, humidity control, and contaminant removal to protect sensitive IT equipment.
• Coordination with Electrical and Mechanical Systems: Collaborating with electrical engineers and mechanical engineers to integrate the heat rejection and HVAC system seamlessly with the electrical infrastructure, UPS systems, emergency power systems, fire suppression systems, and other critical infrastructure components.

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor's Degree with 8+ years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and or education.
• Experience in data center mechanical and electrical equipment installation and operation.
• P. E. registration is required.

Preferred Qualifications:

• A bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, HVAC engineering, or a related field from an accredited university is typically required. Preference would be given to candidates with a master's degree or advanced coursework in HVAC systems or energy management.
• Knowledge of data center TER Standard Topology as per Uptime Institute, TIA 942, ANSI/BICSI 002
• Professional certifications related to HVAC engineering, such as Certified Energy Manager (CEM), Building Energy Modeling Professional (BEMP), or Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED) accreditation, would be advantageous.

• We are interested in every qualified candidate eligible to work in the United States. Permanent residency sponsorship is available for current H1-B visa holders in the United States.
• Relocation assistance may be available for candidates interested in working from our Arlington, VA office.

jobs.title: Construction Project Manager (Starship Launch Pad)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

CONSTRUCTION PROJECT MANAGER (STARSHIP LAUNCH PAD)

The construction project manager coordinates all on-site construction activities and supervises all field personnel as required to successfully complete the project on schedule and within budget. This includes maintaining the highest level of quality and supervising all trade and field personnel, while also administering good construction safety practices with all on-site activities. They also maintain the job site and close out the project. This position is based in Starbase, Texas (Brownsville/South Padre Island Area).

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Manage all aspects of multidisciplinary construction projects, both as an administrator and in the field

• Direct all field personnel to achieve completion of the project on schedule, within budget, and with quality workmanship that conforms to the original plans and specifications

• Resolve design and construction conflicts in real-time in the field

• Promote job site safety, encourage safe work practices, and rectify job site hazards immediately

• Oversee and own the full lifecycle of projects to achieve on-time and under-budget delivery with customer satisfaction. The following project management responsibilities apply:

• Provide guidance and input on preliminary scope/customer requests, including rough order of magnitude (ROM) costs

• Evaluate competitive bids as appropriate

• Review proposals for accuracy, identify and track cost-saving suggestions or improvements

• Recommend the best path of action

• Develop the final cost and schedule for the project

• Implement controls as needed to track and manage cost, schedule, and scope

• Write and manage construction contracts with subcontractors across multiple disciplines through contract close-out

• Facilitate city, county, and regulatory approvals

• Resolve design and construction conflicts in the field in real-time

• Manage the overall site safety and environmental requirements for contractors

• Track and approve invoicing of work

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in architecture, construction management, or an engineering related discipline and 3+ years of professional experience in construction, engineering, or facilities management OR 7+ years of professional experience in construction, engineering, or facilities management in lieu of a degree

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• 2+ years of professional experience in concrete construction, earthwork, and basic steel structures

• 1+ year of demonstrated hands-on experience in the construction field

• Experience with project management of major construction projects including estimating, cost control, schedule, and contractor management

• Greenfield site development experience

• Basic proficiency with AutoCAD or Revit

• Knowledge and familiarity with general construction practices, permitting, and regulations

• Experience working with vendors of multiple disciplines such as civil, structural, mechanical, electrical, piping, geotechnical, and surveying

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• This position is based in Starbase, TX (Brownsville/South Padre Island Area) and requires being onsite – remote work not considered

• Ability to perform hands-on work in all environments (heat, cold, rain), in tight quarters or at heights

• Travel may be required to support projects at other sites (up to 30%)

• Stand: Up to 6 hours per day

• Sit: Up to 6 hours per day

• Push/Pull: Up to ≤ 50 lbs. (unassisted) 15 minutes or less per day

• Overhead reach: Up to 3 hours per day

• Walk: Up to 10 hours per day

• Lift/Carry: Up to ≤ 25 lbs. (unassisted) 15 minutes or less per day

• Climb (ladder/stairs): Up to 10 hours per day

• Kneel/Crouch: Up to 3 hours per day

• Upper body twist: Up to 3 hours per day

• Ability to work in temperatures over 80 degrees 6 hours or greater per day

• Candidate must be capable of safely working at heights (up to 500ft), in confined spaces, using an air purifying respirator, operating heavy equipment and machinery, and performing the physical requirements of the job listed in the job description. Candidate may be required to complete a pre-employment questionnaire and/or physical to confirm these capabilities, which may include a medical history review

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com.

jobs.title: Senior Design Quality Engineer
jobs.description:
Divergent is building the new industrial age. Every day, our teams design, manufacture, and assemble advanced systems for some of the world’s most demanding industries. Our integrated engineering and manufacturing platform transforms complex designs into production-ready solutions, helping customers move faster, build smarter, and deliver critical systems when they matter most. Divergent is a qualified Tier 1 supplier to global automotive OEMs and supports leading U.S. aerospace and defense companies.

Join us and help push the boundaries of what can be built.

Purpose

This Design Quality Engineer role involves bridging design and production, creating and optimizing innovative product designs for manufacturability, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and ensuring compliance with internal and industry standards.

This role works in collaboration with other integrated project team (IPT) members to produce, review and mature high quality technical documentation, including CAD models, drawings, PMI’s, DFMEA’s, bills of material, and engineering specifications.

The role’s expertise in CAD, GD&T, and PLM systems ensures that engineering design intent is implemented in a manner that is accurate, functional, and manufacturable, meeting customer expectations and Divergent’s standards for quality and consistency.

The Role

• Challenge existing design requirements and define new design standards for product functions and features, based on regulations, DFM/DFAM, and product attributes.

• Act as SME for PLM, GD&T, CAD-design best practices and lesson learned.

• Ensure all designs meet required engineering, manufacturability, and industry standards, addressing issues during the release phase.

• Accountable and responsible for protecting the quality of the final engineering products (released designs, CAD, Drawings, & PMI), ensuring the production team receives data that meets quality and usability standards.

• Check technical documentation (incl. drawings, PMI, BOM’s, DFMEA, specs, etc.) before being released into PLM, enforcing compliance to internal SOP and guidelines.

• Analyze drawings, models, and documentation for GD&T accuracy, completeness, manufacturability, assemble-ability and inspectability.

• Support active programs by creating and managing design engineering data, as requested by the IPT.

• Manage ongoing production NCR’s and dispositions, collaborating with ME’s and RE’s.

• Support the implementation of ECR/ECO’s for production parts, as required or needed.

• Work cross-functionally to implement cost reduction, methods and product improvements, and support prototype and production build activities.

• Identify opportunities for standardization, automation, and process improvement in GD&T and PMI practices.

• Support the training of new personnel for the area of competence.

• Maintain and organize design documentation and reference material, ensuring all revisions and updates are properly documented, stored, and disseminated to the broader team.

Basic Qualifications

• Ability to lawfully access information and technology that is subject to US export controls.

• BS in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent.

• Aerospace or automotive design background.

• 2+ years of CAD experience creating detailed models.

• 2+ years of PLM/PDM experience.

• Solid understanding of common manufacturing and assembly methods, GD&T, and tolerance/stack-up analysis.

• Experience with PMI, DFMEA, control plans, PPAP and APQP.

• Experience with ASME Y14.100, Y14.5, Y14.41.

• Self-motivated with strong multi-tasking, organizational, communication and documentation skills.

• Ability to work well in an integrated team including daily interactions with technicians, engineers, and managers.

• Attention to detail and record keeping.

Preferred Qualifications

• MS in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent.

• 2+ years of Siemens NX experience.

• 2+ years of Teamcenter experience.

• Experience interfacing with engineering, manufacturing and quality teams to understand system designs and the associated constraints.

• Experience in CMM programming in a CNC machine shop (Mills, Lathes & EDM).

• Experience with fast iteration prototyping programs.

• Demonstrated development and configuration management experience on technically complex hardware products.

• Expertise in design for manufacturability and design for assembly including experience taking products from prototype design to production.

• Solid understanding of common manufacturing materials and processes, including mills, lathes, welding, sheet-metal bending, lifting/rigging, assembly, inspection, etc. Additive manufacturing is a plus.

• Working knowledge of all chassis systems and vehicle dynamics fundamentals.

• Proficiency in Atlassian tools (Confluence, JIRA).

Work Environment

• Work is performed in an office environment and requires the ability to operate standard office equipment and keyboards.

Compensation

At Divergent, our pay range is based on the level of the job. For this role, we will consider candidates at levels E03 - E05 as evaluated through our interview process.

• E03 / Engineer I: $105,980 - $145,730

• E04 / Engineer II: $122,430 - $168,340

• E05 / Senior Engineer: $141,380 - $194,390

Pay Range

$105,980—$194,390 USD

What We Offer Our Regular, Full-Time Employees:

• Holistic Compensation Package: Enjoy a world-class compensation package that includes a competitive salary, equity plan, and discretionary results-based incentive bonus opportunities, ensuring you're truly valued for your contributions.

• Wellness and Time Off: Embrace a healthy lifestyle with paid vacation, sick time, and company holidays, including a year-end shutdown to recharge. We support growing families with paid parental leave, recognizing the importance of bonding time.

• Comprehensive Health and Wellness: Prioritize your well-being with our comprehensive health and wellness benefits, offering both HMO and Premium PPO options. Additionally, benefit from company-sponsored life insurance and short and long-term disability coverage for peace of mind.

• Investment in Growth: We're committed to your professional development. Take advantage of reimbursement opportunities for learning and development initiatives, empowering you to continuously expand your skill set and reach peak performance.

• Collaborative and High-Performing Environment: Join our collaborative, dynamic, and high-performing team within a fast-paced, mission-driven company. Together, we're disrupting the traditional manufacturing industry, fostering innovation, and integrating people and technology to reduce our footprint.

Equal Employment Opportunity
Divergent is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status, or any other applicable state or federal protected characteristic. Divergent provides affirmative action in employment for qualified Individuals with Disabilities and Protected Veterans in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and the Vietnam Era Veterans’ Readjustment Assistance Act.

From time to time you may be asked to work on special projects or to assist with other work. Your cooperation and assistance in performing such additional work is expected.

E-Verify: Right to Work

E-Verify is a program that electronically confirms a candidate’s eligibility to work in the United States after completing the Employment Eligibility Verification (Form I-9). The information provided on the Form I-9 is compared to the records contained in the Social Security Administration and Department of Homeland Security (DHS) databases. jobs.title: Tool Room Attendant
jobs.description:
Build the Future with Us —EquipmentShare is Hiring a Tool Room Attendant

At EquipmentShare, we’re not just filling a role — we’re assembling the best team on the planet to build something that’s never been built before. We’re on a mission to transform an industry that’s been stuck in the past by empowering contractors and communities through innovative technology, real-time support, and a team that truly cares.

We’re hiring a Tool Room Attendant at our facility in Santa Teresa, NM, and we’re looking for someone who’s ready to grow with us, bring energy, and drive to their work.

Schedule: Varies dependent on Job site requirements. 90 percent travel with Per Diem and overtime after 40 hours.

Primary Responsibilities

As a Tool Trailer Technician, you will have extensive working knowledge of the tool rental industry or experience managing tool trailers and cribs. You will provide overall direction and support for the jobsite. This role is not traditional or conventional like other tool trailer positions. It involves active participation in all aspects of the project beyond delegation and oversight. You are not afraid to get your hands dirty, both literally and figuratively, by doing whatever it takes to ensure the project’s success, whether that means checking equipment in and out, handling punch list items, or transporting equipment from point A to point B.

• End-to-end project support (involvement from the scoping/planning phases with key stakeholders within the company all the way through construction phases to completion of the project)

• Organization of jobsite processes

• Jobsite safety and total compliance for the project

• Quality assurance for materials, labor and overall entities involved in the project

• Communicate weekly with the Construction/Procurement Manager

• Manage equipment and supply needs and provide these to the necessary sites end users

Why EquipmentShare?

Because we do things differently — and we think you’ll feel it from day one. We’re a people-first company powered by cutting-edge technology. That means our proprietary T3 platform doesn’t just run our business — it also makes your job easier, safer, and more connected. Whether you’re behind the wheel, under the hood, leading a branch, or closing deals — tech supports you, and you drive us forward.

We’re a team of problem-solvers, go-getters, and builders. And we’re looking for teammates who take pride in doing meaningful work and want to be part of building something special.

Perks & Benefits

• Monthly Family Dinner Night — We treat you and your family to dinner every month, because family comes first. (An employee favorite!) *restrictions apply

• Competitive compensation

• Full medical, dental, and vision coverage for full-time employees

• Generous PTO + paid holidays

• 401(k) + company match

• Tool and boot reimbursements (role dependent)

• Gym membership stipend + wellness programs (earn PTO and prizes!)

• Company events, food truck nights, and monthly team dinners

• 16 hours of paid volunteer time per year — give back to the community you call home

• Career advancement, leadership training, and professional development opportunities

• Access to industry leading diagnostic tools

About You

You want to be part of a team that’s not just changing an industry for the sake of change — we’re transforming it to make it safer, more secure, and more productive. You bring grit, heart, and humility to your work, and you’re excited about the opportunity to grow within a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

jobs.title: Founding Account Executive
jobs.description:
FOUNDING ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE

At some point in the future, every business will answer their phone with voice AI. We are building the platform that lets them optimize these AI agents for performance.

Phonely builds conversational voice AI agents for high volume phone workflows. Our customers use us to qualify leads, book appointments, route calls, and resolve real customer conversations in production.

We’re hiring an Account Executive who can own revenue end-to-end and bring a meaningful network of buyers who run or rely on call centers.


WHO THIS ROLE IS FOR

This role is for an AE with a real book of business. You have relationships with decision makers at companies that use call centers (in-house or outsourced), especially where calls drive revenue: lead qualification, appointment booking, inbound sales, and customer operations.

You do not need to have sold this exact product category before. You do need to know the people, understand how these teams buy, and be able to run a tight enterprise sales process.


WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Own a quota and full-cycle deals from first meeting through close

 - Source pipeline through your network plus targeted outbound, with a focus on call center heavy operators

 - Lead discovery around call flows, booking rules, transfers, QA, compliance constraints, and success metrics

 - Build champions and multi-thread across Ops, Rev, CX, and technical stakeholders

 - Drive a structured deal process: mutual action plans, evaluation criteria, ROI, security, and procurement

 - Partner with Solutions and Customer Success to scope pilots and align on success criteria before signature

 - Maintain accurate pipeline hygiene and forecasting

 - Capture product feedback and market intel and loop it back to leadership


WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 - Five or more years of closing experience (mid-market and or enterprise)

 - A demonstrable book of business: relationships with operators and executives at organizations that run or heavily use call centers

 - Experience selling into at least one of: insurance, home services, pay per call, BPOs, lead gen, or other high volume phone driven businesses

 - Strong discovery and executive communication, you can speak outcomes, not features

 - Comfortable with technical topics at a practical level (integrations, CRMs, call routing, data flows) without needing to be an engineer

 - High ownership, strong follow-up, and consistent deal control


BONUS POINTS

 - Existing relationships with call center leaders, heads of CX, heads of sales ops, lead gen owners, or BPO leadership

 - Experience with Twilio, Ringba, Five9, Genesys, NICE, Talkdesk, Dialpad, Aircall, ServiceTitan, Salesforce, HubSpot

 - Prior experience selling call center services, telecom, CCaaS, dialers, QA, WFM, or lead gen products


WHY JOIN PHONELY

Small team, high standards, direct access to leadership, and a product that is already proven in production. You will have real ownership over revenue and meaningful input into go-to-market.

jobs.title: Senior Allocator
jobs.description:
Jenni Kayne is a California-based lifestyle brand that aims to empower an elevated approach to everyday living. Whether it’s our edited style ethos or coveted interiors sensibility, we work hard to create a world that's inviting and intentional. From our stores across the country to our operations and corporate teams, we believe in the power of a workplace that’s built on diversity and inclusion—where the varied voices and viewpoints of our community pave the way.

About This Role

As the Senior Allocator at Jenni Kayne, you will own the end-to-end merchandise allocation and replenishment strategy across our retail stores, outlet location, ecommerce, and wholesale channels. Reporting to the Director of Buying & Planning, you will be responsible for ensuring the right products are available in the right locations at the right time to maximize sales, optimize inventory productivity, and drive profitable growth.

This role oversees all aspects of allocation, from initial product launches and seasonal size planning to ongoing replenishment, inventory balancing, and end-of-season consolidation. Leveraging Syrup Tech, NetSuite, AI-powered analytics, and advanced reporting tools, you will establish efficient replenishment processes, identify inventory opportunities, and drive data-informed decisions across apparel, home, jewelry, and third-party merchandise.

The ideal candidate is a highly analytical, detail-oriented professional who takes ownership, operates independently, and thrives in a fast-paced, multi-channel retail environment.

Role and Responsibilities

As the Senior Allocator, your primary responsibilities include the following:

Inventory Allocation & Replenishment

• Own and execute the end-to-end allocation and replenishment process across all retail stores, outlet, ecommerce, and wholesale channels.

• Establish and manage weekly, bi-weekly, and monthly replenishment cadences across apparel, core apparel, candles, home, jewelry, swatches, and third-party merchandise.

• Manage initial allocations for new product launches, seasonal collections, and core programs based on historical sales, store performance, product availability, and channel demand.

• Analyze inventory needs at the store, category, style, SKU, and size levels to optimize product distribution and minimize stockouts and excess inventory.

• Manage store-requested replenishment, consolidating requests, validating inventory availability, and prioritizing transfers based on business needs.

• Establish and maintain replenishment parameters, including store minimums, inventory thresholds, store tiers, and product-specific allocation rules.

• Oversee inventory transfers, including transfer order creation, execution, tracking, and reconciliation within NetSuite.

• Coordinate store-to-store transfers, inventory rebalancing, and replenishment adjustments to maximize sell-through and protect high-performing sales channels.

• Manage allocation and replenishment for new store openings, outlet inventory, promotional events, and key selling periods.

Seasonal Allocation, Size Planning & Inventory Management

• Own seasonal and monthly initial allocation planning, evaluating historical sales, ecommerce versus retail demand, store performance, product classifications, and size level selling trends.

• Develop quarterly size orders using comparable styles, historical sell through, channel demand, and size curves to recommend appropriate inventory quantities.

• Maintain and update seasonal core inventory ladders, evaluating on-hand inventory, sales trends, projected demand, and future inventory requirements.

• Partner closely with Planning and Production to manage core and carryover merchandise, monitor production timelines, shipment status, shortages, and overages, and proactively resolve inventory discrepancies to ensure timely product availability and replenishment.

• Partner with Buying & Planning and Production to recommend replenishment quantities, future purchase orders, and inventory investments.

• Oversee jewelry inventory planning and quarterly ordering requirements.

• Manage wholesale inventory allocations, including pre-launch inventory reservations, ecommerce-to-wholesale transfers, and post-launch inventory reconciliation.

• Support department-store concession assortments and inventory requirements, including initial allocations, replenishment, and assortment updates.

• Lead end-of-season inventory consolidation, store exits, and product reallocation to improve inventory productivity and minimize aged merchandise.

Sales Analysis & Inventory Optimization

• Analyze daily, weekly, and monthly sales performance to identify inventory opportunities, emerging trends, and potential risks across all sales channels.

• Monitor key performance indicators, including sell-through, weeks of supply, inventory turnover, stock-to-sales ratios, size availability, and replenishment effectiveness.

• Evaluate top-selling, underperforming, and slow-moving merchandise to proactively adjust allocation and replenishment strategies.

• Balance inventory availability across retail, ecommerce, and wholesale channels to maximize full price selling opportunities.

• Identify opportunities to reduce stockouts, excess inventory, aged merchandise, and unnecessary inventory transfers.

• Develop recommendations for inventory transfers, markdowns, replenishment adjustments, and product consolidation.

• Provide actionable analysis and recommendations to Buying & Planning leadership to support inventory investment and allocation decisions.

Systems, AI & Process Optimization

• Serve as the primary owner of Syrup Tech allocation and replenishment workflows, including replenishment rules, inventory parameters, store groupings, and system optimization.

• Leverage NetSuite and reporting platforms to manage inventory visibility, transfer orders, product availability, and data accuracy.

• Utilize AI-assisted tools, including Claude, to streamline sales analysis, store replenishment requests, initial allocations, size planning, and transfer order preparation.

• Develop and improve automated reporting and replenishment processes to reduce manual work and increase operational efficiency.

• Validate system-generated recommendations against actual sales, inventory availability, and business requirements to ensure accuracy.

• Identify and resolve data discrepancies, system limitations, and process inefficiencies in partnership with cross-functional teams.

• Establish standardized allocation procedures, reporting tools, and documentation to ensure consistent, accurate, and scalable execution.

Cross Functional Collaboration & Reporting

• Partner with the Director of Buying & Planning to execute merchandise allocation strategies aligned with sales forecasts, inventory plans, and business objectives.

• Actively participate in cross-functional business meetings, serving as the primary representative for allocation and replenishment, providing inventory insights, identifying potential risks and opportunities, and contributing recommendations to support strategic and operational business decisions.

• Collaborate with Merchandising, Production, and Buying teams on product launches, seasonal assortment planning, replenishment needs, and future inventory requirements.

• Work closely with Retail Operations and field leadership to understand store-level inventory needs, regional selling trends, and replenishment priorities.

• Coordinate with Distribution and Operations teams to ensure timely inventory transfers, shipment execution, and resolution of inventory discrepancies.

• Partner with Ecommerce and Wholesale teams to align inventory availability, channel priorities, and launch requirements.

• Prepare and maintain weekly and monthly allocation, replenishment, sales, and inventory performance reports.

• Present inventory risks, opportunities, and recommendations during business reviews and seasonal planning discussions.

• Serve as the primary point of contact for allocation and replenishment matters, ensuring timely communication and resolution of inventory needs across the organization.

Qualifications and Requirements

• 5+ years of progressive experience in merchandise allocation, replenishment, inventory planning, or buying within a multi-store retail environment, preferably in apparel, home, or lifestyle retail.

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Merchandising, Finance, Supply Chain Management, or a related field preferred, or equivalent professional experience.

• Demonstrated experience independently owning end-to-end allocation, initial product distributions, replenishment, size planning, and inventory optimization.

• Strong understanding of retail math, inventory management, sell-through, weeks of supply, inventory turnover, size curves, and store-level demand planning.

• Advanced Microsoft Excel proficiency, including pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and complex formulas.

• Experience with ERP and allocation systems, preferably NetSuite and Syrup Tech.

• Familiarity with AI-powered analytics, automation tools, and reporting platforms to improve inventory decision-making and operational efficiency.

• Experience managing inventory across multiple product categories and sales channels, including retail, ecommerce, and wholesale.

• Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail and data accuracy.

• Demonstrated ability to independently manage competing priorities, establish processes, and take accountability for execution from start to finish.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate cross-functionally and present recommendations to leadership.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving retail environment while balancing strategic planning with hands-on execution.

Physical Requirements

• Ability to sit for extended periods while working at a computer.

• Ability to stand, walk, and move throughout retail or distribution environments during occasional site visits.

• Ability to occasionally lift and carry up to 15 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Additional Notes

jobs.description:
Build the Future with Us — EquipmentShare is Hiring a Shop Technician (Small Engine Mechanic)

At EquipmentShare, we’re not just filling a role — we’re assembling the best team on the planet to build something that’s never been built before. We’re on a mission to transform an industry that’s been stuck in the past by empowering contractors and communities through innovative technology, real-time support, and a team that truly cares.

We’re hiring a Shop Technician (Small Engine Mechanic) at our rental facility in Woodlawn, OH, and we’re looking for someone who’s ready to grow with us, bring energy and drive to their work, provide maintenance and repair for a variety of customer and company owned heavy equipment machinery and aerial lifts and help us build the future of construction. Mechanics will have the opportunity to work on the newest fleet in the industry.

Salary range: $17-$24

Schedule: Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and offers overtime pay after working 40 hours. (This role is subject to on-call scheduling with additional compensation provided)

Primary Responsibilities

As a Shop Technician, you’ll use our tech to create, assign, and monitor work orders, track machine service intervals, order parts, and diagnose issues faster by pulling data from hundreds of makes and models. With real-time information at your fingertips, you can determine the root cause and corrective action for each issue quickly, enabling you to work smarter, not harder.

• Practice safe job practices for repairing equipment

• Use technology (laptops and tablets) comfortably

• Maintenance and repair of complex mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and diesel systems on a variety of rental and customer equipment and tools while using a high degree of independent judgment

• Assist in the training of lower level technicians as needed

• Maintain paperwork/electronic documentation of work performed (work orders) in a complete and timely manner on a daily basis

• Assist with pick-up and delivery of equipment & parts

• Be knowledgeable of OSHA requirements (preferred)

• Year-round company provided OEM training

• Other duties, assigned as needed

Why EquipmentShare?

Because we do things differently — and we think you’ll feel it from day one. We’re a people-first company powered by cutting-edge technology. That means our proprietary T3 platform doesn’t just run our business — it also makes your job easier, safer, and more connected. Whether you’re behind the wheel, under the hood, leading a branch, or closing deals — tech supports you, and you drive us forward.

We’re a team of problem-solvers, go-getters, and builders. And we’re looking for teammates who take pride in doing meaningful work and want to be part of building something special.

Perks & Benefits

• Monthly Family Dinner Night — We treat you and your family to dinner every month, because family comes first. (An employee favorite!) *restrictions apply

• Competitive compensation

• Full medical, dental, and vision coverage for full-time employees

• Generous PTO + paid holidays

• 401(k) + company match

• Tool and boot reimbursements (role dependent)

• Gym membership stipend + wellness programs (earn PTO and prizes!)

• Company events, food truck nights, and monthly team dinners

• 16 hours of paid volunteer time per year — give back to the community you call home

• Career advancement, leadership training, and professional development opportunities

• Access to industry leading diagnostic tools

About You

You want to be part of a team that’s not just changing an industry for the sake of change — we’re transforming it to make it safer, more secure, and more productive. You bring grit, heart, and humility to your work, and you’re excited about the opportunity to grow within a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

We’re looking for people who:

• See challenges as opportunities

• Embrace change and continuous improvement

• Bring energy, effort, and optimism every day

Skills & Qualifications

• Must own tools applicable to position

• Advanced mechanical aptitude and working knowledge of tools

• Extensive knowledge of construction equipment with an advanced understanding of schematics and diagrams

• Superior customer service, teamwork and verbal/written communication skills

Education and Experience:

• Experience in field service, maintenance and repair preferred

Physical Requirements:

• Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds at times

A Workplace For All

At EquipmentShare, we believe the best solutions come from a team that reflects the world around us. Our initiative — A Workplace For All — is rooted in the belief that we must work together to solve some of the toughest problems in construction. That means attracting, developing, and retaining great people from all walks of life.

We value different backgrounds, talents, and perspectives. We want you to feel like you belong here — because you do.

jobs.title: Employee Journey Lead
jobs.location: NZ: Wellington: Xero One (19-23 Taranaki St)
jobs.description:
The role and its impact

Help shape how People Experience services work from start to finish as Xero moves towards an AI-first way of working. You’ll turn complex employee journeys into simpler, more joined-up experiences, using the right mix of self-service, automation, AI and expert human support.

You’ll work across People Experience and enterprise teams, taking selected high-impact ideas from discovery through design, pilot and handover. Service owners keep running their services, and you’ll make sure everyone knows who owns what so improvements stick.



The team and how they connect

You’ll join the Employee Programmes and Delivery team, a small group of utility players who spend their time working out what’s going wrong for people and fixing it in a way that sticks. We Go Together by bringing the right people in early, whether that’s service owners, operations, policy or systems. We try things small before we scale them, and we check whether they helped, not just whether we shipped them.



Initially, you will focus on

 - Getting close to the work by spending time with Employee Experience, Employee Shared Services, PX Systems and service owners, so it’s clear where you lead and where you partner.

 - Listening to employees, people leaders and service teams to find the journeys where change will matter most.

 - Mapping those journeys end to end, finding root causes and shaping a practical future state across self-service, automation, AI and human support.

 - Taking one well-scoped improvement into a governed pilot, with clear measures and a plan to hand it over to the team who runs it.



Where and how you can work

This role is based in Melbourne or Wellington. Xero is hybrid with no mandated office days, and most of the team come in around two days a week. A few of us work remotely, and we keep things workable for anyone who does. The team is mostly based in Australia and New Zealand, so we share working hours and can work things through together. Important things get shared in writing, and we look at the impact you have, not how visible you are.



Here are some of the things we are looking for

 - You’ll Go Bold by rethinking journeys from the ground up, using methods such as journey mapping, service blueprinting and root-cause analysis.

 - A knack for seeing how people, processes, policies and technology fit together, and for making roles and handoffs clear.

 - A track record of taking ambiguous, cross-functional work from discovery through pilot to handover, and knowing when to steer and when to partner.

 - Curiosity about where AI and automation genuinely help, with sensible human oversight built in, and a habit of testing small and learning fast so you Go Fast without cutting corners.

 - The ability to build trust quickly, influence service owners without formal authority, and explain your thinking in plain language to technical and non-technical partners.

 - A desire to Go Further by sharing what you know, through reusable tools, playbooks and coaching that help others improve their own practice.



Apply even if your experience isn’t a perfect match! At Xero, we hire based on your skills, passion, and the unique perspective you can bring to enhance our culture and team.



Xero uses AI to help screen applications based on job-related qualifications. These tools assist our recruiters but do not make automated hiring decisions. A real human recruiter reviews all candidates before any hiring action is taken.
