jobs.title: Startup Events & Community
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

STARTUP EVENTS & COMMUNITY

As a founding member of our Startup Events and Community team, you'll be the growth engine behind SpaceXSI for Startups, responsible for turning our startup strategy into high-impact programs that win the right early-stage companies, help founders get deeper value from SpaceXSI, and turn our strongest founder-users into advocates. This is a builder role for someone who's energized by the founder and startup community. We're building a focused program across top Seed-Series B startups, reaching them directly and through VC and accelerator ecosystems. You'll design the strategy for the events, community moments, and hackathons that create genuine advocacy and deeper product usage and make decisions about where we should show up and where we shouldn't.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Design the startup events playbook: Build and execute a data-driven marketing plan for the startup segment, focused on landing and growing usage within top Seed-Series B companies across YC and the broader ecosystem

 - Own the founder funnel and footprint: Deploy a mix of founder events, hackathons, executive/founder roundtables, and community activations to acquire the right startups and drive them toward meaningful success using SpaceXSI

 - Build ecosystem relationships: Partner with VCs, accelerators, and other startup partners to reach their portfolio founders through growth programs, content, and co-hosted moments. Help identify which partners are worth going deep with

 - Creativity: Fearlessly break the standard playbook by avoiding generic engagement formats - find out how founders actually build and gather and design around that

 - Founder advocacy: Surface and amplify founder/customer stories worth telling, and feature them in our events. Become a trusted partner and peer to the founders using SpaceXSI

 - Event orchestration: Own programs end to end, from ideation and promotion to onsite experience and follow-up. Keep it scrappy and high-signal; obsess over the details that make founders feel SpaceXSI cares about them early

 - Data-driven iteration: Track spend against real outcomes (activation, usage, retention, advocacy), not vanity metrics. Manage your budget toward the highest-impact investments and deprioritize what isn't working

 - GTM partnership: Work closely with the Events, Growth, PMM, and Field Engineering teams. Bring FEs into events to help founders build real automations, align on which startups show strong usage signals, and flag when a company is genuinely ready for an Enterprise conversation

 - Product and marketing partnership: Be the "eyes and ears" of the founder community. Feed real-time insights on messaging resonance, credits/billing confusion, feature awareness, and competitive shifts back to Product and Marketing

 - Field presence: Ability to travel (~20%) to host events, support hackathons, and connect with founders in-region

 - Event craft: Experience producing standout events, from intimate founder dinners to high-energy hackathons, that people actually want to attend

 - Location: In-office role based out of our San Francisco office

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

 - 4+ years in field, community, event, growth, or revenue marketing

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - Experience in or with startups

 - Ideally in B2B SaaS or developer tools. You understand founders and early-stage engineering teams, and how they buy, build, and talk to each other

 - Builder mindset: You're a self-starter who can build a program from scratch and then obsessively optimize it based on data

 - Community obsession: You genuinely like being around founders and builders, and you know the difference between a program that feels authentic to that community and one that feels like a vendor hard sell

 - Storytelling: Your communication is sharp, credible, and founder-native. You can hold your own in a room full of technical founders

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

 - This role is based in our San Francisco office and requires working in-office

 - Field presence: Ability to travel (~20%) to host events, support hackathons, and connect with founders in-region

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

Annual Salary:

$180,000 - $220,000 USD

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

jobs.title: Senior Applied Scientist
jobs.description:
About Upstart

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

The Team

Upstart’s Servicing team supports borrowers after loan origination and works to improve outcomes for investors and borrowers. The team is building data-informed approaches across areas such as collections, loan assistance, payment experiences, and borrower communications, with a meaningful opportunity to apply machine learning to problems that have often been addressed manually.

As a Senior Applied Scientist on the Servicing team, you will build predictive and causal models and translate their outputs into decisions that improve how loans are serviced. You’ll partner with Product, Engineering, and Servicing and Collections Operations to evaluate interventions and shape data-informed approaches to payment plans, loan modifications, communications, and autopay.

How you’ll make an impact

• Develop and evaluate machine-learning models that predict borrower repayment behavior and other servicing outcomes.

• Apply causal inference and experimentation to measure the impact of servicing interventions, including loan modifications and payment assistance.

• Translate model predictions and treatment-effect estimates into practical decision algorithms and actions.

• Partner with Product and Engineering on payment experiences, autopay, and borrower communications, and with Servicing and Collections Operations on collections strategy and agent-performance insights.

• Identify and develop machine-learning opportunities in servicing areas that have historically relied on manual optimization.

• Explain analytical choices, tradeoffs, and findings to technical and non-technical partners to inform high-stakes operational and product decisions.

Minimum Qualifications

• Graduate degree in mathematics, applied mathematics, statistics, physics, econometrics, operations research, computer science, or a related quantitative field.

• Experience applying causal inference methods and experimentation to real-world decisions in an applied science or data science context.

• Applied statistics, probability, and experimental-design expertise used to build or evaluate models or interventions.

• Production-quality coding experience in Python, including data manipulation and algorithm implementation.

• 2+ years of experience conducting machine-learning, statistical-modeling, or applied quantitative research in an academic or industry setting.

Preferred Qualifications

• PhD in a quantitative field.

• Experience with payment products or payment experiences, such as autopay, recurring payments, or payment plans.

• Experience with causal machine-learning methods or treatment-effect modeling.

• Experience with supervised learning, model evaluation, and feature engineering, especially with large or complex datasets.

• Experience taking work from exploratory analysis and experimentation through production model development while maintaining analytical rigor and model reliability.

• Ability to translate broad servicing or business problems into structured research questions and communicate complex findings as actionable recommendations.

Position location

This role is available in the following locations: Remote — United States.

Travel requirements

As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S or Canada (outside of Quebec) but are expected to spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites and in-person meetings. The onsite cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.

At Upstart, our benefits for full-time employees are designed to support your health, financial well-being, family, and personal growth. Here’s what you can expect:

jobs.title: Certified Nurse Midwife (CNM)
jobs.description:
Oula delivers maternity care built around our patients—offering comprehensive support before, during, and after pregnancy. With fewer C-sections and higher VBAC success rates, our research-backed approach is delivering better outcomes. Our team of trusted midwives, OBGYNs, and dedicated care navigators ensure our patients get the type of care they need in the moments that matter most.

Since launching in 2021, we’ve expanded our care options to include Preconception and Miscarriage Care, Pregnancy Care, Postpartum Support, and Gynecology. Today, we serve patients across six clinics in three states, with continued expansion planned for 2027 and beyond. Join our team of clinicians, innovators, operators, and technologists who are passionate about setting a new standard in maternity care.

The Role

We are looking for a Certified Nurse-Midwife (CNM) to join our growing maternity care practice. We’re searching for someone who is thoughtful and passionate about delivering patient-centric, judgment-free care, and is excited to join a dynamic and innovative team.

This is the perfect opportunity for a CNM who is excited to expand their skill set and help define and build a new best-in-class maternity care experience. You will be responsible for delivering full-spectrum perinatal care, as well as helping to shape and refine Oula’s clinical care model.

At Oula, midwives lead their own panels within a truly collaborative model — OB-GYNs are integrated members of the same team, not a separate referral tier — and our patients deliver at our partner hospital. With fewer C-sections and higher VBAC success rates, our research-backed approach delivers better outcomes for the communities we serve. This is the autonomy-with-backup practice many midwives are looking for and rarely find.

This is a full-time position with a flexible schedule that varies based on market and operational needs. At steady-state staffing, a typical schedule includes approximately two office days per week, an average of 24 hours of on-call coverage per week (with a protected post-call day off where applicable), and dedicated administrative and didactic time. During the launch of new markets or other ramp-up periods, scheduling needs—including on-call responsibilities—may temporarily be greater as the practice grows. All Oula patients deliver at Novant Health Presbyterian Medical Center.

Schedule: Full-time, flexible schedule based on market and operational needs. Approximately two office days per week and an average of 24 hours of on-call coverage per week at steady-state staffing.

Employment type: Full-time.

What You'll Do

Full-Scope Midwifery Care

• Provides full-scope midwifery care during pregnancy, labor, birth, and postpartum across a variety of settings: our clinics, our partner hospital, and virtually.

• Attends births as the primary delivering clinician for low-risk patients, supporting physiologic labor and birth while recognizing when escalation or consultation is indicated.

• Collaborates with other team members (e.g., obstetricians, nurses, MAs, doulas, coordinators, therapists, etc.) to provide whole-person care.

Patient Communication & Education

• Communicates effectively with patients during and between appointments to ensure questions are answered and concerns are addressed by leveraging Oula’s technology.

• Able and excited to educate about and promote the midwifery model of care to current and prospective patients, with a focus on growing Oula’s patient population.

Clinical Model & Product Collaboration

• Works collaboratively with Oula’s product & engineering team to give feedback on the patient portal to create a more personalized, inclusive, and consistent approach to care.

Qualifications

Required

• Must hold active state licensure as required to practice midwifery in the clinic’s state (or be eligible to obtain it before start), and current certification by the AMCB as a Certified Nurse-Midwife or Certified Midwife.

• Experience caring for diverse communities with a wide variety of needs.

• Great professional references and a reputation for providing exceptional patient care valued by your patients and colleagues.

Preferred

• Two or more years of full-scope clinical midwifery experience preferred; we also welcome strong earlier-career candidates who are approaching that mark.

• Experience with telemedicine or elements of virtual care.

• Any extra “bonus” skills or passions that will help us serve our patients (i.e. the ability to communicate with patients in their preferred language, passion for birth equity work, lactation certification, nutrition/diabetes training, etc.).

Preferred Skills

• Early pregnancy loss options counseling and medical management.

• Familiarity with Perinatal Mental Health.

• Basic bedside sonography skills (1st Trimester Viability and positioning confirmation).

You Are the Perfect Candidate If You

• Are passionate about improving maternity care through a combination of clinical care, technology, patient empowerment, and education.

• Are enthusiastic about collaborative care models leveraging diverse teams with a wide variety of skill-sets.

• Exude empathy and compassion for patients and team members alike and can rally your team to provide exceptional patient experience regardless of the situation.

• Uphold the core principles of reproductive justice to support principles of body autonomy, self-determination and cultural respect.

• Are comfortable with ambiguity and change, and energized by building processes from the ground up.

• Are excited about realizing the Oula mission, and building the kind of collaborative practice that midwives and patients dream about.

How We Work

Our values are Excellence, Candor, Humanity, Ownership, Evidence, and Service. In practice, that means we care about our patients and each other, have honest conversations with respect, make decisions based on evidence, and keep the patient at the center of everything we do.

Oula offers a competitive total rewards package which includes base salary, and  comprehensive benefits. Exact compensation inclusive of salary and any bonuses is determined based on a number of factors including experience and skill level, location, and qualifications which are assessed during the interview process. Oula is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone's contributions are valued.

Salary Range

$118,000—$150,000 USD

Oula's Commitment as an Equal Opportunity Employer:

We're committed to an inclusive workplace that reflects the communities we serve. You can be a great candidate even if you don't meet every qualification listed. If that's you, tell us about yourself in your cover letter. We especially encourage applicants from historically underrepresented communities, including women, people of color, LGBTQ+ people, veterans, and people with disabilities.

Oula Health participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm you are authorized to work in the U.S.

jobs.description:

SUPPLY CHAIN PLANNING MANAGER (LNG CAPITAL & PRODUCTION)

SpaceX is on a fast track to become the market leader in various product categories, including US-based human spaceflight, rapid vehicle reusability, internet services through the Starlink constellation, and other exciting projects. The SpaceX supply chain department is a critical player in our operations. To capitalize on SpaceX’s technological and market-changing successes, our team will be part of managing an agile, yet robust, supply chain that will enable a competitive advantage for the company. SpaceX's supply chain will play a key role in enabling SpaceX to meet these ambitious growth targets and greatly contribute to making us a multi-planetary species.

This individual will lead material and equipment planning for SpaceX’s liquefied natural gas (LNG) facilities, across the full asset lifecycle. The role ensures that capital equipment, bulk materials, and critical spares are on site when required, protecting project schedules and the continuous plant operation that supports SpaceX’s launch manifest and development goals.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Own the integrated material plan for assigned LNG facilities, translating engineering bills of materials, material take-offs, and construction schedules into required-on-site dates for equipment package and bulk material

• Create and maintain bills of materials and master data in the MRP system, execute purchase orders and planning actions, and manage revisions as engineering designs mature

• Plan logistics, receiving, warehousing, and preservation of equipment and materials, including heavy-haul transport

• Develop commissioning and capital spares strategies from manufacturer recommended spare parts lists

• Plan and manage inventory of critical spares, MRO materials, and consumables, including materials for planned maintenance

• Partner with engineering on strategic stocking to reduce cost and lead time across sites

• Analyze supply chain data and report metrics, including material cost against budget, supplier on-time delivery, schedule adherence, and inventory health

• Ensure compliance with all company policies and procedures and government regulations

• Proactively update leadership on critical supply risks and recovery plans

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Advanced degree and 3+ years, bachelor’s degree and 5+ years, or 9+ years of experience in one or more of the following:

• Procurement, expediting, or materials management for capital projects

• Material or production planning

• Supply chain management in the energy, oil and gas, petrochemical, or utility sector

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Experience planning materials for LNG, gas processing, midstream, or power generation projects

• Technical knowledge of natural gas and cryogenic equipment, including compressors, liquefaction and storage systems, metering and analytical systems, valves, and piping

• Proficiency with ERP and MRP systems, advanced Microsoft Excel, SQL, and Tableau or Power BI

• Detail-oriented, self-motivated, and able to respond quickly to a fast-moving and ever-changing environment

• Holds self to highest ethical standards, and conducts all activities with the highest of integrity

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• This position is based in Starbase, TX and requires being onsite - remote work not considered

• Ability to travel to project sites and supplier facilities for inspections and expediting

• Flexible to work long hours when needed to meet critical deadlines

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

jobs.title: Program Security Manager
jobs.description:
Who We Are

GITAI is a vertically integrated space and defense company building the next generation of hardware for low-Earth-orbit missions.

At our core is the space robotics technology that has defined GITAI from the beginning. A small, highly capable engineering team applies that foundation across satellite buses, in-orbit servicing robotics, and mission hardware for applications such as Earth observation. Today, a major focus of our work is supporting U.S. national security missions, particularly through proliferated LEO satellite constellations and other next-generation space systems.

We design, build, integrate, and test much of our hardware in-house. Electrical, mechanical, software, manufacturing, integration, and test teams work closely together, allowing a small team to own complete systems rather than isolated components. This vertical integration helps us move quickly, learn directly from hardware, and shorten the path from architecture to a working system.

We are still early. The systems, the company, and the market are all being built at the same time. Requirements change, technical problems are often ambiguous, and many answers do not yet exist. We are looking for exceptional engineers and operators who want broad ownership, can work across disciplines, and are willing to stay close to the hardware until the mission succeeds.

About the Role

We are looking for a Program Security Manager to turn Government-approved Security Classification Guides (SCGs), DD Forms 254, and related guidance into clear, practical rules for technical work. You will work directly with Mechanical, Electrical, Software, and Systems Engineering leaders to apply classification requirements to designs, CAD, circuits, firmware, source code, analyses, and test data, and resolve unclear cases with authorized Government representatives. You will also coordinate reviews of Lawful Permanent Resident (LPR) contributions under our Quality Management Plan (QMP) with qualified designated technical reviewers. Hands-on software engineering experience and technical classification-management expertise are essential.

This role reports to the Senior Management Official (SMO), with day-to-day priorities coordinated with the VP of Legal and VP of Program Management. You will work closely with Engineering, the Facility Security Officer (FSO), Quality, IT/Cybersecurity, Contracts, and Export Compliance.

Key Responsibilities

Security Classification & Engineering Integration

• Lead the interpretation and application of Government-issued SCGs, DD Forms 254, and other approved classification guidance to GITAI’s technical work. Maintain internal guidance traceable to those sources.

• Partner with engineering leaders to assess what information is disclosed by designs, software, interfaces, specifications, simulations, manufacturing data, and test results; establish appropriate classification, markings, handling, and segregation requirements.

• Participate in technical and design reviews to identify classification questions early, including issues involving aggregation, compilation, release, and transfer of technical information.

• Coordinate unresolved classification questions with the Government Program Security Officer (PSO) or other authorized Government representatives. Document guidance, decisions, and follow-up actions.

• Build simple, repeatable workflows for classified and unclassified data that let engineers move quickly while meeting classification, access-control, marking, and pre-release review requirements. Prevent information spills and train personnel on their responsibilities.

QMP Review of LPR Contributions

• Coordinate implementation of the QMP “Quality Review of LPR Contributions” process for covered software, firmware, scripts, configuration and build files, hardware and circuit designs, programmable logic, drawings, specifications, analyses, test results, and related components.

• Work with the SMO and Engineering to ensure reviews are carried out by appropriately cleared U.S. citizen employees with need-to-know, relevant technical competence, and written designation by the SMO.

• Coordinate the use of SMO-approved review procedures and tools addressing technical accuracy, contract conformance, unauthorized functionality, and confirmation that contributions are unclassified and prepared without access to classified information.

• Work with designated technical reviewers and IT/Engineering on source-code review, static and software-composition analysis, testing, configuration control, build integrity, and documented acceptance before contributions enter the Program baseline.

• Ensure reviews remain independent of LPR direction or approval, that review standards and tools are SMO-approved, and that feedback to LPR personnel remains unclassified. Coordinate with Engineering and IT to protect the Program baseline and build environment as required by the QMP.

• Ensure review findings, author attribution, corrective actions, and acceptance records are captured; coordinate security concerns or suspected classified content promptly with the FSO and SMO. The FSO retains oversight of record retention and required reporting.

• Personally conduct software-related technical reviews only when technically qualified and formally designated. Mechanical, electrical, and other domain-specific technical reviews remain with suitably qualified designated reviewers.

Security Program Framework & Compliance

• Work with the FSO, Legal, Engineering, Quality, and IT/Cybersecurity to implement relevant classified-information, CUI, technology-control, and FOCI mitigation procedures, including applicable QMP, AOP, TCP, and ECP requirements.

• Support DCSA and Government security reviews, internal training, incident-response coordination, and ongoing improvements to classification and technical-information protection procedures.

• Support program and stakeholder coordination as needed, without primary ownership of program cost, schedule, or portfolio delivery.

Classification activities must follow applicable U.S. Government classification authority and guidance. This position does not confer Original Classification Authority or permit independent classification decisions outside authorized derivative classification procedures.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or another closely related STEM field.

• Hands-on professional experience in software engineering, including developing, integrating, or reviewing software, embedded software, or firmware.

• Demonstrated experience interpreting and applying U.S. Government Security Classification Guides (SCGs) to engineering data, such as source code, hardware designs, technical specifications, or test results, in classified U.S. Government or DoD programs.

• Experience working directly with engineering teams and Government security representatives to resolve technical classification questions.

• Working knowledge of DD Form 254, NISP, classified information, and CUI requirements, with experience developing practical security procedures, training, and auditable processes.

• Professional experience at a venture capital-backed startup, regardless of funding stage. Past or current employment qualifies.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in spacecraft, satellites, defense systems, missile defense, sensors, robotics, or complex hardware/software development.

• Experience building or improving classification and technical-information security processes at an aerospace or defense startup.

• Experience administering FOCI mitigation requirements, Quality Management Plans, or independent reviews of engineering contributions.

• Experience with code review, secure development and build processes, static code analysis, software composition analysis, configuration management, or technical integrity testing.

• Background as a Program Security Manager, CPSO, Classification Management Specialist, Industrial Security Specialist, or comparable role.

• Broader program management, Government customer coordination, and cross-functional stakeholder management experience.

Security Clearance & Export-Control Requirements

• Must be a U.S. citizen and eligible to obtain and maintain the U.S. Government security clearance required for the Program.

• Active Secret clearance or higher strongly preferred given near-term classified program requirements.

• Must be able to comply with all requirements applicable to classified information, CUI, and export-controlled technical data. QMP Designated Reviewer duties, if assigned, also require the applicable clearance, need-to-know, technical competence, and written SMO designation.

Location & Employment Details

• Torrance, CA / Full-time, Exempt

• This is a full-time onsite role based at GITAI’s office in Torrance, CA. This position requires working onsite five days per week. Remote or hybrid work is not expected for this role.

• Limited travel may be required based on business needs, including customer, partner, vendor, or company-related meetings.

Compensation

Base salary for this role is expected to range from $145,000 to $185,000 per year, depending on experience and qualifications.

Benefits

• Health Insurance – Platinum medical plan with 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees; 90% for dependents

• 401(k) Plan – Company match up to 3.5%, with traditional and Roth options

• Equity – Stock option eligibility depending on role

• Relocation Support – Available for qualifying positions

• Time Off – 12 paid holidays per year, 12 days of paid vacation per year, and paid sick leave (in accordance with applicable law)

• Office Perks – Free snacks and drinks, plus regular team events

GITAI does not accept unsolicited resumes from staffing or recruiting agencies. We work only with recruiting partners that have been specifically engaged by GITAI. No fees will be paid for resumes submitted without a prior agreement.

Compensation may include base salary or hourly pay and, depending on the position, equity. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skillset, and other job-related factors.

LA salary range

$145,000—$185,000 USD

Important Notice

• Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the U.S. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

• To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), GITAI Employees must be a U.S. citizen, lawful U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or the U.S. Department of Commerce, as applicable.

• GITAI USA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment with GITAI USA is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Senior Sales Engineer
jobs.description:
At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.

The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #OneJamf.

What you’ll do at Jamf:

At Jamf, we empower people to be their best selves and do their best work. The Senior Sales Engineer's (SE) primary role is to partner with the Sales Department and work alongside. Account Executives to achieve sales and billings goals. This position will evaluate technical requirements of new sales opportunities and present technical solutions to meet the needs of prospective and existing customers. The position works both remotely and on site.

For those candidates who live near a Jamf office, you may be expected to work periodically in-office or collaborative work location with other Jamf employees in your area for certain events or moments that matter. For those candidates who are not near a Jamf office, this role may be offered as remote.

What you can expect to do this role:

Customer Facing Responsibilities:

• Work jointly with the Jamf Sales team, prospective and existing customers, and partners to convey the business value of Jamf

• Gain clear understanding of prospect/customer requirements and clearly outline how to address those requirements via the Jamf Portfolio

• Own all presales technical activities by providing presentation, demonstration, and evaluation experiences to prospective and existing customers

• Cultivate and maintain long-term relationships wiht new and existing customers to progress Jamf portfolio awareness and investment

SE Team Responsibilities:

• Contribute to special projects as assigned by SE Management to support initiatives that progress the Sales Engineering org, and Jamf as a whole

• Supports and promotes a positive, inclusive workplace one in which the talents and strengths of our increasingly diverse workforce are welcomed, further developed, and manifested in our work

Personal Responsibilities:

• Amass and maintain knowledge of value and technical capabilities of all products in the Jamf portfolio

• Exhibit professional and timely written and oral communication

• Perform all job responsibilities in alignment with the core values, mission, and vision of the organization

What we are looking for:

• Minimum of 6 years of technical sales, support, or services experience (Required

• Technical knowledge of typical security architecture, application security, and identity management (Required)

• Minimum of 2 years exposure to Jamf products, related architecture tools and relevant competing solutions (Preferred)

• Minimum of 2 years experience selling to multiple levels within a complex organization (Preferred)

• Advanced proficiency with Apple technology (MacOS and iOS) and Mobile Device Management (MDM) within a medium to large scale Apple environment

• Excellent written and oral communication skills

• Experience in a commercial, government, or education environment

EDUCATION AND CERTIFICATIONS

• Technical Certificate, 4 Year / Bachelor's Degree (Required)

• A combination of relevant experience and education may be considered

How we help you reach your best potential:

• Named a 2025 Best Companies to Work For by U.S. News

• Named a 2025 Newsweek America’s Greatest Workplaces for Gen Z

• Named one of Forbes Most Trusted Companies in 2024

• Named a 2024 Newsweek America’s Greatest Workplaces for Parents & Families

• Named a 2024 PEOPLE Companies That Care by PEOPLE® and Great Place To Work®

• We offer a clear and defined sales career path. Our main goal is to help you successfully step into our Account Executive role, but there are many ways to advance your career at Jamf.

• We train and then we give you the room to grow. Our Jamfs can explore the vertical career path, as well as the horizontal, to discover new interests and opportunities.

• You don’t have to be a techie to be a Jamf. Our best-in-class sales focused Bootcamp training provides you with the technical and product knowledge required to confidently talk with customers about Jamf.

• We set achievable targets, help each other out, and share best practices across the team.

• You will have the opportunity to make a real and meaningful impact for more than 75,000 global customers with the best Apple device management solution in the world.

Pay Transparency

At Jamf, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is set within a defined range. These ranges can vary based on hiring location. Where an individual's pay falls within that range depends on several factors, including role scope, location, budget, skills, experience, and qualifications. This approach helps ensure fair, competitive pay and provides room to grow as you develop in your role.

For sales and commission-based roles, we post On-Target Earnings (OTE), which includes base salary plus estimated commission based on achieving 100% of performance targets. Commission is not guaranteed and varies based on individual performance results.

The national pay transparency range below represents all U.S. locations and accounts for geographic differences in pay, resulting in a broader range.

National Pay Transparency Range

$114,900—$263,600 USD

What it means to be a Jamf?
We are a team of free-thinkers, can-doers, and problem-crushers. We value humility and the relentless pursuit of knowledge. Our culture flows from a spirit of selflessness and relentless self-improvement - driving both personal growth and collective progress throughout our company. We unite around common goals while respecting personal approaches, believing that fulfilled individuals create a thriving, vibrant workplace.

Our aim is simple: hire exceptionally good people who are incredibly good at what they do and let them do it. We provide the support and resources to let everyone be their authentic, best selves at work, at rest, and at play. We are committed to supporting the continual improvement of Apple in the workplace, the organizations that rely on them and the people who keep it all running smoothly.

Above it all, waves our banner of #OneJamf – and the knowledge that when we stand together, we accomplish so much more than we could alone. We seek individuals who share this unwavering journey toward growth to join us in our quest for constant improvement.

What does Jamf do?
Jamf extends the legendary Apple experience people enjoy in their personal lives to the workplace. We believe the experience of using a device at work or school should feel the same, and be as secure as, using a personal device. With Jamf, customers are able to confidently automate Mac, iPad, iPhone and Apple TV deployment, management, and security – anytime, anywhere – to protect the data and applications used by employees in the workplace, students learning in the classroom, and streamline communications in healthcare between patients and providers. More than 2,500 Jamf strong worldwide, we are free-thinkers, can-doers, and problems crushers who are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work each and every day.

Get social with us and follow the conversation at #OneJamf

Jamf is committed to creating an inclusive & supportive work environment for all candidates and employees. Candidates with disabilities or religious beliefs are encouraged to reach out if they need additional support or alternative options to our recruiting processes to accommodate their disability or religious belief. If you need an accommodation, please contact your Recruiter or Recruiting Coordinator directly. Requests for accommodation will be handled confidentially by Recruiting and will not be shared with the hiring manager. Jamf is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against individuals who request reasonable accommodation for disability or religious beliefs. To request accommodations please email us at recruiting@jamf.com

jobs.title: Associate Customer Success Manager (Remote LATAM or US)
jobs.description:
Hi, I'm Joe, Head of Customer Success at Whippy. I'm hiring an entrepreneurial Associate Customer Success Manager to retain and grow a dedicated book of customers.

This role is built for someone early in their career (0-1 years of experience), and new grads are welcome. You'll ramp alongside me and experienced teammates, then take ownership of your own customers as you prove you're ready.

 


WHY I'M HIRING

At Whippy, we view Customer Success as a revenue engine, not a cost center, because if customers don't get value from a tool, they'll leave. Whippy has six incredible products today because we've always built alongside our customers. That's how we evolved from a simple texting platform to now powering calls, texts, email, AI agents, and complex messaging and business automations for over 1,000 businesses. We ship fast to meet our customers' needs.

Most customers start with one use case, like a staffing firm using an AI voice agent to screen candidates. They stay and grow because they see real ROI, then expand use cases until Whippy becomes the infrastructure their business runs on. Your job is to drive that growth: make their first outcome happen during onboarding and implementation, uncover the next problem, and help them get even more value.

In this role, you'll mainly work with customers in the staffing industry. Their data flows into Whippy from their ATS, most often TempWorks, Avionte, Aqore/Zenople, Crelate, or Bullhorn, so you'll learn how staffing firms recruit and place talent, and how to build on top of their data.

Our customer success team has taken staffing customers from an initial $12K deal to $180K ARR because customers like Your Employment Solutions https://www.linkedin.com/company/your-employment-solutions/ are getting over $1M in ROI using Whippy to augment their teams and beat the competition.

You'll help us grow more customers by deeply understanding their desired outcomes, helping them achieve those outcomes, and providing an exceptional experience along the way.

This is one of those rare jobs with massive growth and learning opportunities: there's no bureaucracy here, and we're still early in building a world-class customer success team. You'll have a crucial role to play, and fresh ideas, feedback, and experimentation are always encouraged because we double down on wins and quickly pivot when ideas don't work out.

You'll work alongside our six-person customer success team and report directly to me. I'll provide the support, coaching, tools, and data to do the best work of your career here, plus the variable comp to get well rewarded when you deliver results.

I'm looking for someone who wants to be technical, strategic, and commercial, all in one. Technical as in you enjoy mastering the product and finding the best solutions for our customers. Strategic as in you deeply understand your customers' pain points and always have a plan to solve them. Commercial as in you have pricing awareness and understand the retention and expansion risks and opportunities in your book.

 


SOME THINGS YOU'LL DO

 - Own a book of business end to end, from onboarding through renewal and expansion, as the single point of contact and trusted advisor.

 - Run a proactive cadence on every account: prepared calls, clear agendas, mutual success plans, and follow-through.

 - Become a product and customer expert. Master Whippy's products and know your customers' business well enough to build the workflows, AI agents, and automations that solve their problems.

 - Learn fast. Shadow calls, get hands-on coaching from me, and take on more ownership every month.

 - Pick up the phone. Reach out proactively, ask the question instead of guessing, and get ahead of problems before they turn into escalations.

 - Own your gross and net revenue retention, and get rewarded for beating targets.

 - Tie usage to business outcomes, and report value back in the metrics customers actually care about.

 - Spot expansion signals and hand warm leads to sales when usage outgrows the contract.

 - Turn wins into case studies, references, and testimonials that help sales win the next customer.

 - Tell customers the truth, steering them away from work that won't move their business and toward the work that will.

 - Advocate for the customer. Feed what you hear to product, sales, and engineering so we build the right things.

 - Experiment and iterate. If you have an idea to do something better, do it and document what you learn.

 


OUR CUSTOMER SUCCESS VALUES

This is a high-performance environment, and I'll coach and support you through it. You'll be challenged, coached, and you'll always know where you stand. CS is a team sport, so it's okay to ask for help, experiment, fail, and pivot. A few things that are true here:

 - Everyone is a builder. Our team builds in the product without engineering, and the best product ideas come from you, the person closest to the customer. We use AI to move fast, but we own our work, verify every fact, and don't ship slop.

 - We lead with expertise, not order-taking. We get curious about the why behind every request, and we say no when no is the right answer.

 - We work like owners, not clock-watchers. We care about outcomes, not hours. We take initiative, pick up the phone, and work obsessively on the problem in front of us.

 - CS is a revenue engine, not a cost center. We treat it as the growth engine of the company and pay for results.

 


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Communication above all. This is the number one predictor of success in this role. You overcommunicate by default with customers, your team, and me. You're clear in writing and on calls, you set expectations, and you never leave people guessing.

 - Fast and proactive. You process information quickly, ask for what you need instead of waiting, and show up to every call prepared.

 - Curious, coachable, and low-ego. You're a fast learner who wants feedback, digs into the why behind every request, and gets better quickly.

 - Comfortable getting technical. You don't need to code, but you're the kind of person who enjoys taking a tool apart, figuring out how it works, and building something useful with it.

 - Strategic and commercial. You see usage and growth, not just tickets, and you're comfortable owning a number and an upgrade conversation.

 - Opinionated about customer experience. Good strategic advice needs well-formed views, so have them.

 - Self-directed. You take initiative, stay organized without being told, and run your own book without anyone managing your calendar. Calm under pressure.

 - 0-1 years of experience, and new grads are welcome. A STEM or technical degree, or something that shows you're entrepreneurial (you started, built, or ran something), matters more to us than past job titles. Customer-facing internships or jobs are a plus.

 - Bonus points for experience in the staffing industry or with TempWorks, Avionte, Aqore/Zenople, Crelate, or Bullhorn.

 - Based in Latin America or the US, with fluent written and spoken English, and able to work Eastern hours (we start at 8am ET).

 


YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF...

 - You're technical and love to build.

 - You're entrepreneurial. You treat your accounts like your own business and get energy from building from scratch.

 - You're a consultative problem solver. You dig into the why behind what a customer asks and recommend the right solution, even when it's not the one they came in asking for.

 - This sounds like fun to you: a customer wants to launch a complex, time-sensitive campaign across calls and texts, isn't sure how to structure it, and their team is stretched thin. You roll up your sleeves, map their goal to the product, and build it with them.

 - You thrive in a fast, evolving startup and you're excited to help build a customer success program from the ground up.

 


ABOUT WHIPPY

Whippy is a communication, automation, and AI agent platform. You reach customers across calls, texts, and email, at scale through personalized blasts and automated drips, with every message landing in one shared inbox. Replies get auto-assigned to a teammate, picked up by an AI agent, or carried forward by an automation. Once a conversation wraps, Whippy pushes the data you care about back into your systems in the exact format you need. It's true two-way dialogue on every channel that cuts the repetitive work and frees teams to focus on the human work that drives revenue, without adding headcount.

We're industry agnostic, with our biggest wins so far in staffing, healthcare, and other in-person businesses going through digital transformations. We're bootstrapped, profitable, and growing fast, with over 1,000 businesses using Whippy worldwide. In staffing alone, we've helped firms cut screening costs by 95% and save over a million dollars a year.

Whippy was founded in 2021 by CEO David Daneshgar and CTO Jack Kennedy. Jack is an engineering machine and a marathon runner. David started BloomNation in 2011 after winning $27,205 in a poker tournament, grew it into a platform generating billions in sales for florists, then left to build something bigger with Jack.

 

Location

This is a remote role open to candidates based anywhere in Latin America or the US. Our workday starts at 8am ET, so you'll need to work Eastern hours.

 

Compensation

Competitive compensation based on experience, including monthly performance bonuses and more.

 

Hiring Process

 1. A 30-minute call with me to get to know each other better.

 2. You'll receive a take-home assignment that assesses your technical and strategic skills, and you'll present it to me on a one-hour call. This is your chance to showcase your skills.

 3. A 30-minute call with our CEO, David.

jobs.description:

This role is for someone with 2-5 years of experience who's ready to own a book of customers end to end.

 


WHY I'M HIRING

Most customers start with one use case, like a staffing firm using an AI voice agent to screen candidates. They stay and grow because they see real ROI, then expand use cases until Whippy becomes the infrastructure their business runs on. Your job is to drive that growth: make their first outcome happen during onboarding and implementation, uncover the next problem, and help them get even more value.

In this role, you'll mainly work with customers in the staffing industry. Their data flows into Whippy from their ATS, most often TempWorks, Avionte, Aqore/Zenople, Crelate, or Bullhorn, so you'll learn how staffing firms recruit and place talent, and how to build on top of their data.

Our customer success team has taken staffing customers from an initial $12K deal to $180K ARR because customers like Your Employment Solutions https://www.linkedin.com/company/your-employment-solutions/ are getting over $1M in ROI using Whippy to augment their teams and beat the competition.

You'll help us grow more customers by deeply understanding their desired outcomes, helping them achieve those outcomes, and providing an exceptional experience along the way.

This is one of those rare jobs with massive growth and learning opportunities: there's no bureaucracy here, and we're still early in building a world-class customer success team. You'll have a crucial role to play, and fresh ideas, feedback, and experimentation are always encouraged because we double down on wins and quickly pivot when ideas don't work out.

You'll work alongside our six-person customer success team and report directly to me. I'll provide the support, coaching, tools, and data to do the best work of your career here, plus the variable comp to get well rewarded when you deliver results.

 - Juggle multiple customers and projects at once, and prioritize based on impact.

 - Pick up the phone. Reach out proactively, ask the question instead of guessing, and get ahead of problems before they turn into escalations.

 - Own your gross and net revenue retention, and get rewarded for beating targets.

 - Tie usage to business outcomes, and report value back in the metrics customers actually care about.

 - Spot expansion signals and hand warm leads to sales when usage outgrows the contract.

 - Turn wins into case studies, references, and testimonials that help sales win the next customer.

jobs.title: Global Supply Manager (Natural Gas Origination)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

GLOBAL SUPPLY MANAGER (NATURAL GAS ORIGINATION)

The SpaceX supply chain department is a critical player in enabling SpaceX mission. To capitalize on SpaceX’s technological and market changing successes, our team will be part of managing an agile yet robust supply chain that will enable a competitive advantage for the company. The functions within the department include procurement, planning and fulfillment, supplier development and quality, logistics and inventory. SpaceX supply chain will play a key role in enabling SpaceX to meet the ambitious growth targets and greatly contribute in making us a multi-planetary species. This individual will originate and manage physical natural gas supply and pipeline transportation for SpaceX power generation and for production, test, and launch operations.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Originate and manage physical natural gas supply for assigned SpaceX sites, including term baseload, swing, and spot volumes structured to meet the daily and hourly requirements of power generation, production, test, and launch operations

• Secure and manage firm transportation, storage, and no-notice service on interstate and intrastate pipelines, and lead development of new laterals, taps, and interconnects from precedent agreement through construction and in-service

• Partner with site, power, and facilities leadership to ensure supply and transportation capacity are contracted in advance of site ramp schedules

• Develop and execute supply contingency plans for severe weather, force majeure, operational flow orders, and curtailments, and advise leadership on supply options and risk exposure during critical events

• Manage the delivered cost of gas, including analysis of index and basis exposure, fuel retention, imbalance, and credit, and identify and execute cost reductions through pricing structure, transportation path optimization, and contract restructuring

• Maintain comprehensive market intelligence for assigned supply areas, including hub and basis pricing, pipeline utilization and constraints, production trends, and the counterparty landscape

• Negotiate NAESB base contracts and special provisions, transaction confirmations, precedent agreements, and firm transportation service agreements in collaboration with legal

• Manage counterparty performance against delivery, gas quality, credit, and capacity obligations, and establish performance KPIs for gas suppliers and pipelines

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Advanced degree and 4+ years, bachelor’s degree and 6+ years, or 10+ years of commercial natural gas experience in one or more of the following:

• Physical natural gas origination

• Fuel supply for a power generator, utility, or large industrial end user

• Pipeline commercial roles, including business development, capacity marketing, or shipper contracting

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Experience originating physical natural gas in Texas, Louisiana, or the Mid-Continent, at points such as Henry Hub, Houston Ship Channel, Katy, Waha, Agua Dulce, and Gillis

• Demonstrated success negotiating term physical supply with producers and marketers under the NAESB base contract, including special provisions, credit support, firm delivery obligations, and force majeure terms

• Shipper-side experience on new lateral or pipeline expansion projects, from open season and precedent agreement through firm transportation and interconnect agreements to in-service

• Working knowledge of FERC-regulated interstate and Texas RRC-regulated intrastate pipelines, including tariffs, capacity release, nominations, imbalances, cash-out, and operational flow orders

• Experience supplying gas-fired power generation, including management of hourly swing, no-notice and storage services, and gas quality specifications

• Experience managing natural gas supply through severe weather or force majeure events

• Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills, including the ability to convey deal structure, cost, and risk to executive leadership

• Holds self to highest ethical standards, and conducts all activities with the highest of integrity

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• This position is based in Cape Canaveral, FL and requires being onsite

• Ability to pass Air Force background checks for Cape Canaveral

• Must be able to travel. Up to 25% of work week travel may be required

• Must be able to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed to meet major milestones and to support operations

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com.

Competitive compensation based on experience, including monthly performance bonuses and more.

jobs.title: Lead Engineer, Manufacturing Sciences & Technology (MSAT)
jobs.description:
The field of gene therapy is growing rapidly and Genezen is here to meet the exacting needs of our clients. We provide process development, produce GMP viral vectors, and provide cell transduction for gene and cell therapy clinical trials and are proud to be a part of the process that leads to new cures.

WORKING AT GENEZEN

Many people have worked in environments where you feel like just another nameless part of an enormous machine. Genezen is different. We want our employees to be innovative, collaborative problem solvers who are dedicated to meeting the challenges of working at a fast-growing company. We are dedicated to empowering our employees to be their best and making Genezen a rewarding place to work. Every employee contributes to the success of the company and you can be part of that team.

JOB SUMMARY

The Lead Engineer, MSAT provides technical leadership for the transfer, validation, and cGMP manufacturing of clinical and commercial gene therapy products within a dynamic CDMO environment. The role leads technical activities across assigned programs, drives process understanding and troubleshooting, evaluates and mitigates technical risks, and ensures effective execution as program and client priorities evolve. This individual serves as a key technical partner to Process Development, Manufacturing, Engineering, Validation, Quality, Supply Chain, and external clients, helping translate process knowledge into robust and reliable manufacturing execution.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

• Lead technology transfer to GMP manufacturing by drafting/reviewing process description documents and technology transfer reports, reviewing master batch records, protocols, and providing on-floor support for transfer operations.

• Assist with manufacturing technical support, including process troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and investigation of process and/or quality discrepancies and deviations during GMP production, change controls, and CAPAs.

• Support the planning and execution of process/product lifecycle management, including continuous upstream process improvement to improve process robustness, capacity, and productivity and/or compliance

• Cross functional collaboration with Process Development, Manufacturing, QC, QA, Engineering, Validation and Supply Chain, as needed.

• Lead process validation campaign to develop a thorough understanding of operating and performance parameters.

SPECIAL JOB REQUIREMENTS

• Ability to generate, manage, evaluate, and maintain critical data in a highly organized manner

• Experience with statistical analysis of process data (generation and trending control charts, linear regression and multivariate analysis)

• Criminal background check required

• Other duties as assigned

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

EDUCATION / CERTIFICATIONS / LICENSES

Essential/Desired

BS/MS/PhD degree in Engineering or other related scientific discipline preferred

Essential

ON-THE-JOB EXPERIENCE

5+ years of relevant experience in gene therapy or other biotechnology industry.

Essential

SKILLS / ABILITIES

Strong communication skills at individual, team, and organizational levels, including written and oral communication

Essential

Experience in process development (Upstream must) and sterile GMP manufacturing for cell and gene therapy

Essential

Experience developing and executing tech transfer from process development into GMP manufacturing.

Essential

Ability to drive process FMEAs and risk assessments

Essential

Good understanding of upstream processes of viral vectors, cell/gene therapy, or recombinant biologics.

Essential

Proven knowledge and experience of risk-based approaches to process development and validation.

Essential

Demonstrated sufficient knowledge and experience in cell culture and cell & virus banking.

Essential

Ability to cope with many topics in parallel, to cope with strict timelines and to handle pressure.

Essential

Ability to generate, manage, evaluate, and maintain critical data in a highly organized manner.

Essential

Experience of working in CDMO space.

Desired

Knowledge of the current pharmaceutical, regulatory, and technology trends.

Desired

Knowledge of data management tools and statistical process controls.

Desired

Understanding of downstream processes of viral vectors, cell/gene therapy, or recombinant biologics.

Desired

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is required to meet the following physical demands:

Work Environment

• Regularly sit for long periods of time

Movement

• Frequently required to stand; sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms

• Occasionally required to walk; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl

Lifting

• Frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds

• Occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds

Vision

• Frequently utilize close vision and the ability to adjust focus

Communication

• Frequently required to communicate by talking, hearing, using telephone and e-mail

Pay Range:
The annual salary range for this position is $125,000-$150,000.

GENEZEN'S CURES VALUE-BASED COMPETENCIES

Committed to Science
We are committed to scientific excellence, staying current with industry developments, making data-driven decisions, and pursuing innovation to advance healthcare.

Urgency in action for the patients
We operate with urgency and a commitment to delivering timely treatments to patients by accelerating our partners' programs.

Resilience & Grit in operations
We are committed to overcoming challenges, learning from failures, and persistently striving for success.

Execute with Excellence & Integrity
We are dedicated to delivering quality results and upholding ethical principals.

Solutions driven for our partners
We are committed to being a proactive, collaborative, creative and open-minded partner.

GENEZEN'S BENEFITS

• Paid vacation days, amount based on tenure

• Paid sick time

• 10 observed holidays + 2 floating holiday + 1 volunteer day

jobs.title: Customer Solutions
jobs.description:
CUSTOMER SOLUTIONS (POST-SALES)

About Sent

Sent is a developer tool for customer engagement. We help developers and agents deliver messages across voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and RCS through a single API. Our intelligent routing model automates channel selection, ensuring lower cost and global deliverability without channel-specific integrations. Our built-in multitenancy also enables our customers to deploy messaging and voice agents across their own customers.

We recently closed a $12M Series A backed by Companyon Ventures, Bessemer Venture Partners, UIF, and others. We're hiring the best to scale a best-in-class platform.

About the role

Sent is replacing the infra that every developer complains about. With service and support that developers rave about. We're growing in a market where traditional vendors have spent years giving customers reasons to leave.

Once a customer signs, you take over. As a Customer Solutions Engineer, you own the customer's journey from signed contract to live, growing, and happy. You'll get them onboarded, activated, and sending, then build the relationship that keeps them with us and expanding.

You're part technical problem-solver, part customer champion. This is an early-stage company, so you'll have high ownership, true impact, and a very loose playbook.

What you'll do

 - Onboard: Guide new customers through setup: API integration, webhooks, templates, sender registration, number provisioning, voice setup.

 - Activate: Drive customers from signed to sending live traffic fast. Spot stalled accounts, find the blocker, and clear it

 - Solve: Debug delivery, routing, and compliance issues. Dig into logs and the API yourself, and escalate to Engineering with clear context when needed

 - Build relationships: Be the trusted technical partner for your accounts through regular check-ins, proactive outreach, and honest conversations

 - Grow accounts: Understand each customer's goals, identify new use cases, channels, and volume, and bring expansion opportunities to the team

 - Protect revenue: Monitor usage and health signals, catch churn risk early, and own the save plan

 - Scale it: Build the docs, scripts, templates, and playbooks that make the next onboarding faster

 - Close the loop: Turn customer patterns into clear product feedback for Product and Engineering

You might be a fit if you

 - Have 3+ years in customer success, post-sales solutions engineering, technical account management (or you're an engineer or founder who loves working with customers)

 - Can read API docs, make API calls, and write basic code, and you're fluent in using AI tools for efficiency

 - Explain technical concepts clearly to developers and non-technical stakeholders

 - Build trust quickly and communicate with warmth and directness

 - Care about customer outcomes more than a to-do list

 - Operate with a founder mindset - do well under pressure, high-agency, opinionated, and want to be early at a company where you have a tangible impact

Nice to have

 - Experience with technical products / developer tools, communications APIs, messaging

 - Familiarity with SMS compliance (10DLC, TCR, opt-in/opt-out), the WhatsApp Business Platform, RCS, or voice

 - Early-stage startup experience

 - Experience building lightweight automations or internal tools

What success looks like

 - 30 days: You know the product and API cold and are running onboarding calls and handling escalations.

 - 90 days: You own a book of customers, time-to-first-send is dropping, and you've shipped a tool, doc, or playbook the team uses.

 - 6 months: Customers see you as their technical partner. Retention and expansion in your book are measurably strong, and you've substantially shaped how we scale post-sales.

Our Commitment to You

 - Meaningful equity with high growth potential

 - Top-tier medical, dental, vision fully covered

 - 401(k) with 100% match up to 4%

 - Unlimited PTO

 - Beautiful NYC workspace with daily meals and unlimited snacks

 - New MacBook Pro + Apple Studio Display

 - Fully comped Wellhub Gold or Equinox membership

Sent, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences.

As AI adoption accelerates, security, privacy, and data leaders are rethinking how they find, protect, and govern their most sensitive data. BigID is the platform many of the world’s largest organizations rely on to do it.

As a Senior Customer Success Manager for our West/Central region, you’ll own a portfolio of 10-15 large enterprise accounts and act as a trusted advisor to CISOs, privacy officers, and data and governance leaders. You’ll turn BigID’s platform into measurable business outcomes, spot risk and opportunity early, and lead cross-functional teams to deliver results. You’ll join a Customer Success team of 7, working alongside Sales, Support, Professional Services, Product, and Engineering.

What you’ll do

• Drive measurable outcomes. Build and run success plans tied to each customer’s business goals, and standardized engagement models and playbooks so every customer gets a consistent experience as we scale.

• Lead the customer relationship at every level. Run onboarding, adoption programs, health checks, and QBRs/EBRs, from practitioners through executives.

• Protect the base. Track usage, executive dashboards, and health indicators to catch churn signals early, and build and run mitigation plans for at-risk accounts.

• Grow accounts with Sales. Partner with Sales on renewals, cross-sell, and upsell, aligning BigID capabilities (data discovery, classification, privacy, security, and AI governance) to each customer’s priorities.

• Clear the path. Orchestrate Support, Professional Services, Product, and Engineering to resolve blockers and deliver key outcomes.

• Be the voice of the customer. Bring customer feedback and product needs to Product and Engineering, and keep customers informed on upcoming releases and enhancements.

What success looks like in your first 12 months

• Customers in your portfolio reach their agreed success milestones, with executive-level relationships established at each key account

• Gross and net retention at or above target, with at-risk accounts identified early and moved back to healthy

• A qualified expansion pipeline built in partnership with Sales

• Customer health tracked consistently and reviewed with leadership on a regular cadence

What you’ll bring

Required

• 5+ years in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, or consulting, including 2+ years managing large enterprise accounts

• Background in data security, privacy, data governance, or cybersecurity, as a customer or a vendor

• Working knowledge of multi-cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), on-prem, and SaaS data environments, and of structured and unstructured data

• A record of driving adoption and managing risk to deliver renewals and expansion

• Comfort presenting to a CISO and running an executive business review

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills in complex data environments

• Based in the West/Central US

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

Nice to have

• DSPM, DLP, or AI governance experience

• Understanding of recurring-revenue value drivers

• CIPP, CIPM, CISSP, or cloud certifications

• Experience in a high-growth, scale-up environment

What’s in it for you (BigBenefits)

Our people are the foundation of our success, and we offer a wide range of benefits that help our team be happier and healthier.

• Equity participation, so everyone shares in our success

• Flexible work arrangements

• Medical, dental, and vision coverage

• 401(k) participation from Day 1

• Flexible PTO / holidays / parental leave

• Knowledge training and career development tracks

Our values

We look for people who embody Care, Do, Try & Shine:

• Care: We care about our customers and each other

• Do: We do what it takes to make a positive impact

• Try: We try our best and we don’t give up

• Shine: We shine and make it our mission to always stand out

The annual base salary range is $120,000 to $150,000. Actual salaries vary based on a candidate’s qualifications, skills, and competencies. Salary is one component of our Compensation Philosophy. Variable/bonus compensation and equity incentives align with individual and company performance.

We’re committed to creating a culture of inclusion and equality – across race, gender, sexuality, and disability – where innovation and growth thrive, every voice is heard, and everybody belongs. Learn more about us here.

Must be able to exercise independent judgment with little or no oversight.
