jobs.title: Executive Assistant - Developer Platform
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Austin, TX or New York

About the Role

Cloudflare is looking for a bright, proactive, and detail-oriented Executive Assistant to support three leaders in our Developer GTM organization. We are looking for a dynamic and dedicated candidate who is comfortable with multi-tasking and prioritization in a fast-paced, product-first environment with close attention to detail, accuracy, and timeliness.

Responsibilities

• Calendar & Conflict Management: Proactively manage complex calendars with a strong understanding of business priorities. Independently resolve scheduling conflicts and anticipate meeting requests and logistical needs before they are explicitly stated.

• Travel & Logistics: Manage and coordinate complex international and domestic travel, including visa and passport needs, as well as end-to-end logistical arrangements for executives and teams.

• Executive Support & Business Context: Develop a deeper understanding of the managers' roles, our products, and the broader market and context for Cloudflare. Serve as a trusted gatekeeper who can confidently answer routine questions on behalf of the executives.

• Expenses Meeting Coordination: Prepare and manage expense reports..

• Projects & Process Improvement: Contribute significantly to ad-hoc/special projects. Recognize where operational processes can be improved and actively suggest and implement those process improvements.

• Meetings & Event Planning: Coordinate and assist with large meetings, external stakeholders, and event planning with precision.

Requirements

• 6+ years experience as an Administrative Assistant, in Ops, or equivalent experience.

• Scope & Judgment: A seasoned professional with proven experience handling problems of diverse scope and demonstrating excellent judgment in selecting administrative and operational methods.

• Proactiveness & Autonomy: Strong sense of urgency, proactiveness, and the ability to manage your own time with limited or no supervision.

• Communication & Networking: Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to network and build strong relationships with executives and team members.

• Organizational Skills: Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Mindset: A "no task is too small" attitude combined with the strategic mindset needed to anticipate executive needs.

Drive: Experience working in a tech and AI-native, product-led environment.

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location and level.

Estimated Salary for New York:  $114,000 - 157,000

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

jobs.title: Controls & Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Vast is developing next-generation space stations and space infrastructure using an incremental, hardware-rich, and capital-efficient approach. Vast is rapidly developing its multi-module Haven Station to support a continuous human presence in space for America and its allies, enabling advanced microgravity research and manufacturing, and supporting a growing space economy for government, corporate, and private customers. Haven Demo’s 2025 success made Vast the only operational commercial space station company to design, build, and operate its own spacecraft in orbit. Next, Haven-1 is targeted to become the world’s first commercial space station, with launch anticipated in 2027, followed by additional Haven modules. Additionally, the company recently announced two new offerings leveraging its space station components and the heritage of Haven Demo: Vast Satellite, a high-power satellite product line; and Vast Lunar Systems, power, communications, and habitats for the Moon.

Headquartered in Long Beach, California, and with more than 1,000 employees and over a billion dollars in private capital, Vast has built the facilities capable of manufacturing America’s next space station. The company plans to develop future habitats and systems for Mars, dedicated modules for government partners, and other crewed systems designed to unlock the expanding long-term space economy.

Vast is looking for a Controls & Automation Engineer, to help develop the systems behind our human-rated space stations. You will drive the development and execution of human-rated vehicle processes as Haven-1 transitions from design to a flight-ready station.

This will be a full-time, exempt position located in our Long Beach, CA location.

Responsibilities:

• Develop and maintain a data acquisition and controls stack to support a wide range of partnering test teams at the Long Beach site—creating software tools and setting standards for test assets and practices.

• Design, implement, and own complex control systems for testing space-rated hardware, with responsibility for both hardware and software components.

• Collaborate across disciplines—including software, thermal, manufacturing, propulsion, ECLSS, and mechanical test teams—to drive robust testing practices, gather upgrade requests, and define new capabilities for the test stack.

• Troubleshoot and debug test assets to resolve issues quickly and ensure optimal test system performance.

Minimum Qualifications:

• B.S. in mechanical, aerospace, manufacturing or electrical engineering, physics, mathematics, or a related technical field.

• Manufacturing experience (including internships) managing a product/product line across multiple work centers and/or departments, fluid, pressurized, propulsion, or environmental control hardware in design, manufacturing, or test.

• 2-4+ years of experience for Manufacturing Engineer II

• 4-6+ years of experience for Senior Manufacturing Engineer

• Hands-on fabrication, assembly, and/or integration experience; CAD proficiency (NX preferred).

Preferred Skills & Experience:

• Hands-on experience building or testing hardware, in industry or through student teams such as Formula SAE, rocketry, CubeSat, or robotics.

• Experience with aerospace, spacecraft, propulsion, or other safety-critical or high-reliability hardware.

• Experience taking designs or processes from concept through build or test, and from R&D to production.

• Familiarity with CAD tools, ideally Siemens NX, and PLM tools such as Teamcenter.

• Exposure to thermal or structural analysis using Ansys, or similar tools.

• Awareness of aerospace workmanship, design, and environmental test standards such as IPC, SMC-S-016, NASA-STD-5001, or MIL-STD-810.

• Proficiency applying GD&T.

• Strong problem-solving skills, including troubleshooting and structured root cause analysis.

• Strong attention to detail, clear communication, and the ability to work well in cross-functional teams.

• Senior Level: experience mentoring engineers or technicians and managing multiple projects at once.

Additional Requirements:

• Willingness to work evenings and/or weekends to support critical mission milestones.

Pay Ranges:

• Engineer/ Level I: $86,100.00 - $122,220.00

• Engineer/ Level II: $112,340.00 - $159,468.00

• Senior Engineer/ Level III: $137,760.00 - $195,552.00

We calibrate level and compensation to the selected candidate's experience and demonstrated capability. We welcome applicants across a range of experience levels to apply.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

Base salary will vary depending on job-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, business needs, and market demand. Salary is just one component of our comprehensive compensation package. Full-time employees also receive company equity, as well as access to a full suite of compelling benefits and perks, including: medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents, generous paid time off; up to 20+ days of vacation for exempt staff and up to 10+ days of vacation for non-exempt staff with the ability to cash-out unused vacation annually, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, ClassPass credits, personalized mental healthcare through Spring Health, and other discounts and perks. We also take pride in offering exceptional food perks, with snacks, drip coffee & onsite barista, cold drinks, and dinner meals remaining free of charge, and lunch subsidized as part of Vast’s ongoing commitment to providing high-quality meals for employees.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Vast is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with Vast is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: External Affairs Insights Manager
jobs.description:
About SK hynix America:

At SK hynix America, we are at the forefront of semiconductor innovation. As a global leader in HBM, DRAM, and NAND flash technologies, we develop the advanced memory solutions powering everything from advanced mobile technology to massive AI data centers. With major investments in the U.S. and a leading position in the global AI revolution, we build the critical infrastructure of the digital landscape and remain committed to sustainable operations. We invite innovative minds to be part of our journey. Here, you will be part of a collaborative team pioneering the next generation of memory technologies, expanding our market footprint, and defining the future of computing.

Work Model: Onsite

Key Responsibilities:

Public Safety and Emergency Coordination

• Serve as the External Affairs liaison to local law enforcement, sheriff’s offices, fire/EMS, and emergency management, in coordination with Security and EHS.

• Coordinate public-safety contacts, preparedness meetings, tabletop exercises, and interagency communication protocols

• Provide situational updates during major incidents, severe weather, public demonstrations, or other disruptions affecting the site or neighboring community.

Early Warning and Risk Assessment

• Identify and assess emerging community conflicts, reputational risks, public-safety concerns, and potential operational disruptions

• Evaluate likelihood, impact, affected stakeholders, and response options; promptly escalate material risks to External Affairs leadership and relevant functions

• Support contingency planning for construction impacts, environmental concerns, accidents, labor-related tensions, and high-profile visits

Stakeholder and Agency Engagement

• Build and maintain working relationships with police, fire and EMS leaders, emergency managers, municipal officials, neighborhood representatives, and community organizations

• Represent External Affairs at public meetings, agency coordination sessions, and site visits; document commitments and follow-up actions

• Provide Community Relations and Government Relations with stakeholder context, issue history, and engagement recommendations

Community and Stakeholder Insights

• Monitor public meetings, local media, approved open sources, and stakeholder feedback for developments affecting site operations, construction, employees, or community relationships

• Track concerns involving traffic, noise, environmental impact, land use, housing, workforce growth, and public safety; identify recurring themes and trends

• Maintain a stakeholder map covering local government, public-safety agencies, neighborhood groups, businesses, educational institutions, and nonprofits

• Distinguish verified incidents and credible operational risks from rumors, isolated complaints, and lawful civic activity

Executive Reporting and Internal Coordination

• Prepare concise leadership briefings, issue assessments, stakeholder updates, and pre- and post-event reports with recommended actions

• Coordinate with Communications, Government Relations, Community Relations, Security, EHS, Construction, HR, and Operations on issue response

• Track outstanding stakeholder concerns, agency coordination items, and company commitments through resolution

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Criminal Justice, Emergency Management, Public Administration, Political Science, or a related field; alternatively, 15+ years of directly relevant professional experience

• 10+ years of experience in law enforcement, emergency management, public safety, or public-sector safety leadership

• 5+ years in a supervisory, command, director-level, or senior public-safety liaison role

• Current or previously held state-recognized law-enforcement certification, Certified Emergency Manager (CEM) credential, or comparable documented public-safety qualification

• 5+ years of direct coordination with police, sheriff’s offices, fire/EMS, emergency management, or municipal government agencies

• Completed NIMS/ICS training or equivalent documented incident-management training (preferred)

• 2+ years working with manufacturing, major construction, utilities, infrastructure, or other critical-infrastructure operations (preferred)

Ethical and Operating Standards:

• Use lawful, transparent, and approved information sources; do not request or use nonpublic law-enforcement records, protected personal data, or sensitive political information

• Do not characterize lawful criticism, resident complaints, union activity, or peaceful protest as security threats solely because they oppose company actions

• Maintain separation between stakeholder engagement and law-enforcement or investigative functions; refer legal, privacy, ethics, and security issues to the appropriate teams

Requirement:

• Must be authorized to work in the United States without restrictions or future sponsorship.

Benefits:

• Top Tier health insurance at no employee cost

• Paid day offs: Paid Time Off, Company Holidays, Parental Leave, Happy Fridays

• 401k Matching

• Flexible Spending Account (FSA) for Health Care & Dependent Care

• Educational reimbursement up to $10,000 per year

• Donation Matching and volunteering opportunities

• Corporate discount programs

jobs.title: Executive Communications Lead
jobs.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

The browser, and browser engine remain how we underpin choice and control when people access the web. Now, AI is posing generation-defining questions: what say do people have in their choices online and who controls the web? Over 25 years ago Mozilla and allies took on this challenge, but the time has come to revisit some fundamentals. This is exactly the kind of moment Firefox was built for.

We're looking for a Head of Executive Communications to lead how Mozilla's senior leaders show up in the world. This is a role for someone who has experience working directly with a CEO, thinks strategically, writes exceptionally well, has strong project management skills and understands how to translate complex ideas into narratives that move people and shape debates.

Mozilla has a perspective that is rare in tech. We are driven by our double bottom line, not by shareholders. We are a deeply technical organization, mission-driven, and have decades of experience at the heart of the open web. Getting that perspective heard, and heard in the right rooms, is what this role is about.

You will own executive visibility and thought leadership for Mozilla's CEO and leadership team, working closely with the wider Communications team, Product teams and Public Policy to ensure our leaders are positioned as authoritative, credible voices on the issues that define the future of the internet. You will report into the Director of Corporate Communications and serve as a trusted strategic partner to the executives you support.

What you'll do:

• Own the executive communications function: develop and drive a proactive, strategic approach to how Mozilla's CEO and senior leadership team are seen and heard externally.

• Prepare executives for high-stakes engagements: major interviews, keynotes, regulatory testimony, crisis moments, and industry forums.

• Build and manage an executive visibility calendar that is proactive, strategic, and aligned to Mozilla's goals, not just reactive to inbound requests.

• Write, develop, and refine speeches, keynote remarks, op-eds, briefing documents, talking points, and interview preparation materials across a range of formats and audiences.

• Build productive working relationships and act as a consistent partner to the executives you support: understanding their voice, their expertise, and how to marry both to Mozilla's corporate objectives.

• Partner closely with the broader Communications team, Public Policy, Marketing and other cross functional teams to ensure executive communications is consistent with and reinforcing Mozilla's broader narrative, policy positions, and product moments.

• Develop a thought leadership strategy that positions Mozilla's leadership as distinctive, credible voices on the questions that matter, but are often in a crowded space: AI and the future of the web, privacy and digital rights, open source, competition, and the intersection of technology and public interest.

• Coordinate with external agencies and freelance writers where needed, maintaining a high editorial bar throughout.

What you’ll bring:

• 8–12+ years of experience in communications, with a significant focus on executive communications, speechwriting, or thought leadership, ideally in or around technology, policy, or mission-driven organisations.

• Direct experience of working at CEO level, and the ability to work across teams and build trust with senior stakeholders quickly.

• Exceptional writing skills. You write clearly, quickly, and in other people's voices. Your op-eds are readable. Your briefing documents are used. Your talking points don't sound like talking points.

• A track record of preparing senior executives for high-stakes external engagements, and of making them better communicators over time.

• Strong editorial judgement for both the issues and the draft: you identify where Mozilla's leadership should participate in public debate, where they should shape it, and where they should stay out of it; you know what a good argument looks like, you know when a draft isn't there yet, and you can explain why.

• Experience working at the intersection of technology, policy, and public interest, or a clear understanding of why Mozilla's position in that space matters.

• Comfort with complexity and nuance. Mozilla operates at the intersection of technology, policy, and public interest, and our communications environment reflects that.

• Mission alignment. You understand why Mozilla exists, you find the work meaningful, and that comes through in how you operate.

• Commitment to our values:

• Play to win Build for people first Engage evidence over ego Decide and deliver Ship, learn, repeat

What will help you stand out:

• Global or multilingual experience: coordinating people across regions or working with international press.

• Policy or public affairs exposure: a basic government affairs understanding of some of our key issues (privacy, security, AI, competition).

What you’ll get:

• Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team

• Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage

• Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)

• Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together

• Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday

• One-time home office stipend

• Annual professional development budget

• Quarterly well-being stipend

• Considerable paid parental leave

• Employee referral bonus program

• Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission.  We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at hiringaccommodation@mozilla.com to request accommodation.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race (including hairstyle and texture), religion (including religious grooming and dress practices), gender, gender identity, gender expression, color, national origin, pregnancy, ancestry, domestic partner status, disability, sexual orientation, age, genetic predisposition, medical condition, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable laws.  Mozilla will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior, conduct, or purpose.

jobs.title: Training & Safety Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Opportunity:

Position Summary

The Training Coordinator supports the distribution center by coordinating and executing operational training while supporting environmental, health, and safety programs that protect employees, promote regulatory compliance, and strengthen a proactive safety culture. The role provides day-to-day direction and readiness support to facility trainers, maintains training documentation and schedules, and partners with Operations, site leadership, frontline employees, and EHS team to support incident prevention, facilitate safety training, and maintain accurate EHS reporting. The position is expected to maintain a visible presence on the warehouse floor while balancing training, administrative, reporting, and continuous-improvement responsibilities.

Position Responsibilities:

Training Coordination

• Provide day-to-day direction to facility trainers and ensure trainer readiness and coverage.
• Ensure operational training programs are properly and consistently executed within the facility.
• Determine facility training needs and partner with the Safety & Training Supervisor and site leadership to develop or update training programs.
• Implement approved training program changes and ensure training materials contain current, location-specific information.
• Plan training schedules and coordinate trainer coverage to support operational needs.
• Maintain training documents and records for audit and compliance purposes.
• Identify, prepare, and print training paperwork, instructions, labels, and other supporting materials.
• Track trainees overall training & efficiencies and provide accurate reporting to leadership.

Environmental, Health & Safety

• Conduct routine safety walks to identify hazards, evaluate risks, recommend mitigation strategies, and follow through on corrective actions.
• Record workplace injuries, incidents, and near-misses; prepare required reports; and assist with investigations and root cause analysis.
• Coordinate and facilitate EHS training, including new-hire onboarding, emergency procedures, ergonomics, safe work practices, and compliance topics.
• Lead or support employee safety engagement initiatives, site campaigns, safety meetings, and other activities that strengthen a proactive safety culture.
• Support risk-mitigation programs including ergonomics assessments, equipment inspections, warehouse safety checks, and compliance audits.
• Serve as a visible floor-level safety resource by coaching employees, reinforcing safe behaviors, and partnering with Operations on corrective actions.
• Identify trends and improvement opportunities and collaborate with site leadership to enhance training and safety processes.

General Responsibilities

• Collaborate effectively with management, employees, customers, vendors, staffing partners, and corporate partners.
• Prepare clear reports and correspondence; read and interpret operational, shipping, inventory, safety, and compliance documents.
• Analyze and interpret reports, graphs, metrics, and other data to support training, staffing, and EHS decisions.
• Maintain strong attention to detail, accurate data entry, and timely completion of assigned work.
• Use Microsoft Office and learn applicable training, operational, and EHS systems.
• Maintain regular and timely attendance and perform other responsibilities assigned by the manager or supervisor.

What We’re Looking For:

• Experience working in a warehouse, distribution center, logistics, training, safety, or related operational environment preferred.
• Ability to build rapport and work effectively with employees at all levels across a diverse workforce.
• Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to facilitate training and safety meetings in group settings.
• Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and recommend practical corrective actions.
• Ability to speak, read, and write in English; bilingual English/Spanish preferred.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office and ability to learn training, operational, and EHS-related software tools.
• General knowledge of environmental, health, and safety practices, including hazard identification, ergonomics, incident investigation, and regulatory compliance.
• Technical EHS knowledge, including OSHA/Cal-OSHA standards and safety systems, preferred.
• Knowledge of warehouse machinery, processes, and ergonomics preferred.
• Certified Clamp Truck Operator preferred.

Don’t meet every single requirement? At Mattel, we are dedicated to an inclusive workplace and a culture of belonging. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. Join Mattel's Talent Community and start receiving exciting updates about our company, our employees, and our culture. Also, interested in signing up for job alerts? Do so here!

How We Work:

We are a purpose driven company aiming to empower generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors:

• We collaborate: Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower.
• We innovate: At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking.
• We execute: We are a performance-driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best-in-class outcomes. We believe in accountability and ownership and know that our people are at their best when they are empowered to create and deliver results.

Our Approach to Flexible Work:

This role is an in-office role Monday-Thursday, and work from home on Fridays. We embrace a flexible work model designed to empower a culture of growth, optimism, and wellbeing, where every employee can reach their full potential. Combining purposeful in-person collaboration with flexibility, our focus is to optimize performance and drive connection for moments that matter.

Who We Are:

Mattel is a leading global toy and family entertainment company and owner of one of the most iconic brand portfolios in the world. We engage consumers and fans through our franchise brands, including Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher-Price, American Girl, Thomas & Friends, UNO, Masters of the Universe, Matchbox, Monster High, MEGA and Polly Pocket, as well as other popular properties that we own or license in partnership with global entertainment companies. Our offerings include toys, content, consumer products, digital and live experiences. Our products are sold in collaboration with the world’s leading retail and ecommerce companies. Since its founding in 1945, Mattel is proud to be a trusted partner in empowering generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential.

Mattel’s award-winning workplace culture has been recognized by Forbes, Fast Company, Newsweek, Great Place to Work, TIME, and more.

Visit us at https://jobs.mattel.com/ and www.instagram.com/MattelCareers.

Beware of recruiting scams: Mattel will only contact you through official @mattel.com or @smartrecruiters.com email addresses and will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.

Mattel is an Equal Opportunity Employer where we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day. We welcome all job seekers, and all applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran and protected veteran status, disability status, and or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

Pursuant to the Los Angeles Fair Chance Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act, qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment.

The pay range for this position is between $20 and $24 per hour. The pay range is indicative of projected hiring range, however base pay will be determined based on a candidate’s work location, skills and experience. Mattel offers competitive total pay programs, comprehensive benefits, and resources to help empower a culture where every employee can reach their full potential.

jobs.title: Staff Storage Engineer
jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.



We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.



We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.



If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.



About the Role:

At Crusoe, we are on a mission to align the future of computing with the future of the climate. As a Staff Storage Administrator on the Storage Team, you will be the lead architect and operator of the data layer for our vertically integrated AI cloud. This team sits at the critical intersection of massive-scale data ingress/egress and high-performance GPU workloads, ensuring that our sustainable clusters deliver world-class data throughput for the world’s most demanding AI and HPC use cases.

You will manage the end-to-end lifecycle of our world-wide storage environment from initial bring-up and configuration to high-level vendor strategy. In this role, you will have a direct hand in shaping our enterprise infrastructure, collaborating on vendor RFPs and reviewing responses while working directly to influence vendor product roadmaps. Your work ensures that Fortune 500 companies and leading AI researchers have the performant, reliable, and sustainable storage needed to power the AI revolution.



What You'll Be Working On:

 - Performance Analysis & Optimization:  Evaluate performance of block, file, and object storage systems across diverse workloads. Identify bottlenecks at the hardware, firmware, OS, and application layers. Develop and execute performance test plans, benchmarks, and stress tests. Tune storage stacks (I/O schedulers, caching layers, drivers, protocols) to achieve target KPIs.

 - Validation & Testing: Design and execute Proof of Concept (PoC) exercises to take new arrays through their paces. You will validate new vendor software releases in staging environments before rolling them out to our global production footprint.

 - Full-Stack Administration: Own the initial bring-up, configuration, and ongoing performance tuning of large enterprise arrays. You will manage the lifecycle of the storage OS, ensuring all systems are optimized for AI training and inference I/O patterns.

 - Enterprise Infrastructure Building: Collaborate with the Compute and Networking teams to build a seamless "gold standard" cloud infrastructure. You will design cloud-scale storage systems that can excel in high-concurrency, high-throughput environments.

 - Storage Strategy & Selection: Lead the technical evaluation of new storage technologies. You will be responsible for authoring RFPs, reviewing vendor responses, and leading "down selection" processes to ensure we invest in the best hardware for AI workloads.

 - Vendor Roadmap Influence: Serve as the primary technical point of contact for storage partners (such as VAST Data, Pure Storage). You will sit with their engineering teams to provide feedback on bugs, missing features, and prioritize Crusoe’s requirements on their development roadmaps.

 - Cross‑Functional Collaboration: Work closely with service engineering and architecture teams to influence design decisions. Provide performance guidance during feature development and release cycles. Communicate findings to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.



What You'll Bring to the Team:

 - 10+ years of experience in storage systems administration, with a heavy focus on petabyte-scale, on-premise data environments.

 - Hands-on production experience administering VAST Data and/or Pure Storage (Everpure) arrays, including bring-up, configuration, upgrades, and performance tuning.

 - Strong understanding of storage architectures (block, file, and object) and I/O paths.

 - Hands-on experience with performance benchmarking and observability tools (FIO, ElBencho, blktrace, nvme-cli, nfs-gaze, eBPF, etc.).

 - Experience with SSDs, NVMe, RAID, caching, or distributed storage systems.

 - Deep familiarity with enterprise flash arrays and distributed file systems.

 - Proficiency with scripting (Python, Go, or Bash) to automate array management and monitoring.

 - Ability to analyze complex performance data and present clear conclusions.

 - Proven ability to lead the authoring of technical requirements, evaluate RFP responses, and manage complex vendor relationships.

 - Experience with system design for specific I/O use cases (AI training and inference), and a disciplined approach to testing and validating new vendor releases.

 - A genuine interest in Crusoe’s mission to reduce the environmental impact of the AI revolution through sustainable infrastructure.



Bonus Points

 - Experience with RDMA, iSCSI, NVME-oF, RoCEv2 or InfiniBand networking as it relates to high-performance storage.

 - Previous experience at a major Cloud Service Provider (CSP) or a high-scale AI infrastructure company.

 - Familiarity with distributed storage systems (Ceph, Lustre, Gluster, etc.).



Benefits:

 - Competitive compensation and equity packages

 - Restricted Stock Units

 - Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs

 - Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

 - Employer contributions to HSA account

 - Paid parental leave

 - Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

 - Professional development & tuition reimbursement

 - Mental health & wellness support

 - Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

 - Cell phone stipend

 - 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

 - Volunteer time off

 - Global travel insurance & emergency assistance

 - Daily meals allowance

 - Additional perks & programs specific to location



Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $215,000 - $255,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer - AI Harness
jobs.location: NZ: Wellington: Xero One (19-23 Taranaki St)
jobs.description:
The role / impact

This senior engineering position owns a critical delivery stream on MyXero, the foundational platform that underpins every organisation and user record while managing hundreds of millions of daily requests. You will take ambiguous platform challenges from problem framing to durable architectural solutions, designing the specs, verification harnesses, and AI guardrails that enable software agents to handle implementation safely.

Your work directly enables the modernisation of a massive system into decoupled domain services without disrupting dependent products. By engineering automated verification loops and robust testing harnesses, you will ensure high reliability, mentor team members, and shape how our engineering practices operate safely with intelligent tools.

The team / how they connect

You will join the MyXero Ghostbusters squad within our Identity and Platform group, collaborating with engineers and product partners primarily based across New Zealand. The team operates with a written-first, remote-first philosophy, using design records, paired kick-offs, and blameless reviews to ensure every voice is heard and no one works in isolation. While delivery is high-tempo, the group maintains a supportive, open environment where technical curiosity and shared learning are core to daily routines.

Initially, you will focus on

 - Setting up an intentional local development harness with automated validation checks to safely handle production changes.

 - Refactoring legacy monolith endpoints and services built on .NET Framework, C#, and SQL Server towards modern APIs.

 - Developing automated verification loops, test simulation harnesses, and tools that reduce operational toil and human checks.

 - Building cloud agent tooling and collaborative workflows that support the evolution toward an automated development lifecycle.

Where and how you can work

This role is open to candidates based in New Zealand, offering a flexible remote-first setup with office access in Wellington or Auckland. Our working environment is structured around async communication and balanced collaboration.

Here are some of the things we are looking for

 - You bring deep full-stack or backend engineering experience with typed languages, ideally with exposure to C# and .NET environments.

 - Hands-on exploration with AI harnesses, coding agents, or automated verification pipelines in a personal or professional setting.

 - Practical familiarity with distributed systems architecture, API design, data modeling, and managing complex relational database migrations.

 - Proven capability in taking ambiguous technical problems from initial conception to production delivery.

 - Strong written communication skills to articulate system trade-offs clearly through design records and technical documentation.

 - A collaborative mindset with a drive to share learnings, uplift team capabilities, and contribute constructively to production support rotations.

Apply even if your experience isn't a perfect match! At Xero, we hire based on your skills, passion, and the unique perspective you can bring to enhance our culture and team.

WE ARE AN APPLIED AI LAB BUILDING END-TO-END SOFTWARE AGENTS.

We're the makers of Devin, the first AI software engineer. 

Our team is extremely talent-dense. Among our founding team, we have world-class competitive programmers, former founders, and leaders from companies at the cutting edge of AI including Scale AI, Palantir, Cursor, Waymo, Tesla, Lunchclub, Modal, Google DeepMind, and Nuro.

Building Devin is just the first step—our hardest challenges still lie ahead. If you’re excited to solve some of the world’s biggest problems and build AI that can reason on real-world tasks, apply to join us.



ROLE MISSION

Developers hear about Devin mostly from other developers, and most of that happens on X and LinkedIn. Our social accounts are one of the most direct lines we have to the people we build for, and today they are run part-time by people with other jobs.

You will run them full-time. You decide what we post and when, show what Devin can actually do, answer people, and make sure our launches reach the developers who should see them. You will also work with creators and with paid social so good posts get more reach. This role needs someone who already knows how developers talk online and can represent us well there every day.




WHAT YOU'LL ACCOMPLISH

 - Show the product: Turn launches, demos, customer stories and research into posts developers want to share.

 - Be in the conversation: Respond to questions, engage with people building with Devin, and handle criticism directly and well.

 - Make launches travel: Plan the social side of every launch with the launch and creative teams.

 - Work with creators: Build relationships with developer and AI creators and coordinate with paid social and influencer programs.

 - Know what's working: Track reach and engagement in a simple way and adjust.
   


EXCEPTIONAL CANDIDATES HAVE DEMONSTRATED

We care more about demonstrated capability than years of experience.




RESOURCES & ENVIRONMENT

jobs.title: Fleet Inventory Specialist
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Physical Intelligence is bringing general-purpose AI into the physical world. We are a group of engineers, scientists, roboticists, and company builders developing foundation models and learning algorithms to power the robots of today and the physically-actuated devices of the future.




THE TEAM

The Robotics Technician Team works closely with PI's fleet operations and engineering teams to maintain the robotic platforms that power our AI research. The team is collaborative, fast-moving, and deeply technical, and this role is a direct partner to the technicians and engineers who depend on parts being in stock to keep robots running.




ABOUT THE ROLE

The Inventory Specialist owns every part the Robotics Technician Team stocks, at every site, in one system of record. You will receive and put away shipments, run cycle counts, set and maintain stock levels with shift leads, move stock between sites, manage the rework and return queue for robot arms and parts, and consolidate reorders. When a technician reaches for a part, it is there, labeled, and counted.




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL

 - System of Record
   
   - Own the inventory system for all technician team stock, with one record per part: part number, description, location by site and bin, quantity on hand, minimum, maximum, and source.
   
   - Set minimum and maximum levels per site with shift leads, and reorder before a part reaches minimum.
   
   - Run weekly cycle counts on high-turn parts and a monthly full count on robot arms and high-value items, reconciling every variance with a recorded reason.

 - Receiving & Put-Away
   
   - Receive every shipment the day it lands, verify it against the order, label it, and put it away in the correct bin at the correct site.
   
   - Receive PiBuild arm shipments, log serials, and stage arms for the shift that needs them.
   
   - Flag short shipments, damage, and incorrect parts to the lab manager and the vendor the same day.

 - Cross-Site Stock
   
   - Keep every site stocked to minimum, run transfers on the site shuttle, and log every move so the system matches the shelf.
   
   - Build and maintain shift kits and site toolboxes against a published tool list, audit them on a set cadence, and replace what is missing.
   
   - Keep bins, labels, and shelf locations consistent across sites so a rotating technician finds the same part in the same place.

 - Returns & Rework
   
   - Own the rework and return queue: broken arms, failed parts, and vendor returns tracked with a serial, a reason, and a destination.
   
   - Ship reworked arms and returns back to PiBuild or the vendor on a schedule, with no item in the queue longer than two weeks.
   
   - Track what comes back so a returned arm re-enters stock the day it arrives.

 - Purchasing Support & Reporting
   
   - Consolidate reorders across the team, place orders within set limits, and route anything above those limits to the lab manager.
   
   - Track lead times by part and vendor, and flag long-lead items before they become stockouts.
   
   - Compare stocked parts against the BOM and flag gaps to engineering.
   
   - Deliver a weekly stock report to the lab manager and shift leads (items below minimum, stockouts, inbound, rework queue age) and a monthly spend view by category.


WHAT WE HOPE YOU'LL BRING

jobs.title: Senior Researcher, Medicaid Policy and Financing
jobs.description:
Join AIR as a Senior Researcher with our Healthcare Transformation Program. This role combines deep Medicaid policy and financing expertise with rigorous research, applied analytics, project leadership, and client engagement to support federal and state decision-making. Our team works collaboratively to address complex challenges related to coverage, care delivery, operations, cost containment, and quality, supporting federal and state partners in improving healthcare outcomes.

Our multidisciplinary team—including economists, data scientists, public health experts, clinicians, and policy researchers—advances evidence through rigorous research and evaluation, results driven technical assistance, and applied analytics.

The Senior Researcher will bring deep expertise in Medicaid financing and policy topics to a range of work across our portfolio of Medicaid-related projects, supporting clients such as CMS, MACPAC, and foundations. The role will include designing rigorous studies, managing teams and budgets, overseeing data collection and analysis, developing proposals, and communicating actionable findings while serving as a trusted partner to clients and stakeholders.

Candidates hired for the position may work remotely within the United States (U.S.) or from one of our U.S. office locations. This does not include U.S. territories.

About AIR:

Founded in 1946 and headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, the American Institutes for Research (AIR) is a nonpartisan, not-for-profit organization that conducts behavioral and social science research and delivers technical assistance to address some of the most pressing challenges in the United States and globally. We generate evidence and apply data-driven solutions that expand opportunities and improve lives for all.

Responsibilities:

• Manage day-to-day Medicaid-related project operations in roles such as principal investigator, project director, or task lead, ensuring deliverables are completed on time, within budget, and to a high standard.

• Lead collaborative project teams by developing timelines and coordinating staff assignments.

• Identify research problems and design rigorous applied studies, including aligned research questions, methodologies, and analytic plans.

• Apply subject-matter expertise to design and implement relevant, responsive, and impactful research, operations, and technical assistance projects.

• Lead and oversee analyses of Medicaid claims (T-MSIS Analytic File), hospital cost reports, and other complex administrative data.

• Devise and implement innovative solutions to practical challenges in applied research.

• Lead Medicaid data collection and analysis efforts, including identifying trends, outliers, and Medicaid data reporting issues, and synthesizing findings.

• Communicate study progress and findings clearly and effectively through reports, briefings, presentations, visualizations, and other materials to describe policy-relevant findings and actionable insights.

• Represent the organization professionally in client interactions and manage client and stakeholder relationships with awareness of the broader policy and practice landscape.

• Communicate effectively, both orally and in writing, with clients, partners, and stakeholders, and foster positive, collaborative working relationships.

• Contribute thoughtfully and creatively to project teams.

• Contribute to business development by identifying opportunities, developing client relationships, and leading or contributing substantively to competitive proposals.

Qualifications:

Education, Knowledge, and Experience

• PhD in related subject area (e.g., Economics, Health Services Research, Public Policy, or a related discipline) with 3+ years of relevant experience or master’s degree with 7+ years of relevant experience.

• Extensive knowledge of Medicaid financing and policy, including areas such as federal-state financing, payment policy, managed care, supplemental payments, waivers, delivery-system reform, or program integrity and fraud oversight.

• Demonstrated ability to translate complex ideas into actionable work plans and timelines.

• Experience managing project and/or task teams on research, evaluation, and technical assistance projects.

• Experience building and maintaining strong client and partner relationships.

• Experience supporting business development efforts, including grant and proposal writing.

• Experience analyzing claims and other large or complex data sets.

• Experience working in contract research and/or evaluation organizations.

Skills

• Strong organizational and interpersonal skills including strong communication skills with the ability to produce concise, high-level summaries and briefings.

• Strong negotiator and communicator, with excellent client and partner management skills.

• Strong presentation and facilitation skills.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy when writing.

• Can collaborate effectively in a virtual work environment.

• Ability to analyze Medicaid claims and other data using statistical software such as R, Python, SAS, or Stata.

jobs.description:

We're the makers of Devin, the first AI software engineer.

Building Devin is just the first step—our hardest challenges still lie ahead. If you’re excited to solve some of the world’s biggest problems and build AI that can reason on real-world tasks, apply to join us.

Devin’s self-serve product is growing fast, and we’re building the growth team behind it from day one. As our first Paid Social & Influencer Lead, you’ll own our first scaled acquisition channels, with real budget, a product developers love to talk about, and a direct line to leadership.



About Cognition

We are an applied AI lab building end-to-end software agents. We’re the makers of Devin, the first AI software engineer.

Our team is extremely talent-dense. Among our founding team, we have world-class competitive programmers, former founders, and leaders from companies at the cutting edge of AI, including Scale AI, Palantir, Cursor, Waymo, Tesla, Lunchclub, Modal, Google DeepMind, and Nuro.

Building Devin is just the first step. Our hardest challenges still lie ahead. If you’re excited to solve some of the world’s biggest problems and build AI that can reason on real-world tasks, we’d love to hear from you.

You’ll decide how we spend across Meta, X, LinkedIn, Reddit, and YouTube, run the creative testing that finds what works, and build a content pipeline for great creative. Developers are a tough, skeptical audience, and great creative wins them over. You’ll work closely with our in-house creative team to find the angles that actually land.

You own the numbers: signups and paid conversions from your channels, including planning and expanding a substantial acquisition budget.

You don’t need a tech background. Some of the best performance marketers we know come from consumer, CPG, and beauty, and we’d love to hear from you.


What you’ll have

jobs.title: Senior Customer Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
At Mudflap, we're modernizing the $1 trillion trucking industry, the backbone of the U.S. economy. By helping over 100,000 underserved small businesses save over $1.5 billion on fuel, Mudflap has quickly grown into a profitable fintech platform that processes billions in annual payment volume.

We're accelerating our outbound sales motion and looking for a Senior Customer Onboarding Specialist to help turn that momentum into active, fueling customers.

Working closely with Sales, you'll own the critical first eight weeks of the customer journey, getting fleets onboarded, fuel cards activated, and drivers fueling as quickly and seamlessly as possible. You'll build relationships with fleet owners, understand their operations, remove roadblocks, and drive meaningful adoption.

At Mudflap, customer growth doesn't stop at signup. As a consumption based business, our growth is fueled by customer usage. Getting fleets onboarded quickly, drivers fueling, and gallons flowing is where this role makes a real impact. We're looking for someone who takes ownership of ambitious goals, moves quickly, and knows how to understand each customer's needs to help them get the most out of Mudflap.

Work Location: This role is based in Austin, TX, and follows a hybrid schedule, with in-office collaboration required on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Fridays and the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays and Thursdays.

To support our team, we offer:

 - Commuter benefits to ease your travel

 - Lunches and snacks to keep you fueled when at the office

 - A collaborative, high-growth environment where you’ll work closely with talented teammates across the company

Expectations (In this role, you will):

 - Own the onboarding experience: Guide outbound-sourced fleet customers from Sales handoff through card activation, first swipe, and their first eight weeks of adoption.

 - Drive fast, seamless activation: Proactively identify and remove roadblocks, coordinate across teams, and help customers start fueling as quickly as possible.

 - Build strong customer relationships: Work directly with fleet owners and managers to understand their operations, educate them on Mudflap, and create a great onboarding experience.

 - Drive meaningful adoption: Monitor customer activity and fuel usage, identify opportunities to increase adoption, and help fleets progress toward their expected fuel volume.

 - Partner closely with Sales: Maintain momentum after the handoff, communicate customer needs, and ensure a smooth transition from prospect to active customer.

 - AI-First Mindset: You're comfortable using AI tools in your daily workflow, constantly experimenting with new ways to work smarter, move faster, and improve results.

 - Manage multiple accounts with precision: Stay organized, prioritize effectively, and maintain clear visibility into each customer's onboarding progress, risks, and next steps.

 - Help us scale: Identify opportunities to improve onboarding processes, reduce friction, and build repeatable workflows as our outbound business grows.

Experience (What we look for):

 - Bachelor’s degree required.

 - Customer Onboarding Experience: 2+ years experience owning customer onboarding, activation, or account management, ideally in a high-growth B2B environment.

 - High-Volume Account Management: Proven ability to manage a portfolio of 50–80+ accounts simultaneously, balancing competing priorities while maintaining exceptional organization and follow-through.

 - Speed to Activation: Experience driving customers through fast onboarding cycles, removing friction, and accelerating time to first use and ongoing adoption.

 - Commercial & Business Acumen: Understands how customer activation, product usage, and retention drive revenue. Experience in consumption-based or usage-driven business models is a plus.

 - Consultative Customer Engagement: Skilled at conducting discovery, understanding customer operations, overcoming objections, and building trusted relationships.

 - Data-Driven Execution: Comfortable using CRM tools, customer activity data, and performance metrics to identify gaps, prioritize outreach, and drive measurable results.

 - Builder Mentality: Thrives in fast-paced, evolving environments with ambitious goals, high ownership, and a bias toward action.

Perks and Benefits (What we offer):

 - Competitive salary and equity in a high-growth startup

 - Multiple health benefit options

 - Responsible Time Off

 - 401(k) matching

 - Opportunities and support for major career growth

 - Annual Company offsite event (Mudfest!)

The salary range for this role is $100,000-$115,000, plus a target annual variable equal to 25% of base. This information reflects a base salary range for this position based on current market data, which may be subject to change as new market data becomes available. The candidate's skills, experience, and other relevant factors will determine the exact compensation.

Company Overview (Who we are):

Mudflap is on a mission to transform the trucking and logistics industry by leveling the playing field for owner operators and small fleets. Backed by top-tier venture investors, including QED, Matrix Partners, Commerce Ventures, NFX, and 500 Startups and included in the Forbes Fintech 50 list, Mudflap offers fleet fuel management solutions. Our core team hails from Disney, Uber, Procore, DoorDash, Google, Meta, Capital One, Affirm and Brex.

Here are the core values that we believe in and look for in new teammates:

 - Be Customer Obsessed: We deeply understand customer needs and put our customers at the center of everything we do

 - Make it Count: Act like an owner by focusing on the impact of your work

 - Find a Way: Be a creative problem solver who pushes past roadblocks to win for our customers and our teammates

 - Sweat the Details: We keep our standards high and achieve them by paying attention to every detail

 - Be Curious: Use a growth mindset to question assumptions, take calculated risks and stretch the boundaries of what’s possible

jobs.title: Director, Grid Planning Product Management
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

GridUnity is the industry leader in interconnection life cycle management, delivering cutting-edge software solutions that eliminate bottlenecks in the interconnection process and accelerate the transition to a more affordable, sustainable, and resilient energy future.

Our Mission

We unite all grid interconnection stakeholders on a single platform that converts centralized data into actionable intelligence and accelerates the transition to a reliable, sustainable, and cost-efficient electric grid.

GridUnity is a trusted partner to leading utilities, grid operators, and policymakers. Our technology solutions tackle the interconnection queue backlog by significantly reducing processing times. Whether cutting transmission interconnection timelines from years to months or enabling distribution applications to be processed within a day, we help accelerate energy projects at every scale.

Our Vision
Energizing the planet with a faster, smarter, and more sustainable grid.




ABOUT THE ROLE

This position reports to GridUnity’s Strategic Product Officer and is a leadership role in the Product Team. You will be responsible for evolving the strategy and roadmap for the grid planning offerings that the GridUnity Intelligence Platform provides to our national customer base. You will partner with GridUnity’s larger Product  team,  power system engineering and customer growth, to ensure that each planning product module leverages the platform in the most efficient manner and delivers valuable and differentiated products to our customers. You will track, report on, and hold your team to product metrics to ensure customer value is maximized and product investment decisions are data-driven. Your team will continue to grow as you hit product metrics and generate company value.

You will set the vision for grid planning products and keep stakeholders aligned around it. You work with others on the larger GridUnity product and customer growth teams to understand and monitor changing customer needs. You ensure the engineering team maintains a well-defined understanding of the prioritized components, backlog and goals for each development increment, which is delivered through iterative Agile development. This is a player-coach role: you’ll set strategy and own the backlog hands-on while building the team.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


STRATEGY & ROADMAP

 - Own the multi-year strategic roadmap for grid planning product offerings and coordinate delivery timing with Product Management leadership consistent with company priorities

 - Engage with customers to understand needs, test and validate concepts, and continuously confirm that the strategy reflects real customer and market problems

 - Evaluate product enhancements to drive selection of those with extensible and / or specific strategic value, including build/buy/partner and sequencing tradeoffs

 - Set grid planning product success metrics and report against them in terms leadership cares about; course-correct or kill initiatives that aren't delivering value


BACKLOG & REQUIREMENTS

 - Define what success looks like for each feature before it’s built, and measure it after

 - Own the grid planning backlog: write user stories, acceptance criteria, and edge cases, and stay accountable for them as the team grows

 - Act as the go-to decision-maker for the development team on scope, sequencing, and acceptance; unblock engineering quickly when requirements shift


STAKEHOLDER & CROSS-FUNCTIONAL MANAGEMENT

 - Manage competing stakeholder demands (sales, customer success, executives, engineering) ensuring your product position and the value it delivers to market participants is understood

 - Keep executive leadership and stakeholders informed on status, risk, and tradeoffs through concise, structured communication that includes any needed context

 - Build trust with engineering and customer growth teams so that prioritization calls are respected

 - Provide subject matter expertise and support as needed to GridUnity sales team (e.g., RFP support, product demonstrations, training, documentation, etc.)

jobs.description:
Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL) is a global health organization that partners locally and globally to create and scale solutions to the world’s deadliest health threats. Millions of people die from preventable health threats. We collaborate to close the gap between proven, life-saving solutions and the people who need them. Since 2017, we’ve worked with governments and other partners in more than 60 countries to save millions of lives. We work toward a future where people live longer, healthier lives, communities flourish, and economies thrive. This is an ambitious vision, and it inspires us and our partners to make progress every day.

Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL) works with governments and partners to strengthen and transform primary health care (PHC) to improve health and save lives. Our approach focuses on making PHC more prioritized, proactive and accountable for outcomes, and strengthening how care is organized, delivered, financed and measured. Drawing on expertise across RTSL's portfolio, we bring together solutions in health system resilience and epidemic readiness, digital health and data-driven decision-making, performance measurement and improvement, and sustainable health financing. We apply these capabilities to address priority health challenges, including cardiovascular health, maternal survival and sexual and reproductive health, while strengthening health systems to deliver more equitable, effective and resilient care.

Position Purpose

The Director, Maternal & Reproductive Health will provide strategic and technical leadership for RTSL's portfolio to reduce preventable maternal deaths and improve sexual and reproductive health outcomes. The role will lead the development and implementation of a multi-country program that strengthens government capabilities to identify and address barriers to quality care, translate data into action, and deliver measurable improvements in health outcomes.

The Director will have overall accountability for the strategy, resources, quality, performance, and results of the maternal survival and reproductive health portfolio, leading a multidisciplinary team and working closely with governments, technical partners, and colleagues across RTSL to design, implement and scale evidence-informed approaches. The role requires deep expertise in sexual, reproductive and maternal health, strong program leadership, and the ability to translate technical evidence into practical, sustainable health system improvements.

Work Location: 100% Remote with travel as stated.

Duration: Full-time employment for a fixed term of 24 months.

Core Duties and Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership and Portfolio Management

• Set the strategic direction, priorities and implementation approach for RTSL's maternal survival and reproductive health portfolio, exercising delegated authority to make program investment, resource allocation, and partnership decisions within approved organizational parameters and in alignment with country priorities.

• Oversee a multi-country portfolio, with accountability for program planning, budget development and management, resource allocation, performance and delivery against strategic objectives.

• Lead and manage a multidisciplinary team, establishing clear responsibilities and performance expectations, overseeing staffing and talent development, addressing performance and capacity gaps, and building the capabilities needed for sustained program delivery.

Technical Leadership and Program Development

• Provide expert technical leadership across maternal survival and sexual and reproductive health, including maternal death surveillance and response, quality maternal care, family planning, and adolescent pregnancy prevention.

• Lead the development and adaptation of evidence-informed approaches that connect data-driven learning with targeted improvements in clinical care, service delivery and wider health system capabilities.

• Guide the design and implementation of country programs, identifying opportunities to strengthen government leadership, institutional capabilities and sustainable approaches to improving health outcomes.

• Drive innovation and collaboration across RTSL's technical teams, drawing on expertise in PHC delivery, digital health, measurement and financing to address priority health system bottlenecks.

Country Engagement and Strategic Partnerships

• Lead senior-level engagement with Ministries of Health and national partners to identify priorities, shape country strategies and secure government ownership of programs and results.

• Develop and manage strategic partnerships with donors, multilateral agencies, technical institutions and implementing partners, identifying opportunities for collaboration, investment and program expansion, and representing RTSL in high-level technical and policy discussions.

Performance, Learning and Accountability

• Maintain overall accountability for portfolio performance and results, establishing clear performance expectations and monitoring mechanisms, and using evidence and implementation learning to inform strategic decisions, address delivery challenges, and adapt approaches.

• Oversee the generation, synthesis and dissemination of evidence and practical learning to inform policy, program improvement and scale-up across countries.

Qualifications

Education

• Advanced degree in medicine, public health, sexual and reproductive health, obstetrics and gynecology, or a related field.

Experience

• At least 15 years of relevant global health experience, including substantial technical and leadership experience in sexual, reproductive and maternal health in low- and middle-income countries.

• Demonstrated experience developing and leading complex, multi-country programs, including strategic planning, budget oversight and accountability for results.

• Extensive experience engaging senior government officials, donors and international partners, with the ability to build relationships and influence strategic decisions.

Skills & Abilities

• Recognized technical expertise in maternal survival and reproductive health, with a strong understanding of evidence-based interventions, health service delivery and health system strengthening.

• Proven ability to lead and develop multidisciplinary teams and manage programs across different countries and organizational functions.

• Strong understanding of data-driven program improvement, implementation challenges and approaches to translating evidence into sustainable results.

• Excellent strategic thinking, judgement, communication and leadership skills, with the ability to navigate complex political and operational environments.

• Fluency in English required; proficiency in French desirable.

• Willingness to travel internationally, approximately 30% during program start-up and up to 25% thereafter.

Compensation and Benefits

Resolve to Save Lives prides itself on cultivating a supportive, connected remote team doing work that matters. We do everything possible to ensure our employees are connected and set up for success.

The exact offer will be determined by various factors, such as the candidate's skills and experience relative to the requirements of the role. For applicants based outside the US, salaries are set according to national labor rates for the international NGO sector.

In addition to a competitive salary, Resolve to Save Lives provides a generous package of benefits, including:
