jobs.description:
Vast is developing next-generation space stations and space infrastructure using an incremental, hardware-rich, and capital-efficient approach. Vast is rapidly developing its multi-module Haven Station to support a continuous human presence in space for America and its allies, enabling advanced microgravity research and manufacturing, and supporting a growing space economy for government, corporate, and private customers. Haven Demo’s 2025 success made Vast the only operational commercial space station company to design, build, and operate its own spacecraft in orbit. Next, Haven-1 is targeted to become the world’s first commercial space station, with launch anticipated in 2027, followed by additional Haven modules. Additionally, the company recently announced two new offerings leveraging its space station components and the heritage of Haven Demo: Vast Satellite, a high-power satellite product line; and Vast Lunar Systems, power, communications, and habitats for the Moon.

Headquartered in Long Beach, California, and with more than 1,000 employees and over a billion dollars in private capital, Vast has built the facilities capable of manufacturing America’s next space station. The company plans to develop future habitats and systems for Mars, dedicated modules for government partners, and other crewed systems designed to unlock the expanding long-term space economy.

Vast is looking for a RF Systems Engineer, reporting to the Director, RF Engineering, to execute the development of the RF Systems for spacecraft including space stations and satellites.

As an RF Systems Engineer, you will manage communication system requirements and verification for space stations and satellites. Your responsibilities will include RF system design, link budgets,  satellite coverage analysis, and definition of system concepts-of-operation (CONOPs). You will be expected to own one or more RF components and to collaborate with your mechanical, thermal, test, integration, and mission assurance engineering counterparts to guide those components through testing, integration, and operation during the mission.

This will be a full-time, exempt position in our Long Beach location.

Responsibilities:

• Own and manage spacecraft RF system requirements and verification plan

• Specify link parameters including modulation, error correction coding, symbol rate, and channel filter

• Calculate link budgets, considering data throughput requirements, link conditions, and ground station characteristics

• Estimate the expected data throughput and bit error rate based on your link budgets

• Maintain link budgets with consideration to on-vehicle antenna patterns, cable losses, radio specifications, and channel conditions for the expected orbit

• Support regulatory license applications by providing required analyses such as power flux density and antenna contours

• Use standard tools such as Ansys STK to estimate coverage and link variability during real mission orbit scenarios

• Document and review your work output with peers through trade studies and design reviews

• Own one or more RF products from development testing through mission operation

• Be a center of subject matter expertise over your RF components in the context of the overall RF system

• Plan the design, manufacturing, testing, integration, and delivery to the vehicle and coordinate the schedule with interfacing teams and project management

• Manage relationships with cross-functional teams including mechanical engineers, test engineers, manufacturing engineers, thermal engineers, and avionics engineers

• Manage vendors and clearly communicate requirements, deliverables, and schedule

• Define test plans and procedures for acceptance and qualification testing

• Define and document checkout tests to validate proper operation during and after integration at the vehicle level

• Support mission operations as a subject matter expert on the spacecraft RF system

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in ECE, EE, Physics, or related STEM discipline

• Familiarity with digital RF communication theory, components, and fundamentals

• G/T ratio

• S-parameters

• Design for space

• Testing for space environments

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer - IT Software Engineering
jobs.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

Could we build a better version of an expensive SaaS tool on Elasticsearch? Our new IT Software Engineering team asks that question about the software Elastic pays for, and then we build the answer. Each system helps run the company day to day and becomes a reference architecture for Elastic's own products.

We're a team of builders, and this is a hands-on, 100% individual contributor role. Every engineer here owns their work end to end: shaping the problem, designing the system, shipping it, and keeping it healthy for years. Knowing what to build, and what not to build, matters more here than typing speed.

What this role is not:

• Not a front-end role. The user interface follows a shared kit and is the simplest part of the work.

• Not a prototype or demo role. What we ship runs in production and is maintained for years.

• Not vibe coding. We use AI to build faster, not to skip design, review or testing.

• Not SaaS administration or configuration, and not an infrastructure-only or DevOps-only role.

• Not a people-management role.

What You Will Be Doing

• Take an open business problem, decide what to build and what to leave out, and turn it into a clear spec, data model and API contracts.

• Build internal applications that replace paid, specialized tools.

• Solve the hard parts that all of these applications share: reading data from several systems of record accurately and efficiently, without overloading or slowing those systems down storing sensitive data so it never leaks enforcing permissions on the server, so each person sees only the records and fields they are allowed to see

• Design and evolve the shared, versioned building blocks that every application is built from: data connectors, authorization, data storage and migrations, search, and reporting.

• Build with AI coding agents such as Claude Code inside a disciplined, spec-driven process. Acceptance criteria are traced to tests, interface contracts get compatibility checks, and small slices are reviewed and proven before the next one starts. Automated quality gates decide when work is done.

• Own what you build for its whole life: review, testing, releases, production operations including on-call, new features, maintenance and, eventually, retirement.

• Help set the team's standards for architecture, contracts, testing and observability, and feed what you learn back into Elastic's products.

What You Bring

• Senior-level experience designing, shipping and maintaining production backend systems through failures and changing requirements, not just launching them.

• Sound judgment about what to build, what to leave out, and how to keep a system simple as its requirements change. You apply abstraction, separation of concerns, single responsibility, SOLID and common design patterns where they fit.

• Strong API and data design: clear contracts and careful data models, and the ability to change both without breaking the people who depend on them.

• Experience integrating with other systems (APIs, databases, event streams) safely and efficiently.

• Security-first thinking about authorization and sensitive data.

• Search fundamentals. You can explain: how information is indexed and how text is processed how results are scored and ranked when to use keyword, vector (semantic) or hybrid search

• Strong experience in TypeScript, Python, Java or a comparable language. We build in TypeScript, and engineers from other backgrounds who want to work in TypeScript are welcome.

• Comfort building with AI coding agents and reviewing their output skeptically. You hold yourself accountable for everything that ships.

• You like writing specs and recording design decisions, and you let tests and checks, not claims, decide when something is done.

• Daily, disciplined use of AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot or similar) on production work.

Bonus Points

• Hands-on experience with Elasticsearch

• Observability: logs, metrics, traces and alerting.

• LLM features: retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, LLM gateways and evaluations.

• A degree in Computer Science or a related field.

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

SOFTWARE ENGINEER, ENTERPRISE PLATFORM

We're hiring an Enterprise Platform Engineer to build the foundational systems that make Cursor ready for the world's largest engineering organizations. Today we have basic organizations, simple IAM primitives, early audit logs, analytics APIs, and admin APIs, but enterprise customers need much more. You will design and build the platform layer that powers organization management, access control, compliance, and administrative tooling across Cursor's product surface. This is a deeply technical IC role focused on building correct, secure, and scalable enterprise infrastructure, not gluing together vendor SDKs.

 - Extend enterprise settings and policies, org-wide defaults, security policies (allowed models, MCPs, Tools, network restrictions), and configuration inheritance across different products; deepen our audit logging infrastructure, comprehensive, queryable, tamper-evident audit trails that satisfy customer-specific compliance requirements

Experience designing and building scalable systems or shared platform infrastructure.



PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - Opinions on permission models, role inheritance, and policy evaluation

 - Experience building multi-tenant organization or IAM systems in production and opinions on permission models, role inheritance, and policy evaluation

 - Experience shipping RBAC or ABAC systems and understand the tradeoffs between flexibility and complexity

jobs.title: General Manager, AI Test & Evaluation Products
jobs.description:
General Manager, AI Test & Evaluation Products

About CoVar

CoVar is a small AI/ML R&D software company with offices in Durham, NC and McLean, VA. We build AI/ML tools that help the Department of War (DoW) find threats, help researchers find new treatments, and help industry keep machinery safe. Our engineers take hard problems out of the lab and into systems that actually get used.

About this position

CoVar develops technology under DARPA and DoW research programs that has value well beyond the original contract. Some of it is ready to become a product. We are hiring a General Manager to build a business around one of these technologies.

You will develop a new line of business, from first customer conversations through initial sales, revenue, and ultimately product P&L. The product is software built under a DARPA program to test and evaluate autonomous and AI-enabled systems, a market where Government test organizations, primes, and commercial developers all face the same problem: proving that AI-enabled systems behave as intended.

You will talk to buyers in the DoW test community, at defense primes, and in commercial robotics and AI assurance. You will turn what you learn into a value proposition backed by real numbers. You will also build the go-to-market and financing plans, and take them to customers and investors. You will report to our VP of Strategy and work directly with our CEO and CTO.

Responsibilities

• Own the commercialization strategy and product roadmap, taking the technology from its DARPA program baseline to a supportable, fieldable product

• Lead customer discovery across DoW test ranges and operational test agencies, acquisition program offices, defense primes, and commercial autonomy and AI assurance buyers

• Define the value proposition, pricing, and business model, grounded in customer data and validated with paying pilots

• Identify and pursue transition pathways, including SBIR Phase III, Other Transaction Agreements, CRADAs, program office funding, and commercial licensing

• Build the go-to-market and financing plans, and present them to customers, Government sponsors, and investors

• Work with engineering to turn customer requirements into product priorities and a realistic delivery plan

• Set commercialization milestones and revenue targets, and report progress to CoVar leadership

Who we're looking for

You have taken an early-stage or deep-tech product from prototype to paying customers. You know how the DoW buys and tests technology, and how a product moves from a research program to a program of record. You communicate easily with people from a wide variety of backgrounds, from engineers and test directors to program managers and investors. Veterans and transitioning service members with test and evaluation or acquisition experience are encouraged to apply.

Minimum qualifications

• B.S. in engineering, computer science, physics, math, or a related field, or equivalent technical experience (hands-on experience with autonomous systems, coding, engineering, etc.)

• 8+ years of professional experience, including at least 3 years leading go-to-market, business development, or product commercialization

• Working knowledge of the DoW test and evaluation (T&E) community and the DoW acquisition process

• Track record of taking an early-stage or deep-tech product to paying customers, with measurable revenue results

• Experience raising private capital or winning Government transition funding (e.g., SBIR Phase III, OTA prototype or follow-on production awards, or program-of-record funding), including proposal writing, presentation creation, etc.

• Experience running customer discovery and setting pricing and business models

• Excellent written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical audiences

• Ability to work from Durham, NC or McLean, VA, with regular travel to customers, investors, and DoW test sites

• Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance (U.S. citizenship required)

Preferred qualifications

• MBA or equivalent business training

• Experience at a DoW test range, test organization, or acquisition program office

• Experience in commercial autonomy, robotics, or AI assurance

• Network in the DoW, prime contractor, and defense-tech investor communities

• P&L ownership for a product or business unit

• Active U.S. security clearance

• Experience building or licensing a dual-use product for both Government and commercial markets

• Familiarity with AI test, evaluation, and assurance frameworks, such as the NIST AI Risk Management Framework

• Experience hiring and leading a small cross-functional team

Benefits

• Competitive salary, cash bonus, equity structure, and 401k with employer contributions

• Excellent health care coverage, including dental and vision plans

• Parental leave

• Short-term and long-term disability insurance

• Life insurance

• Flexible work schedule

• Tuition support

• PTO and paid holidays

Visit us: www.covar.com

jobs.title: Mass Properties Intern (Summer)
jobs.description:
At REGENT, we’re on a mission to revolutionize regional transportation between coastal cities. We're not just building vehicles, we're creating a new category of transportation: the Seaglider. These groundbreaking wing-in-ground-effect craft travel just above the water’s surface, combining the speed of an airplane with the low operating costs of a boat. Capable of 180 miles at 180 mph on today's battery tech (and up to 400 miles with next-gen batteries), Seagliders will unlock fast, affordable, and sustainable coastal transit for passengers and cargo - connecting cities, islands, and communities like never before.

Backed by leading investors and powered by a team of passionate, forward-thinking engineers, builders, and operators, we’re now scaling from a breakthrough prototype to full production - and building the team to make it happen.


ROLE OVERVIEW

REGENT's Mass Properties discipline sits at the heart of every vehicle program. As the Mass Properties Engineer Intern, you'll work directly on real, high-impact work from day one.

This isn't spreadsheet upkeep. You'll do the engineering a full-time hire would do: pulling mass, CG, and inertia data directly from CAD, working with various IPTs to keep the data accurate, and writing scripts that replace manual work. You'll help close out weight and balance control for our prototype vehicle, and help define the management plan, database architecture, and tools that our production craft will rely on through production.

You'll join the Aero & Performance team within Hardware Engineering. If you'd rather open a CAD model and find the answer yourself, write a script than repeat a task by hand, and help build a discipline instead of plugging into one that already exists, you'll fit right in!




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Support R&D W&B Control: You'll help develop and implement the processes that control our products’ weight and balance properties through the maturation of design, including how mass data is sourced, verified, updated through configuration changes, and reported.

 - Build Supporting Tools: You'll write scripts to automate reporting of mass properties and mass rollups across programs, establishing the appropriate checks and balances.

 - Work Laterally Across the Company: You'll gain a system view by interfacing directly with adjacent departments (structures, propulsion, avionics, etc) to collect mass properties, challenge their reports, and keeping the database up to date.

 - Exposure to Design Tools: You'll have visibility into the PLM system and the DMU to gain a deeper understanding of the system layout and reports generated by the responsible engineers.

 - Identify Risks and Opportunities: You'll assess mass and balance data to flag potential weight or CG issues, identify opportunities to reduce weight, and share your findings with the relevant engineering teams.

 - Define and Deliver a Real Outcome: You'll scope a clear goal with your manager early in the term and present your results, including your assumptions and data sources, to the team at the end of it.

 - Set Your Priorities: You'll work independently under the guidance of the Mass Properties Engineer, who will mentor you and help you define your priorities across the different programs to achieve your set objectives.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - CAD Fluency: You can navigate CATIA, SolidWorks, NX or similar tools to independently understand the vehicle layout, pull mass, CG, and inertia data.

 - Scripting Instincts: You have working proficiency in Python, MATLAB, SQL, VBA, or similar, and you reach for a script when a task is about to become a recurring manual chore.

 - Weight and Balance Fundamentals: You understand CG calculations, moment of inertia, and how margins and contingencies get carried through a program.

 - Comfort With Ambiguity: You are able to focus across multiple active programs and changing priorities.

 - Confidence Reaching Out: You're are proactive and comfortable engaging with engineers on other teams directly to track down a number and get it confirmed.

 - Curiosity About Change Control: Exposure to PLM or PDM systems and interest in how engineering changes are tracked through the lifecycle of a program is an advantage.

 - A Head Start, If You've Got One: Though we don't expect you to have it, familiarity with aircraft weight management standards, having a private pilot’s license, or prior weight and balance experience from a program, class, or club project, will help you ramp up quickly.




WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Collaborative Team Player: You believe that great things happen when teams work together. You communicate effectively and collaborate with engineers, stakeholders, and other cross-functional teams to align on goals and move projects forward. You bring people together, ensuring that everyone is on the same page and moving towards a shared vision.

 - Creative Problem Solver: You thrive on tackling complex challenges and finding innovative solutions. Whether you're resolving installation challenges, debugging elusive electrical issues, or adapting on the fly during integration and test, you bring a practical, inventive mindset to every problem. You don't just patch issues - you improve processes, anticipate downstream impacts, and help turn one-off fixes into scalable solutions that raise the bar for future builds.

 - Adaptable & Agile: In a fast-paced, ever-evolving startup environment, you quickly adapt to changing priorities and requirements. You approach challenges with a calm, resilient mindset, and know how to pivot and adjust your approach as needed, ensuring that progress continues without missing a beat.

 - Innovative Mindset: You’re driven by curiosity and a passion for technology. You’re passionate about driving continuous improvement, embracing new technologies and methodologies to enhance efficiency, quality, and team performance.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive compensation

 - Housing Stipend available for those temporarily moving to join our team

 - Daily, free catered lunches

 - Learning & professional development opportunities

 - Meaningful projects that make an impact

 - Mentorship & guidance from experienced team members

If you’re ready to take on an exciting challenge, grow with us, and make a lasting impact, we want to hear from you. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, but you see yourself contributing to our mission, we encourage you to apply! We value diverse skillsets and experiences and believe in the potential of passionate individuals to make a big impact.

Equal Opportunity Employer

REGENT is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Principal, Corporate Development
jobs.description:
Hut 8 brings exceptional people together to solve the world’s most consequential problems at the intersection of energy and technology. Today, that means building infrastructure for AI at a pace and scale without precedent. Tomorrow, it could mean powering a new era of innovation through robotics, advanced manufacturing, or an industry that does not yet exist. Whatever the technology demands, our ambition holds: to build the defining physical infrastructure company of our generation.

We look for thinkers and builders with the rigor, humility, and ownership to solve problems at this scale. They start from zero and choose truth over tradition. They back the best idea, whatever its source. They bet on themselves and embrace the hard truths that force them to grow. Our commitment is to keep the path from idea to execution short, trust them with critical decisions and the work that follows, and surround them with colleagues whose curiosity extends beyond their expertise.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking an analytical and motivated Principal to join our team and support the Head of Corporate Finance. This individual will play a key role in evaluating and executing strategic and financial initiatives, including financing activities, investment opportunities, joint ventures, and M&A across our AI, advanced computing, and energy ecosystem.

The ideal candidate has a strong background in corporate finance, investment banking, or private equity, with a focus on AI infrastructure, digital infrastructure, data centers, or technology/energy sectors. This role offers direct exposure to Hut 8's high-priority corporate development initiatives and a clear path to collaborate with senior leadership by contributing to, and eventually driving, these strategic financial decisions.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Financial Modeling & Analysis

• Build Financial Models: Develop and maintain detailed financial and operating models to evaluate data center developments, GPU procurement, and infrastructure investments.

• Scenario Analysis: Conduct analysis of alternative capital structures, financing scenarios, lease vs. buy options, and sensitivity cases.

• Executive Presentation: Prepare valuation materials, transaction summaries, and strategic analyses to support decision-making for the executive team and the Board.

Deal Execution

• Support Deal Lifecycle: Participate in the full transaction process, from initial screening and financial evaluation through due diligence, structuring, and closing.

• Valuation Ownership: Manage valuation workstreams, including DCF, comparable company/transaction analysis, and unit economics modeling for high-performance computing (HPC) assets.

• Market Research: Monitor and analyze trends in the AI landscape, hyperscaler demand, and energy infrastructure to help validate new growth opportunities.

• Create Materials: Draft investment committee memos, board presentations, and marketing materials for lenders and investors.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Project Management

• Internal Coordination: Work closely with teams across Data Center Development, Energy Origination, EPC, Treasury, Legal, and Accounting to ensure seamless transaction execution.

• Manage Diligence: Coordinate due diligence processes, acting as a central point of contact for internal stakeholders and external advisors (legal, tax, technical).

• Relationship Support: Help maintain and cultivate relationships with investment banks, technology vendors, and institutional investors.

ABOUT YOU

• Experience: 1–3 years of experience in investment banking (TMT, Digital Infrastructure, or Power/Energy groups), private equity, infrastructure funds, or a corporate development role within the tech or utility sector.

• Technical Skills: Strong financial modeling capabilities and a solid understanding of corporate finance principles and transaction mechanics.

• Industry Interest: Familiarity with or a strong interest in the economics of data centers, AI compute infrastructure, power constraints, and cloud ecosystems.

• Work Ethic: Highly organized with strong attention to detail, good problem-solving skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines.

• Communication: Clear verbal and written communication skills, with the professional maturity to interface with senior executives and external partners.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.

ABOUT THE WORK ENVIRONMENT

This role is in office at our corporate headquarters in the Brickell area of Miami, Florida. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

jobs.description:
ON BOARD EXPERIENTIAL

On Board Experiential (OBE) is an award-winning, full-service, experience-led agency that creates meaningful brand experiences worldwide. We work out of our homes and physical offices in San Francisco, Los Angeles, and NYC, or wherever our adventures take us! Our clients include Nike, Meta, JPMorgan Chase, The Infatuation, Stripe, and OpenAI, to name a few. We know, "Cool, cool, but what’s it like to work at OBE?" We thought you'd never ask. Event Marketer has recognized OBE as one of the best places to work in events and well, we couldn't agree more.

The most important part of our business is our people. They are hardworking, brave and make magic happen on the regular. But under each majestic exterior is a human deserving of a healthy work-life balance. That’s why we believe in recovery days, happy hours, friendly but competitive fitness challenges and company offsites.

We conduct open meetings to facilitate discussions that heal, inspire, and bring us closer. We encourage each other to bring our whole selves to work. We want to hear about your lived experiences and unique perspectives. We don't just want you to be unapologetically you: it's part of the job description.

SUMMARY OF POSITION

Our Production Directors are responsible for all elements of production for each assigned project/program from start to finish and for executing the approved production-specific Scope of Work in support of client goals and objectives.  General responsibilities include management and direction of all production related personnel including, but not limited to, internal producers, external producers, third-party vendors/suppliers, and will often involve leading and/or overseeing multiple projects simultaneously at various stages of activation.

This person will play a critical and prominent role in the development of each program, which will include, strategic thinking, concept development, feasibility work, development of the overall project plan, comprehensive pre-production work, budget development, management and tracking P/L, and the overall quality of the project/program. By working closely with our internal and external teams in a collaborative manner the Production Director will continuously look to elevate the level at which OBE is operating.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

jobs.title: TikTok Creative Manager
jobs.location: Marina del Rey, California, United States
jobs.description:
Why We Exist and What We Do:

At Dr. Squatch (www.drsquatch.com), we’re raising the bar on men’s personal care with our line of natural, high-performance products. We’re on a high-growth, fast-moving ride, continually introducing new product categories, launching into retailers nationwide, and growing internationally. We have been recognized and certified by Great Place to Work® multiple times, and we achieved status as a certified B Corp in 2023. We are looking for passionate, talented people who want to join us in our mission to inspire and educate men to be happier and healthier!

About the Role:

Dr. Squatch is hiring a TikTok Creative Manager to lead the creative direction and day-to-day content strategy for our TikTok channel. In this role, you will review team content, use performance data to inform future creative, and drive channel growth.

A key part of the role is leading content direction that supports TikTok Shop revenue goals while keeping a steady flow of entertaining brand content that builds awareness. You will also help strengthen creative direction across the broader social team.

The ideal candidate has experience making branded content with performance in mind, loves comedic content, and has a strong understanding of TikTok culture.

This role will report to the Sr. Social Media Manager. This is a full-time role with company benefits based in Marina del Rey, CA.

The anticipated base compensation range for this role will be $100,000 to $115,000. Compensation will be commensurate with the candidate's experience and local market rates.

What You'll Do:

• Strategy & Ownership

• Lead Dr. Squatch’s TikTok strategy, with a focus on audience growth, brand presence, and TikTok Shop performance.

• Plan content around campaigns, product launches, Shop priorities, and ongoing brand content.

• Identify opportunities to increase reach, engagement, and revenue.

• Agency & Creator Management

• Manage relationships with creative partners.

• Give the internal social team and creative partners clear creative briefs, direction, and feedback.

• Creative Direction

• Develop concepts, moodboards, and briefs to guide content production.

• Keep the Dr. Squatch voice consistent while bringing fresh ideas to the channel.

• Stay ahead of trends and translate them into scalable content.

• Content Creation

• Create and publish in-feed TikTok content.

• Step in as on-camera talent.

• Coordinate with agencies on video content that supports TikTok Live.

• Collaborate with internal teams and partners to execute campaigns.

• Performance & Optimization

• Analyze content performance and apply findings to strategy and creative.

• Track channel growth, engagement, and GMV.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with the Social, Marketing, and Growth teams on campaigns and content priorities.

• Align TikTok initiatives with broader brand goals.

• Share trends and insights to improve overall social strategy.

About You:

• Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Video Production, or a related field preferred.

• 4+ years of experience creating and directing social content, with a strong focus on TikTok.

• 4+ years of experience working with or directing creators, agencies, or other collaborators.

• Strong understanding of TikTok analytics and performance metrics, with the ability to translate insights into content direction and growth strategy.

• Highly comfortable performing on camera.

• Strong editing and production skills using tools such as TikTok’s native editor, CapCut, Premiere Pro, Photoshop, or similar.

• Deep understanding of TikTok culture, trends, memes, and audience behavior.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a natural ability to connect with an online community.

• A creative storyteller who can develop engaging content and scalable formats that drive growth.

• Passion for community engagement and representing a brand voice consistently and authentically.

• Energetic, witty, adaptable, and willing to take creative risks in a fast-moving environment.

• A collaborative team player who stays positive and brings a good sense of humor to the job.

#LI-TC1 #LI-FULLTIME #LI-HYBRID

Who We Are:

Our core values come naturally and make us a better, more whole, and unique team. We are Bold & Innovative - we are creative, rethink how things are done, and find a way. We Play to Win - we have high standards, we encourage ownership of work, we are scrappy, we act with urgency, and we invest in the outcome of our work. We are Team Squatch - we are humble, help others outside our own wheelhouse, stay positive, have fun, and have approachable and transparent leadership.

We offer a competitive salary in a growth-focused & collaborative team environment. Benefits include medical, dental, vision, 401k with Squatch match, and PTO. We also have great perks like healthy snacks, frequent company events, and of course, free products!

For Applicants with Disabilities. Reasonable accommodation will be made so that qualified applicants with disabilities may participate in the application process. If you need any accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know when you submit your application and we'll do our very best to adjust as needed.

For Information regarding Data Privacy, please review https://privacy.drsquatch.com/.

Unsolicited Resume Policy. Dr. Squatch (“DRSQ”) employs an internal Talent Acquisition department. Exceptionally, DRSQ may choose to supplement that internal team with support from temporary staffing agencies, placement services, and/or recruiting agencies ("Agency"). Agencies are hereby specifically directed NOT to contact DRSQ employees directly in an attempt to present candidates. DRSQ’s Talent Acquisition team is responsible for all candidate presentations to our hiring managers.

To protect the interests of all parties, Dr. Squatch will not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate. Any unsolicited resumes sent to DRSQ, including unsolicited resumes sent to a DRSQ email address or mailing address, directly to DRSQ employees, or to DRSQ’s resume database will be considered property of Dr. Squatch.

DRSQ will not pay a placement, service or other fee for any placement resulting from the receipt of an unsolicited resume. This also includes partial resumes, LinkedIn profiles, general candidate profiles, and/or candidate details or information. DRSQ will consider any candidate for whom an Agency has submitted an unsolicited resume to have been referred by the Agency free of any charges or fees.

DRSQ’s Talent Acquisition team must provide advance written approval to an Agency to submit resumes and/or profiles for a specific job-opening, and the approval must be in conjunction with a valid fully executed staffing, placement or other service agreement. DRSQ will not pay a fee to any Agency that does not have a fully executed agreement in place prior to submission, receipt and placement of candidates.

jobs.title: H&M Sales Advisor (Seasonal) - Santa Fe Place
jobs.description:
About the Role

As a Sales Advisor, you'll be responsible for providing excellent customer service, welcoming & guiding customers through your store to actively sell our products and providing customers with support & guidance. You'll use your fashion and product knowledge to provide our customers with all the relevant information they need for the best experience. You'll also work on garment refill & care, presentation and contribute to a clean and tidy sales floor and back of house, working closely with the rest of your store team to deliver an excellent customer experience.

A Day in the Life

Working at H&M means no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will include the following responsibilities*

Customer Sales & Profit

• Provide excellent customer service: welcoming & guiding customers through the store & OMNI experience where available, supporting them with direct customer service
• Willingness to engage and have conversations with customers to provide excellent service
• Guide customers through our fashion trends, stories & products in all areas of the store
• Ability to effectively promote and sell our products to customers
• Actively promote our Customer Loyalty App (Hello Member) & in-store sustainability initiatives
• Representing yourself and the H&M brand positively during all customer interactions
• Support with commercial or operational actions to reach sales targets with store management team

General Information

Fashion & Trend Awareness

• Keep up-to-date with fashion scene, trends, tendencies, styles, brands, products, competitors, and relevant influencers, etc.
• Use your product & fashion knowledge to share relevant information to customers

Team & Development

• Retain and share your service, fashion and store operations knowledge and skills with colleagues
• Follow all procedures, routines, and legal requirements in all areas of the store
• Give & receive feedback with your colleagues to learn, develop & support each other
• Participate in relevant available Onboarding, introduction processes & trainings and courses relevant for your role & future development

Retail Operations/ Visual & Commercial Execution

• Complete full garment cycle from unpacking and refill to steaming and ensure good garment care
• Operate fitting room and checkout areas according to best practice & processes
• Contribute to a clean and tidy sales floor and back of house (including stockrooms)
• Support with garment presentation, execution and maintain attractive merchandise displays, clear trends & stories according to visual & commercial guidelines
• Ensure good stock levels with replenishment routines on sales floor
• Upkeep & follow best practice for any in-store OMNI Services & in-store tech services/tools, etc (Instore Care App, Click & Collect, Smart Store etc)
• Support with opening and closing of the store
• Following all H&S guidelines and legal requirements applicable to role and responsibilities

Who You Are

• As a Sales Advisor, you'll be passionate about fashion and everything we create in-store.
• Motivated by giving customers a great experience.
• You should also be communicative, creative and curious, motivated, flexible, decisive, and action-oriented.
• You should also enjoy working in a collaborative and dynamic environment.
• You have sales experience working in a dynamic and collaborative environment that you can apply to your role
• Experience working with customer service in fashion, retail or other service-related industries

Why You'll Love Working at H&M

• We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability
• We pride ourselves on being a values-driven organization, guided by our 7 unique values that have been part of our success story for over 75 years
• You'll have access to our Colleague Resource Groups (CRGs) to find community and networking opportunities among colleagues
• We are an inclusive company where you're encouraged to be yourself at work
• You will have access to a large global talent community, where career growth and aspirations have no limits
• We believe in supporting your overall wellbeing and offer comprehensive benefits inclusive of health insurance, wellness and family support programs, company match retirement plan, paid leave programs, and paid time off, including a community day to serve your local community
• You'll be able to express your personal style with our employee discount at H&M, & Other Stories, and COS

Job Status: Hourly, Non-Exempt

EEOC Code: SLS

Compensation: Sales Associates Pay Rate $16.00 per hour**

*This job posting highlights the most critical responsibilities and requirements of the job and is not all-inclusive. There may be additional duties, and responsibilities assigned for this job at the company's discretion.

**H&M, in good faith, has assessed this posted range of compensation as the accurate range for this role and location at the time of this posting. H&M may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range depending on candidate qualifications. This range may be modified in the future.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. If you require assistance or accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at https://hm.ethicspoint.com, and use Ask a Question.

Benefits:

We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Afound. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment type and countries.

Inclusion & Diversity:

H&M is a part of H&M Group. At H&M Group, we’re determined to create and maintain inclusive, diverse and equitable workplaces throughout our organization. Our teams should consist of a variety of people that share and combine their knowledge, experience and ideas. Having a diverse workforce leads to a positive impact on how we address challenges, on what we perceive possible and on how we choose to relate to our colleagues and customers all over the world. Hence, all diversity dimensions are considered in our recruitment process.

We strive to have a fair and equal process and therefore kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter in your application as they often contain information that easily can trigger unintentional biases.

Company Description:

H&M is a fashion brand that offers the latest styles and inspiration, from fashion pieces and unique designer collaborations to affordable wardrobe essentials. Our business idea is fashion & quality at the best price in a sustainable way. Learn more about H&M here.

H&M Fashion USA, Inc. – Maki Assessment Tool:

We use an online assessment tool called Maki for skills-based selection of applicants for sales advisor positions within some of our stores. Maki is not an automated decision-making tool. Rather, it is a tool that uses an AI-created avatar to present to you a set of multiple-choice questions. These questions are prepared by the H&M hiring team to assess candidates’ ability to perform the duties of the position for which they are applying. The assessment calculates your total score based on predefined point values provided by our H&M team. The hiring team will review your whole application, including your assessment score, to decide whether to advance each candidate to the next stage. Doing the assessment is optional. If you choose to complete the assessment, your score will be one factor that the hiring team considers.

If you have any difficulties or concerns with the online assessment method, you can request an alternative method of assessment by contacting recruitment_support@hm.com. Choosing an alternative method will not affect your chances of being considered for the position, nor does any assessment method provide an advantage or disadvantage in the selection process. You will have the opportunity to provide optional feedback immediately after the assessment and you may always ask questions.

When you take the assessment, we collect your responses and use this information to evaluate your suitability for the role to which you have applied. The answers are saved in your applicant profile. We do not sell the information captured in the questionnaire and do not use any personal information to train any AI models. Our applicant tracking system provider has access to this information but is contractually prohibited from using it for any other purpose.

During this process, we may collect information from you through cookies, with your consent. This may include details such as your electronic network activity information (IP address, timestamps, and device identifiers). This information is accessible to our hiring team but is otherwise kept confidential. For more information, please refer to our Cookie Notice.

We retain this information for 3 years in your applicant file and use it as set forth in our Applicant Privacy Notice. For more information on how your personal data is processed by us, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: AI Account Executive, Glass
jobs.description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Ramp is building the future of work with AI. We’re bringing a new class of AI-native products to market that can understand business context, make decisions, and increasingly execute work on behalf of customers.

We’re looking for an AI Account Executive to help build the commercial motion for this emerging portfolio. You’ll own the full sales cycle, from creating pipeline and shaping the customer’s problem through evaluation, close, and activation. You’ll work across Engineering, IT, Security, and Procurement to turn complex AI capabilities into clear business outcomes.

This is a founding seller role. You’ll help define the market, qualification criteria, sales process, messaging, and playbooks that the broader organization will use. The right person is both a closer and a builder: someone who can win important early customers, learn quickly from the field, and turn those lessons into a repeatable system. We’re hiring AI Account Executives at multiple levels. The scope of the role, title, and compensation will reflect your experience and demonstrated ability to lead complex sales cycles and build new commercial motions.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own the full sales cycle: Source, qualify, develop, and close net-new opportunities for Ramp’s AI products, with accountability for pipeline creation, revenue, and forecast accuracy.

 - Create demand in an emerging category: Help customers identify high-value AI use cases, connect technical capabilities to urgent business problems, and build conviction before a mature buying process exists.

 - Navigate complex buying groups. Multi-thread across Finance, Engineering, IT, Security, Procurement, and executive stakeholders to align technical requirements, economic value, and organizational priorities.

 - Build the business case: Quantify ROI, total cost of ownership, operational impact, and risk reduction to earn executive sponsorship and create urgency.

 - Lead rigorous evaluations: Partner with Solutions, Product, and Engineering to scope demonstrations, pilots, security reviews, and implementation plans that establish a credible path to production.

 - Shape the commercial narrative: Pressure-test positioning, discovery, pricing, objection handling, and competitive messaging through direct customer engagement.

 - Turn field learning into a playbook: Document repeatable qualification criteria, buyer patterns, use cases, proof points, and deal strategies that improve the performance of future sellers.

 - Influence the product roadmap: Build a tight feedback loop with Product and Engineering by clearly communicating what customers value, where deals stall, and which capabilities will unlock adoption.

 - Operate as a founding team member: Help establish the standards, culture, tooling, and operating cadence for Ramp’s AI sales organization.


WHAT YOU NEED

 - A track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets in complex B2B software sales, whether you’re an experienced AE ready for a new challenge or a seasoned enterprise seller looking to build something new.

 - Experience owning multi-stakeholder sales cycles from pipeline generation through close, ideally involving six-figure contracts or enterprise customers.

 - Demonstrated success selling a new product, emerging category, or technical solution without relying on a fully established playbook.

 - Strong discovery and business-case development skills, including the ability to quantify ROI, total cost of ownership, and measurable operational outcomes.

 - Technical fluency and intellectual curiosity: you can credibly discuss integrations, data flows, security, reliability, and AI capabilities with technical stakeholders without resorting to hand-waving.

 - Executive presence and the ability to communicate clearly with CFOs, CTOs, Finance leaders, Engineering teams, Procurement, and Security.

 - Strong pipeline discipline, forecasting judgment, and familiarity with structured sales methodologies such as MEDDICC, Command of the Message, or similar frameworks.

 - High agency and comfort operating in ambiguity. When the answer or playbook doesn’t exist, your instinct is to build it.




BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL)

 - Flexible PTO

 - Centralized home-office equipment ordering

 - Health and wellness stipend

 - Budget for intra-office travel

 - Weekly coffee stipend




UNITED STATES

 - 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

 - One Medical annual membership

 - 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

 - Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

 - Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

 - Pet insurance

 - In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

 - Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)
   
   


CANADA

 - Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

 - Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

 - Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)

 - Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)

 - Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay

 - Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health




UNITED KINGDOM

 - Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite

 - Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi

 - Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option

 - Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay




REFERRAL INSTRUCTIONS

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

 


OTHER NOTICES

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

 

Beware of recruiting scams: Ramp will only contact you through official @Ramp.com http://Ramp.com email addresses and will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.
